sngon 'groyigatapa/༄:8/ /de yang :ra btang 'jig rten 'di'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la tshe phrog gi rin thang bstsal te/ byamasabartsesabaskyed bsringasashing 'tshoba'i snum mdangasakyi mngar kha sbyin mkhan ni rlabasache ba'i ma yum gyi tshogasayin pa bshad mi dgosal/ bye brag tu 'dzam bu gling gi lo rgyusasteng ma yum gyi rigs la bsam blo ba dang / lugasaganyisal gzigasapa yangasapa'i mdzangasam dang / grub pa brnyesapa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ dgra bcom ma/ skye dgu yongasakyi yid dbang cig char phyogasapa'i mdzesam sogasa'agro ba mi spyi'i migadaper 'osapa yang du ma zhig byung myong ba nang bzhin/ rang re bod layang 'dasapa'i lo rgyusastengagadong dmar srin molirigasargyud lasachad pa'i mi molitshul can gyi rlabs chen ma brjod lasa'adasapa zhig byon myong ba'i dpe mtshon tsam brjod na/ btsan mo 'bro bza' khri ma lod lta bu'i srid 'dzin ma dang / mkhar chen bza' oṃ shesamatsho rgyalalta bu'i grub brnyesakyi rig 'dzin ma/ ma cig lab kyi sgron moltabu'i rnala'abyor ma dang / myang tsha dkar rgyan lta bu'i mo rusadang zhe ru can gyi mdzangasam sogasabarjod lasa'adasapa zhig byon myong bani lo rgyusabaden don gyisar sprod 'dug la/ de lasakyang bod kyi ma yum rnal 'byor ma sgor zhig ni nang bsam blolishes rig gi tshad ches mtho zhing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha'i gzhung lugasal thosabasam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa gnang ba'i 'bras rtagasasu sku tshe gcig gi yun la grub pa'i samathor gshegasatshul/ khong rnam pa rang rang gi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / phyi rabasagadul bya'i gsosasu bzhag pa yang dag tshad ma'i rgyab rten dang byin rlabs kyi drod stangasa'athul ba'i gsung rtsom bstan bcos
du ma bzhugasapasashesathub/ desan rang re phyi rabasabod kyi bu mo tshosam yum gong ma dag gi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / gsung zab zhal gdamasakyi skor yid bzhin nor bu lta bu rnams la thosabasam zab mos nges cha yod par byas nasadam pa de dag gi ya rabs tshul mthun/ spobasapa thod rgal/ dgongs spyod ngang bzang gi yon tan sogasal mig ltosanan gyisabyasate/ gangasacan bod kyi ma yum mdzangaphuma'i lugasardzol phul du byung ba'i rgyun zin par bya rgyu gtsor bzhag gi thog dusarabasadang 'tshamasashing dam pa'i lha chosadang 'jigarten mi chosakyi snying don dang ma 'gal ba zhig gi thog nas/ rjesarabsbod kyi ma bu mo tsho'i lasadabang la sgul shugasagatong thub pa'i phyogasal gom pa spo ba de 'u tsho'i phrag la bab pa'i 'os 'gan du ngos zin byed pa ni ches gal che ba'i rang bzhin zhig red 'dug snyam/ rgyu mtshan der brten 'dir rang re kha ba ri ba la bka' drin gzhan las lhag pa'i rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog gi zugs gter yongs kyi bdag mo/ ma tshogs mkha' 'groligatso mo dbyangs can me shes mtsho rgyal mchog slar yang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ gangs ri'i gdul zhing 'dir dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi molin ma par bzhengs pa'i bdag nyid chen mo/ gsang chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling gi sbyi dpal/ bka' drinagazhal med kyi rje btsun ma 75 med ye shesamatsho mo mchog gi zhabs rdul gtsug gi nor bur thob pa'i 'dus sde chen mo sku gsum mkha' 'groligling gi dge tshul ma skor zhig gis slob spyong gi bar gseng bed spyad de/ rang re bod la sngon byon grub mtha' risamed kyi skyesachen ma rnam pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gsung rtsom zhal gdams kyi skor bsdu rub phyogs bsgrigs/ yig gtags dpe bsdur sogs kyi bgyi ba dang du len mgo brtsams shing / rigs kyi me tog phog pa'i skyabs gcig rje btsun ma mamu med ye shes mtsho mo
mchog la dgongasazhu dang / 'dzam gling mkhasagrub yongasakyi gtso bo 'dren mchog (chasrje yid bzhin nor bu'i zugasasras bu chen gyi gtso bo mkhan chen 'chi med rig 'dzin sogs kyis zugs bkod kyi 'og nas (ar+ya tā re'i dpe tshogs /zhes nang don sngon byon gyi ma yum rlabasachen dag dang 'brel yod kyi dpe tshogs/ rnam pa deb phreng gi rang bzhin can par bskrun 'grem spel tsho chung zhig rtsa 'dzugadragabyas te/ gcig tu 'phags bod kyi sngon byon mkhas grub ma dag gi gsung rtsom 'jig rten gyi khyad nor lta bu'i dpe rgyun srung spel la ched du kha gtad pa dang / gnyisasu 'dzam gling gi klog mkhan sbyi dang lhag par du rang re bod kyi bu mo tshos/ pho mchog mo dman de dus rabasakyi lo rgyusatsam du bskyur zin pa'i gna' boligoms srol phyogs ris pa re zung dang / shed stobs sogs lus kyi grub cha re zung gi pho mo3khyad par tsam rgyu mtshan du byas te rang cag ni bud med do snyam nasarang mgo rang gis smad de mi sdod par/ tshe 'di'i don dang skye ba tshe rabs kyi las don gnyis po gang gi bya gzhag la 'jug rgyu'i dbang du btang yang /bsgrub bya'i mthun phyogasadang mi mthun phyogasal 'dor len yang dag pa shesathabasadang /dus kyi gnas babasadang bstun te phyi'i ya rabs kun spyod nas/ nang bsam blolishes rig dang 'brel yod kyi blo spobs/ nus stobasasogasaji ltar mthor 'degasasu gtong dgosamin gyi dpyadagazhi'am bslab gzhi kho na'i dmigasayul gtso bor bzung ste/ grub brnyesarig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nyisabargya tsam gyi rnam thar deb phreng rin thang che ba 'di/ gya che'i gzigasamakhan rnam par bsam pa bzang polilegasaskyes kyi tshul du/ si khron bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob 'tshol sgrig khang gtso bo yin pa'i 'di ka 'brel yod dpe skrun khang gi rgyab skyor mthun sbyor gyi 'og nas/ dpe phreng rin po che 'di nyid spyir 'jig rten la phan bde 'byung ba'i gsosasman dang / /sa gangs ljongasakyi don gnyer che ba'i klog
mkhanarnam par chesarin thang che ba'i legasaskyesashig gi tshul du par bskrun 'grem spel byasapa yin la/slad nasakyang mu nasamu ru skyesachen ma dang rlabasachen ma dag gi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / gsung rtsom tshad ldan gyi skor lag tu gang rnyed kyisagrub mtha'i phyogs risasogasamed par phyogasasgrig dang 'grem spel ci nus su byed rtsisayin mod/ 'on kyang 'di 'dra'i rin thang che ba'i rnam thar dang gsung rtsom skor zung spel gyi bya bar mos 'dun che ba tsam ma gtogs/ spyir nga tsho dpe sgrig tsho chung la mtshon na shesa'ajon gyi tshad gzhi dma' ba dang /khyad par du dpe rnying phyogs sgrig gi lasarigasa'adi la nyamasamyong zhan pas/ dpe tshogasa'adi nyid kyi phyi'i jusa'agod dang nang gi zhu dag sogs gang ci'i thad nasakyang /nor zhabrul shor yod pa dang 'thusasgo ma tshang ba mi ga ba zhig yod pa ni smosam dgosapa zhig yin/ de lasakhyad par du 'dasalog gi skor dang rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma mkha' 'gro ye shesamatsho rgyal gyi skyesarabasarnam thar rgyasapar bkod pa sogskyisamatshon nasadape dkon yig rnying phal che ba tshig don 'grel dka' ba dang ma yig mi gsal ba brda rnying dang skung yig mang ba/ sa cha re zung gi yul skad sor bzhag byas pa/sum rtagasadag gsum gyi dgongasadon ltar brisamed pa sogasamador na ma yig ma bor tsam las med pas tshig don gnyis char gyi phyogs la lhag chad mi nyung ba song yod pas/'dir nga tsho'i dbyings bzhugs ma yum mkha' 'gro'itshogs dang / rgya che'i klog mkhan dang dpyod ldan rnam par snying nasabazod gsol zhu ba dang chabs cig khyed rnam pas nga tsho'i bya bzhag 'di la dgongs 'char lhug stsol bcas/ phyogs so solim yum rlabs chen rnam pa'i rnam thar dang / gzhan 'brel yod kyi gsung rtsom mkho sprod kyi rgyab skyor gnang rgyur snying thag pa nasabaka' drin che zhu ba lags/zhesaglarung/ar+yatwatshorapetshogs/lcamanywagatshan4'a tshe rangaphyor+sāyogalo'izla4ches256khusaphul/
dkar chag1 byang m+mu semasam blo grosabazang mosaston pa la chosabargya don drisate de'i bsgrub par dam bcaphutshuladang bu mo desa'aphagasapa 'jam dpal la chosakyi dbyingasalasbrtsamasate drisalan mdzad tshul/ 1na klu'i bu mo bye ba phrag dgu bsartsadrugagisaston pa la ngo mtshar ba'i mchod sprin du masamachod cing de dag lung bstan pa'i skor/ 143 bu mo dpal phreng masaston pa'i mdun du yi dam chen po bgrabacasate smon lam bag cing grong khyer de'i bu mo lo bdun yan tshad theg pa r+sā po'ichosal bkod pa'i tshul/ 224 sangasargyasakyisabud med kyi skye ba lasalog ste skyesapar 'gyur ba'i rgyu brgyadagasungs shing bu mornam dag dad pa 'dor bu mo lnga brgya dang bcasapa rang rangs lusakyi rgyan cha thamasacad sangasargyasal mchod pa'i tshul/ 725 dge bsnyen mgangagā'i mchog cesabya bsaston pa lazab mo'oganasalugasalasbrtsamasate dri ba rgya cher mdzad rjesabu mo 'khor dang bcasapa rabasgyu byung nasalhag med du mya ngan lasa'adasapa'i tshul/ 906 bu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pa zhesabya bsashā ri'i bu sogasatheg pa chung ngu'i nyan thosadag lakhur+sāpa ma byasapar theg pa chen po'izab mo'ogatam gyi dri ba dri lan mdzad pa'i skor/ 987 rgyal pogasal rgyal gyi bu mo dri ma med kyi nyin [ zhesabya bsanyan thosabargyad
dang byang chub semasadapa' brgyad lazab mo'idon gyi dri ba mdzad pa la de dag ā(39 lha (ba pa'i m+mu dang sangasargyasakyi dru nga du phyi na lha lu nga ba sta na pa 1318 rgyal pogazugasacan snying po'ibatsun mo bde ldan ma zhesabya ba sangasargyasadang 'phrad nasalung bstan pa thob tshul/ 1709 li ts+tsha bī dri med gragasapa'i srasamo bu mo zla mchog cesabya bas nyan thosadang byang chub semasadapa'i tshogasarnamasal zab molichosakyi 'bel gtan mdzad cing sangasargyasal mchod pa du ma phul te lung bstan thob tshul/ 17510 lha mo chen mo dpal zhesabya bsamatshan gyi rnam grangasabargyad rtsabargyad kyi phan yon dang de'i rgyu rkyen bu mo de'i de bzhin gshegasapa du ma la bsnyen bkur byasapa'i tshul bstan pa/ 21211 skyesapa dang bud med mtha' dag bde ba'i thabasamakhasakyisa'adul bar mdzad pa'i byang chub semasadapa' bud med 'gyur ba zhesabya ba dang rab 'byor gnyisakyi zab molidon gyi dri ba dri lan mdzad cing bud med de sangs rgyas dang mjal naslung bstan brnyesatshul/ 22033gzhon nu nor bzang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems ma nyi shu'i rang rang gis swāhā/ ñtsha pa(rnyi(( ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grangs re re'i che ba dang de dag gi rgyu rkyen sogasabastan 12 rgyal po〉bu mo byamasam zhesabya bsagazhan nu nor bzang la rang gi khang bzang gi bkod pa'i mthong ba bstan pa dang shesarab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i rgyud kun nas rnam thar brgyan pa'iting nge 'dzin gyi phan yon dag gsungar+sāpa'i tshul/ 211
13 gzhan nu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshephuganyen dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba zhesabya bsabasod namasakyi mdzod mi da pa'i rgyan zhesabya ba'i yonartan mngon du brnyesapa'i tshul/ ji 27914 dge bsnyen ma migayo ba zhesabya ba'i rang gi sngon gyi skyeng rabasadangating nge 'dzin la bstenanasa'aphagasapa'i spyod yul zab mo dgagazhon nu nor bzang la bstan pa'isnor/ ji 29215 gzhon nu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshephuganyen dge slong ma seṅge rnam par bsgyingspa zhesabya bsa'akhor gyi tshogaphubasamagyisami khyab pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dpag tu med pa bstan nasabazhugasapa'i tshul/ 30516 g.yin nu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshephuganyen bcom pa ma lha'i bshephuganyen ma zhesbya bsachagasapa dang bral ba mthar phyin pa zhesabya ba sogasakyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyesapasachagasapa dang bral lam la 'god pa'i tshul/ ji 32117 gzhon nu nor bzangagi dge ba'i bshephuganyen sa'i lha mo brtan ma zhesabya bas〈'phrul du ma bstan cing sa'i gter kha du ma mngon du snang bar mdzad tshul/ 32918 gawo nu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshephugar+sā mag molilha mo dpyid dang ldan pa zhesabya bsarangs yonatan gyirnam grangasadu ma bstan cing de'i rgyu skye ba snga ma rnamasasu byang chub semasadapa'i lam la ji ltar bslabasatshul/ 33319 gawo nu nor bzangagi dge ba'i bshephuganyen mag mo'ilha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od cesabya bsabyang chub semasadapa'i spyong pa 'grub pa'i chosabacu dang rang gi che ba'i yonatan dag bstan tshul/ 3563
2༷ gzhonacanorabazang dge ba'i bshephugar+sā mag mo3lha mo rabasgyu dga' ba'i mig 'gro b.rarnam par snang ba zhesabya baphugazhon nu nor bzang larang gi sku lusakyi sprulaba'ibakod pa tshad med pa dag bstan cing yonatanade dgas rgyu skye bstan pa'iskor/ 36521 gzhon dunorabazang dge ba'i bshephuganyen man+da mo'ilha mo semasacan kunasgyu skyong ba'igazibarjed dpal zhesabya bsarangs yon tan gyi rnam grangasadapag tu med pa snang bar mdzad cing dedagasha rgyu rkyen bstanapa'i tshul/ 398
༄tsho/ /byang chub semasam blo grosabazang mos ston pa la chos bcu'i don dris te de'i bsgrub par dam bcas tshul dang bu mo des 'phags pa 'jam dpal la chosakyi dbyingasalasabartsamste drisalan mdzad tshul sogs bzhugs/mdo rjedakon mchogabartsegasapa'i le'u suyonapa lasabatus:rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya su ma ti dwa ri ka bṛts+tsha nā ma ma hā rdza na smu tra/ bod skad du/'phagasapa bu mo blo grosabazang mosazhusapa zhesabya ba theg pa chen polimado/ sangasargyas dang byang chub semasadapa' thamasacad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal polikhab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong stong nyisabargya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub semasadapa' khri'i byang chub semasadapa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabasacig tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen po na khyim bdag drag shul can gyi bu mo blo gros bzang mo zhes bya ba btsasanasalo brgyad lon pa 'dra ba/ gzugs bzang ba/ mdzesapa/ lta na sdug pa/kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa zhig 'dug pa de 'khor dang bcas pa bya rgod kyi phung poliri ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ༈ phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la
mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/gal te skabasaphye bdag gisani/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod gang zhu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /yid la ci 'dod thams cad ni/ /bu mo khyod kyis dri bar gyis/ /byang chub semasadapa'i spyod pa kun/ /ci 'dra khyod la bstan par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasal bu mo blo grosabazang mos tshigasasu bcad de gsol pa/ gang gis su ni mdzes par 'gyur/ /gang gisanor ni che ba dang / /mi phyed 'khor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /thub pas 'di ni bdag la gsungs/ /chosakyi rgyal polispyan sngar ni/ /gang gis rdzus te skye 'gyur zhing / /'dab ma stong ldan pad+ma la/ /mchis par yang ni gda' ba dang / /zhing rnams bye ba dpag yas par/ /sangs rgyas phyag bgyir mchi ba yi/ /rdzu 'phrul pha rol phyin 'gyur ba'i/ /spyod pa rgyal bas lung bstan gsol/ /dgra zla ma mchis gang gis 'gyur/ /tshig kyang btsun par 'gyur ba dang / /las kyi sgrib pa ma mchisadang / /bdud kyi las kun ma mchis dang / /'chi ba'i dus ni bgyid pa na/ /mngon sum sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /de lasachosakyang nyan pa dang / /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong mi 'gyur/ /de skad cesagasol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisabu mo blo grosabazang mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di dri bar sems pa legasaso legasaso/ /bu mo de'i phyir legasapar rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang ngas bshad do/ /bu mo blo gros bzang mos bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapaX chosabazhi dang ldan na mdzesapar 'gyur te/
bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tha na dgra la yang khro bar mi byed pa dang / byams pa la gnas pa dang / chosa'adod pa dang / de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku gzugasabyed du 'jug pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gnod pa'i rtsa ba khro ba 'phel mi byed/ /byams la gnas par byed dang chos 'dod dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byas na ni/ /mdzes par 'gyur te blta bar 'osapa yin/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chosabazhi dang ldan na nor che bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dus su sbyin pa dang / 'gyod pa med par sbyin pa dang / yid du 'ong ba sbyin pa dang / rnam par smin pa mi re bar sbyin pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na nor che bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ dusasu byin dang 'gyod pa med pa dang / /yid 'ong sbyin dang rnam smin mi re ba/ /dpa' bo rnams ni las 'di byas pas na/ /rtag tu longs spyod chen po thob pa yin/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na 'khor mi phyed par 'gyur te/bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phra ma'i tshig spangs pa dang / sems can 61ga par lta ba rnams yang dag pa'i lta ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'jog par byed pa dang /dam pa'i chos 'jig pa'i tshe dam pa'i chos srung ba dang / sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'jog par byed pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi po de dag dang ldan na 'khor mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ phra ma de bzhin log par lta ba spong / /dam chos 'jig pa'i tshe na srung ba byed/ /sems can byang chub yang dag 'dzin 'jug na/ /'khor rnams mi phyed phun sum tshogasapar 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tha/ du rin po che chen po〉pad+ma las rdzus te skye
bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phye ma'am/ me togam+mud pa la'am/ pad+ma 'am/ku mu da'am/ pad+ma dkar pos lag pa bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la 'bul ba dang / gzhan dag la yang gnod semasami skyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa byed du 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyasakyi byang chub la nges pa rgya cher mos pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thad du rin po che chen po'ipad+ma lasanusate skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ phye ma me tog bkang ste 'bul ba dang / /gnod semsspong zhing sku gzugasabyed pa dang / /mosapa rgya chen la ni gnasabyed na/ /rgyal ba dag gi thad du rdzus te skye/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na rdzu 'phrul gyis sangasargyas kyi zhing nasasangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzhan dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar chad mi byed pa dang / gzhan dag chos nyan pa la bar chad mi byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegasapa'i mchod rten dag la mar me 'bul ba dang / ting nge 'dzin sgom pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na ṭu'aphrul gyis sangasargyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyasakyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ dge ba dag gi bar chad mi byed dang / /gzhan gyi chosagatam dag la mi smod dang / /rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag la mar me 'bul/ /ting 'dzin bsgomasapas de ni zhing du 'gro/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na dgra zla med par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ g.yo med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag la sten pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba la ser sna mi byed pa dang / gzhan gyi rnyed pa la dga' ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bya ba dang stanas pa thams cad la khong khro bar mi byed
mdo 'i snod laphubanyunga'i byang chub semaphuma'irnam tharator/cing mi snyan pa mi zlogasapa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi po de dag dang ldan na dgra slo med par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ dge ba'i bshesaganyen rnamsla de g.yo med/ /gzhan gyi rnyed la dga' zhing ser sna med/ /byang chub semasadapa'i spyod la mi smod na/ /rtag tu dgra zla med par spyod par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na tshig btsun par 'gyurarta/ bzhigang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ji skad smraspa de bzhin byed pa dang mdza' bo dag la yod pa'i rang bzhin mi 'chab pa dang / klan ka mi tshol bar chos nyan pa dang / gzhan chos smra ba dag la dpya skur mi byed pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi po de dag dang ldan na tshig btsun par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa dang / /mdza' la yod pa'i rang bzhin mi 'chab cing / /klan ka mi tshol chosani nyan byed na/ /'jigasapa med cing tshig kyang btsun par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na lasakyi sgrib pa med par 'gyur zhing / yongs su dag pa yang myur du rtogasapar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bsgrubs pasasdom pa gsum yang dag par len pa dang / mdo sde zab mo rnams mi spong ba dang / sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la thamasacad mkhyen pa nyid du 'du shes skyed pa dang / sems can thamasacad la byamasapa sgom pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi po de dag dang ldan na lasakyi sgrib pa med par 'gyur zhing yongasasu dag pa yang myur du rtogasapar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pasasdom pa gsum la gnas/ /mdo sde zab mo rnams la rtag tu mos/ /sangs rgyas sras la thams cad mkhyen ltar lta/ /sems can rnams la byams pas las dag 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na bdud kyi las med par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ chos 5
thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sgom pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba ste/ bu mo byang chub semsdpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na bdud kyi las med par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ chosarnamasal ni chosakyi tshul rtogasal/ /brtson 'grus brtsamasashing sangsrgyas rjes su dran/ /yongs su bsngo zhing bshags dang phyag 'tshal ba/ /de la bdud kyis grags ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe mdun du sangs rgyas bzhugs shing de las chos kyang nyan la sdug bsngal yang myong bar mi 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzhan dag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogasapar byed pa dang / mos pa mang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa bkod pa sna tshogasanye bar sgrub pa dang / dkon mchog gsum mchod pa la brtson pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe mdun du sangs rgyasabazhugasashing de lasachosakyang nyan la sdug bsngal yang myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ de ni gzhan gyi bsam pa rdzogs byed cing / /mos pa dang ni sbyin pa rgya che ba/ /mkhasapa de ni rtag tu sbyin par byed/ /de phyir de mdun de bzhin gshegasapa bzhugs/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas bcom ldan 'das la bu mo blo gros bzang mos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'dasabyang chub semasadapa'i bslab pa ji skad bcas pa 'di dag la bdag gis bslab par 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gis bzhi pa bcu po ji skad du bka' stsal pa 'di dag las chos gcig cig ma spyad na yang bdag gis de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku bslusapar gyur cig de nas gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen pos bu mo blo gros bzang mo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' rnamaX kyi spyod pa ni nyamasa'og tu chud par dka'
na khyod 'di lta bu yang dag par len par byed na/ ci khyod kyisasemasal dbang thob bam/de skad cesasmras nas bu mo blo grosabazang mos tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la/'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gisabadag gisachosthamasacad yongasasu rdzogasapar byed par 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig desstong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te lha'i me tog gi char 'bab par gyur cig ma dkrol bar yang sil snyan gyi sgra 'byung bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bu mo blo gros bzang mos de ltar bden pa'i byin brlabs byasam thag tu de'i mod la stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khamasa'adi rnam pa drug tu g.yosate/ lha'i me rtag gi char bab par gyur cing / ma dkrol bar lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra yang byung bar gyur to/ /bston pa mod gal gyi bu bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ da ltar de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangadragargyas shākya thub pa ji lta ba de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bdag de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur zhing / sangasargyasakyi zhing der bdag la bdud kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang /ngan song rnams kyi ming yang med pa dang / bud med kyi skyon rnams med par 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i mig des/ 'khor 'di gser gyi kha dog can du gyur cig bu mo blo gros bzang mosatshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu de'i mod la thamasacad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de gser gyi kha dog can du gyurato/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po stan las langs te chos gosaphrag pa gcig tu bgosanas busamo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud stas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces
gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasabadag ni semasadang po bskyed pa nasabazung ste byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nasa'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bu mo blo gros bzang mo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /blo gros bzang mo khyod chos gang la gnasate bden pa'i byin gyi rlabasa'adi byas/ blo grosabazang mosasmrasapa/ 'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings ni gnas pa ma mchis pas de la gnas par mi nus te 'di la dri ba ma mchisaso/ /'jam dpal gyisasmrasapa/ blo grosabazang mo byang chub cesabya ba 'digang gi tshig bla dwagasayin/ blo grosabazang mos smrasapa/ 'jam dpal byang chub cesabagyi ba ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /'jam dpal gyis smrasapa/ blo gros bzang mo 'di ltar byang chub semasadapa' zhesabya ba 'di gang gi tshig bla dwagasayin/ blo gros bzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid gyi chosakyi tshig bla dwags so/ /'jam dpal gyisasmrasapa/ blo grosabazang mo ci de bzhin gshegasapa yang byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa mdzad dam/ blo grosbzang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal dper na smig rgyu dang brag cas byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegasapasakyang byang chub kyi phyir spyod do/ /'jam dpal gyissmras pa/ blo grosabazang mo khyod kyisaci lasabasamasate de skad cesasmras/ blo grosabazang mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di la chos 'ga' la yang bsam pa'am bsam pa ma lags pa ma mchisaso/ /'jam dpal gyisasmrasapa/ blo grosabazang mo bsam pa de lta bu yin du zin na byisapa thamasacad kyang byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /blo grosabazang mosasmrasapa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du dgongs/ byisapa rnamskyang gzhan la mkhas pa rnams kyang gzhan te byang chub kyang gzhan par de ltar gzigs sam/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ choXkyi dbyingasakyi tshul du 'di ni dbyingasagacig
pa lags te/ blang ba ma mchis shing dor ba ma mchis la sgro btags pa ma mchis so/ /'jam dpal gyis smrasapa/ blo gros bzang mo bshad pa 'di'i don shes pa ji snyed cig yod/ /blo grosabazang mosasmrasapa/ 'jam dpal bshad pa 'di'i don 'tshal ba ni sgyu ma sprul pa'i semasadang semasalasabyung ba ji snyed mchisapa de snyed do/ /'jam dpal gyissmrasapa/ blo grosabazang mo sprul pa nyid kyang med na de'i semasadang semasalasabyung ba lta ga la yod/ blo grosabazang mosasmras pa/ 'jam dpal chosakyi dbyingasani mchisapa yang ma lags/ ma mchisapa yang ma lagasate/ de bzhin gshegasapa yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar bu mo blo gros bzang mo 'di zab mo3bazod pa dang ldan pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smrasapa de bzhin te/ bu mo blo grosabazang mo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs nas bskal pa sum cu lon pa'i 'og tu gdod ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /khyod kyang bu mo blo grosabazang mo 'di nyid kyisami skye ba'i chosal zhugasapar byas so/ /de nas'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs te bu mo blo gros bzang mo la phyag byas nasatshig 'di skad du bdag gisaslob dpon yun ring mo zhig na mthong zhesakyang smrasaso/ /blo gros bzang mosasmrasapa/ 'jam dpal ma rtog shig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal gyisasmras pa/ ci'i phyir slob dpon gyis bud med kyi lus las da dung ma bsgyur/ blo gros bzang mosasmras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ni bud med do/ /'di ni skyes pa'o zhes bya ba de ni dmigs pa ste/ 'on kyang khyod kyi the tshom med par bya'o/ /bden pa ga) gis bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin
gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyas su 'gyur ba'i bden pa desabadag skyesapar gyur cig bu mo blo grosabazang mosatshig de skad cesasmrasam thag tu de'i mod la de'i bud med kyi dngos po mi snang bar gyur nas skyes par red de chos gos ngur smig gyon nas des 'di skad du bden pa gang gis bdag gis byang chub thob pa na dge slong tshur shog cesabyasapasarab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag gi sangasargyaskyi zhing der bdud kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ngan song gi ming yang med pa dang /bud med kyi skyon rnams kyang med par 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo sum cu lon pa'i spyod lam ci 'dra ba de lta bur gyur cig cesabyasaso/ /byang chub semasadapa' blo grosabazang posatshig 'di skad smrasam thag tu de'i mod la dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo sum cu lon pa'i spyod lam ci 'dra ba de lta bur gyur to/ /'jam dpal bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du semaphucan rnams kyi lus gser gyi kha dog lta bur 'gyur ba dang / bsam pas bza' ba dang btung ba 'grub par 'gyur te/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi longasaspyod dang / yongasasu spyod pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na ngan song gsum yongs su spangs par 'gyur ba dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ldon pa dang / rin po che'i dra bas yongs su bskor cing rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma dag gis rgyas la steng rin po che'i bla re bres te/ 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ci 'dra ba kho na dang mnyam zhing mi lhag pa de lta bur 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des 'khor 'di gser gyi kha dog can du gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang pos tshig de skaX smras ma thag tu de'i mod la thams cad dang
ldan pa'i 'khor de gser gyi kha dog can du gyur to/ /de nas sa bla'i lha rnams kyi lha'i lusakyisagacig nasaspru9ga tu sgra bsgragasashing skad kyisago bar byasate/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros bzang po byang chub thob pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing lha yon tan bkod pa ni de lta bur 'gyur ro zhes ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasakyisa'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal byang chub semasadapa' blo grosabazang po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasarig pa dang zhabasasu ldan pa/ bde bar gshegasapa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnamasakyi ston pa/ sangasargyasabacom ldan 'dasayon tan rin chen dpal gyi snying po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bka' stsal pa na/ phrog chags bye ba phrag sum cu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lasaphyir mi ldog pa nyid la yang dag par gnasapar gyur to/ /lha bye ba phrag brgyad cu ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go /srog chagaphubargya stong gisani ye shesamangon par rtogasapar gyur to/ /byang chub semasadapa'i theg pa pa'i dge slong byang chub kyi semasalas phyir mi ldog par 'dod pa lnga stong tsam yang byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang polilhag pa'i bsam pa rtogs shing dge ba'i rtsa ba'i che ba nyid mthong nas de dag rang rang gi bla gosabacom ldan 'daskyi sku la gsol te/ lhag pa'i bsam pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos nas tshig 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasdu pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur cig ces
smras so/ /dge slong de dag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos ma thag tu bskal pa dgu bcu'i 'khor ba bsnyil te bor nasabla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gnasapar gyur to/ /de dag thamasacad kyang bcom ldan 'dasakyisalung bstan te/ 'jam dpal dge slong 'di dag ni bskal pa bcu gnyis na bskal pa dri ma med pa'i 'od cesabya ba la de bzhin gshegs pa bzod par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can du bskal pa gcig la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i rgyan cesabya bar thamasacad ming mthun par 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de ltar na chosakyi rnam grangs 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnamasadang / nyan thos rnams la ṭu'aphrul chen po byed pa yin no/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo byang chub 'dod pa gang gis bskal pa stong gi bar du thabasamakhasapa dang ma bral bsapha rol tu phyin pa drug spyad la gang gisachos kyi rnam grangs 'di bris nas zla ba phyed kyi bar du lan re blags na bsod nams kyi phung po snga mas ni bsod nams kyi phung po 'di'i brgya'i char yang mi phod/ stong gi cha dang /brgya stong gi cha dang / bye ba brgya stong gi cha dang / grangasadang / bgrang ba dang / dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /'jam dpal de bas na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di khyod la gtad kyisakhyod 'dun par gyisal sngon gyi byang chub semasadapa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mdo 'di lta bu 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na zungs shig kun chub par gyis shig chongs shig shod cig ltogs lhag ston cig gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig 'jam dpal dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ji srid du gnas pa de srid du 12
rin po che sna bdun med par mi 'gyur la/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po shi na rin po che sna bdun med par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'di 'jig rten na ji srid du spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che sna bdun dang / byang chub kyi phyogasakyi chosakyi tshul thams cad med par mi 'gyur la/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'di med par gyur na dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de bas na mdo sde rin po che 'di lta bu 'di yi ger bri ba dang /lung 'bogasapa dang / bcang ba dang / bklag pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis brtson 'grus brtsam par bya'o/ /'di ni nga'i rjesasu bstan pa yin no/ /phyisa'agyod pa can du gyur ta re/'di ni rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo byang chub 'dod pa la ngas bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros bzang po dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcasapa'i 'jig rten yi rangasate/bcom ldan 'dasakyisagasungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen polichos kyi rnam grangasale'u stong phrag brgya pa lasabu mo blo grosabazang mosazhusapa'i le'u zhesabya ste sum napa rdzogasaso/ / / /13
༄tshi/ /klu'i bu mo bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gisaston pa la ngo mtshar ba'i mchod sprin du masamachod cing de dag lung bstan pa'i skor/mdo rje dkon mchog brtsegasapa'i le'ubadun pa lasabatus/de nas klu'i bu mo bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gis lha ma yin gyi dbang po de dag dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po de drag gi mchod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas mchog tu dga' ba chen po skyes te/ de dag dga' mgu yi rangs nas rab tu dga' lta/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur to/ /de dag gis rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs be+eḍūr+ya'i dra ba lda ldir bkye ba murtag dmar po'idra bas bskor ba/ gser gyi yu ba can/ be+eḍūr+ya'i thur ma brgya stong bkye ba/ rin po che'i chun po sbyangasapa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug mngon par sprul to/ /rta sngon po kha dog sngon po/ sngon po lta bur ston pa/ 'od sngon po 'grang ba/ rgyan sngon pos brgyan pa/ be+eḍūr+ya'i srab kyis bsrabs pa/ bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug mngon par sprul to/ /nor bu skar mdog gi bla re kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad drug cu yod la/ des'khor de dag thamasacad yog pa cig kyang steng gi bar snang la mngon par sprul to/ /de la rin po che sna bdun gyi lda ldi bkra ba mig tu mdzes pa lta na sdug pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug bres par mngon par sprul to/ /bla re de'i kho ra khor yug tu rin po che sna bdun gyi dril bu g.yer spru'i dra ba mngon par sprul te bres so/ /rin po che sna bdun gyi khrung khrung rkang dag mngon par sprul to/ /klu'i rol ༈ phrul snyan bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug mngon
par sprul to/ /de nasaklu'i bu mo de dag rta sngon po de dag la zhon nas rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugasasteng gi bar snang la bres te/ nam mkha' las 'dong zhing rol mo'isgra bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug po de dag dkrol cing / bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor ba cibyed la lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor/ lha'i a ga ru dang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / ud pa la'i phye ma dang / me tog sna tshogs kyang bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor/ me toga.ud pa la dang / tsam pa sga'i phreng ba dag kyang 'thor/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dag kyang 'thor/ spros sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dag kyang 'bul te/ lha ma yin gyisaji ltar byas pa de bzhin du mchod pa rgya cher byasaso/ /de nas de dag gis rol mo sil snyan bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug po de dag byas pa'i sgras stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang bar gyur te/sems can gang dag gis rol mo3sgra de thos pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /nor bu skar mdog gi bla re dag dang / rin poche sna bdun gyi lda ldi de dag dang / dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba de dag dang / khrung khrung rkang de dag rlung gis bskyod pa las 'di lta ste/ dper na rol mo sil snyan yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa mkhas pas dkrol ba de lta bur snyan la de lta bur yid du 'ong zhing mnyan na bde ba'i sgra byung bar gyur to/ /sgra des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khamasargyasapar gang bar gyur te/ sems can gang gis rgyan gyi sgra de dag thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lasaphyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas klu'i bu mo de dag gis me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char dang / spos chu rnam pa / snags kyi char mngon par phab par gyur te/
me tog gi char de bab pa'i tshe spos kyi dri zhim polingad byung ste/ 'gro zhing ldog go /spos chu'i char de bab pas kyang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po'ikho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad drug cu tshun chad spos chu'i rdzab tu gyur te/ spos kyi dri des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i'ajig rten gyi khamasargyas par gang bar gyur to/ /sems can gang gis spos kyi dri de tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lasaphyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas klu'i bu mo de dag gis gdugs bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug dang / rta bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug dang / rol mo sil snyan bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa de dag bar snang gi nam mkha' la 'khod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogasagacig tu 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smrasaso/ /klu yi bu mo mkhasapa de dag yi rangs dga' mgu yid kyis su/ /byang chub zhi ba tshol zhing shākya thub la der ni mchod pa chen po byas/ /rgyan gyis legs brgyan bye ba dgu bcu drug gi gdugs rnams mngon sprul te/ /bde bar gshegs pa mchod cing rab tu dul ba'i yid kyisachagasadang bral/ /rgyan gyis legasabargyan bye ba dgu bcu drug gi rta rnams mngon sprul te/ /kha dog sngo zhing rgyan yang sngo ba'i rta la rgyal mtshan sngon pos brgyan/ /de dag thams cad bar snang dong nas thub la rta yisamachod pa byed/ /klu yi bu mo de dag dang ba'i yid kyis thub la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mchog la mchod pa'i don du klu yi gnas nas klu yi sil snyan gyis/ /mchod pa'i 'os gyur 'dren pa shākya thub la der ni mchod pa byas/ /sil snyan de dag bde bar gshegs la mchod pa'i sgra de khams gsum 16
grags/ /sgra de thosapa'i semasacan khrag khrig dag ni byang chub yang dag zhugs/ /de dag rnams kyis der sprul mkha' la bla re chen po gcig tu gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i dpag tshad drug cur rgyas shing 'gro ba thams cad khebs par gyur/ /nor bu rin chen skar ma'i mdog gi gzi brjed phyogs su 'bar zhing gsal/ /klu yi bu mo dga' nas 'gro ba'i don du rgyal la mchod pa byas/ /gzhal du med pa'i semasabaskyed dga' nas byang chub zhi ba tshol byed cing / /'jig rten don byed bde gshegasasangasargyas 'jig rten mkhas pa grub par shog /ji ltar stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni sems can sdug bsngal 'grol ba ltar/ /chos kyang bstan te sems can nyon mongs sdug bsngal bsgribs pa khrag khrig dgrol/ /chos rnams sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra zhing dbu ba lta bur nyam chung la/ /char rgyun chu la phog pa'i chu bur lta bur 'jig cing bdag po med/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan 'dra bar 'gro ba thamasacad brtagasanasani/ /'gro ba dag la chosakyi rang bzhin yang dag de nyid bstan par bgyi/ /sgyu ma bkod pa lta bur ma mchis brdzun pa byis pa rmongs bgyid pa/ /skye bo mi mkhas ji bzhin ma 'tshal ba dag ma rung rab bgyid pa/ /byis pa rmongs bgyid chos rnams sdig med khyod kyis de ltar legs par gzigs/ /de dag ji ltar gzigs pa de bzhin de dag sems can rnams la bstan/ /ji ltar sa chen 'di la sprin 'khrigasagyur na ri ltar gda' ba yang / /yang dag tu na ri ltar ngo bo nyid kyis de la gnas ma mchis/ /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin ma mchis dbang po rmongs par bgyid/ /shes pas brtags nas skye bo mkhas pa dag ni rmongs par 'gyur ma mchis/ /yang dag tu na 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin ma mchis khyod ston pas/ /des na 'dren pa rgyal ba khyod la skye bo mkhas pa mi phyed 'gyur/ /khyod kyi sras rnams chos kyis yongs su tshim nas rdzab la zam pa 'dra/ /'di ni byis pa'i skye boliyul min 'gro ba 'di ni sgra phyir 17
'brang / /de lta lagasapasasdig med yang dag ston pa byisapa'i skye bolimagon/ /skyabs dang dpung gnyen gnasadang rten dang rtsa lag khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /gzhal yas byang chub de btsal slad du rnam par 'dren pa khyod la mchod/ /sangs rgyas gyur nas rtogs bgyid sdig bral 'jig rten don rnamasabagyid par shog /de nas bcom ldan 'dasakyisklu'i bu mo de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugasasu chud nasa'adzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ /'jig rten na ni 'jig rten mkhas pa rnam par 'dren mchog khyod 'dzum mdzad/ /dpal sdug 'dzum pa mdzad la rgyu ma mchisapa bdag gisayongasam mthong mi yi dbang po dam pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu ni yang dag gsungs/ /de thos lha mi lha min tshogasadang klu yi bu mogasang ba pa/ /dri za rnamasakyang skyob pa'i dgongasapa thosanasayid ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten dag na 'jig rten rnam 'dren khyod kyis rgyu rnams thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal bas chos gang rgyu dang rnam pas mkhyen par ma gyur yong ma mchis/ /de ltasabade gshegasargyal ba khyod kyisaji ltar thugs chud 'dzum rgyu gsungs/ /de thos nasani 'gro ba thamasacad yi rangasadogs pa chad par 'gyur/ /thub pa bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa mchog la don kyang thob par mchi/ /'khor rnams 'di dag don myong gyur nasayid ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog dbang du mi 'gyur byang chub yid kyisargyal ba'i spyod nyan 'gyur/ /bde gshegasakhyod kyi 'dzum mdzad don thosarang 'byung nyid du ngesapar 'byung / /'khor 'di rgyal ba khyod kyi zhal nasa'adzum mthong the tshom 'tshal gyurarta/ /sdug bsngal dogasabacasayid mi bde zhing chosal som nyi gang 'tshal ba/ /de dag la ni thub pa ston pas dogs bsal the tshom dgum du gsol/ /drang srong khyod kyis gang slad 'dzum bstan myur du bka' stsal the tshom khum/ /rgyal ba gang gisade ring yid ni 18
rnam par sbyangs shing bdud bcom thul/ /su zhig yid rab tshim nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dam pa bgyis/ /'di ni su yi mthu lags ston pa 'gro ba'i mdun du 'di bka' stsol/ /thos nas bdag cag yi rangs mchog tu dga' ba skyes nas bde bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi zhabasakyi drung du 'dusapa'i 'gro ba 'di dag the tshom 'tshal/ /'dzum rgyu dga' ba skyed pa bka' stsol thub pa the tshom bsal du gsol/ /de thos lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag the tshom ma mchisa'agyur/ /rgyal ba'i gsung sgra yang dag thosanasade dag yid dga' 'gyur/ /de nasabacom ldan 'das kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul legasasorgyal ba'i dgongasapa 'dzum pa 'dini legasapar dris/ /klu yi bu mos mchod tshe 'jig rten phan phyir ngas ni 'dzum pa bstan/ /de yi 'bras bu bstan gyisayid gnyisatha ba spangasapa'i semasakyisanyon/ /gang gi don du ngas ni 'dzum pa 'dir mdzad nga yi tshig la nyon/ /klu yi bu mo 'di dag chags med yid kyisabyang chub yang dag zhugs/ /'gro ba thams cad stong par rnam bshig blo ldan dogs med legs par gnas/ /'di na byed med tshor med gang zag med cing skye ba po yang med/ /chos rnams 'di dag rdzun zhing smig rgyu mtshungs la me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'di dag rnams kyisamachod byasabyasagazo blo grosayang dag ngasashesate/ /rgyal ba'i chosanyid dang ni 'gro ba stong zhing bdag po med mthong legs/ /mchod pa rnam par phye zhing legs par bkod pa 'di dag sgyu ma 'dra/ /byang chub gzhal yas gang du smon lam btab pa de yang 'di 'drar stong / /nga la gzhal yasamachod pa de byasapa dang 'gro ba stong shes pas/ /klu las shi 'phos nas ni lha gnas brgya byin gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gsum song ste lha yi nang du dga' bar tshe rdzogs/pa/ /ma smad grags dang ldan pa'i lha gnas
'thab bral gnasasu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'thab bral lha nang gnas te lha yi gnas su lha yi dga' ba spyod/ /lhar gyur bde gshegs sras rnams de ni tshe yi tshad du gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams 'thab bral dga' ba spyad nas tshe tshad zad pa dang / /dga' ldan gnasasu lha yi grong khyer lha dang brtul zhugar+sā'adra bar 'gyur/ /de dag de na lha yi bu mosabaskor nas lha yi dga' ba spyod/ /pad ma chus mi chags pa bzhin du bde gshegs mi gnas blo can gnas/ /'gro ba thams cad stong par rtogs rig blo las nyams par yong mi 'gyur/ /skyob pa rnams kyi dran pa rdo la brkos pa bzhin du yong mi nyams/ /de dag dga' ldan gnas der gnas te lha yi dga' ba spyod nas ni/ /tshe tshad yongs su zad nas de tshe rab 'phrul dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bde gshegs ma smad grags ldan der yang lha mo3tshogs kyis mchod 'gyur te/ /mi gnas blo gros ldan pa tshe tshad bar du gnasan gnasapar 'gyur/ /de dag gnas der rab 'phrul gyur te lha yi dga' ba spyad nasani/ /mkhas pa tshe zad blo grosaldan pa chosakyi mthar ni phyin gyur nas/ /'dren pa bsam pa dag pa chags med yid ldan chos kyi bsam pa can/ /chos dang ldan rnams gzhan 'phrul gnas su lha 'du bar ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de dag lha gnasade na gnasashing lha yi dga' ba spyod par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs ma rmongasablo ldan de dag rang gi tshe tshad gnas par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das ltar lha yi 'dod pa'i yon tan mnyam nyid zhi bar rtogs/ /bsam gtan bsam pas tshangs gnas ma smad grags dang ldan par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su bsam gtan mkhas shing bsam gtan 'brasabu spyad gyur nas/ /der gnas dpe med gyur cing byang chub yid kyis bskal par gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag bskal par tshangs gnas mthun par ye shes don gnyer brtul zhugs bzang / /thub pa mkhas 20
pa thabs mkhas de dag 'jig rten don ni mtha' yas byed/ /mkhas thub de dag de na bsam gtan spyod yul bsam gtan chags pa med/ /bsam gtan bde ba mnyam nyid 'drar rig byang chub phyir ni dbang po zhi/ /kun tu grolayid drang srong byang chub phyir ni byang chub blo dang ldan/ /mya ngan 'das pa lta bur bsam gtan blo gcig zhi ba'i mtshan nyid 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs dang bcom ldan sras po byang chub zhi ba yongs tshol ba/ /tshangs pa'i yid ldan 'jig rten don byed de dag tshangs gnas de na gnas/ /kun kyang tshangs pa'i blo ldan mthar phyin sha stag byang chub don gyi phyir/ /rang 'byung dgongs pa khams gsum lam las 'das pa'i nges par 'byung ba ston/ /tshangs pa la ni gus pa bskyed nasa'agro ba byang chub tshol bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i bsam pa rang byung bsam pa ngesa'abyung mthar thug shesanasani/ /bde bar gshegasakyi bstan pa mchog la brtson pa de dag 'gro ba la/ /ci nasachosatshul 'brasabu myur du shesa'agyur de ltar chosakyang ston/ /de dag tshangs gnas de na gnas shing 'jig rten dag la byang chub phyir/ /phan pa byas nas srog chags bye ba khrag khrig mang po byang chub bkod/ /rgyal ba kun la mchod phyir 'jig rten khamasamang khrag khrig 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dbang po zhi ba de dag bskal pa skar ma 'dra la rgyal bar 'gyur/ /lha dang mi dang klu dang 'dab bzang dag dang lha min bcas pa dang / /dri za grul bum mi'am ci tshogs gnod sbyin 'gror bcasadaga' zhing mgu/ /bcom ldan sbyodas kyis byang chub lha niyangs sbyangs chosakyis stobs rnyed dhī/ /two dag d+dhi/sna swāhā snro ((pa/lha /zlo ba bar gshegasal mgasaphyag 'tshal/ /klu bu lung 21
༄tsho/ /bu mo dpal phreng masatshon pa'i mdun byā yi dam r+sā po bcu bos te smon lam btab cang grong khyer de' bu mo lo bdun yan chad theg pa chen poyichosal bkod pa'i tshul/mdo rje dkon mchogabartsegasapa'i le'u bzhi bsazhebargyad pa lasabaltas/'di skad bdag gisathosapa dusagacig na/ bcom ldan 'dasamanyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nasde'i tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / btsun mo dam pa btsun mo phreng ldan mas lha mo dpal phreng chos rtogasanasaring po ma lon pa'i bar skabs su gtam gleng pa/rgyal po chen po kye ma khyod kyi srasamo lha mo dpal phreng ni mdzangasashing gsal la zab cing mkhasate/ gal te desabacom ldan 'dasamathong ba lta na tshegasachung ngusachosartogasal/bcom ldan 'dasakyisachosabastan pa la yang the tshom ma mchisapar 'gyur ro/ /de nasayul ko sala'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyisabatsun mo phreng ldan ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /phreng ldan ma 'u bu cag gis lha mo dpal phreng la pho nya nus pa zhig gtang gor ma chag go /de skad ces smras pa dang / btsun mo phreng ldan masargyal po gsal rgyal gyi tshig de mnyan nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / btsun mo phreng ldan mas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan gyi bsngags pa rnam pa du ma bris te/ nang kor ma yid brtan pa zla ba lta bu zhesabya ba de'i lag tu 'phrin yig bskur nasade mthar gyisasong ste/grong khyer 'thab med du phyin nas btsun moXkhor du song ste/ lha mo dpal phreng la phyag
shāshā rnyi sna sna phan tshun kun dga' ba'i gtam byas te lha mo dpal phreng gi lag tu 'phrin de nasalha mo dpal phreng gisapha ma la gusapasa'aphrin yig de lag pa gnyisakyisblangasanasamago la gtugasate bdag nyid kyisa'aphrin yig bklags nas/ 'phrin yig gi don bzang ngo zhesangesapar bzung ste/ don du ngesapar bzung nasamago gcogasate ya mtshan du bzung nasalha mo dpal phreng gis nang kor ma zla ba lta bu la tshigasasu bcad pa 'di dag smrasaso/ /sangasargyasazhesabya'i sgra 'di ni/ /'jig rten dag na shin tu dkon/ /gal te tshig 'di bden gyur na/ /bdag gisakhyod la bgo ba sbyin/ /gal te bcom ldan sangasargyas de/ /'jig rten don du byung gyur na/ /de ni bdag la thugasarje yis/ /bstan pa'i ched du 'dir phyon cig /denasadeyisnad cig la/ /mgon pogashegasanasamakha' labazhugs/ /bsam gyisami khyab sangasargyasasku/ /'od zer 'gyed cing bzhugasapa mthong / /de nasade tshe lha mo ni/ /gusapasa'akhor bcas langasanasakyang / /sgyi bor thal mo sbyar byasanas/ /smra ba'i mchog la bstod pa ni/ /mgon po khyod kyi 5 gzugs dang / /dpal dpe gang na'ang yod ma mchis/ /bsam yasadape zla ma mchis pa'i/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po khyod kyi sku gzugasadang / /ye shesal yang bsam mchis/ /khyod kyi sangs rgyas chos mi bas/ /de bas thub khyod skyabs kyang lags/ /bsam yas rtsal ldan khyod kyis ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi skyon rnams bsal/ /nyams ma mchis pa'i sa brnyesapa/ /chosargyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ shesabya thamasacad khyod kyis mkhyen/ /ye shes sku yi dbang phyug ste/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhal yas khyod la phyag )tshal lo/ /dpe las 'das la phyag 'tshal
'o/ /bsam yas chosakhyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yasagazugasakhyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni da ltar mgon pos bskyabs/ /byang chub sa bon rnam par bskyed/ /slan chad srid pa gzhan dag tu/ /thub pas bdag la phan gdags mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ /sngon tshe rnamasasu lha mo khyod/ /ngasani byang chub sbyor ba byas/ /phyiskyang tshe rabs gzhan dag tu/ /ngas ni rjes su gzung bar bya/ /lha mo dpal phreng gis gsol pa/ /bdag gisa'adi dngagazhan dgatu/ /bsod namasagang dngagang bgyisapa/ /bsod namasade yisamagon po khyod/ /rtag tu bdag gisamathong bar shog de nasalha mo dpal phreng dang lhan cig tu btsun mo kun dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhagaphul gtugasaso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dus pa'i nang du lha mo dpal phreng bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te/ lha mo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la yang dag pa'i yon tan dag gis mngon par bstod pa'i bsod nams bsagasapa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'disalha mo khyod bskal pa tshad med grangasamed par lha dang mi'i rgyal srid phun sum tshogs pa myong bar 'gyur te/ tshe rabs thams cad du yang nga mthong ba dang bral bar mi 'gyur zhing nga la mngon sum du 'di lta bu'i bstod pa bsngagasapasabasngagasapar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med grangs med pa dag la yang mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /da phyin chad bskal pa brgya stong phrag grangs med pa nyi shu na khyod de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ de'i tshe yang lha mo khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing der ngan song dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe sems can rnams kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la 24
gnas par 'gyur te/ sems can de dag la nad kyang med rga ba yang med/ yid du mi 'ong ba'i gnod pa yang med de/ mi dge ba'i las kyi lam rnamasakyi ming yang mi gragspar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems can gang dag 'byung ba de dag gis ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnamasakyang 'di ltar bde ba dang / gzugasadang / kha dog dang / dpal dang / gzi brjid dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / longasaspyod thamasacad kyisazil gyisanon par 'gyur te/ semasacan de dag shin tu bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems can gang dag 'byung ba de dag thamasacad kyang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugasapar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba dag byas pa'i sems can rnams de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing der 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /de nasalha mo dpal phreng gi lung bstan pa kun sum tshogspa thos nas lha dang mi dpag tu med pa dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar smon lam btab bo/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams der skye bar bcom ldan 'dasakyisalung bstan to/ /de nas lha mo dpal phreng gis bcom ldan 'das las mngon sum du bdag nyid lung bstan pa thosanasathal mo sbyar te yi dam chen po bcu yang dag par blangasaso/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das da slan chad bdag gidragatshul khrims kyi dus las 'da' ba'i sems bskyed par mi bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam dang po 'di ni byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das da slan chad bdag gis bla ma dag la ma gus pa'i sems bskyed par mi bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das yi dam gnyis pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bco/ ldan 'das da slan chad bdag gis gang du
yang sems can la khro ba dang / gnod semasakyi semasabaskyed par mi bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'dasayi dam gsum pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'dasad slan chad bdag gisagazhan gyi dpal dang / gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa dag la phrag dog gi sems bskyed par mi bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das yi dam bzhi pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar zug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'dasad slan chad bdagagisatha na kham slad ma tsam la yang ser sna'i semasabaskyed par mi bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam lnga pa 'di yang byang chub kyi lhang polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'dasad slan chad bdagagisabadag nyid kyisalongasaspyod pa'i slad du nor yongs su gzung bar mi bgyi ste/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das sems can dbul po sdug bsngal zhing mgon ma mchisapa yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du yongs su gzung bar 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam drug pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gisayang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'dasad slan chad bdag gisabasdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can rnams la phan 'dogasapas na bdag la sman du re ba'i slad du sems can bsdu bar mi bgyi ste/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das zang zing ma mchis pa'i semasadang / chog par mi 'dzin pa dang ldog pa ma mchis par semasacan yang dag par bsdu bar 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'dasayi dam bdun pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das da slan chad bdag gis sems can mgon ma mchis pa dang / go rar stsal ba dang bcings pa dang nad kyisanyam thag pa dang sdiX bsngal ba dang / dbul po dang phongs par
gyur pa dang / tshegs chen pos 'tsho ba dag mthong na/ de dag la sman ma btags par gom pa gcig kyang dor bar mi bgyi'i/ bcom ldan 'dasabadag gisasems can sdug bsngal gyisanyam thag pa de dag mthong na sdug bsngal de dang de dag lasayongs su thar bar bgyis la nor gyi bsdu bas bsgrubs nas slad kyis bdag mchi bar bgyis te/bcom ldan 'dasayi dam brgyad pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das da slan chad bdag gis phag 'tshong dang / bya ba la sogs pa sdig pa'i las kyis 'tsho zhing de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa'i chos 'dul ba las nyams pa'i chos can dag mthong na yal bar mi dor gyi/ bcom ldan 'dasagrong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul gabor dang /rgyal polipho brang 'khor gang dang gang dag na bdag gis mchid nyan pa de dang de dag tu tshar dgum pa'i rigs pa rnams la ni tshar dgum/ sman gdags pa'i rigs pa rnams la ni sman gdags par 'tshal la/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dadragatshar dgum pa dang / sman gdags pas ni 'jig rten du dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba'i slad du ste/ dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas na lha dang mi rnams kyi lus rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur zhing ngan song rnams yongs su 'grib par 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes su skor bar bgyid pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam dgu pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du bdag gisayang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'dasad slan chad bdag gis dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung ba las bskyud par bgyi ba'i semasagacig tsam yang bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos gzung ba las bskyud na theg pa chen po bskyud par 27
'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das theg pa chen po bskyud na pha rol tu phyin pa bskyud par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa bskud na theg pa chen po las mi 'dun par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub semasadapa' sems dpa' chen po gang theg pa chen po lasam ngesapa de ni dam pa'i chosayongs su 'dzin pa la mi 'dun par 'gyur zhing rang nyam du gnas par 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de ni byis pa so so3skye bolisar mchi ba'i skal ba can du 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gis nyes dmigs dang / gnod pa chen por mthong lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa las ni bdag dang ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phan yon dpag tu ma mchis pa'i don yongs su grub par mthong ste/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i yi dam bcu pa 'di yang byang chub kyi snying polimathar thug gi bar du bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi yi dam chen po bsgrupo 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan sngar blangasapa lags te/ 'di la chosakyi rje nyid bdag gi dbang du gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasaston pa mngon sum du gyur du lags kyang sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu la la dag kye ma yi dam chen po bcu po 'di dag ni lcogs par dka'o snyam du bdag la the tshom za'am/ yid gnyis 'tshal ba de dag ni bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis yun ring por gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang phung bar 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de dag nyid la sman gdags pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs 'di bgyi bar 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis yi dam chen po bcu po gang dag blangs pa'i yi dam chen po bcu po 'di dag la bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag ji /da smras pa de bzhin du bgyid par 'gyur ba
lta na/ bcom ldan 'dasabadag gi bden pa'i tshig 'disa'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir lha'i me tog gi char 'bab par gyur cig lha'i sgra grag par gyur cig dedragakyang bdag gi bden pa'i byin gyi rlabasa'adi len par gyur cig lha mo dpal phreng gis tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu de'i tshe lha'i me tog gi char chen po bab nas bar snang las lha'i sgra grag par gyur te/ des bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs de mnos nas lha mo de de bzhin no/ /ji ltar khyod kyisabaden pa'i byin gyis rlabs byas pa de ni de bzhin du 'gyur te gzhan du ma yin no zhes byasaso/ /de nasarmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul de yang mthong / lha'i sgra mnos pa de yang thosanasathamasacad dang ldan pa'i 'khor the tshom med cing mchog tu dga' bar gyur te/ lha mo dpal phreng dang mi 'bral zhing 'grogs par smon lam btab bo/ /'khor de thams cad kyang de bzhin du 'bral bar mi 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan to/ /de nas lha mo dpal phreng gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar smon lam chen po gsum btab bo/ /gsum gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bden pa'i byin gyis rlabadraga'adis semadragacan dpag tu ma mchis pa dag la sman btags pa gang lags pa'i bsod nams bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bcom ldan 'das bdag tshe rabs thams cad du dam pa'i chos rtogs pa thob par gyur cig bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi smon lam chen po dang po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dam pa'i chos rtogs pa de thob nas kyang ngal ba dang yongs su skyo ba ma mchis par sems can rnams la chos ston par gyur cig bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi smon lam chen po gnyisapa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasabadag gisadam pa'i chosabastan pa de yang lus dang srog la mi lta bar dam pa'i chos bsrung ༵ dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung bar
'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi smon lam chen po gsum pa lags te/bcom ldan 'das bdag ni smon lam chen po gsum po de dag 'debs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dpal phreng gi smon lam chen po yul che ba gsum po 'di dag lung ston pa mdzad de/ lha mo 'di lta ste dper na gzugasasu gtogasapa thams cad ni nam mkha'i khams kyi khongasasu 'dusashing khongasasu gtogasal khong du chud do/ /lha mo de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag kyang smon lam chen po 'di gsum gyi khongs su 'dus shing khongs su gtogs la khong du chud de/smon lam chen po gsum po de dag ni de ltar yul che'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo dpal phreng gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la smon lam chen poliyul bstan pa gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bdag gis spobs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo khyod la de bzhin gshegs pas gnang gis khyod spobs par gyis shig de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo dpal phreng gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasabyang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gang dag lags pa de dag thams cad kyang 'di ltar dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i smon lam chen po gcig gi khongs su 'dusashing khong du chud de/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa ni de ltar yul che ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dpal phreng la legasaso zhesabya ba byin te/ lha mo legasaso legasaso/ /lha mo khyod ni shes rab zab pa ste/ thabasakyis yongs su bsgos pa'i shes rab dang ldan no/ /lha mo sems can gang dag khyod kyis chos bstan pa'i don rtogs pa de dag ni dkon pa yin te/ yun ring po nas sangasargyasadu ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed bskyed pa yin no/ /lha mo khyod kyisadam 30
pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba bstan pa ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang dam pa'i chos yongasasugazung ba bstan pa de nyid bshad do/ /'chad do/ /'chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo nga yang da ltar mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob nas dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba bstan pa rnam pa du mar ston te/ lha mo de ltar dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba bstan pa ngas rnam pa du mar bshad kyang dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i yon tan rnamadragakyi mtha' 'am mi thug pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegasapa'i spobs pa la yang mtha' 'am mi thug pa med do/ /lha mo dam pa'i chosayongs su 'dzin pa ni de ltar don che'o/ /lha mo dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa ni de ltar phan yon che'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo dpal phreng gisa'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus don chen po bstan pa gzhan yang bdag gis spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo da de'i dus la bab par shes na khyod spobs par gyis shig de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas bcom ldan 'dasal lha mo dpal phrengagisa'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasdam pa'i chosayongs su 'dzin pa ni sangasargyas kyi chos dpag tu ma mchis pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni chosakyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong sdud pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasadaper na 'chags pa'i dusakyi che'i sprin chen polini kha dog mtha' yasapa'i rgyun dang / rin po che mtha' yas pa'i rgyun dang ldan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa yang bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa'i chab kyi rgyun dpag tu ma mchis pa dang / ye shes rin po che'i rgyun dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ldan pa lags so/ /31
bcom ldan 'das dper na 'chags pa'i dus kyi tshe chab kyi phung po chen po stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khamasakyi skye gnas de las ni gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / dbyibs sna tshogs pa 'byung zhing / 'khor gling phran bye ba brgya phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi chab kyi phung po chen po de las 'byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa theg pa chen po yang dag par 'grub pa'i 'byung khungs dang / skye gnas su gyur pa de las byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad dang / chos snang ba'i sgo rnam pa sna tshogs dang / 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug thams cad dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba lha dang mi rnams kyis sngon ma myong ba gang lags pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'dasadaper na phuchen po ni khur chen po bzhi'i rten bgyid pa lagasate/bzhi po de dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ chab kyi phung po chen po rgya mtsho dang / ri mang po thams cad dang gnas pa dang / rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / me tog dang / nags tshal thams cad dang / sems can gyi tshogs thams cad kyi rten bgyid de/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar sa chen po khur chen po bzhi po 'di dag gi rten bgyid pa de bzhin du/bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni sa chen po bas kyang ches khur chen po bzhi khyer ba lags so/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/rigs kyi bu'am rigasakyi bu mo sems can dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral zhing thos pa dang mi ldan la chos can ma lags pa rnams lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par bgyid pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dag la sbyor ba ni sa chen po bas kyang ches khur chen po khyer ba lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu m+b+ya sems can kha cig nyan thos kyi theg pa la
spyor bar bgyid pa ni sa chen po bas kyang chesakhur chen po khyer ba lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo sems can kha cig rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la sbyor bar bgyid pa ni phuchen po bsakyang chesakhur chen po khyer ba lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigasakyi bu mo semasacan kha cig theg pa chen po la sbyor bar bgyid pa ni sa chen po bas kyang ches khur chen po khyer ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bzhi po de dag ni khur chen po lags so| |bcom ldan 'dasarigasakyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dam pa'i chos yongasasu 'dzin pa ni khur chen po 'di bzhi khyer ba lags te/ sa chen po bas kyang ches rten du gyur pa dang / sachen po bsakyang chesakhur chen po khyer ba dang / khur mtha' yasapa khyer ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi gzhi rten du gyur pa dang / byams pa bgyis pa dang snying rje can dang / sman par 'tshal ba dang snying brtse ba dang / chos kyis 'jig rten gyi ma zhesabagyi ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper na sa chen po ni rin po che sna bzhi'i 'byung gnas lags te/ sna bzhi po de dag gang zhe na/ rin po che rin thang ma mchis pa dag gi 'byung gnas dang / rin po che rin thang mchis pa dag gi 'byung gnas dang / rin po che de bas chung ba dag gi 'byung gnas dang / rin po che de bas kyang chung ba dag gi 'byung gnas lags te bcom ldan 'das ji ltar sa chen po rin po che sna bzhi po 'di dag gi 'byung gnas su gyur pa de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa la brten nas sems can rnams kyis rin po che'i mchog chen po rin po che thamasacad kyi dam par gyur pa bzhi'i khe rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na dge ba'i bshes gnyen rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la brten nas sems can rnams kyis lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par bgyid pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogasakyi khe rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos kyi theg par nye bar 33
'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thob par bgyi ba rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg par nye bar 'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thob par bgyi ba rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasasu nye bar 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs ches mthon po thob par bgyi ba rnyed par 'gyur ba ste/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa la brten nas sems can rnams kyis rin po che thams cad kyi mchog ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rin po che chen po bzhi'i khe rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'dasagater chen po rin po che mtha' yasapa'i 'byung gnasazhes bgyi ba de ni dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa'i tshig bla dgasalagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa zhesabagyi ba ni bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chosakyang gzhan ma lags la/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa po yang gzhan ma lagasate/ bcom ldan 'dasadam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa po nyid dam pa'i chos lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyang gzhan ma lags dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa po yang gzhan ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa nyid pha rol tu phyin pa rnamasalags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rigasakyi bu'am rigasakyi bu mo dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa ni semasacan gang dag sbyin pas yongs su smin par bgyi ba de dag ni sbyin pas yongs su smin par bgyid de/ tha na lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag yongs su gtong bas kyang yongasasu smin par bgyid de/ de ltar yongs su smin par bgyisapa rnams dam pa'i chos la gnasapar 'gyur ba 'di ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasasems can gang dag tshul khrimasakyi/4 yongasasu smin par bgyi ba'i semasacan de
dag ni dbang po drug bsnams pa dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las yongs su dag pasayongs su smin par bgyid de/ tha na spyod lam gyis kyang de dag gi semasabasrung zhing yongs su smin par bgyid de/ de dag de lta de ltar yongs su smin par bgyis pas dam pa'i chos la gnas par 'gyur ba 'di ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasasems can gang dag bzod pas yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i sems can de dag la ni de dag gis de la spyos brgyad de gtse bar bgyis kyang gnod semasam mchisashing sman par 'tshal ba dang / bzod pa'i stobasadam pa dang ldan pas yongs su smin par bgyid de/ tha na bzhin gyi mdangs kyis kyang de dag gi sems srung zhing yongs su smin par bgyid de/ de dag yongasasu smin par bgyis pas dam pa'i chosal gnasapar 'gyur ba 'di ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag brtson 'grus kyis yongasasu smin par bgyi ba'i sems can de dag ni sems ma zhum zhing le lo ma mchis pa dang / 'dun pa chen po dang brtson 'grus rtsom pa mchog dang ldan pasayongs su smin par bgyid de/ tha na rang gi spyod lam bsgrims pas kyang de dag gi sems srung zhing yongs su smin par bgyid de/ de dag de ltar yongs su smin par bgyis pas dam pa'i chos la gnas par 'gyur ba 'di ni de'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag bsam gtan gyis yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i sems can de dag ni sems mi g.yeng ba dang / yid phyi rol du mi rgyu ba dang /dran pa 'khrul pa ma mchis pa mchog dang ldan pas yongs su smin par bgyid de/ tha na bgyis nas yun ring du lags pa dang / smras nas yun ring du lags pa mi bskyud pas kyang de dag gi sems srung zhing yongs su smin par bgyid de/ de dag de ltar yongs su 35
smin par bgyisapasadam pa'i chosal gnas par 'gyur ba 'di ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag shes rab kyis yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i sems can de dag ni sems can gyi don 'dri ba dag la le lo ma mchis par lung ston pa dang / bstan bcosathamasacad dang / rig pa dang bzoyignas thams cad kyi mthar phyin pas yongs su smin par bgyid de/ tha na bzo grwa'i gnas chen po dag tu yang de dag gi sems srung zhing yongs su smin par bgyid de/ de dag de ltar yongasasu smin par bgyisapasadam pa'i chos la gnas par 'gyur ba 'di ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas pha rol tu phyin pa rnamasakyang gzhan ma lagasal/ dam pa'i chosayongs su 'dzin pa po yang gzhan ma lagasate/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa po nyid pha rol tu phyin pa rnams lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus don chen po bstan pa gzhan yang bdag gisaspobs so/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo de bzhin gshegasapas gnang gi khyod kyis spobs par gyis shig de nas bcom ldan 'dasal lha mo dpal phreng gisa'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa po dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa po zhes bgyi ba ni bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa yang gzhan ma lags la/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa po yang gzhan ma lags te/bcom ldan 'dasadam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa po nyid dam pa'i chos yongasasu 'dzin pa lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa des ni bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chosayongs su gzung ba'i slad du yan lag gsum yongs su gtong bar 'gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na/36
mdo rje'i snod laphubasnyagapa'i byang chusasemaphuma'irnayothar skor/'di ltar lusadang srog dang longs spyod rnams te/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo lus yongasasu gtong bsani sangs rgyas kyi sku 'khor ba'i phyi ma'i mtha'i mu dang mnyam pa rga bdang / na ba dang 'chi ba dang bral ba mi shigasapa/ rtag pa/ brtan pa/zhi ba/ zer zug pa/ 'chi 'pho dang bral ba/ mtha' yasapa/ yon tan bsam gyisami khyab pa dang ldan pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'dasarigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo srog yongasasu gtong bsani sangs rgyasakyi chosarnam par 'phrul par gnasapa 'khor ba'i phyi ma'i mtha'i mu dang mnyam pa 'chi 'pho dang bral ba/ mtha' yas pa rtag pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo longs spyod yongs su gtong bas ni sems can thamasacad kyisamachod pa 'khor ba'i phyi ma'i mtha'i mu dang mnyam pa semasacan thams cad dang thun mong ma lags pa/ bas par mi 'gyur ba/ rnam par rtog pa ma mchis pa/rtag par rgyun mi 'chad cing rtag tu gnas pa/ yon tan bsam gyisami khyab pa dang ldan pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa yan lag gsum po 'di dag yongs su gtong bas ni yon tan shin tu rmad du byung ba gsum po de dag thob par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang lung ston par mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das rigasakyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig dam pa'i chos rnam par 'jig pa'i tshe dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma rnamsbye zhing gnyis su gyur la sde sder chad de/ phyogs phyogs su gyes nas rtsod par gyur pa na g.yo ma mchis shing gya gyu ma mchis la sgyu ma mchis par chosal dga' zhing dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i slad du chos can ñtsha rtogs la 'jug par bgyid na bcom ldan
'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu 57 de zhugs pa nyid kyis sangs rgyadragathams cad lasalung bstan pa ngesapar thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni de ltar brtson 'grus chen po lags pa snyam bdag bgyid de/ 'di la bcom ldan 'das nyid spyan du gyur pa lags te/ ye shes su gyur pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das ni mnga' bdag lags/ bcom ldan 'das ni ston pa lags so/ /de nasabacom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dpal phreng gis dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa bstan pa la rjes su yi rangs ba mdzad de/ lha mo de de bzhin te/ lha mo dam pa'i chog yongasasu 'dzin pa ni brtson 'gruphuchen po yin no/ /lha mo dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas gnad du mi drag par bsnun du zin kyang snad par 'gyur zhing nad bskyed par byed do/ /lha mo de bzhin du dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa ni chung du zin kyang bdud sdig can la gnod par 'gyur zhing mya ngan bskyed la smre sngags 'don par byed do/ /lha mo ngas ni bdud sdig can la dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ji ltar gnod par 'gyur zhing mya ngan bskyed la smre sngags 'don par byed pa de ltar gnod par 'gyur ba dang / de ltar mya ngan bskyed pa dang de ltar smre sngagasa'adon par byed pa'i dge ba'i chosagazhan gcig kyang ma mthong ngo / /lha mo dper na ba lang gi mchog khyu mchog gis ni 'di ltar 'phang mtho ba dang chu zheng gis ba lang gi tshogs thams cad zil gyis mnan te mngon par brdzid cing yang dag par mngon par brdzid do/ /lha mo de bzhin du theg pa chen po pa'i dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa yang chung du zin kyang 'di ltar rgyas pa dang / rgya chen por gyur pas nyan 'os dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyi dge ba'i chos thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ /lha mo dper na ri'i rgyal po ri 38
rab kyisani 'di ltar mtho ba dang / rgya che bsari nag po thamasacad zil gyisaganon cing mngon par lhag ger 'dug go /lha mo de bzhin du theg pa chen po pa'i lusadang srog la mi lta zhing / phan gdags pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa yang 'di ltar rgyas pa dang rgya chen por gyur pas theg pa chen po pa theg pa la gsar du zhugasapa lusadang srog la lta ba rnamasakyi dge ba'i chosathams cad zil gyisaganon na gzhan dag gi lta ci smosate/ lha mo de bsan semasacan rnamasadam pa'i chosayongs su gsang ba nyid yang dag par 'dzin du gzhug par bya/ yang dag par bstan par bya/ yang dag par gzengs bstod par bya/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar bya/ gzud par bya dgod par bya'o/ /lha mo dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa ni de ltar don che'o/ /de ltar 'bras bu che'o/ /de ltar phan yon che'o/ /lha mo gal te bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med par dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i yon tan dang phan yon ngas bshad du zin kyang lha mo dam pa'i chos yongasasu 'dzin pa'i yon tan dang / phan yon bshad pa de dag gi mtha' 'am mur thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /lha mo dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni de ltar yon tan mtha' yas pa dang ldan no/ /lha mo dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba sangs rgyasathams cad kyis bzhed pa ngas bstan pa de da khyod kyis bshad pa spobs par gyis shig de nas lha mo dpal phreng gisabacom ldan 'das la legs so zhesagasol nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bskul ba mnos te/ bcom ldan 'dasal 'di skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasadam pa'i chos zhes bgyi ba de ni theg pa chen politshig bla dwagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i dge ba'i chos thams cad ni theg pa chen posarab tu phye 39
ba'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'adi lta ste dper na klung chen po bzhi ni mtsho ma drosapa lasa'abyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du nyan thosadang rang sangasargyasathamasacad dang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten lasa'adas pa'i dge ba'i chosathams cad kyang theg pa chen po las 'byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dper na sa bon gyi rnam pa gang ci yang lags pa dag dang / nadang shing gel pa dang sman dang / nags tshal de dag thams cad ni sa chen po la rten cing sa chen po la gnas te skye zhing 'phel la rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gang lags pa dag dang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i dge ba'i chosagang lagasapa de dag thams cad ni theg pa chen po la rten cing theg pa chen po la gnas te skye zhing 'phel la rgyasapar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas theg pa chen po la gnas shing theg pa chen po yongs su bzung na nyan thosadang rang sangasargyasakyi theg pa thamasacad dang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i chos thams cad kyang rten cing gnas te yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dam pa'i chosaganas pa dang / dam pa'i chosanub pa dang / so sor thar pa dang / 'dul ba dang / rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogasapaganasadrug po 'di dag dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisabastan cing btags pa gang lags pa'i gnas drug po de dag kyang theg pa chen polidagongs pa lasabyung ba lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos gnas pa zhes bgyi ba'i btags pa 'di ni theg pa chen polidagongs pa can lags te/ bcom ldan 'das theg pa chen po gnas pa nyid ni dam pa'i chos gnas pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ṭ+wāṃ zhes bgyi ba'i btags pa 'di ni theg pa
