chen polidagongasapa can lagasate/ bcom ldan 'dasatheg pa chen po nub pa nyid ni dam pa'i chos nub pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das so sor thar pa dang 'dul ba zhesabagyi ba'i chosa'adi gnyisani don gcig ste/ yi ge'i 'bru ni tha dad lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'adul ba zhesabagyi ba 'di ni theg pa chen po pa rnamasakyi bslab pa lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasa'adi ltar de bzhin gshegasapa nyid kyi slad du rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogasapa lagasapa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'dasade lta lags pas 'di ltar 'dul ba zhes bgyi ba dang rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bgyi ba'i btagasapa 'di ni theg pa chen policho ga'i tshul khrims kyi phung po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogasapa ma mchisaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ nyan thosadang rang sangs rgyas ñtsha slad du rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa t+na ma mchis kyi/bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegasapa nyid kyi slad du nyan thosarnamasadang / rang sangsrgyasarnamasarabasgyu 'byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogasapa lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang de bzhin gshegasapa nyid la skyabasasu mchi ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'dasadagra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangasargyas rnamasakyang 'jigs pa dang bcas pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa rnamasadang / rang sangs rgyasarnamasakyang 'du byed thams cad la mi bzad par 'jigs pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas pa lags pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper na gshed mas ral gri gzas pa bzhin te/bcom ldan 'das de lta lagasapasade dag kyang nges par 'byung ba shin tu bde ba thob pa ma lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ skyabs su gyur pa ni skyabasagazhan 41
tshol ba ma mchisapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar semasacan skyabasam mchispa rnams gang dang gang gis 'jigs skrag pa'i 'jigs skrag pa de dang de las 'byung ba tshol ba de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang 'jigs pa de mchis te/ 'jigs pa des skrags pas dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi bar khas len pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasadagra bcom pa rnamasadang / rang sangasargyasarnamskyang 'jigs pa dang bcas pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang skye ba'i chos kyi lhag ma dang bcas pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gi skye ba ma bas pa yang mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'dasade dag ni bsten par bgyi ba'i lhag ma dang bcasapa lagasate/ desan de dag ni dag pa ma lags/ lasamathar phyin pa ma lagasate de dag gi bgyi ba mang lagasaso/ /de dag gi spang bar bgyi ba'i chos gzhan yang mang du mchis te/ de dag ma spangs pas dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings dang ring ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan lasa'adas pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa brnyes pas yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa lags la/ bcom ldan 'dasadagra bcom pa rnamasadang / rang sangasargyas rnamasani yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs lags te/de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das n+d+ra pazhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag
par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasarnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa brnyes pas yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa lags la/ bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa rnams dang /rang sangasargyasarnamasani yon tan bsam gyisami khyab pa dang ldan pa ma lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs lags te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyasarnams ni mya ngan lasa'adasapa brnyesapasaspang bar bgyi ba'i skyon thams cad spangasashing mchog tu yongssu dag pa dang ldan pa lags la/ bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyasarnams ni skyon gyi lhag ma rnams dang bcas pa/ yongs su ma dag pa'i chos can lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs lags te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni mya ngan lasa'adosapa brnyesapa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pasadagra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings dang ring ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasadagra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnamasakyis rnam par grol ba la so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi mtha' dbugs phyin pa rjes su dran pa bzhi po gang lags pa de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das dgongs pa can dang / lhag ma dang bcas pa dang / drang ba'i don dang rnam par phye ste lung bstan par bgyi ba lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'chi 'pho ni 'di gnyis lags te/ gnyisagang zhe na/rgyun chad pa'i 'chi 'pho dang / yongs su /rdzus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho
lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasade la rgyun chad pa'i 'chi 'pho ni nying mtshamasasbyor ba dang bcas pa'i sems can rnams kyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su bsngos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ni dgra bcom pa rnamasadang / rang sangasargyasarnamsdang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbang thob pa dang / yid kyi lus rnamasalagasate/ byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasade la 'chi 'pho 'di gnyis lasargyun chad pa'i 'chi 'pholidabang du bgyisate/ bdag gi skye ba zad do snyam du dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes pa 'byung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar lhag ma dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bgyis pa la brten nas bdag gis tshangs par spyod pa bsten to snyam du dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangasargyas rnamasakyi shesapa 'byung lags so/ /phyisapa so so3skye bo dang lha dang mi bgyi ba dang bcas pa thams cad dang / slob pa bdun po dag gis nying mtshams sbyor ba dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams spang ba sngon ma bgyisapa de spangspa la brten nasabya ba byasaso snyam du dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyasarnamskyi shedragapa 'byung lagadragaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'adi lta bu nyid lasagazhan mi shesaso zhesabagyi ba ni dgra bcom pasaspang bar bgyi ba'i nyon mongasapa rnamasadang / yang srid par nying mtshamasaspyor ba'i dbang du bgyis nas 'di lta bu nyid las gzhan mi shes so snyam du dgra bcom pa rnams dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes pa 'byung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu nyid las gzhan mi shes so snyam pa'i shes pa de yang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa yang ma lags/ skye ba thamathagacad yongs su 'tshal ba las byung ba yang ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dgra ༷༷ma pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyasarnams
la yang nyon mongs pa rnamasam spangs pa dang / skye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams yongs su ma 'tshal ba yang mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa dag ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gnas kyi sa'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang / kun nas ldang ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das gnas kyi sa yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di ltar lta ba gcig la gnas pa'i gnas kyi sa dang / 'dod pa'i 'dod chags la gnas pa'i gnas kyi sa dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags la gnas pa'i gnas kyi sa dang / srid pa'i 'dod chagasal gnasapa'i gnasakyi saste/ bcom ldan 'dasaganas kyi sa bzhi po de dag gis nyon mongs pa kun nas ldang ba thams cad skyed lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang skad cig pa ste/ sems kyi skad cig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasam rig pa'i gnasakyi sa thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas mchis pa ni sems dang mi ldan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gnas kyi sa bzhi po 'di dag gi nang na stobs che ba gang lags pa de ni nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa stobs che ba'i grangs sam/ cha'am/ bgrang ba'am/ dpe'am/ rgyur yang mi bzod lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar na ma rig pa'i gnasakyi sani stobasache ba lagasate/ srid pa'i 'dod chags la gnasapa'i sa zhes kyang bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper na bdud sdig can ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i nang du gtogs kyang 'di ltar gzugs dang / kha dog dang / gzi brdzid dang /stobs dang / 'khor dang / dbang phyug gis gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams zil gyisaganon to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa srid pa'i 'dod chags la gnas pa'i gnas kyi sa zhes bgyi bas lha gnas kyi sa bzhi po 'di dag zil gyis
gnon te/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma lasa'adas pa snyed kyi rten du gyur pa dang / nyon mongasapa bzhi dang yang yun ring po nas lhan cig gnas pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyasakyi shesapas mi rdzi ba dang / de bzhin gshegasapa'i byang chub kyi ye shes kyis gzhom par bgyi ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ni stobs che ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper na len pa'i rkyen gyis zag pa dang bcas pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i srid pa gsum 'byung ba de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa'i rkyen gyis zag pa ma mchis pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang thob pa rnams kyi yid kyi lus gsum 'byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ni sa gsum po 'di dag tu yid kyi lus gsum po 'di dag 'byung ba dang /zag pa ma mchis pa'i las mngon par sgrub pa'i rten lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasarkyen mchis na rkyen 'byung ste/ de lta lags pas ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ni yid kyi lus gsum po rnams dang / zag pa ma mchis pa'i las kyi rkyen lags pa'i slad du srid pa'i 'dod chagasal gnasapa'i gnas kyi sa dang ming 'dra ba lagasaso/ /de lta lags kyang srid pa'i 'dod chags la gnas pa'i gnas kyi sa dang las thun mong ba ni ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ni gnas kyi sa bzhi po dag las tha dad pa kho na lags te/ yongs su grol ba'i sa pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sasaspang bar bgyi ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shesakyi sagazhom par bgyi ba lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasadagra bcom pa rnams dang /rang sangasargyasarnams kyi sa ni gnas kyi sa bzhi spangasakyang zag pa zad pa la dbang ba'i stobs kyang mi 'thob/ mngon sum du yang mi bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das zag pa zad 46
pa zhes bgyi ba de ni ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa'i tshig bla dgas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasade lta lags pas dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / srid pa tha ma par gtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sas bsgribs shing chod la yongs su dkris te ldongs par bgyis pas chos de dang de dag rab tu ma 'tshal cing mi rtogs so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos de dang de dag ma 'chal cing ma mthong bsaspang bar bgyi ba'i chos de dang de dag mi spongs shing byang bar mi bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das spang bar bgyi ba'i chos de dag ma spangs shing byang bar ma bgyis pas bcom ldan 'das de dag skyon las rnam par grol ba lhag ma dang bcas pa lags kyi/ skyon thams cad las rnam par grol ba ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de dag ni rnam par dag pa lhag ma dang bcas pa'i chos can lags kyi/ thams cad rnam par dag pa'i chosacan ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasade dag ni lhag ma dang bcaspa'i yon tan dang ldan pa lagasakyi/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag skyon las rnam par grol ba lhag ma dang bcas pa lags kyi/skyon thams cad las rnam par grol ba ni ma lags pa dang / rnam par dag pa lhag ma dang bcas pa'i chos can lags kyi/ thamasacad rnam par dag pa'i chosacan ni ma lagasapa dang / lhag ma dang bcasapa'i yon tan dang ldan pa lags kyi/ yon tan thamasacad dang ldan pa ni ma lags pa de dag ni bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal yongs su 'tshal ba lhag ma dang bcas pa lags so/ /kun 'byung ba spangs pa lhag ma dang bcas pa lags so/ /sdug bsngal 'gog pa mngon sum du bgyis pa lhag ma dang bcas pa lags so/ /sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam bsgoms pa lhag ma dang bcas pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag sdug bsngal yongs su 'tshal ba lhag ma dang bcas pa dang / sdug 47
bsngal kun 'byung ba spangs pa lhag ma dang bcas pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa mngon sum du bgyis pa lhag ma dang bcas pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam bsgoms pa lhag ma dang bcas pa de dag ni bcom ldan 'das de'i yan lag gi mya ngan lasa'adasapa dang / de'i yan lag gi mya ngan lasa'adasapa thob pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das de dag ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su zhugs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su 'tshal ba dang /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba thams cad spangs pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa thams cad mngon sum du bgyis pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam thams cad bsgoms pa gang lags pa de dag ni/ bcom ldan 'das mi rtag pas bcom zhing rtag tu na ba'i 'jig rten du rtag pa dang / zhi ba dang bsil ba'i dngos po3mya ngan las 'das pa thob ste/ bcom ldan 'dasade dag ni skyob pa ma mchis pa dang / skyabs ma mchis pa'i 'jig rten na/ 'jig rten gyi skyob pa dang / skyabs lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'dasabazang ngan du 'byed pa'i chosacan dag ni mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa ma lags kyi/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes mnyam pa dag gis mya ngan las 'das pa thob/bcom ldan 'das rnam par grol ba mnyam pa dag gis mya ngan las 'das pa thob/bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag pa'i ye shes gzigs pa mnyam pa dag gis mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyingasani ro gcig ste/ 'di ltar rig pa dang rnam par grol ba'i ror ro mtshungs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la dag ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ma spangs shing byang bar ma bgyis pa de dag ni bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su ro gcig pa ma lags te/ 'di ltar rig pa dang rnam par grol bar ro mtshungs pa ma 48
lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnasakyi sa ma spangs shing ma sbyangs pas ni spang bar bgyi ba'i chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed ma spangs shing ma sbyangs pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das spang bar bgyi ba'i chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed de dag ma sbangs shing ma sbyangs pas chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed ma thob cing mngon sum du ma bgyis par gyur pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ni sgom pas spang bar bgyi ba'i nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i 'byung gnas lagasate/ bcom ldan 'dasade lasani semasakyi nye ba'i nyon mongasapa dang / zhi gnas kyi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / lhag mthong gi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / bsam gtan gyi nye ba'i nyon mongasapa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi nye ba'i nyon mongasapa dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang /shesapa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / 'bras bu'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / rtogasapa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / stobs kyi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / mi 'jigs pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa yang 'byung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shes kyis gzhom par bgyi ba de dag thams cad kyang ma rig pa'i gnas s+t+ya sa r+yaṃ sa 'byung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa ni nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang /kun nasaldang ba thamasacad kyi rgyu dang / gzhi dang / rkyen lags so/ /bcom ldan 'daskun nas ldang ba gang lags pa de dag ni skad cig pa ste/ sems kyi skad cig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa lags so/ /bcom lda/ 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa thog ma ma
mchis pa'i dus nas mchis pa ni sems dang mi ldan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das spang bar bgyi ba'i chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shes kyis gzhom zhing spang bar bgyi ba'i chos de dag thams cad kyi gzhi dang rten ni 'di ltar ma rig pa'i gnasakyi salags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper na phubon gyi rnam pa gang ci lags pa dag dang / cadang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal de dag thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das sa la brten cing sa la gnas te skye zhing 'phel la rgyas par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasas chen po tshig cing zhig la mi rgada' bar gyur te ma mchis par gyur na ni sa bon gyi rnam pa gang ci lags pa dag dang / rtswadang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal de dag thamasacad kyang tshig cing zhig la mi gda' bar 'gyur zhing ma mchis par 'gyur lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du spang bar bgyi ba'i chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'dasapa snyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shesakyis gzhom par bgyi ba de dag thams cad kyang ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa la rten cing ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa la gnas te skye zhing 'phel la rgyas par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i gnas kyi sa spangs shing sbyangasate ma mchis par gyur na ni spang bar bgyi ba'i chosagang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shes kyis gzhom par bgyi ba de dag thams cad kyang spangs shing sbyangs te ma mchis par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa de dag thams cad spangs shing sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed brnyes pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis chos thams cad la sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa brnyes te thams cad mkhyen pa dang / thams cad 50
gzigasapa dang / skyon thamasacad spangasapa dang / yon tan thamasacad dang ldan pa dang /chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos thams cad la mnga' sgyur ba'i sar gshegs nas nga'i skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyad pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /'di lta bu nyid lasagazhan mi shesaso zhes seng ge'i sgra sgrogs par mdzad do/ /bcom lda na 'das de lta lagasapasade bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi seng ge'i sgra 'di ni nges pa'i don lags te/don 'di ni mgo gcig tu lung bstan par bgyi ba yang lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu nyid las gzhan mi shes so zhes bgyi ba'i ye shes la yang rnam pa gnyis te/bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegs pasasangasargyas kyi rnam par rgyal ba bla 5 ma/ mchis pas bdud bzhi bcom ste pham par mdzad nas chos kyi sku 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phagasapa semasacan thamasacad kyis blta bar bgyi ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes te/ shes bya'i sa thams cad la thogs pa ma mchis pa'i chos kyi dbang phyug mdzad pa na 'di las lhag par bya ba'am/ rtogs par bya ba'i sa med do zhes yang dag par gzigs te/ stobs bcu po dag gi stobs dang ldan zhing mi 'jigs pa'i sa bla na med pa'i mchog tu yang dag par gshegs te/ shes bya thams cad la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shesakyis rnam par gzigs nasa'adi lta bu nyid las gzhan mi shes so zhes bgyi ba'i ye shesakyi saseng ge'i sgra sprogasapar mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las rgal ba de ma thag tu rnam par grol ba dag gi bde ba nyams su myong ba rnams ni 'di ltar bdag ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa rnams las yongs su grol gyis/ bdag gis ni phyin chad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar mi 'gyur ro snyam du yang dag par mthong sto/bcom ldan 'dasadagra bcom pa rnamasadang / rang sangasargyasa'adi lta bu nyid las gzhan 51
mi shes so zhesabagyi ba rtogs nas dbugs phyin pa'i mchog mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la so sor rtog go /bcom ldan 'dasade dag gis rtogs nas kyang sade la rmongs pa ma mchisapa'i chosacan du 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog par bdag gisani 'di ltar lhag ma dang bcas pa'i sa thob ste/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu ngesapar gyur to snyam du 'tshal to/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasanyan thos dang / rang sangasargyasakyi theg pa rnams ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'du ba'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'dasatheg pa chen po zhesabagyi ba de ni sangasargyasakyi theg pa'i tshig bla dwags lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar na theg pa gsum po 'di dag ni theg pa gcig kho na'i grangs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das theg pa gcig rtogs pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub ces bgyi ba de ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyingasakyi tshig bla dwags lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mya ngan lasa'adasapa'i dbyings zhesabagyi ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chosakyi sku'i tshig bla dwagasalagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi sku rtogasapa'i mtha' ni theg pa gcig pa lagasate/ bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegs pa yang gzhan ma lags/ chosakyi sku yang gzhan ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyid chos kyi sku lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chosakyi sku rtogasapa'i mtha' ni theg pa gcig gi mtha' lagadragaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasatheg pa gcig gi mtha' zhes bgyi ba de ni theg pa gcig gi mthar sbyar ba'i tshig bla dwagasalags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni dus kyi mtha' (chis pa la gnas pa ma lags te/ bcom
ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnamasani phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par gnasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegasapa rnamasani 'jig rten la sman pa'i slad du dusakyi mtha' mchisapa'i thugasarje can dang / dusakyi mtha' mchisapa'i thugs dam mnga' ba ma lags te/ kye 'jig rten la phan pa'i phyir dus kyi mtha' med par snying rje dang ldan pa dang / dus kyi mtha' med par yi dam bcas pa'i sems can a la la zhes mchi ba dag ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa nyid la yang dag par smra bsasmra ba lagasaso/ /kye 'jig rten la phan pa'i phyir chosamizad pa dang / chosartag pa dang / chosabartan pa dang / skyabasakyi sems canalta5 la la zhes mchi ba dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la yang dag par smra bas smra ba lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasade lta lagasapasa'adi ltar de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni skyabs ma mchis pa dang / skyob pa ma mchis pa'i 'jig rten na phyi ma'i mthar thug par skyabs mi zad pa dang / skyabs rtag pa dang / skyabs brtan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos zhes bgyi ba de ni theg pa gcig gi lam bstan pa'i tshig bla dwagasalagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasadage 'dun zhesbgyi ba de ni theg pa gsum pa'i tshogasakyi tshig bla dwagasalagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasskyabasa'adi gnyisani de'i yan lag gi skyabasazhesabagyi ste skyabasakyi rab ma lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasatheg pa gcig gi lam bstan pa'i chosakyang choskyi sku rtogs pa'i mtha' lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de'i pha rol na theg pa gcig gi lam bstan pa'i chos kyis ni bgyi ba ci yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das theg pa gsum pa'i tshogs kyang 'jig pa dang ba/pa pas de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs su
mchosapa dang / 'byung ba'i thabasatshol ba dang / slob pa dang / bgyi bdang bcasapadang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la zhugs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasade ltar na skyabasa'adi gnyisani skyabs kyi rab ma lagasate/ dusakyi mtha' mchispa'i skyabs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das semasacan gang dag de bzhin gshegasapasbtul ba de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabasasu mchi ba na chos nyid kyi rgyu mthun pa la mngon par dad pas chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la yang skyabs su mchi lta/bcom ldan 'das chos nyid kyi rgyu mthun pa la mngon par dad pas skyabs su mchi ba gnyis la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegspa la skyabs su mchi ba ni chos nyid kyi rgyu mthun pa la mngon par dad pasamachi bar bgyi ba ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs su mchi ba ni skyabssu mchi ba yang dag pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das skyabs su mchi ba gnyis kyang yang dag par na de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabasasu mchi zhesabagyi ba'i mtha' lagasapar khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yang gzhan ma lags/skyabs gnyis po yang gzhan ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa nyid skyabs gsum lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das theg pa gcig gi lam bstan pa'i chos 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi gsung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng ge'i sgra so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang ldan pa lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mos pa ji lta ba dag la de bzhin gshegs pas theg pa gnyis po thabs kyi sgrub pas bsgrubs pa de dag kyang theg pa chen po bdag nyid kyi slad du lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das theg pa 'aX gnyisakyi ming ni ma mchisate/ bcom ldan
'dasayang dag par na 'di la theg pa gcig po ni theg pa yang dag pa lags te theg pa gsum yang dag par 'du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phags pa'i bden pa thog mar mngon par rtogs pa'i shes pa gcig pus ni gnas kyi sa de snyed cig spong bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das shesapa de gcig pus yongs su 'chal ba la sogs pa yon tan bzhi po rnamasamangon sum du bgyid par 'gyur zhing don bzhi po bdag nyid chosanyid kyis shin tu so sor rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes pa la shes pa bzhi 'phyo ba dang dmigs pa bzhi 'pho ba ma mchis te/ bcom ldan 'dasa'ajig rten lasa'adasapa'i shesapa rdo rje lta bu ni mi 'pho ba'i chos can lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'di la nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi sa spong ba'i 'phagasapa'i bden pa shes pa dang po ni yang dag pa'i shes pa lags te/bcom ldan 'das de dag la 'phags pa'i bden pa shes pa rnam pa gnyis kyis gnas kyi sa spong ba ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasarnams ni nyan thosadang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul ma lags pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi sbubs spong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa'i sbubs thams cad 'byed pa'i mthar phyin pa'i ye shes gang lags pa de ni yang dag pa'i ye shes zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa 'chal ba dang ngo ni mthar phyin pa'i shes pa ma lagasate/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugasapa'i shesapa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i don de ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thamasacad kyi tshig bla dgas ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos 55
dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad ni yon tan tshad mchis pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'dasade'i yan lag gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i slad du nyan thosadang / rang sangs rgyas rnamasal 'phagasapa zhesabagyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'aphagasapa'i bden pa rnamasazhesbgyi ba de dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa ma lags/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan ma lags te/ bden pa 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyasarnams kyis thog mar mngon par rdzogs par sangasargyas shing mngon par mkhyen la so sor rtogs nas de mngon par mkhyen pa'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs su bcug pa'i 'jig rten la bstan cing btags te/ de'i slad du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnamasashesabagyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'aphags pa'i bden pa'i don bshad pa ni zab cing phra la brtags par dka' ste khong du chud par dka' zhing brtag mi nus la rtog ge'i spyod pa ma lagasate/ mkhasashing mdzangasapasarig pa dang / 'jig rten thamscad dang mi mthun pa lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasazab mo bstan pa bshad pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po lags pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul lags te/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni 'phags pa'i bden pa'i don bshad pa 'di'i gnatha(laga'(so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying poliganas zab pas na 'phags pa'i bden pa'i don yang zab cing phra la brtags pa dka' ste rtogs par dka' zhing brtag mi nus la rtog ge'i spyod pa ma lagaX 6te/ mkhas shing mdzangs pas rig pa dang /
'jig rten thamasacad dang mi mthun pa zhesabagyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasagang nyon slongspa thamasacad kyi skrubasakyi mthasadakrisapa de bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po la the tshom ma mchis pa de ni nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi sbubs nas rnam par grol ba'i de bzhin gshegasapa'i chosakyi sku la yang the tshom ma mchisapa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasagang gi yid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku dang /sangasargyasakyi yul bsam gyisami khyab pa'i dgongasapa'i mthar phyin pa de ni bcom ldan 'dasa'aphagasapa'i bden pa'i don bshad pa rnam pa 'di gnyisal yid chesashing dad de mosapa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasade ltar na 'phagasapa'i bden pa'i don bshad pa rnam paganyisani rig par dka' zhingartogasapar dka' ba lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'aphags pa'i bden pa'i don bshad pa rnam pa gnyisagang zhe na/'phags pa'i bden pa'i don bshad par bgyi ba mchis pa dang / bgyi ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de la 'phags pa'i bden pa'i don bshad par bgyi ba mchis pa ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bstan pa dang / btags pa tshad mchis pa lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasagazhan gyisabagyid du stsal kyang sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su 'tshal ba dang / sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba thams cad spang ba dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa thams cad mngon sum du bgyi ba dang / sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam thams cad bsgom par mi nus te/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pasa'akhor ba la yang 'dusabyasadang / 'dusam byasapa mchis so/ /mya ngan las'das pa la yang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas pa mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa'i don bshad par bgyi ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa ni bcom ldan 'dasade la 'phagasapa'i bden pa bzhi bstan pa dang / btagasapa dag dpag tu ma 57
mchisapa lagasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasabadag nyid kyisabasal kyang rin pa'i sdug bsngal thamasacad yongs su 'tshal ba dang rin pa'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba thamasacad spang ba dang / zin pa'i sdug bsngal 'gog pa thamasacad mngon sum du bgyi ba dang / zin pa'i sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam bsgom par nusapa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'dasade ltar na de bzhin gshegs pas 'phagasapa'i bden pa bzhi bstan pa bshad pa gang lags pa de dag ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam pa brgyad du lañtsar ro/ /bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyasarnams ni 'phagasapa'i bden pa'i don bstan pa bgyi ba ma mchisapa bzhi po dag la rdzogasapar mdzad pa lagasaso/ /nyan thosarnamasadang / rang sangasargyasarnamsni rdzogs par bgyid pa ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rab 'bring tha ma'i chosartogs pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings rtogs pa ma lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das/ ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasarnams 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i don bshad pa bgyi ba ma mchis pa dag la rdzogs par mdzad pa lags zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma 'ongasapa'i sdug bsngal thamasacad ni yongs su mkhyen/ bcom ldan 'dasanyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad 'du ba'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba thams cad ni spangs/ bcom ldan 'dasayid kyi phung po thamasacad 'gog pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'gog pa ni mngon sum du mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal 'gog pa ni chos chud gson pa ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad dze+e spya na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs
pa'i chosakyi sku thog ma ma mchisapa'i dusanasamachisapa/ ma bgyisapa/ ma skyesapa/ mi bas pa/ bas pa ma mchis pa/ rtag pa/ brtan pa/ rang bzhin gyis yongasasu dag pa/nyon mongasapa thamasacad kyi sbubasanasangesapar grol ba/ sangasargyasakyi chosatha dad du mi gnadragapa/ grol bar shedragapa bsam gyidragami khyab pagang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'daspa snyed dang ldan pa ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i ming gis bstan pa'i slad du lta/ bcom ldan 'das de nyid la de bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po chosakyi sku nyon mongs pa'i sbubs nasangesapar grol ba zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po shesapa nyid ni de bzhinabashegasapa rnamasakyi stong pa nyid kyi ye shesalagasate/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni nyan thosadang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyisasngon ma mthong ma rtogs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ni thugs su chud cing mngon sum du mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po stong pa nyid shes pa ni 'di gnyis lagasate/ gnyisagang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyon mongasapa thamasacad kyi sbubasadang tha dad du gnasapa ma grol bsashespa rnams kyis stong pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying polisangsrgyas kyi chos tha dad du mi gnas shing grol bas shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa snyed dag gis mi stong pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po stong pa nyid shesapa rnam pa 'di gnyisal ni nyan thosachen po dag kyang bcom ldan 'dasanyid la yid ches pas 'jug par bas te/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stong pa nyid shes pa ni phyin ci log gi dmigs pa bzhi po dag la 'jug pa lagaX9 so/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas
nyan thosadang / rang sangs rgyasathamasacad kyis sdug bsngal 'gog pa thamasacad sngon ༵ /sna ji sngon ma rtogasate/ bcom ldan 'das kyisani thugs su chud cing mngon sum du nyon mongasapa'i sbubs thamasacad 'jomasapa sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam thams cad kyang bsgoms so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di dag la bden pa gsum ni mi rtag pa lags so/ /bden pa gcig ni rtag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das bden pa gsum ni 'dus byasakyi mtshan nyid du gtogasapa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'dasagang 'dusabyasakyi mtshan nyid du gtogs pa de ni mi rtag pa lagasaso/ /gang mi rtag pa de ni rdzun pa slu ba'i chos can lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasagang rdzun pa slu ba'i chosacan de ni mi bden pa dang mi rtag pa lags te skyabs ma lags the(/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas 'phags pa'i sdug bsngal bden pa dang / sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba bden pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phagasapa'i bden pa yang yang dag par na mi bden pa dang mi rtag pa lagasate/ skyabasam lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la bden pa gcig ni 'dusbyas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul las 'das pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul lasa'adas pa de ni rtag pa lagasaso/ /gang rtag pa de ni mi slu ba'i chos can lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang mi slu ba'i chos can de ni bden pa dang /rtag pa dang / skyabs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas 'di la sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i bden pa nyid ni yang dag par na bden pa dang / rtag pa dang / skyabs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa'i yul las 'das pa sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i bden pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ nyan thos dang rang 60
sangasargyasathamasacad kyi shesapa'i spyod yul ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasadaper na dmus long gzugs la lta mi nus pa dang / bu btsa' ba'i gnas na mchis pa'i byis pa dgung bdun lags pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la lta mi nus pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i bden pa yang byis pa so so'iskye bo thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa'i yul yang ma lags/ nyan thos dang / rang sangasargyasathams cad kyi shesapa'i yul yang ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bgyi ba de ni mtha' gnyis la lta ba'i phyin ci log pa rnams kyi tshig bla dgas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes pa zhes bgyi ba de ni shes pa dag pa'i tshig bla dgas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mtha' gnyis su lta ba zhes bgyi ba de ni nye bar len pa'i phung po dag la bdag tu mngon par zhen pa'i byis pa so so3skye bo rtog ge ba dag gi tshig bla dgas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di gnyis ni mthar lta ba zhes bgyi ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ chad par lta ba dang /rtag par lta ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasagal te 'du byed rnams la mi rtag par lta na de ni de'i chad par lta ba ma lags te/ de ni de'i yang dag pa'i lta ba lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te mya ngan las 'das pa la rtag par lta ba de ni de'i rtag par lta ba ma lags te/ de ni de'i yang dag pa'i lta ba lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das rtog ge ba dag gi lta ba ni 'di lta bu lags te/ lusadang / dbang po dang / tshor ba dang / sems pa rnams tshe 'di nyid la 'jug par mthong nas srid pa'i mtshams sbyor ba la 'jug par mi bgyid cing ma 'tshal bas ldongs par gyur pa skad de chad par lta bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rtog ge ba dag gi sta ba ni sems kyi rgyud la rmongs shing sems
kyi skad cig 'jig pa la yang 'jug par mi bgyid la/ rnam par shesapa'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa skad de rtag par lta bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar rtog ge ba dag gi lta ba ni de lta bu dag lags pa skad de de dag ni don de lasathal ba'i lta ba dang / don de'i tha chad kyi lta ba dang / gzhan gyi mtshan nyid dang 'dres pa'i lta bas chad par rlom sems bgyid pa dang / rtag par rlom sems bgyid pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das semasacan rnamasani zin pa'i phung po lnga po dag la phyin ci log par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'dasade dag ni mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shesapa dang / sdug bsngal ba la bde bar 'du shes pa dang / bdag ma mchis pa la bdag tu 'du shes pa dang / mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar 'du shesapa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasathams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes pa dag bas kyang sngon ma mthong lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams de bzhin gshegasapa la dad pas rtag par 'du shes pa dang / bde bar 'du shes pa dang / bdag tu 'du shes pa dang / gtsang bar 'du shes pa'i sems can de dag ni bcom ldan 'das phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba ma lagasate/ bcom ldan 'das sems can de dag ni yang dag pa'i lta ba can du 'gyur ba lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa'i chos kyi sku nyid rtag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bde ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bdag gi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gtsang ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasasems can gang dag de bzhin gshegasapa'i chos kyi sku la de ltar mthong ba de dag ni yang dag pa mthong ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i mthong ba gang lags pa de dag ni/ bcom ldan 'daphukyi srasathugar+sālasaskyes pa dang / zhal nas skyes 62
pa dang / chos lasaskyes pa dang / chos kyis sprul pa dang / chos kyi bgo skal la spyod pa zhes bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes pa dag pa zhes bgyi ba ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyasathamasacad kyi shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags te 'di ltar shes pa dag pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i bden pa ni shes pa dag pa de'i spyod yul yang ma lagadragayul yang ma lags na/ bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i bden pa rton pa bzhi'i shesapa can dag gi spyod yul ma lags shing yul ma lags pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das theg pa gsum pa'i lasadang po pa rmongasapa ma mchis pa'i chosacan dag gis don de khong du chud par 'gyur zhing don de rtogasapar 'gyur ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'dasakyisarton pa bzhi bshad cing btagasapa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rton pa bzhi po 'di dag ni 'jig rten pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rton pa gcig pu 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i bden pa ni rton pa thams cad kyi mchog 'jig rten las 'das pa lags te/ de ni yang dag par rton par bgyi ba dang / skyabs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po ni 'khor ba na rton pa lags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyid kyi dbang du bgyis nasabacom ldan 'das kyisasngon gyi mtha' med do zhes bshad cing btags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mchis na 'khor ba zhes mchi na ni tshig de rigs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba zhes bgyi ba ni zin pa dag gi dbang po rnamasa'aphosam thagatu:na pa dag gi dbang po rnamasalen pa la 'khor ba zhesabagyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'achi 'pho dang / skye ba zhes bgyi ba'i chosaganyisakyi ming de ni de bzhin gshegasapa'i snying politshig bla dgas laga~X so/ /bcom ldan 'das gum zhes bgyi ba
dang / skyesazhesabagyi ba 'di ni 'jig rten gyi tha snyad lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das gum zhesabagyi ba ni dbang po 'gags pa 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes zhes bgyi ba 'di ni dbang po gsar pa rnams byung ba 'di lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la ni skye ba'am/ 'gum pa'am/ 'pho ba'am/ byung ba yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul lasa'adasapa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po ni rtag pa dang / brtan pa dang / ther zug pa lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasade lta lags pasade bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po ni tha dad du mi gnasashing 'brel la sbubasanasagrol ba'i shesapa can dgas gzhi dang / rten dang / gnasalagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'adi ltar de bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po ni 'brel pa ma mchisashing tha dad du gnasal shes pa grol ba ma lags pa phyi rol gyi 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi gzhi dang / rten dang /gnas kyang lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ma mchisan ni sdug bsngal la skyo ba dang / mya ngan lasa'adasapa la 'dod cing don du gnyer ba dang smon pa yang ma mchisapar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa drug po gang lags pa 'di dag dang / rnam par shes pa gang lags pa 'di dang / bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar chos bdun po 'di dag ni mi gnas pa dang / skad cig pa dang / sdug bsngal rnams myong ba ma lags pas chos de dag ni sdug bsngal la skyo ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la 'dod cing don du gnyer ba phyon par mi rigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni thog ma dang tha ma ma mchis pa'i mthar mchis pa dang / mi skye ba dang / mi 'gag pa'i chos can sdug bsngal myong ba lags pas/ bcom ldan 'das de 64
bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de ni sdug bsngal la yang skyo ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la yang 'dod cing don du gnyer ba dang smon par 'os so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yang bdag ma lags/ sems can ma lags/ srog ma lags/gang zag ma lagasate/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa'i snying po ni sems can 'jig tshogs la lta bar lhung ba dag dang / phyin ci log gisanyamasapar gyur pa dag dang /stong pa nyid lasasemasagayengasapa rnamasakyi spyod yul ma lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasde bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di ni dam pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po lags so/ /chosakyi sku'i snying po lagasaso/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chosakyi snying po lags so/ /rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i chos kyi snying po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa slo bur gyi nye ba'i nyon mongasapas nye bar nyon mongasapa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul te/ bsam gyis mi khyab bo snyam pa dag bgyid do/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'dasadage ba'i sems ni skad cig pa ste/ nyon mongs pa rnams kyis kun nasanyon mongs pa ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das mi dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig pa ste/ sems de yang nyon mongs pa rnams kyisakun nas nyon mongs pa ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa rnams ni sems la mi reg sems kyang nyon mongasapa rnamasal mi reg pa lagasan/ bcom ldan 'dasa'adi la ji ltar semasami reg pa'i chos can nye bar nyon mongs par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das nye ba'i nyon mongs pa yang mchis la/ semasanye bar nyon mongs pa yang mchis pas bcom ldan 'das sems rang bzhin gyisayongs su dag pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongasapa'i don t+na khong du chud par dka' ba lagasate/ bcom ldan 'das 'di la bcom ldan 'dasanyid spyan du gyur pa lags te/65
ye shesasu gyur pa lags/ bcom ldan 'dasani chosathamasacad kyi rtsa ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das ni mnga' bdag lags/ bcom ldan 'das ni rton pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasakyisalha mo dpal phreng gi rtogasapar dka' ba'i don bshad pa gsan nasarjesasu yi rang ba mdzad de lha mo de de bzhin no/ /lha mo de de bzhin te/ semasarang bzhin gyisayongasasu dag pa'i nye ba'i nyon mongasapa'i don ni rtogasapar dka'o/ /lha mo chosa'adiganyisani rtogasapar dka' ba ste/ 'di lta ste semasarang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa rtogasapar dka' ba dang / semasade'i nye ba'i nyon slongs pa rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /lha mo chosa'adiganyisanyan nusapa ni khyod dam byang chub semasadapa' chosachen po dang ldan pa gzhan dag yin no/ /lha mo lhag ma nyan thosarnamasani chos 'di gnyisal de bzhin gshegasapa la dad pas 'gro bar zad de/ lha mo nga'i nyan thos gang dag dad pa dang ldan zhing dad pa'i dbang du byed pa de dag ni dad pa'i snang ba la brten nasachos dang mthun par sdud pa'i shesapasa'adi la ngesapar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo chosadang mthun par sdud pa'i shesapa zhesabya ba ni lha mo dbang polirnam par rig pa yid kyi spyod yul la rnam par lta ba dang / lasakyi rnam par smin pa la rnam par lta ba dang / dgra bcom pa rnamasakyi gnyid la rnam par lta ba dang / semasal dbang du gyur pa rnamasakyi bsam gtan la dga' ba dang / bde ba la rnam par lta ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangasargyasarnamasakyi 'phagasapa'i zlasa'aphrul la rnam par lta ba ste/ lha mo rnam par lta ba'i rang bzhin rnam pa lnga la mkhas pa 'di dang ldan na lha mo da ltar dang / nga 'dasapa'i 'og ma 'ongasapa'i dusan nga'i nyan thosadad pa dang ldan zhing dad pa'i dbang du byed pa de dag dad pa'i snang ba la brten nas chosadang mthun par sdud pa'i shes pasrang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa dang / sems kyi nye bar nyon mongs pa la nges par 66
'gyur ro/ /lha mo de dag gi nges pa de nyid ni theg pa chen polilam du 'jug pa'i rgyur 'gyurahe/ lha mo de ltar na 'di lta ste/ chosazab mo mi spong ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegasapa la dad pas 'gro ba la ni phan pa mang ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo dpal phreng gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la sman pa mang ba'i don bshad pa gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bdag spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/ lha mo khyod spobs par gyisashig de nas bcom ldan 'dasla lha mo dpal phreng gisa'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsum po 'di dag ni rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo chos zab mo dag la ma rmasam nyams par bdag nyid la srung ba dang / bsod namasakyang mang du skyed pa dang / theg pa chen polilam du yang zhugasapar 'gyur ba lags so/ /gsum gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rigasakyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag rang gisarig pa'i chosazab mo dang ldan pa dang / bcom ldan 'dasarigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos dang mthun par sdud pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos zab mo dag la bdag nyid kyi shes pa zhum par 'tshal nas 'di ni bdag gis mi shes te/ don 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen par zad do zhes bcom ldan 'das la sems rnam par gtod par bgyid de/ sems rnam par gtod pa de dang ldan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gsum po 'di dag ni rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo chos zab mo dag la ma rmas ma nyams par bdag nyid la srung ba dang / bsod nams kyang mang du skyed pa dang / theg pa chen polilam du yang dag par zhugs par 'gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gsum po 'di dag las gzhan pa'i sems can gang 67
lagasapa de dag ni chosazab mo dag la nan tan gyis mchog tu bzung nasagob lob kyi sems 'dzin cing mngon par zhen te/ ston par bgyid kun tu smra bar bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni de dag la dam pa'i chos la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang / gzhan mu stegs can dag sa bon rul ba lags te/ rgyal polithad du yang mchis la brlag par bgyi'o zhes mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sa bon rul bar gyur pa de dag ni lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis legs par tshar gcad par bgyi ba lags so/ /de nas lha mo dpal phreng gis de skad ces gsol nas/ 'khor dang bcas pasabacom ldan 'dasakyi zhagasal gtugadragaso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dpal phreng la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/lha mo khyod kyis dus dang skabs su chos zab mo dag la bdag nyid yang dag par bsrung ba'i thabs kyi don bstan pa bshad pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi dgra tshar bcad pa bshad pa legasaso/ /lha mo khyod ni sangasargyasa'abum phrag bye ba mang po la bsnyen bkur byasapa yin pas khyod kyis don bshad pa 'di las ngo mtshar che ba med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal 'bar bas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi lus la 'od kyis khyab par mdzad nasata la bdun srid tsam du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te/ zhabasakyi gom pa 'dor ba'i dzu'aphrul gyisamanyan yod kyi grong khyer ga la ba der gshegasaso/ /de nas lha mo dpal phreng 'khor dang bcas pas sbyi bor thal mo sbyar nas lta bas chog mi shesashing mig mi 'dzumasapar lta bsabacom ldan 'dasal lta zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mig rgyang gisami slebs par gyur pa de'i tshe lha mo dpal phreng 'khor dang bcas pa mchog tu dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i bzhin dang ldan pas gcig gis gcig gi mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rnams rnam pa du 68
mar bsngagasashing sangasargyasarjesasu dran pa yid la byed pa ma brjed bzhin du grong khyer 'thab med du dong ngo / /de nas lha mo dpal phreng gis rang gi khyim thab rgyal po grags pa'i bshephuganyen theg pa chen po la ngesapar bcug go /grong khyer chen po'ibud med kyi tshogasabu mo lo bdun lon pa yan chad thamasacad theg pa chen po la btsud do/ /rgyal po grags pa'i bshes gnyen gyis kyang grong khyer chen po〉skyes pa'i 'khor khye'u lo bdun lon pa yan cad thams cad theg pa chen po la btsud par gyur te/ de ltar grong khyer ba thamasacad theg pa chen po la mngon du phyogasapar byasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du byon te nang du gshegasanas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la yang bka' stsal cing / lha'i dbang po brgya byin la yang dgongasaso/ /de nasalha'i dbang po brgya byin skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la lha'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisalha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi rgya cher yang dag par bstan te/ ko shi ka chosakyi rnam grangs 'di khyod kyisazungasashig ṅgā shi ka chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi khyod kyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnamasal shod cig kun dga' bo khyod kyis kyang chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi༄ngasashig kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'khor bzhi po dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag la shod cig de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyir+sā'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ṣ+ka shi ka chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni yon tan mtha' yas pa dang ldan te/ ko shi ༵ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad
kyis kyang mdo sde 'di'i don thams cad ma lus par shes pa'am/ blta ba'am nye bar brtag par mi nusan semasacan gzhan dag gisalta ci smos/ ko shi ka de ltar na chosakyi rnam grangs 'di ni zab la yon ga chen poli'abyung gnas yin no/ /ṅgā shi ka de'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i yon tan gyi ming yongs su brjod pa tsam zhig bshad kyis de legasapar rab tu nyon la yid la zungasashig dang ngasakhyod la bshad do/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bosabacom ldan 'dasal legasaso legasaso zhesagasol te bcom ldan 'dasakyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad cesabaka' stsal to/ /k+ko shi ka 'di ni de bzhin gshegasapa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa yang dag par bstod pa zhes bya bar zungs shig sa shi ka 'di ni yi dam chen po bsam gyisami khyab pa zhesabya bar yang zungasashig smon lam thamasacad sdud pa smon lam chen po zhesabya bar yang zungasashig dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa bsam gyisami khyab pa bstan pa zhesabya bar yang zungasashig theg pa gcig tu yang dag par 'du ba bstan pa zhesabya bar yang zungasashig 'phags pa'i bden pa brgyad bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungs shig de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungs shig chos kyi sku bstan pa zhesabya bar yang zungasashig stong pa nyid kyi don gyi dgongs pa yang dag par bstan pa zhesabya bar yang zungs shig bden pa gcig tu bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungasashig rtag pa dang / brtan pa dang / zhi ba dang / ther zug pa dang / skyabsgcig tu gyur pa bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungs shig phyin ci log gis bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungs shig rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i sems la dgongasapa bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungs shig de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras kyi yang dag pa bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zungasashig ko shi ka 'di ni lha mo dpal phreng gi seng ge'i sgra zhes bya bar 70
yangazungasashigako shi ka mdo 'dir bstan pa gang dag bshad pa de dag thamasacad ni rgyu ba bcad pa dang /ngesapa'i don dang /rton pa gcig pa zhesabya bar yang zungasashigako shi ka lha mo dpal phreng gi seng ge'i sgra bstan pa'i chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi ni ngasakhyod kyi lag tugatad kyisa'ajig rten na dam pa'i chosaji srid gnasapa de srid du phyogasabacu'i 'jig rten thams cad du yang dag par sgrogs shigaston cigalha'i dbang po brgya byin gyisabacoyoldan 'dagul legasasozhesagasolarta/bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan sngar choskyi rnam grangasa'adi bzung zhing kun chub par byasanasalha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / gzhan yang gang der 'dusapar gyur pa dag dang / lha dang /mi dang /lha ma yin dang /drizar bcasapa'i 'jigarten yi rangasate/bcom ldan 'dasakyisagasungasapa lamangon par bstod do////
dbyañdza/ /sangasargyas kyisabuṅgā med kyi skye ba lasalog ste skyes par 'gyur ba'i rgyu brgyad gsungasashang bu mo rnam dag dad pa 'khor bu mo lnga brgya dang bcas pa rang rang gi lusakyi rgyan cha thamscad sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i tshul/mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegasapa'i le'u bzhi bcupa lasabatus/de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo rnam dag dad pa zhes bya ba gzhon nu ma byad bzhin sdug cing mdzesapa/ semasacan rnamasakyisamathong bar mosapa/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ theg pa chen po bsgoms pa zhig yod pa de bu mo gzhon nu ma lnga brgyas yongs su bskor te/ so so nasagaser gyi phreng ba thogs nasagrong khyer mnyan yod nas byung ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhags la spyi bos gtugs te phyag byas nas/ lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas tshigs su bcad de mngon par bstod pa/ yun ring bsod nams rnam dag phrin lasabasags/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yasayongs rdzogs shing / /mang po dad mos dga' bar mdzad pas na/ /de slad thub mchog khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gzi byin lham me ya mtshan rab ston cing / /rin chen 'byung gnas chosasgo ston par mdzad/ /sku yi 'od zer 'dom gang rtag gsal ba/ /blo chen bsil ba'i rdzing la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan ljon shing bsod namasabs ma 'tshal/ /mi mchog khyod la 'jig rten kun gyis bsngags/ /smon lam chen po tshul khrims yongs rdzogs pas/ /de slad mchod 'osagatso la bdag phyag 'tsha(2/ /chos mchog rab gnas rtag par zhi zhing
dben/ /'jig rten kun la thugs snyoms bu gcig bzhin/ /mkhyen pa dag gisaspyod rnamasarab mkhyen pas/ /'dren mkhan bzhin du mnyam pa'i shul yang ston/ /rab brtan brtson 'grus ldan pa mchis gyur na/ /byams dang thugs rjes sems can sman mdzad pas/ /byang chub semasadapa'i spyod pa gang lagasapa/ /de bzhin gshegasapasabakasani bshad du gsol/ /ji ltar rab brtan stobasani thob gyur nas/ /'khor bar gnasakyang bdud dpung pham bgyid lags/ /ji ltar mnyam pa'i chosani thob 'gyur zhing / /ji ltar sems can yongs su smin bgyid lags/ /ji ltar bgyisan phugazhi nam mkha' dang / /rlung dang chu me ji lta bzhin du 'gyur/ /ji ltar yid chesathob nas chosaganasashing / /ri rab sengage'i rgyalapo bzhin du 'gyur//ji ltar byamasasnang semasani yongasaspangasanas//sems gtsang drang la g.yo sgyu ma mchis 'gyur/ /ji ltar sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'gruphubasam gtan rnam grol skye 'gyur zhing / shesarab nyon mongasamun pa rab bcom nas/ /rtag par thabasachen la ni gnasapa dang / /ting 'dzin gzungasal thogs pa ma mchisashing / /tshad med bzhi dang mngon shes lnga la gnas/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas spyan sngar gnasagyur nas/ /rtag par rdzus te skye zhing tshe rabs dran/ /sbyangs pas rtsod pa ma mchisadagon gnasanas/ /semasani rab btul nyon mongs zhi bgyid dang / /tshul khrims ldan zhing byang chub lam bsgoms dang / /bdud rtsi 'gog thob bdud dpung 'jomasapa dang //bde stsol chos kyi 'bor lo skor 'gyur ba//de 'dra'i yang dag lam ni bkasabashad gsol//de nasabacom ldan 'das kyis bu mo rnam dag dad pa la bka' stsal pa/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' gang stobs rnam pa brgyad dang ldan par gyur na 'khor ba na gnasakyang rab tu brtan pa'i dpa' bor 'gyur zhing ༷༷sa su ngal ba med par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad
gang zhe na/ dang po ni semasakyisa'adun pa'i stobasate g.yo sgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyispa ni mos pa'i stobasate/ sdig pa rnams spong bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni sbyor ba'i stobasate/ rtag tu dge ba bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni mngon par yid chesapa'i stobasate/ lasakyi rnam par smin pa dag la shin tu mngon par yid chesapa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni byang chub kyi semasakyi stobs te/ theg pa dman pa yongs su mi tshol ba'i phyir ro/ /drug pa ni byams pa chen polistobs te/ sems can la gnod pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa ni snying rje chen polistobasate gnod pa byasapa rnamasadang du len par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa ni dge ba'i bshephuganyen gyi stobs te/ dus dus su sad par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /bu mo 'di ni stobs rnam pa brgyad ces bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' gang stobasabargyad po 'di dag dang ldan par gyur na rab tu bstan pa'i dpa' bor 'gyur bsa'akhor ba na gnas kyang mngon par zhen cing chagasapa med par 'gyur ro/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasakyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ semaphu'adun dpa' bo gang yin pa/ /g.yo sgyu dag ni spong byed cing / /rtag par drang por spyod pas na/ /yang dag byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /mos pa'i stobs ni gang yin pa/ /nyesapa mang po spong byed cing / /dge ba 'ba' zhig spyod pas na/ /yang dag brtson la gnas par 'gyur/ /spyor ba phun sum tshogs gyur pa/ /rtag tu legs par rab bstan nas/ /brtson 'grus brtan par gyur pas na/ /sems can rnams ni bde bar byed/ /mngon par yid ches stobs dbang gis/ /lasakyi rnam smin rig pas na/ /sangasargyas ye shes yid ches shing / /'jig rten yongs su sdud par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems stobs gang yin des/ /theg pa dman pa spong byed cing / /sangs rgyas gdung ni mi gcod pas/ /chos nyid la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /byamasachen stobasakyi dbang gisani/ /semasacan snyomasapar lta byed cing / /74
byamasasdang dag ni med pasan/ /zhe sdang gnod semasaskyed mi 'gyur/ /snying rje chen po'istobasakyisani/ /semasacan dang du len byed cing / /'khor ba dag la zhen med pas/ /yongs su skyo zhing ngal ba med/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen stobs kyis sna/ /rtag par phan tshun sad byed cing / /sems ni bying bar mi 'gyur bas/ /byang chub la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo gang yin de dag gis/ /stobs brgyad 'di dag thob gyur na/ /byang chub snying por 'dug nasani/ /bdud dpung mang po bcom par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chosarnam pa brgyad dang ldan par gyur na mnyam pa nyid la rab tu gnasapar 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na dang po ni semasacan thamasacad mnyam par gyur pa ste rang bzhin gyis bdag med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni chos thams cad mnyam par gyur pa ste chosrnams rab tu dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni zhing thams cad mnyam par sgyur pa ste/stong pa nyid kyi khamasasu 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam par gyur pa ste/ snyoms pa nyid du ston pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni spyod pa thams cad mnyam par gyur pa ste/ rgyu dang rkyen la rang bzhin med pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa ni theg pa thams cad mnyam par gyur pa ste/ 'dus ma byas su mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa ni sems mnyam par gyur pa ste/ sems sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa ni bdud rnams mnyam par gyur pa ste/ nyon mongasapa'i thog ma mi dmigasapa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni chos rnam pa brgyad kyisamanyam pa nyid la rab tu gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sems can rang bzhin bdag med pas/ /skad cig tsam yang dmigs mi 'gyur/ /mnyam pa nyid la gang gnas pa/ /de lta bur ni blta bar bya/ 7/༷sa rnams thamasacad mnyam pasan/ /rang
bzhin rtag par stong zhing dben/ /yi gesatha dad phye bar zad/ /chosarnamasarang bzhin bye brag med/ /phyogasabacu'i zhing rnamasathamasacad kun/ /mu mtha' dag ni mi dmigspas/ /de yi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni rtag tu mnyam/ /dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /chosadabyingasaganasapar mnyam pasan/ /ye shesmtha' yas3ma par grol/ /sangasargyasakun kyang de bzhin no/ /semasacan rang bzhin rgyu rkyen rnams/ /thamasacad kun kyang mnyam pa dang / /de yi spyod pa rab shesapas/ /ci rigs par ni go bar byed/ /sems can ji snyed tha dad pa/ /sgyu sprul lta bur rab tu rtogs/ /phyi nang gnyisaka len med pas/ /rang bzhin rtag tu rnam par dag /theg pa sna tshogs rab bshad kyang / /'dusam byasasu rab tu mnyam/ /'dren pasathabasani rab mkhyen pas/ /rnam par phye:thegagasumabashad/ /nyen mongasabadud larabaganasakyang / /nyon mongasadangos po ci yang med/ /lha dang phung po 'chi bdag bdud/ /spyod yul thamscad stong pa yin/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabargyad dang ldan na byamssnang rnamasayongasasu spong bar byed do/ /brgyad gang zhe na byamasapa dang ldan pa dang / snying rje dang ldan pa dang / rtag par phan 'dogasapar byed pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i chosal ma chags pa dang / rang gi lus la chags pa med pa dang / rtag tu ting nge 'dzin ñtsha sems sgom pa dang / lus dang srog yongs su gtong ba dang / nyon mongs pa rnams la so sor rtog pa ste/ chosabargyad po 'di dag mngon par sgrub par nus na byamasasnang yongasasu spong bar 'gyur ro/ /9 de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ byams sems go cha rab bgos nas/ /thams cad kun la snying brtse zhing / /mnyam pa'i sems la gang gnas pa/ /byams ldang sems lag spra mi 'gyur/ /blo ldan phan 'dogs spyod
pas na/ /rtag par gzhan la bde ba gtong / /rnyed pa thob kyang rang mi mthong / /brnyasshing smad kyang 'khon 'dzin med/ /rlung brgyad kyis ni mi bskyod pas/ /byams sdang dag ni mi skye zhing / /bdag gam gal te gzhan yang rung / /byams sdang 'du shes yongs mi skyed/ /'du shes rnams ni rab spangs nas/ /spyod yul dag la zhen pa med/ /rtag par rang gi lus rtogadragapas/ /luthag11ga dag la phongs pa med/ /mkhas rnams sdug bsngal bde ba yis/ /g.yosapar mi 'gyur nam mkha' bzhin/ /nyon mongs legs par rtogs byed na/ /bdag dang bdag gi gnyis ka spong / /spyod 'dzin rtag par sa 'dra bas/ /byams sdang dag ni yongs mi skyed/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos rnam pa brgyad dang ldan na 'khor bsayongs su ngal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yangasashing rgya che ba'i phyir dang / sems can la so sor rtog par byed pa'i phyir dang / rtag par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong zhing mchod pa byed pa'i phyir dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa rnams mthong ba'i phyir dang / rtag par sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa yongs su gnyer ba'i phyir dang / 'khor ba rmi lam lta bur rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir dang / chosakhyad par can dag la zhum pa med pa'i phyir dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' dang yang dag pa'i mtha' la so sor rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /de nasabacom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigasasu bcad de bka' stsal pa/ rnal 'byor lam ni gang sgom pa/ /dge sbyong skyon 'phen dri ma med/ /bar snang zla ba rnam dag bzhin/ /sdug bsngal semasacan sgrol bar byed/ /yon tan rnamasani bsdu ba'i phyir/ /'khor basyongs su ngal mi 'gyur/ /sems can rang bzhin rtog byed cing / /rab brten brtson 'grus spyod par byed/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni tshad med du/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gus mchod pas/ /de phyir stobs bcu gang ldan pa/ /'khor bas yongs su ngal mi 'gyur/ /77
'jig rten tshad med dpag med du/ /bsam gyis mi khyab chos ston cing / /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi gcod/ /chos rgyal nyid du mngon 'tshang rgya/ /tshul khrims dam pa gang srung ba/ /'khor bas ngal bar mi 'gyur zhing / /'khor ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /rmi lam sprin dang glog ltar shes/ /chos las gang zhig rnam grol ba/ /'khor bas yongs su ngal mi 'gyur/ /byang chub la ni rab gnas shing / /dga' ba'i sems kyisartag tu bde/ /thabs kyis pha rol gang phyin pa/ /'khor bas yongs su ngal mi 'gyur/ /rtag par dam chos sgrub pa yang / /bar snang zla bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gang mos pa/ /'khor bas yongs su ngal mi 'gyur/ /'khor ba mu mtha' med gyur kyang / /rtag par yang dag mtha' la gnas/ /yud tsam shes rab rjesamathun pa/ /'khor ba dag gis ༵༵ m+p+raṃ (khyur/ /gzhan yang bu mo chos brgyad dang ldan na sems kyi khams mnyam par brgyad gang zhe na/ sems sa dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang / sems chu dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang / sems me dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang /sems rlung dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang / sems nam mkha' dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang / sems chos kyi dbyings dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang /sems rnam par grol ba dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir dang / sems mya ngan lasa'adas pa dang mtshungs par gyur pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni sems kyi khams mnyam pa nyid rnam pa brgyad ces bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sems ni sa dang mtshungs pas na/ /thams cad khur du khyer bar byed/ /dge ba dang ni sdig pa'ang rung / /'phel ba med cing 'grib pa med/ 7/༷mas ni chu dang mtshungs pas na/ /dri ma mi
gtsang 'khru byed cing / /'jig rten rnams ni gso ba dang / /nyon mongs gdung ba sel bar byed/ /sems ni me dang mtshungs pas na/ /nyon mongs dag ni sreg byed cing / /sgron ma chen po snang ba yis/ /gsal bar mi byed gang yang med/ /sems ni rlung dang mtshungs pas na/ /gnas pa med cing rten med par/ /tshul khrims thos pa'i dri yis ni/ /dus gsum kun tu khyab par byed/ /sems ni nam mkha' mtshungs pas na/ /lta ba spong zhing rnam par dag /thamasacad kun tu 'jug byed kyang / /bdud kyi rjes su 'brang mi byed/ /sems ni chos dbyings mtshungs pas na/ /bde ba nyid du rab gnas shing / /'phel ba med cing 'grib med par/ /rtag par mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi/ /rnam par grol ba thob gyur kyang / /'ching ba dag kyang yod min la/ /grol ba dag kyang yod pa min/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /'ong ba med cing 'gro med ces/ /rab dben nyer zhir gnas nas ni/ /dus gsum kun tu 'gro bar byed/ /gzhan yang bu mo chos rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ dang po ni sbyin pa 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ ci bdog pa rnams yongs su gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni tshul khrims 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ nyams pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni bzod pa 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ zhe snang med pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni brtson 'grusa'abyung gnasasu gyur pa yin te/le lo med cing nur ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni bsam gtan 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ thabs la mkhas pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa ni shes rab 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ tshul khrimasasrung zhing mang du thos pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa ni tshangspa'i gnas pa 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin 39/ rnam par grol bas nye bar zhi bar 'gyur
ba'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa ni mngon par shes pa 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ rtag par mnyam par bzhag pa la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasakyisayang tshigasasu bcad de bka' stsal pa/ rtag par sbyin pa gang gtong ba/ /'dod chags gdung ba spong bas na/ /'bras bu rnam smin mi re bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sngo bar byed/ /khrims ldan theg pa che ba'i phyir/ /bcad cing gtubs kyang khong khro med/ /rtse gcig bde chen gnyer byed cing / /bag chags spangs nas 'gog mngon med/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus can/ /bskal mang sems can ched du ni/ /sdug bsngal bzod cing 'jig rten rgyu/ /brtson 'grus stobs ni 'phel bar byed/ /bsam gtan dag ni gang sgom pa/ /spros pa rnams ni spong byed cing / /bsam gtan pha rol phyin gyur kyang / /bsam gtan rjes su yong mi skye/ stonaphurab chen po mtshungs med pas/ /mthar lta rnamsni spong byed cing / /'jig rten stong dben rig pas na/ /gti mug mun pa ma lusasel/ /nyer zhi tshangs gnas gang sgom pa/ /ngan song rnams sna spangs pas na/ /rtag par brgya byin tshangs par 'gyur/ /don gyi phan pa nan tan sgom/ /mngon shes sangs rgyas zhing rgyu ba/ /sangs rgyadradabasnyen bkur chos kyang nyan/ /rang bzhin mos pa rab shes pas/ /chosabashad semasacan zlosapar byed/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' ni chos brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir gzungs dang / thogs pa med pa'i slobs pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ chosal bla mar byed pa'i phyir dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon la rim gro byed pa'i phyir dang / chos yongs su gnyer ba la skyo ba med pa'i phyir dang / ji skad thos pa bzhin du yang dag par ston par byed pa'i phyir dang / chos la ser sna mi byed pa'i phyir dang / gzhan gyi nyes pa sgrogs pa~X mi byed pa'i phyir dang / chos smra ba dag la
mkhan po bzhin du gus pas sri zhu byed pa'i phyir dang / gzhan gyi nyes pa mi mthong zhing nyes pa spong bar skul bar byed pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' chos brgyad dang ldan na gzungs dang / thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par 'gyur ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ rtse gcig rtag tu chos gnyer ba/ /mkhan po dge bshes rim gro byed/ /sdig pa'i grogasapo spong bsan/ /mi zad gter 'dzin thob par 'gyur/ /mang thos yongs su skyo med par/ /rab brtson chosani gnyer bar byed/ /ji skad thosabazhin ston byed pas/ /rnyed pa dag la re tshol med/ /spobs pa rnam dag gang thob pa/ /'khor mang dga' bar byed pas na/ /chos sbyin pa la rab mos shing / /ser sna phrag dog spong bar byed/ /chos spyod mngon par zhen med cing / /gzungasani gang zhig thob 'gyur ba/ /khrimasasrung rang lusalta bsan/ /gzhan gyi nyesaskyon yong mi tshol/ /byamasadang snying rje gnasagyur cing / /dusamin tshig ni mi smra bas/ /thogasamed spobasapa thob gyur nas/ /spro tshig pha rol phyin pa ston/ /chosani legs par smra ba la/ /mkhan po bzhin du gus par byed/ /skyon 'chab nyes pa spong skul bas/ /mi zad kun 'dzin rgya mtsho 'thob/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' ni chos rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar pad ma las rdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ srog la bab par gyur kyang gzhan gyi nyes pa mi brjod pa dang /sems can rnamasadakon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar skul ba dang / thams cad byang chub kyi sems la 'god pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa la gos pa med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dag byas nas pad mo'i gdan la 'jog pa dang /sems can mya ngan byed pa dag gi mya ngan sel bar byed pa dang / khengs shing nga rgyal byed 81
pa dag gi mdun du rtag par bdag nyid dman par byed pa dang / gzhan la 'tshe bar mi byed pa gang yin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gal te sdug bsngal gzir gyur kyang / /nam yang gzhan gyi skyon mi smra/ /rtag par dkon mchog gang bsngagasapa/ /sangasargyasaspyan sngar rdzusate skye/ /byang chub semsni bskyed pa dang / /thamasacad mkhyen pa gnyer bskul nas/ /rtag par tshangs par gang spyod pa/ /sangasargyasaspyan sngar rdzusate skye/ /gser gyisasangasargyasagazugasabargyanate/ /rin chen pad ma'i gdan la bzhag /sems can mya ngan gang sel ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar rdzus te skye/ /nga rgyal byed pa de dag la/ /slob ma bzhin du bdag dman zhing / /gzhan la gang zhig mi 'tshe ba/ /sangasargyas spyan sngar rdzus te skye/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chosarnam pa brgyad dang ldan par gyur na sbyangs pa'i yon tan kun sum tshogasapar 'gyur zhing rtag par dgon pa na gnas pa la mosapar 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shesapa dang / dge ba'i chosayongs su rdzogs par gyur pa dang / dge bas bdag nyid gso bar byed pa dang / rtag par 'phags pa'i rigs yongs su 'dzin pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong bas sems la rtag par skyo ba dang / rtag par mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med par lta ba dang / dad pa shin tu brtan zhing gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa gang yin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pas/ /chos dga' dge mang bdag nyid gso/ /rtag par 'phagasarigs sgrub la mos/ /'khor ba'i skyon mthong semasal skrag /sbyangasapa dag la rtag modradapas/ /bse ru gcig ltar grogs kyang med/ /'dus byas sdug bsngal bdaka med ces/ /blo yisarab dang brtson 'grusaganas/ /chosamathongagazhan gyi rjesami 'brang / /82
rtag par dben gnadragasangadragargyadragabasngags/ /sbyangadra(pas thag bsrings gdung ba med/ /rtsod pa nyesadamigasamang po med/ /gnyen bshes yongs spangs bsngags pa rjod/ /des na dgon par gnas la mos/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' ni chos rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir bdud kyi dpung rab tu pham par byed do/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la zhugs pa dang / mtshan ma med pa la mngon par yid chesapa dang / smon pa med pa la mngon par yid chesapa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med par rab nyu shes pa dang / de la the tshom dang som nyi med pa dang / skye ba med par rab tu bzod pa dang / ngo bo nyid med par rab tu rtogs pa dang / thabs la ma/bas pas chos thams cad la so sor rtog cing de bzhin nyid 'jig par mi byed pa gang yin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ stong dang mtshan ma med dang smon med pa/ /rnam thar gsum thob bdud dpung rab tu 'joms/ /'dus byas 'dus min mtshan nyid gnyis su med/ /skye med thob pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /chosarnamasaskye med de ltar gang bzod pa/ /de dag bdud dpung rab tu pham par byed/ /skye ba med dang 'gag med 'di dag dang / /phung po khams la bdag med sgyu ma 'dra/ /chos la ngo bo nyid med rab tu rtogs/ /de bzhin nyid ni mi 'jig thabs ma/bas pas/ /chos rnams bdud kyi las zhes gang 'byed pa/ /rnam rtog spangs nas bdud ni pham par byed/ /thabs dang shesarab gnyis ka rab spyod cing / /yod dang stong la gnas pa med par ni/ /de ltar chodragamachog gang zhig sgom byed pa/ /thabs mkhas gzugasalusmdzes pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /chos rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir byang chub dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta bas log par lta ba'i sems can yongs su 83
smin par byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i dran pas log par sems pa'i semasacan la snying brtse bar byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag gis log par smra ba rnamasal snying brtse bar byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mthas log pa'i las can rnams yongs su sdud pa dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol bas log par rtsol ba rnams yongs su zlog pa dang yang dag pa'i 'tsho bsalog par 'tsho ba'i sems can rnamasaspong bar mi byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pas log par yid la byed pa spong bar byed pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge lhaX ṭ+wāṃ ༈ rdzu dzog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnasapa dag bslang nasagong du rtsol du gzhug pa de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ yang dag lta dang gang ldan pa/ /log lta de dag smin par byed/ /rtag par yang dag dran sgom pa/ /log semasadag la brtse bar byed/ /rnam dag yang dag dgagisani/ /log smra rnamasal bakhregabar byed/ /yangadag lasamatha'aganasapa yis/ /log pa'i lasacan sdud par byed/ /rtag par yang dag rtsol bsgoms nas/ /log brtson dag ni spong bar byed/ /yang dag 'tsho bas rjesamathun pas/ /log 'tsho gang yin sdud par byed/ /blo ldan yang dag rtog pa yis/ /log par yid byed brtse bar sems/ /yang dag ting 'dzin rtag gnas nas/ /log pa'i ting 'dzin sdud par byed/ /bla med yang dag lam brgyad kyis/ /chu bo dag la sgrol bar byed/ /rgyun phyogasaded pa zlog byed pas/ /de ni byang chub lam chen yin/ /nyan thosadang ni rang rgyal rnams/ / tswayi gzingasabazhin bdag nyid zlos/ /byang chub semsdpa' kun zlosapas/ /dper na gru chen 'dren mkhan 'dra/ /gzhan yang bu mo byang chub sems dpa' ni chos rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bdud rtsi'i lam mngon sum du byed par lañtsar ro/ / 84
brgyad gang zhe na/ rtsod pa med pa'i chos la gnas pa dang / thogasapa'i sems legasapar rab tu srung bar byed pa dang / rtag par de kho na nyid kyi don la lta bar byed pa dang / byang chub kyi semasal rab tu gnasanas/ rjes su dran pa drug sgom par byed pa dang / nanatan brtson 'phrusakyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnamasasgom par byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsab bsagasanasasemasacan yongasasu smin par byed pa dang / snying rje chen po la gnasnasayang dag pa'i chosayongasasu sdud par byed pa dang / mi skye ba'i chosal bzod pa thob nas/ phyir mi ldog pa la rab tu gnasapa gang yin pa'o/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasakyisyang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ rtag par rtsod med spyod bsgrubs nas/ /dge spyong chen polichosalaganas/ /zhe sdang nyesapa yongasaspangasanas/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba sogspar byed/ /yang dag don la rab lta bas/ /mi zad sbobs rnams 'thob par byed/ /byang chub semasal rabaganasanas/ /rtag par dran byed rjesasu dran/ /pha rol phyin pa thamadragacad la/ /rab brtson bsgrubs pas 'ordzog pa med/ /thabs mkhas stobs rnams thob pasan/ /desani semasacan sgrol bar byed/ /chosakyi mnga' bdag nor gyisani/ /brtse semasathamasacad kun sdud pas/ /myur du mi skye bzod thob nas/ /byang chub lasani ldog mi 'gyur/ /galarta de ltar spyod nusan/ /sangasargyasachosani thob mi dka'/ /ring por mi thogasabadud btul nas/ /byang chub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bu mo des chos de lta bu thos nas dga' mgu rangasapar gyur nas bcom ldan 'dasal 'di skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos du dang ldan par gyur na bud med kyi dngosapo lasaldog par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/bu slo chos brgyad dang ldan par gyur na bud med kyi dngos po las ldog par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ phrag dog mi byed pa dang / ser sna mi byed pa dang / g.yo sgyu med pa dang /85
khong khro ba med pa dang / bden par smra ba dang / ngag rtsub po mi smra ba dang / 'dod chags spangasapa dang / log par lta ba rnamasaspangasapa gang yin pa ste/ bu mo chosabargyad po 'di dag mngon par bsgrubs na/ myur du bud med kyi dngos po las ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gzhan la phrag dog mi byed cing / /ser sna spangasanasachosamosadang / /g.yosgyu dag ni mi spyod cing / /bud med lusal skyo ba dang / /byams semadragazhe sdang rab sbangs nas/ /rtag par bden tshig smra ba dang / /'dod bsal ngag rtsub spangasanasani/ /yang dag lta laganasapar bya/ /gang gis bud med lus skyo nas/ /'di 'dra'i chos ni sgrub byed na/ /myur du bud med dngos spangs nas/ /skyes pa'i lus bzang len par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bu mo chos brgyad dang ldan par gyur na/ bud med kyi dngosapo lasaldog par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ sangasargyas la bla mar byed cing / chosal shin tu mosapa dang / tshul khrims dang /bzod pa dang / mang du thosapa dang ldan pa'i dge spyong dang bram ze dag la bsnyen bkur dang rim gro byed pa dang / skyesapa dang / bud med dang / khyim gyi dngos po dag la mngon par zhen cing / chags pa med pa dang / bslab pa'i dngos po yang dag par blangs pa rnams 'jig par mi byed pa dang / srog chags rnams la log pa'i bsam pa mi skyed pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pas bud med kyi dngos po la yongs su skyo bar 'gyur ba dang /byang chub kyi sems kyisaskyesabu chen polichosal gnasapa dang / 'jig rten pa'i khyim gyi 'tsho chas rnams la sgyu ma lta bu dang rmi lam lta bur lta ba gang yin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas rab gus chos la mos/ /tshul khrims mang thos bla mar byed/ /'dod chags sred sems mi skyed na/ /bud med dngos po myur du spong / /khrimasasrung ngo tsha khrel yod ldan/ /gzhan la mi bden bsam 86
mi byed/ /byang chub semasal rab gnasanas/ /theg pa gzhan la mosamed na/ /desani myur ba kho nar yang / /mi gtsang bud med dngosapo spong / /bsam pa mchog gis sems skyo nas/ /thamasacad sgyu ma lta bu dang / /chos rnamasarang bzhin g.yo med dang / /rgyu rkyen rang bzhin stong dben zhes/ /nan tan yang dag chos bsgoms na/ /myur du skyes pa'i lusa'athob 'gyur/ /de nas bu mo rnam dag dad pasagaser gyi phreng ba thogs pa de darga bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor ba dang / steng gi bar snang la gser yang dag pa'i gzhal med khang / khang pa brtsegs pa dag tu gyur nas gzhal med khang de dag gi nang na sprul pa'i de bzhin gshegaphupa gser gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ sha stag mngon du byung bar gyur to/ /de nasabu mo lnga brgya po de dag gis kyang so so nas/ lus kyi rgyan rnams bkrol nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor ba dang / steng gi bar snang la rguser gyi gzhal med khang dang / rin po che'i gur dang / rin po che'igadugasadang / bkod pa rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur to/ /de nasabu mo lnga brgya po de dag gis de lta bu'i cho 'phrul chen po mthong ba dang / skad mthun par tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bcom ldan mi mchog khyad par 'phagaphupas na/ /zugadragarjes semasacan rnamasal sman par mjad/ /bdag cas deng ni byang chub semasabaskyed nas/ /mos pa rjes mthun rab tu dul la gnas/ /bcom ldan 'dren pa bde ba rab stsol ba/ /bdag cag mi mchog la ni mchod par bgyi/ /chos thos dbang gis rdul rnams rab spangs nas/ /bdag cag the tshom rnam nur yongs ma mchis/ /desan bud med nyon mongs mang spangasanas/ /nyon mongs gtan bcom bdud ni pham par bgyi/ /phyogasabacu'i sangasargyas bye ba tshad med rnams/ /bdag cag dga' bas rtag tu mchod par 'tshal/ /sbyin dang phrul khrims brtson 'grus rab gnas nas/ /
