bzod dang bsam gtan semasani rab tu bgyi/ /thabs dab shephurab semasacan yongsbsdus nas/ /byang chub mchog lam gang lags mngon du bgyi/ /lha mi'i 'khor ni tshad med sman btags nas/ /thams cad theg chen sems ni bskyed par bskul/ /bdag cag seng ge'i sgra ni sgrogasapar 'gyur/ /bdag cag lha mi'i ston pa bgyid par mchi de nasabacom ldan 'dasa'adzum pa mdzad do/ /sangasargyasarnamasakyi chosanyid ni nam 'dzum pa mdzad pa na 'od zer kha dog rnam pa sna tshogasa'adi lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / dngul dang / shel gyi kha dog lta bu dag de bzhin gshegasapa'i zhal gyi sgo nas byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khamasatshad med dpag tu med pa dag nas/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du khyab par snang bar byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gtsug tu thim par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu rkyen gang gi slad du 'dzum pa 'di lta bu bstan par mdzad lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis bu mo rnam dag dad pa 'di mthong ngam/ kun dga' bos gsol pa/ mthong lagsson/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo bu mo rnam dag dad pa la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po 'di dag ni/ 'di nasatshe zad pa dang / bud med kyi lusaspangs nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris su skye ste/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa dang / bskal pa bzang po'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bkur sti dang / rim gro dang / mchod pa byed par 'gyur bsabu mo rnam dag dad pas bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dasapa'i 'og tu 'jig rten kyi khams glo/8 gi 'od ces bya bar mngon par rdzogs par
'tshang rgyabar 'gyurate/ debazhinagashegasapa 'odazer gyi bkod pa zhesabya bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa'i ming ni rtag par snang ba zhesabya'o/ /de bzhin gshegasapa de'i sku che'i tshad ni dga' ldan gyi lha bzhin du/ tshe lo stong phrag bcu gnyis thub par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khamasade na yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'ba' zhig gi 'khor tshad med dpag tu med pa dag gis gabor byed par 'gyur ro/ /bu mo lnga brgya po 'di dag kyang 'bor de dag gi nang na gtso bo mchog byed par 'gyurahe/ ji ltar da ltaranga'i tshe byang chub semasadapa' 'jam dpal la sogasapa drug napo 'di dag gtso bor gyur pa bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo bud medagang la la zhig chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi thosanasayongasasu 'dzin par byed/ klog par byed/ kha ton du 'don par byed na bud med kyi lusa'adi dag gtugasanasaphyisayang len par mi k+ṣ+ṇā ) mi ༈ hūm̐ spri tsho zlor smi pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogsbcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bu mo rnam dag dad pa la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la rab tu dga' nas mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen (lichos kyi rnalha grangs (lha / rdzoṭ+wāṃ /phrag brgya pa las bu mo rnam dag dad pas zhus pa' le'u ste ba bcu pa 89
༄tsho/ /dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog cesabya bsaston pa la zab moliganas lugasalas brtsamasate dri ba rgya cher mdzad rjesabu mo 'khor dang bcasapa rab tu byung nas lhag med du mya ngan las 'dasapa'i tshul/mdo sde dkon mchogabartsegasapa'i le'u sogacugs lasabatus/'di skad bdag gisa'os pa dusagacig na/ bcom ldan 'dasamanyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon medazasasbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugasate/ de'i tshe grong khyer chen po mnyan yod na dge bsnyen ma gang grwa'i mchog ces bya ba zhig gnasaso/ /de nas dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mtshog mnyan yod nas byung nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zasasbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der song ste phyin nasabacom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bosaphyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisar/khyen bzhin du dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog la gang gā'i mchog khyod da gzod gang nasa'ongs zhes smrasaso/ /gang grwa'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig gis sprul pa la smras te/ khyod da gzod gang nas 'ongs zhes de skad bgyis na ji skad lan 'debs par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog sprul pa la ni 'greng ba med/ 'dug pa med/ nyal ba med/ 'ong ba med/ 'gro ba med/ 'chi 'pho med/skye ba med na 'di nas 'ongs so zhes de ci zhig ston par 'gyur/ gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom lda na 'das ci chos thamaX ༷da sprul pa lta bu lags sam/ bka' stsal
pa / gang grwa'i mchog de bzhin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'dasagal te chos thams cad sprul pa lta bu lags na/ gang gā'i mchog khyod da gzod gang nas 'ongs zhes ci'i slad du smra/ bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog sprul pa ni ngan song du mi 'gro/ mtho risasu mi 'gro/ yongs su mya ga lasa'adasapar mi 'gro na ci gang gā'i mchog kyang ༅ song du mi 'gro/ mtho ris su mi 'gro/ yongasasu mya ngan lasa'adasapar mi 'gro 'am/ gang gā'i mchog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gis dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog sprul pa'i rang bzhin lasagazhan lags par mthong na ni dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog ngan song du mchi ba'am mtho ris su mchi ba'am yongs su mya ngan lasa'adasapar mchi ba ma lagasaso zhesabadag sprul pa dang bstun du yang mi rung lags na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dge bsnyen ma gang grwa'i mchog sprul pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan lags par ma mthong ste/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis ma mthong na dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog ngan song du mchi ba'am/ mtho risasu mchi ba'am/yongs su mya ngan lasa'adasapar mchi ba zhesaji skad bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'dasde lta lags kyis kyang g.yo ba dang / rlom sems dang / bskyod pa dang / sprosapa mchis na ji ltar 'di snyam du bdag ga song du 'gro ba'am/ mtho rir+sāsu 'gro ba'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'o snyam du sems lags te/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings ni nam yang ngan song du mchi ba'am/ mtho ris su mchi ba'am/yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog kyang de lta bu'i dbyings can lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang grwa'i mchog khyod ci yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la yang dag par ma zhugs sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das su zhig 91
gisami skye ba la smrasate/ khyod yongasasu mya ngan lasa'adasapa la yang dag par ma zhugssam zhes de skad bgyis na ji skad lan 'debasapar 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'daskyisabaka' stsal pa/ gangaka'i mchog mi skye ba zhesabya ba ni mya ngan lasa'adas pa'i tshig bla dgas yin na de ci zhig lan 'debasapar 'gyur/ gang gā'i mchog gisagasol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci chos thams cad ni mya ngan las 'das pa dang mtshungs pa lagssam/ bka' stsal pa/ gangagwa'i mchog de de bzhin te/ chosathamasacad ni mya ngan las'dasapa dang mtshungasaso/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'dasagal te chosathamasacad mya ngan las 'das pa dang mtshungs pa lags na gang gā'i mtshog khyod yongs su mya ngan las 'dasapa la yang dag par ma zhugasasam zhesang ci zhig smra ste/ bcom ldan 'dasasu zhig gisasprul pa la smrasate/ khyod yongasasu mya ngan lasa'adas pa la yang dag par ma zhugssam zhes de skad bgyisan ji skad lan 'debasapar 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'daskyisabaka' stsal pa/ gangagwa'i mchog dri ba 'di ni dmigasapa med pa'o/ /gsol pa/ ci bcom ldan 'das kyis dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i smra bas smras lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog dri ba 'di ni dmigs pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'khor 'di na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo 'du ba dag yod de/ de dag gi don chen por 'gyur bas dris so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gā'i mchog de bzhin gshegs pas ni chos nyid ces bya ba yang mngon par rdzogasapar sangs ma rgyasan gang de lasabyung ba'i chosayongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas pa lta ga la yod/ gsol pa/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis chosanyid ces bgyi ba yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas te/ de lasbyung ba'i chosalta gang zhig mchis par gyur na bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi slad du ji ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrubs lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 92
stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog gang dmigs pa de ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba de ni gang gi tshe yang dag par sgrub pa de'i tshe yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid mi 'dor ro/ /gang gi tshe yang dag par mi sgrub pa de'i tshe yang bsam gyisami khyab pa nyid mi 'dor ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'dasabasam gyisami khyab pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bgyi ba ci'i slad du bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bsam gyismi khyab pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog chos 'di ni sems pasathob par bya ba ma yin te/ sems pas thob par byar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar 'di la ni sems nyid kyang mi dmigs na gang sems las ge ba tu byung ba'i chos lta ga la yod/ gang gā'i mchog sems mi dmigs nga ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud gang yin pa de ni thob pa ma yin/ mngon par rtogs pa ma yin/ shes pa ma yin/ mngon sum du byas pa ma yin te/ de ni thob par bya ba ma yin/ kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin rnam par byang ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gang gā'i mchog 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pas ni chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar nges par thugs su chud de/ gang gā'i mchog chos thams cad ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa gnyen po med pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa gnyen po ma mchisapa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis gzugs zhes btags pa dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnamasadang rnam par shes pa zhesabatags pa dang / phung po rnamasadang / khamasarnamasadang / skye mched rnams dang /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / zag pa dang bcasapa dang / zag pa ma mchis pa dang /kun nasanyon mongasapa dang / rnam par bya raṃ dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das
pa zhes btags pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog 'di lta ste dper na bdag bdag ces 'dogs kyang bdag gang yang mi dmigasapa de bzhin du gang gā'i mchog ngas gzugs zhes btags te gzugs gang yang mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du ngasatshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnamasadang / rnam par shes pa zhes btags te rnam par shes pa gang yang mi dmigs so/ /phung po rnams dang / khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang /zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / kun nasanyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan lasa'adas pa zhesabya ba yang ngasabatags te mya ngan las 'das pa gang yang mi dmigs so/ /gang gā'i mchog 'di lta ste dper na smig rgyu rnams la ni chu yang med de mi dmigs so/ /gang gā'i mchog de bzhin du ngas gzugs zhes bya bar btags kyang gzugs gang yang mi dmigs so/ /ngas tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa zhes btags kyang rnam par shes pa gang yang mi dmigs so/ /phung po rnamasadang / khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang /kun nas nyon mongasapa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya bar ngas btags kyang don dam par na de dag thams cad med cing mi dmigs so/ /gang gā'i mchog gang chos la mchog tu 'dzin pa med par changs par spyad pa spyod pa de lta bu ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la changs par spyod pa la gnas pa yin no/ /gang gā'i mchog mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gnas dmigs nas tshangs par spyad par spyod pa de dgagi tshangasapar spyod pa de ni yongasasu ma dag pa'o zhesang smra'o/ /gang dag changs par spyod pa yongs su ma dag pa de dag ni zab mo rgyud chad pa'i chos 'di 94
lta bu 'di thos na dngangasaskrag par 'gyur te/ de dag skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las yongs su mi 'grol te/ de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi skal ba can du 'gyur ro zhes nga smra'o/ /gang gā'i mchog da ltar ram nga 'das pa'i phyi na yang rung ste/gang dag zab mo rgyud chad pa 'di lta bu'i chos ston pa de dag la mi/ gti mug pa dag gsod pa poli'adu shes bskyed par 'gyur te/ de ltar mi gti mug pa de dag log par zin pas bsad pa'i zhe ldang bskyed nas ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gā'i mtshog gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyud chad pa rgyud chad pa zhes bgyi ba ci'i slad du rgyud chad pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gā'i mchog chos 'di ni rgyud gcad pa'am/ dbye ba'am/ rnam par gzhig pa ma yin te/ de'i phyir rgyud chad pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nasa'od zer kha dog sna tshogasakha dog du ma 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / btsod ka dang / shel dang / dngul gyi /ba dog lta bu dag byung nas de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag snang bad byas te 'od kyis khyab par byas nasachangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par byung ste slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgor nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugadraganas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 'ordzogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad /sna gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin
gshegs pa rnamaphuni rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ngas mngon par shes te/ sa phyogs 'di nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa stong gis gang gā'i mchog cesabya ba kho na'i dge bsnyen ma sha stag las brtsams te/ chos kyi rnam grangasa'adi bshad do/ /dge bsnyen ma de dag thams cad ni rab tu byung nasaphung po med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyingasasu yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangasa'adi ni dri ma med pa zhesabya ste/ 'di dri ma med pa zhesabya bar zungasashig chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi bstan pa na dge slong bdun brgya dang /dge slong ma bzhi brgya len pa med par zag pa rnams ladragasems rnam par grol 'o1/ /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis lha'i me tog rnams dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma rnams mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das la gtor nasatshig 'di skad cesa'adi ltar grong khyer mnyan yod na dge bsnyen ma 'di lta bu gnas la de de bzhin gshegs pa dang lhan cig tu smra yang de'i lus ngal bar yang mi 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar yang gang gā'i mchog 'di sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas shing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / yun ring po nas dge ba spyad pa dang / yun ring po nas changs par spyad pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa 'di ni ngo mtshar to zhes smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu dag de de bzhin te/ 'di ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ ༷ge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ yun ring du tshangs
par spyad pa la gnadragapa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i mchog dang / lha dang / mi dang lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangasate/ bcom ldan 'dasakyisagasungasapa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen polichos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong lha/ shā gā pa las gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa'i le'u zhes bya ste sum cu rtsa gcig pa
༄9ñdza/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pa zhesabya bas shā ri'i bu sogs theg pa chung ngu'i nyan thos dag la gusapa ma byas par theg pa chen po'izab mo'igatam gyi dri ba dri lan mdzad pa'i skor/mdo sde dkon mchogabartsegasapa'i le'u soganyisapa lasabatsos/rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a sho ka dat+ta byā ka ra ṇa nā ma ma hā rdza na gu tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa mya ngan med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gisathosapa dusagacig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal polikhab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' brgyad stong thams cad kyang gzungs thob pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa/ mngon par shes pa sgrub pa la mkhasapa/ chos zab mo'i tshul la gnas pa stong pa nyid la gnas pa/mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa/ smon pa med pa la gnas pa/ mi dmigs pa'i chos la gnasapa/ mi gnasapar chosaston pa/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' lhun po dang / byang chub sems dpa' lhun po chen po dang / byang chub semasadapa' ye shesalhun po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen seng ge dang / byang chub sems dpa' seng ge blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu lag brkyang dang / byang chub sems dpa'anya stag tu lag bsgreng dang / byang chub sems
dpa' rtagasgyu brtson dang / byang chub semasadapa' rtag tu 'dzum zhing rab tu dga' ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' dbang po las 'das pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu gdung dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen sems dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin chen dang / byang chub semasadapa' lag na rin chen thogs dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen bkra ldan dang / byang chub sems dpa' kha lo sgyur dang / byang chub sems dpa' kha lo sgyur chen po dang / byang chub semasadapa' bden nga la dga' ba dang / byang chub semasadapa' byamasapa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dang la bzhor nur gyur pa dang / skyes bu dam pa brgyad la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dang 'a bzang skyo nga dang /byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang / byang chub sems dpa' phug sbasadang / byang chub semasadapa' dbang polilha dang / byang chub sems dang 'a chu lha'i lha dang / byang chub semasadapa' blo grosayangs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros khyad par can dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros 'phel dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' brgyad stong dang thabadragacig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'dasargyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po na gnas shing bzhugs pa la rgyal po ma skyesadagra dang / rgyal po'i bka' la gtogs pa dang / blon po dang / sna chen po la gtogasapa dang / shad blon gyi bu tsha dang / zhagasadrung na 'khod pa dang /pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis bsti stang du byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod par byas te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos bstan pa 'ji lta ste/ changs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/99
yongasasu byang ba rab tu ston to/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa byamasama'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye bar 'khor dang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin dang / tshe dang ldan pa nam gru dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gagasapa dang / de dag dang gzhan yang nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po rnams snga dro3dus kyi tshe chos gos dang sham thabs bgosanas lhung bzed thogs te rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ /de nas nyan thos chen po de dag rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen por mthar chagasasu bsod snyomasakyi phyir rgyu zhing mthar gyisargyal po ma skyesadagra'i pho brang ga la ba der dong ste lhags nasaphyogs gcig tu cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i pho brang na bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa zhes bya ba btsas nadraga'ordzo bcu gnyis 'o1na pa 'dra ba gsags bzang ba/ mdzedrangapa/ lta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa de rang gi pha'i khang bzang na khri gser gyi rkang pa can yod pa la 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas nyan 'os chen po de dag mthong na khri de las ma langadragate bstsur yang mi 'a17/ phyag kyang mi byed/ gtam yang mi zer/ stan yang mi 'ding bsod snyomasayang mi 'bul bar kha rog ste 'dug go /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras nyan 'thos chen po de dag rgyal po'i pho brang du 'ongs zhes pos nas rang gi khang bzang ga snga khang ga la ba der song ste ༷༷ nasanyan thosachen po de dag la mchog tu
sdug par 'dzin pasamangon par dga' zhing stan yang bting ngo / /rgyal po ma skyes dgrasbu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pasanyan thosachen po de dag mthong bzhin du kha rog ste 'dug pa mthong nasabu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pa la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bu mo 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasashākya thub pa de'i nyan posachen po ste/ che ba nyid kyi yon tan gyi chos dang ldan pa/zag pa3da pa/ bya ba byasapa/ byed pa byasapa/ khur bor ba bdag gi don rjesasu thob pa/srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongasasu zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shesapasasemasashin tu rnam par grol ba/ bsod namasakyi zhing du gyur pa/ snying brtse ba can yin te/ 'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir bsod snyomasakyi phyir rgyu ba khyod kyisami shesasam/ ci na khyod kyisade dag mthong la/ mthong bzhin du khri las kyang mi ldang / bstsu bar yang mi byed phyag kyang mi 'tshal/ gtam yang mi zer/ stan dang bsod snyomasal yang spyan mi 'dren/ dad pa dang gusapa yang mi skyed par ci'i phyir ma gusapa ston cing kha rog ste 'dug khyod kyisadon gyi dbang ci zhig mthong / de skad cesasmrasapa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas rang gi pha rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab 'di ji snyam du dgongs/ ci 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rgyal phran la ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchi ba nam yang gsan tam/ gzigasasam/ rgyal posasmrasapa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smrasapa/ yab ci lha'i dbang po brgya byin lhagazhan dag la ldang ba'am/ bsgyur mchi'am/ rgyal posasmrasapa/bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mosasmrasapa/ yab ci mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa lha gzhan dag la ldang ngam/ bsnar mchi'am/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ci rgya mtsho chen po mtsho dang / mtshe'u dang / chu mig dang / mtsho phran dang /lteng ka dang / khran pa la phyag 'tshal ba gsan tam/ gzigs sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/101
bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mosasmras pa/ yab ci ri'i rgyal po ri rab ri nag po gzhan dag la 'dud pa'am/ phyag 'tshal ba gsanalhom/ gzigasasam/ rgyal pos smrasapa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mosasmrasapa/ yab ci nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / skar ma'i tshogasasrin bu me khyer gyi 'od 'dod pa gsan tam/ gzigs sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mosasmrasapa/ yab ci ri dwagasakyi rgyal po seng ge wa la ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchi ba gsan tam/ gzigs sam/ rgyal posasmrasapa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab de bzhin du su zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen poliseng ge'i sgra bsgrags la dman pa la mos pa'i nyan thos wa lta bur gyur pa byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang bral ba dag la dga' zhing ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchi ba'am/ phyag 'chal ba'am/bkur sti bgyid/ yab chos kyi rgyal po chen po su zhig chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor tam/ skor bar bgyid pa na nyan thosadaman pa/ zhan pa zhum pa/ nyi tshe ba'i shes pa dang ldan pa rnams la dga' baphuphyag 'tshal ba'am/ 'dud pa bgyid/ yab lha'i bdag po lha'i dbang po lta bu su zhig rnam par dag pa'i lha'i bdag po don du gnyer ba na dge ba chung ba'i lha lta bu'i nyan thos dag la 'dod pa'am/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ ldang ba'am/bgyur mchi bar bgyid/ yab mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangasapa lta bu su zhig 'jig rten na changs pa'i snga khang bla na med pa don du gnyer ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ba'i tshangs pa lta bu'i nyan thos dag la 'dod pa'am/ ldang ba'am/ bsgyur mchi ba'am/ phyag 'tshal bar bgyid/ yab su zhig ye shes rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i chos rtogs pa tshol ba na ba lang gi rmig rjes kyi chu lta bu'i tshul khrimasakyi rjes su song ba'i nyan thos dag la 'dod pa'am/ ldang ba'am/ bstsur mchi ba'am/ phyag 'tshal bar bgyid/102
yab su zhig ri rab lta bu'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi sku don du gnyer ba na yungs 'bru lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang ldan pa'i nyan thos dag la ldang ba'am/ bsnar mchi ba'am/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ 'dud pa'am/ 'dod pa skyed par bgyid/ yab su zhig sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'dasarnamasakyi che ba nyid shesarab dang / bsod namasadang / ye shesadang / yon tan nyi ma dang zla ba'i snang ba dpag tu med pa lta bu thos nasasrin bu me khyer gyi 'od lta bu rang gi rgyud la snang ba gnas pa gzhan gyi sgra'i rjes su song ba'i nyan thos dag gi rnam par grol ba la 'dod pa skyed par bgyid/ bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnamasayongasasu mya ngan las 'das kyang nyan thos rnams la phyag mi 'tshal na bzhugs bzhin du lta ci smos/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ su zhig zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor btang ste srin bu me khyer la phyag 'tshal bar bgyid/ yab gang nyan thosal sten pa ni nyan thosakyi semasadang gnaspar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bsten na thams cad mkhyen pa'i rin po che'i semasabaskyed pa dang gnasapar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar khyod nyan thosa'adi dag mthong bzhin du mi ldang zhing bstsur mi 'gro la phyag mi 'tshal zhing bsnyen bkur mi byed de/ 'di dag stan dang / bsod snyoms la spyan mi 'dren pa ni bu mo khyod lhag pa'i nga rgyal can zhig go /de skad ces smras pa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pasarang gi pha rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /yab bdag ni lhag pa'i nga rgyal can ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yab khyod nyid grong khyer gyi dbul po rnams la mi bzhengs/ bstsur mi bzhud/ stan mi 'dings pa las na khyod nyid lhag pa'i nga rgyal can lags pa snyam bgyid do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de 103
dag ni nga dang mtshungasapa ma yin no/ /bu mosasmrasapa/ yab de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' semasadang po bskyed pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thamasacad dang mtshungs pa ma lagasaso/ /rgyal posasmras pa/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' rnamasani nga rgyal dang dregasapa spangasate semasacan thamasacad la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal bar mi byed dam/ bu mosasmras pa/ yab byang chub sems dpa' ni 'khon du 'dzin pa dang / tha ba dang / khro ba dang / gnod semasadang / nyesapa spang ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongasasu smin par bgyid pa'i slad du sems can thamasacad la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab nyan thosachen po 'di dag la ni 'khon du 'dzin pa dang / tha ba dang / khro ba dang / gnod semasadang / nyespa bsal bar bgyi ba ma mchis/ spang bar bgyi ba dang / dge ba 'phel bar bgyi ba yang ma mchis te/ yab nyan thos thams cad la ni sangs rgyas 'bum gyis nyan thos kyi tshul khrimasaji snyed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ji snyed pa dang / shesarab ji snyed pa'i chos bstan du lagasakyang / yab de dag la ni tshul khrims kyang ga las mchi/ ting nge 'dzin kyang ga las mchi/ shes rab kyang ga las mchi/ rnam par grol ba yang ga las mchi/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba yang ga las mchi/ yab 'di lta ste dper na bum pa chab kyis gtams pa'i nang du char bab na de chab kyi thigs pa gcig kyang mi len la/ der gnas par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /yab de bzhin du nyan thosarnams la gal te sangasargyas 'bum gyis chos bshad du lags kyang de dag 'dzin par yang mi 'gyur la tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shārnyisna snang ba yang de dag la gnas par mi 'gyur zhing rnam par 'phel bar yang mi yab 'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni chu klung thams cad dang / char gyi rgyun 104
thamasacad 'dzin cing der gnasapar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni chad ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /yab byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgya mtsho lta bu de dag kyang de bzhin te/ chos bstan pa'i chu thams cad yang dag par 'dzin cing chosabastan pa thamasacad de la yang dag par gnasaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi semasakyi snod deni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i slad du'o/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ /ma skyes dgra'i bu mor gyur pa ni/ /mya ngan med spyan yon tan gzi brdzid brgyan/ /nyan thos lnga brgya dag ni lhags gyur kyang / /de la phyag bya'i phyir ni de ma langs/ /ma skyes dgra yisade la smrasapa ni/ /bu mo don 'di nga lasamanyan par gyis/ /khyod kyisanyan thoslnga brgya mthong bzhin du/ /phyag bya'i phyir na ci phyir ldang mi byed/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin na re/ /nyan thosa'adi dag bdag gisamathong ba na/ /ci phyir phyag 'tshal bsam pa mi skye ba/ /bdag mchisayab cig tshig ni gsan par gsol/ /dper na mi zhig rgya mtshor mchisanasakyang / /rin chen 'byung khung nasani mching bu blangs/ /de bzhin bdag ni nyan thos thams cad kyang / /ye shes dbyings nas nyan thos blangs snyam bgyid/ /dper na rgyal po nor gyi dbang phyug po/ /phubadag 'khor los sgyur ba mnyes bgyisanas/ /kār ṣā pā ṇa gcig tsam gsol na ni/ /de yis rgyal po bsten pa don ma mchis/ /gang gis 'khor losasgyur ba mnyesabagyis nas/ /bye ba phrag stong gsol ba bgyisan ni/ /des ni dbul mang nor dang ldan par bgyid/ /des ni rgyal po legs par bsten pa lags/ /kār khi pā ṇa slong ba'i mi bzhin du/ /gang gis sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas rnams/ /thos nas theg pa dman la 'dod skyed pa/ /nyan thos kun la bdag ni de snyam bgyid/ /nor rnamasasgrub bgyid mi ni ji lta ba/ /byang chub semasadapa' mkhas pa de 'dra ste/ /rgyal 1()5
ba chos kyi rgyal po mnyes bgyis shing / /byang chub reg nas sems can 'dul bar bgyid/ /dper na nad pa nad brgyas gzir rnamasasman pa yis/ /grol bgyid de bzhin gzhan gyi sgra phyir 'brang ba yi/ /nyan thos nyon mongs rnams kyis gzir ba thams cad kyang / /byang chub sems dpa' sman pa lta bus grol bar bgyid/ /sems can mang po grol bgyid sman pa btang nas ni/ /sos gyur sems can la ni su zhig 'dud par bgyid/ /de bzhin rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasasman par gnyer ba na/ /sosagyur nyan thos la ni su zhig 'dud par bgyid/ /'di ltar nad pa sos par gyur pa thams cad la/ /sman pa dag gisagaso bar nusapar mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin nyan thosathamasacad sosapar gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyasasman pa dag gis gso bar mi spyod do/ /'di na sman pa gang zhig bdag gis bdag nyid la/ /gso bar semasakyi sems can gzhan la ma lags te/ /de 'dra'i bdag nyid 'gengs par bgyid pa'i nga rgyal gyi/ /sman pa de dag la ni 'dod pa'i sems mi skyed/ /sman pa gang zhig snying rje bskyed nas bdag nyid ji lta bar/ /de bzhin pha rol rnams kyang nad las grol bgyid pa/ /de ni mchod par 'os shing bsngags par bgyi ba dang / /'jig rten kun gyis 'dud par bgyi ba'i gnasakyang lags/ /gang zhig ye shes rig pa gtso bo rtogs gyur nas/ /bdag nyid grol bar bgyid kyi sems can gzhan ma lags/ /de ni sman pa bdag nyid grol bar bgyi ba ltar/ /mkhas pa dag gis mchod par bgyi ba'i gnas ma lags/ /gang zhig ye shes rig pa gtso bo rtogs gyur nas/ /sems can grangs med sdug bsngal dag las grol bgyid pa/ /de dag byang chub mchog la 'dun pa skyed pa ste/ /de ni 'jig rten kun gyis bsngags par bgyi ba lags/ /e ran da yi shing sdong mdzes pa ma lags rna khu/ /de dag rnams kyi grib ma 'ang yangs pa ma lags te/ /e ran da yi shing 'dra nyan thos 106
thams cad kyi/ /rnam par grol ba'i grib ma nye bar bsten ma lags/ /tsan dan mchog gi sdong chen dag ni tsha ba yis/ /gdungs pa'i skye bo rnamasakyi nye bar bsten pa lags/ /de bzhin bdag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /lha dang bcasapa'i 'jig rten dag gi don bgyid snyam/ /ba lang rmig rjes chu ni yangs ma lags/ /tsha bas gdungs pa zhi bar mi bgyid la/ /gang gā'i klung ni sems can bye ba stong / /tshim par bgyisanas rgya mtsho chen por mchi/ /ba lang rmig rjesachu 'dra'i nyan thos kun/ /sems can kun gyi tsha ba zhi mi bgyid/ /gang gā'i klung 'dra byang chub semasadapa' rnams/ /semasacan mtha' yaschos kyis tshim par bgyid/ /ji ltar rin chen char ni 'bab pa na/ /dbul po dag ni 'gron bu len par bgyid/ /gang zhig nor mang de dag blangs nas ni/ /sems can dbul po nor dang ldan par bgyid/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rin chen chos char 'bebs/ /nyan thos rnams ni dam chos rin chen las/ /chung ngu 'dzin te byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sems can don slad mang du len par bgyid/ /ji ltar sems can dag ni ri rab kyi/ /drung du mchisan gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur/ /ri bo gzhan la semasacan rnams mchis na/ /gser gyi kha dog can du yong mi 'gyur/ /byang chub semasadapa' rnamasani ri rab bzhin/ /gang dag mthus ni lhar bcas skye dgu rnams/ /rnam grol mdog tu kha dog gcig tu 'gyur/ /nyan thos rnams kyi ye shes 'dod mi bgyid/ /yab cig ji ltar rtswa bran rtse mo yi/ /zil pa'i thigs pas lo tog rgyas mi bgyid/ /rab tu khebs pa'i sprin gyis sa steng 'di/ /tshim par bgyid cing lo tog 'phel bar bgyid/ /nyan thos thams cad zil pa'i thigs pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab khebs sprin dang 'dra/ /snying rje mngon byas gang dag bsten na ni/ /stong gsum dam chos chu yis tshim par bgyid/ /ka ge bi ra'i me tog dri mchog min/ /des ni skyes pa bud med dga' mi 'gyur/ /cam pa ka yi me /07
tog dri la dga'/ /yud pal bal shi ka yang de bzhin no/ /nyan thos ka ra bi ra'i dri bzhin te/ /de dag shes pas skye dgu dga' mi 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen dri can byang chub sems dpa' la/ /lha dang mi rnams rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /gcig pu mchi ba de la mtshar ci mchi/ /gang zhig semasacan mtha' yasakhrid pa rmad/ /nyan thosami reng gcig pu mchi ba bzhin/ /byang chub semasadapa' rnamasani ded dpon 'dra/ /mgron zhig gzhan gyis stsal ba 'tshal ba dang / /skye bo kun la stsol bgyid kun mgron bzhin/ /sgra 'brang nyan thosakun ni 'gron dang 'dra/ /byang chub semasadapa' kun la mgron bgyid bzhin/ /gzings la brten pas chu bo chen po las/ /gzhan dag bsgral bar nus par mi 'gyur gyi| |brtan bgyis gru yi nang du zhugs nas ni/ /sems can bye ba mang po sgrol bar bgyid/ /nyan thosagazingasal brten pa lta bu ste/ /semasacan gzhan dag sgrol bar ji ltar nus/ /rdzogasapa'i byang chub grur zhugs byang chub sems/ /sdug bsngal mtsho las semaphucan sgrol bar bgyid/ /ji ltar g.yul ngor bong bu zhon na ni/ /dgra lasargyal bar nus par mi 'gyur gyi/ /glang chen rta dang shing rta zhon na ni/ /g.yul du lhags pa'i dgra rnams choms par nus/ /nyan thos rnams ni bong bu zhon pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' glang chen zhon 'dra ste/ /sems can kun la phan dang bde slad du/ /de dag shing dbang drung du bdud kyang 'joms/ /ji ltar bar snang skar mas rgyas gyur kyang / /de dag gis ni mtshan mo mdzes mi 'gyur/ /zla ba rab tu rgyas pa shar bas ni/ /mtshan mo mkha' la thig le bzhin du mdzes/ /yab cig nyan thos 'di dag skar ma 'dra/ /rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bzhin/ /gang dag sems can kun la sman slad du/ /ye shes shar bas skye bo snang bar bgyid/ /yab cig srin bu me khyer tshogs 'od kyis/ /lasarnams la ni 'jug par mi nus kyi/ /'jam gling 'di na nyi 108
ma'i 'od rnamasakyis/ /bya ba sna tshogs brgya dag bgyid par 'gyur/ /nyan thos 'di dag srin bu me khyer 'dra/ /de dag shes 'od yang dag mthong mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyasarnam grol nyi ma lta bu yi/ /shes rab ye shes kyis ni sems can 'grel/ /yab cig wa brgya dag gis skad phyung yang / /ri dwags tshogs rnams 'drog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /seng ge'i skad kyis glang chen ri dwags dang / /byar bcas rnams kyang phyogs su 'byer bar 'gyur/ /yab cig de ltar nyan thos wa 'drar gzigs/ /de dag skad kyis bdud rnams skrag mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod spyad pas/ /bdud dang de bzhin bdud rig skrag par 'gyur/ /yab cig rgyu 'di bdag gisamathong bsan/ /theg pa dman pa dag la 'dod mi skyed/ /su zhig bla med byang chub spangs nasani/ /theg pa dman la 'dod pa skyed par bgyid/ /gang zhig byang chub dam pa yongs spangs nas/ /theg pa dman la 'dod pa skyed par bgyid/ /de dag 'tsho ngan rnyed pa thob ma gyur/ /de dag mir skyes pa ni nyesapar mchis/ /gang dag lhar bcas 'jig rten sman slad du/ /byang chub mchog la 'dun pa skyed par bgyid/ /de dag legs 'tsho rnyed pa legs par rnyed/ /de dag mi lus thob pa legs par mchis/ /gang dag lusadang ngag dang yid kyisakyang / /'jig rten sman slad las bgyid yid kyang rton/ /gang dag rtag tu sems can sman slad brtson/ /de dgakhu dum ba ra'i me rtog bzhin/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pastshigs su bcad pa bstan pa 'di dag thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shwa ri'i bu 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma bu mo 'di spobs pa thogs pa med pa zhig na/ ci bzod pa thob pa'am ma thob pa bdag gis 'di brtag par byar nges so snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i busabu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci bu mo khyod nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag pa ra zhugs sam/109
smradragapa ma yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs sam/ smras pa ma yin no/ /bu mo khyod ci zhig don du gnyer na 'di ltar seng ge'i sgra sgrogs par byed/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu gal te bdag chos 'ga' zhig don du gnyer na ni bdag seng ge'i sgra ci yang mi sgrog pa zhig na/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar bdag ni chos gang yang don du mi gnyer te/ de'i phyir bdag seng ge'i sgra sgrogs so/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu yang gang 'di skad du ci bu mo khyod nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs sam zhes zer ba ni btsun pa shā ri'i bus chos gang mngon du byas pa'i chos de la ci nyan thos zhes bya ba'am/ rang sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'am/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i theg pa rnam par gzhag pa yod dam/ gnas brtan shā ri'i bus smras pa/ bu mo chos de dag la ni theg pa rnam par gzhag pa med de/ chos de ni 'di ltar mtshan nyid med par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /bu mos smras pa/ bcun pa shā ri'i bu mtshan nyid med pa'i chos la don du gnyer ba ci zhig yod/ shā ri'i bus smras pa/ bu mo chos de la ni don du gnyer ba ci yang med do/ /gnas brtan zhwa ri'i bus bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la gzhan yang 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams la bye brag ni ci yod/ tha dad du dbye ba ni ci yod/ bu mos smrasapa/ bcun pa shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid la bye brag ni ci yod/ tha dad du dbye ba ni ci yod/ shwa ri'i bus smras pa/ bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /bu mos smras pa/ bcun pa shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid dang / dben pa nyid la ji ltar bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med pa de bzhin du btsun pa shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang / so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams la yang bye brag med cing / ༷da du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /bcun pa shā
ri'i bu 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' dang bla gab med pa la yang bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du sangs rgyasakyi chosarnamasadang /so so skye bo'i chos rnams la yang bye brag med cing tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /gnasabartan shā ri'i bu cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo ci khyod de skad ces zer ba las na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni shin tu ches lhag pa zhig tu mthong la/ nyan thos kyi chos rnams ni shin tu dman par mthong ngam ci na khyod nyan thos chen po rnams mthong na ldang bar yang mi byed/ phyag kyang mi 'tshal/ snang yang mi 'gro/ gtam yang mi zer/ stan dang bsod snyoms la yang spyan 'dren par mi byed de skad ces smras pa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na skar ma'i gzugs su gtogs pa ji snyed cig yod pa shes sam/ mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ bu mo snyoms par zhugs na ni kho bos grangs shes kyi snyoms par ma zhugs na ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/bcun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bzhin gshegs pas ni lan cig mnyam par bzhag pa nyid kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na sems can 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa yang rab tu mkhyen na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams gcig tu gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi lta ci smos te/ bcun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / nyan thos rnams kyi khyad par yin te/ 'di t+na tha dad du dbye ba yin no/ /btsun pa mod pal gyi bu chen po phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na
sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ 'chags pa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi busasmras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smrasapa/ bcun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das 'dasapa ni ji snyed cig yod/ ma byon pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ da ltar bzhugasapa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bussmrasapa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mosasmras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po sems can 'dod chags la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ zhe sdang la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod/gti mug la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ cha mnyam pa la spyod pa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi busasmrasapa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po nyan thosakyis 'dul ba'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ rang sangs rgyasakyis 'dul ba'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ sangs rgyas kyisa'adul ba'i semasacan ni ji snyed cig yod shesasam/ mod gal gyi busasmras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smrasapa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yang dag pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ log pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod/ ma nges pa'i sems can ni ji snyed cig yod shes sam/ mod gal gyi bus smras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bzhin gshegs pas ni de dag dang gzhan yang de'i gong du gang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma yin pa dag kyang rab tu mkhyen na/ sems can gzhan dag gi lta ci smos te/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla ma'i 112
khyad pashā ༵/ spya mo/ da/ gal gyi bu chen po gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pas khyod rdzu'aphrul chen po rnams kyi mchog tu bstan gyis/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od ces bya ba gang na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyang ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na shing ljon pa thams cad las tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'ispos gang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de khyab par 'gyur ba'i spos kyi ngad ldang ba yod pa ded song shig gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen posasmras pa/ bu mo sangs rgyasakyi zhing de'i ming yang kho bosad gdod thosan sangs rgyasal blta ba dang / chosamanyan pa'i phyir ji ltar 'gro bar bya/ de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas khri de las ma langs bzhin du tshig 'di skad ces smras te/ bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems dang po bskyed ma thag tu nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon pa lta na/ bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer des bdag nyid dang / rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyan thos chen po 'di dag la ston par gyur cig tsan dan gyi dri de dag kyang nyan thos chen po 'di dag gis tshor bar gyur cig cesabyas so/ /de nasabu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshig de skad ces smras ma thab/ tu bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer gyis de nyid kyi tshe 'od gang gis nyan thos chen po de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od de dang / de bzhin gshegs1 ༷3 dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i
sangs rgyas spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer de chos ston cing bzhugs par mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i 'od sku las bkye'o/ /chos bstan pa de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir thos so/ /tsan dan sprul gyi snying po'i dri des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir khyab par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer des kyang gsung gi yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems dang po bskyed ma thag tu nyan thos dang rang sangasargyas thamasacad zil gyis gnon to/ /de nas byang chub semasadapa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa bya rgod kyi phung po 'a gnas pas tsan dan sprul gyi snying po〉dri tshor nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tsan dan sprul gyi snying po'idri 'di ga las byung lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byams pa bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa 'dis nyan thos chen po rnams kyi mdun du seng ge'i sgra bsgrags te/ des nyan thos chen po de dag la bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od ces bya ba na de bzhin gshegasapa sposarab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la chos ston cing bzhugs pa yang bstan/ 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od de'i tsan dan sprul gyi snying po'i dri des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di khyab par byas so/ /de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po mkhas pa su zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gi cho 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rmad 114
du byung ba 'di lta bu dag mthong ngam thos na nyan thos dman pa/ zhan pa/ zhus pa/ nyi tshe ba'i shes pa dang ldan pa rnams la ldang ba'am/ stsur 'gro ba'am/ phyag 'tshal bar byed/btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od de ji tsam du thag ring ba shesasam/ mod gal gyi busasmras pa/ bu mo de ni mi shes so/ /bu mosasmrasapa/ bcun pa mod gal sgya bu chen po gal te khyod 'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul can sha stag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di dper na bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal lam/ 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ 'bras swa lu'i zhing bzhin du mtshams med par gang bar gyur nasade dag thamasacad kyisabaskal par rtsis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od ces bya ba de sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji snyed cig 'das pa'i pha rol na 'dug pa bgrang ba'i thabs kyisartogasapar mi nusaso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spos rab tu 'gyed pa'i 'od zer gyisa'od de dag mi snang bar mdzad de/ sangasargyasakyi zhing de yang mi snang bar rma/dzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas shākya thub pa de sngon mthong ngam/ bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar nus sam/ de bzhin gshegs pas/gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pas sbong bar zhugasapa ste/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnamasani chos nyid blta/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /chos nyid shes par bya min pas/ /de ni rnam par shes mi nus/ /zhes ma gsungs sam/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po gzhan yang bu mo khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya 115
thub pa de sngon mthong ngam zhes de skad zer ba ni btsun pa 'od srung chen po bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong mod kyi/ sha'i mig gis ma yin te gzugs su ma yin no/ /lha'i mig gisam yin te tshor bar ma yin no/ khresarab kyi mig gisam yin te 'du shes su ma yin no/ /chosakyi mig gisam yin te 'du byed du ma yin no/ /sangs rgyasakyi mig gis ma yin te rnam par shes par ma yin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po gzhan yang bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ste/ dper na gnaphubartan gyis ma rig pa dang srid pa la sred pa mthong ba bzhin no/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po gzhan yang bdag gisde bzhin gshegs pa mthong ste/ dper na gnas brtan gyisangar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa mthong ba bzhin no/ /gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos smrasapa/ bu mo 'di ltar ma rig pa dang / srid pa la sred pa dang / ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa'i chos 'di gnyisani med pa yin no/ /chosagang med pa de ni blta bar mi nusaso/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pasasmrasapa/btsun pa 'od srung chen po de de bzhin no/ /chos thamasacad ni med pa yin te/ de dag ni blta bar mi nus so/ /'od srung chen posasmras pa/ bu mo ci sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang med dam/ bu mosasmras pa/ gnasabartan sangasargyas kyi chosarnamasasam so so'iskye bolichosrnams kyang rung ste/ chos 'ga' zhig yongs su grub par 'dod dam/ 'od srung chen pos smrasapa/ bu mo kho bo ni so so'iskye bo'i chosarnamasal yang yongasasu grub par mi 'dod na sangasargyas kyi chosarnamasalta la ci smos/ bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po chos gang dag yongasasu grub pa med pa'i chosade dag ci yod pa yin nam/ 'on te med pa yin/'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo med pa de dag ni med pa yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/btsun pa 'od srung chen po de bsan chos thaX cad ni med pa nyid do/ /med pa gang yin

skad ces smrasaso/ /bu mo khyod ma la khri gser gyi rkang pa can la 'dug cing stan shin tu mtho ba la 'dug nasanyan thos chen po dag dang gtam zer ba de ni rung ba ma yin par gnasapa yin no/ /bu mo mi na bar stan mthon po la 'dug pa la stan dma' ba la 'dug pasachos bshad par mi bya'o zhes bya ba ci khyod kyis ma thos sam/ de skad ces smras pa dang / bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa sgra gcan rin 'jig rten na gang dag ni rung ba yin/ 'jig rten na gang dag ni rung ba ma yin pa khyod kyis shesasam/ sgra gcan zin gyis smrasapa/ bu mo kho bodra'onadragate/ gang dag ji ltar bcadragapa'i bslab pa la slob cing bslab pa de ladraga'agal bar mi byed pa de dag ni rung ba zhedrangabya'o/ /gang dag bslab pa de las 'gal bar byed pa de dag ni rung ba ma yin pa zhesabya'o/ /bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas smras pa/ btsun pa sgra gcan zin thong de skad ma zer cig btsun pa sgra gcan rin gang dag ji ltar bcas pa'i bslab pa la 〉(ba pa de dag ni rung ba ma yin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni rtog cing rnam par rtog pa'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa sgra gcan zin gang dag mi rtog cing rnam par mi rtog pa de dag ni rung ba zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa sgra gcan zin rung ba zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa rnamadragakyi tshig bla dwagadrangayin te/ de dag ni bslab pa las 'gal bar mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams ni bslab pa las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir te/ de dag ni phyir yang bslab nga 'dod pa ma yin pas de ni rung ba yin no/ /de dag ni khams gsum du phyir mi 'ong ba yin/ de dag ni bslab pa las yang dag par 'das pa yin te/ mi slob pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na de dag gi bslab pa ni mi dmigasate/ khamasagasum pa btags pa tsam du shes so/ /de'i phyir de 122
dag ni rung ba zhesabya'o/ /sgragacanarin gyisasmrasapa/ bu mo rung ba dang / rung ba ma yin pa la tha dad du dbye ba ci zhig yod/ bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa sgra gcan zin 'di lta ste dper na gser dngul rgyan du byasapa dang / rgyan du ma byasapa la tha dad du dbye ba ci yod/sgra gcan zin gyis smras pa/ bu mo tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /bu mos smras pa/btsun pa sgra gcan:na de bzhin du rung ba dang / rung ba ma yin pa la yang yi ge'i tha snyad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir tha dad du dbye ba ci yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni ci dang yang bral ba'i phyir te/ rang bzhin gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin no/ /btsun pa sgra gcan zin yang 'di skad du stan shin tu mtho ba la 'dug ste chos nyan tam zhesazer ba la byang chub semasadapa' ni nabating ba la 'dug kyang shin tu mtho ba la 'dug pa yin no/ /sgrawāṇan zin gyisasmrasapa/ rnam grangasagangagisakhyod de skad smra/bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sgra gcan zin 'di ji snyam du sems/ byang chub sems dpa' gang la 'dug ste byang chub thob par gyur/ sgra gcan 4na gyis smras pa/ rtswa bting ba la bzhugs nas byang chub thob po/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sgra gcan zin ci byang chub sems dpa' rtswa bting ba la 'dug pa la stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams na tshangs pa'am/ brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ngam/ de las gzhan pa 'og min man chad kyi lha gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyisalus btud de thal mo sbyar nas byang chub semasadapa'i zhabs la gtug par byed dam/ sgra gcan zin gyisasmrasapa/ bu mo de de bzhin te/ khyod kyisaji skad smrasapa bzhin no/ /bu mos smrasapa/ btsun pa sgra gcan zin de'i phyir rnam grangs des kyang dper na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtswa bting ba la 'dug kyang stan shin tu mtho ba la 'dug pa yin gyi/ nyan thos tshangasapa'i 'jig rten na 'dug pa ni de lta ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes 123
dgrasabu mo mya ngan med kyisabyin pa la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bu mo btsun pa sgra gcan zin ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de nyid kyi sras yin te/ bslab pa 'dod pa rnams kyi mchog yin na ci khyod kyis mi shes sam/ bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas smras pa/yab thongs shig thongs shig 'di ltar btsun pa sgra gcan zin bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de'i sras yin zhes ma gsungs shig ri dwagasakyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can cod pan btags pa lta bus/ bu wa skyed par gyur pa nam yang gsan tam/ gzigs sam/rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i rtsal lta bus gshegs pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i zhabs 'bring ba ni nyan thos mdzedragapa ma lags so/ /yab de bzhin gshega'altapa'i sras gang yin zhesayang dag pa'i smra bas gang smra na byang chub sems dpa' nyid yin no zhes de dag yang dag pa'i smra bas smra'o/ /yab de lta badragan de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su khas len par 'tshal bas ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /gtam 'di brjod pa'i skabs su rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i btsun moli'akhor nas btsun mo nyi shus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /lha'i bu brgya tham pas kyang bu mo de'i seng ge'i sgra 'di thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de tshig 'di skad du bdag cag 'di rnams 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sras su khas len to zhes kyang smras so/ /lha'i bu de dag gis 'di ltar bu rmo/ mya/ ngan med kyis byin pa la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen po tham sa cad lta 'i me tog dag gis mngon par gtor to/ // pas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa khri gser
gyi rkang pa can las babs te nyan thos chen po de dag gi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / bldag pa dang / gzhib pa dang / myang bar bya ba bsod pa mang po dag gis bkur sti byas te/ dad pa dang gus pas rang gi lag nas nyan thos chen po de dag tshim par byas nas 'di skad du btsun pa dag rang dgar slad dro 〉lhaX /spya gh+nāX sasna chos nyan du bzhud cig bcun pa dag bdag kyang mchi bar 'chal de nas bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa pha ma la sogs pa 'khor mang po dang / skye bo phal po ches yongasasu bskor nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /rgyal po btsun moli'akhor dang bcas pas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'chal nas gnang ste phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /nyan thos chen po de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ste bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nasabacom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'ji skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa'i spobs pa ni ngo mchar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhwa ri'i bu bu mo 'dis ni thog ma nyid du byang chub don du gnyer ba na sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis la dge ba'i rtsa ba dag bskyed do/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du bu mo 'dis bud med kyi lus ma bsgyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ zhwa ri'i bu 'di ji snyam du sems/bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pa la bud med do snyam du sems na de ltar mi blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dag ri sems can yo rdzu su smin par bya ba'i phyir smon lam gyis
bdag nyid bud med kyi gzugs su ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bu mo mya ngan med kyis byin pas bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs byas te/ bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs gang gis chos thams cad skyes pa yang ma yin/ bud med kyang ma yin pa lta na bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag skyes pa'i lus su gyur cig thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dis kyang mthong bar gyur cig tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu bud med kyi mtshan ma mi snang bar gyur te/ skyesapa'i mtshan ma byung bar gyur nas steng gi bar snang la ta la bdun srid cam du 'phags so/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasakyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shāri'i bu byang chub sem/sa dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pa steng gi bar snang la 'phags pa khyod kyis mthong ngam/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pa 'di ni bskal pa grangs med pa bdun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ che'i chad ni bskal pa brgyar 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chosani bskal pa bcur gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dge 'dun ni byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur te/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams de yang be+eḍūr+ya las grub pa rin po che sna bdun gyis bkra bar byas shing mig mangs ris su bris la rin po che'i pad+mas khebasapa dang / ngan song thams cad rnam par spangasapar 'gyur ro/ /lha dang mi rnamasakyi longasaspyod dag kyang khyad par med de/shā ri'i bu dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi nye ba(2 stad pa dang / longs spyod ji lta ba bzhin du
mi rnamasakyi yang der de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med kyis byin pa'i ma rgyal po ma skyesadagra'i btsun mo dam pa zla ba can zhes bya ba des thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis skyes bu dam pa 'di dgung zla dgur rum na bzung ba ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag 'jig rten gyi khams dri ma med pa'i 'od de nyid du 'di'i 'og tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu btsun mo zla ba can 'di khyod kyis mthong ngam/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'daphumathong lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/zhwa ri'i bu rgyal polibatsun mo zla ba can 'di ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur zhing lha'i bu rin chen mchog ces bya bar 'gyur te/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' byams pas byang chub thob par gyur pa de'i tshe rgyal po dung zhes bya ba de'i bu rgyal po gzhon nu mthong na dga' ba zhes bya bar gyur nas de bzhin gshegasapa byamasapa la mchod pa byasate rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /desade bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i dam pa'i chos thog ma dang / bar dang / tha ma'i bar du 'dzin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang mnyes par byed cing mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de mthar gyis de bzhin gshegasapa mya ngan med pasabyang chub thob pa na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mu khyud 'aX/ ces bya bar 'gyur te/ des de bzhin
gshegs pa de la mchod pa tshad med pa dag byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de lta bu de nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od zer zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal polibatsun mo zla ba can gyis bdag nyid lung bstan pa thos nas tshim zhing mgu ste yi rangs nas bcom ldan 'das la mu tig gi do shal brgya stong ri ba phul te tshangs par spyod par rgyal pos gnang nas bslab pa'i gzhi dag bzung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pas lhas phul ba'i me tog man dwa ra ba dag gis bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor thams cad la gtor to/ /de nas bar snang las babs te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tshig 'di skad du bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bdag gi byang chub thob pa na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad rdzus te skye zhing chos gosangur smig gyon la rin po che'i pad+ma dag la skyil mo krung bcas te skye bar 'gyur ba lta na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des dper na dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgyad lon pa'i spyod lam ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gnas par gyur cig ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pas bden pa'i byin gyi brlabs byas ma thag tu dge slong gi spyod lam dang ldan par snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med kyis byin pas pha rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /yab 'di ltar chos thams cad ni bcos ma ste rnam par bsgrubs pas nye bar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid dang / yongs su brtags pa las langs pa med bzhin du phyin ci log dang mtshungs par ldan pa lags so/ /rgya la po chen po gzigs shig dang de ring kho na'i gdugs gcig la bu mo'i gzugs su yang 126
gzigs khye'u'i gzugs su yang khyod kyis gzigs/ da ni bdag la dge slong gi gzugs su yang spu(da kyidragagazigadragan 'di la gang yang dag pa'i gzugs lags/ rgyal po chen po de ltar na ya ma brla'i chos thams cad la 'di na kha cig lta ba'i kun nas dkris pas kun nasagrags shing mchis te/ rang gi rgyud la mchis pa'i nyon mongs pa rnamadrangakyis yongasasu sreg go /yongasasu bsregasapasachosa'adul ba 'di ma 'tshal te 'gyod pa ma lagasapa la 'gyod par semasaso/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar na khyod kyisabag yod par mdzod la/ rgyal srid nyam nga ba na bzhugs bzhin du rtag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du bzhud cig dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pasakhyod kyi yod pa ma yin pa phyin ci log lasabyung ba'i 'gyod pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po khyod ni bya ba mang zhing byed pa mang ba lags kyis bzhud cig de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra dang / btsun mo zla ba can dang / btsun moli'akhor thams cad kyisabacom ldan 'dasadang / byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med kyisabyin pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni bgyi ba mang zhing bgyid pa mang ba lags kyis bdag cag mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po da de'i dus la bab par shes na songs shig ces bka' stsal nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra btsun slo zla ba can la sogs pa btsun mo'i'akhor chen po dag dang lhan cig tu bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri las rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen por dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang lda na pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zungs shig chongs shig lhogs shika kun chub par gyis shig gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cig kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 129
'di bdag gis gzung lags na/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir chosakyi rnam grangasa'adi mya ngan med kyisabyin pa'i seng ge'i sgra zhes bya ba dang / mya ngan med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa zhes bya bar zungs shig gzhan dag la yang ston cig kun dga' po gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna tshogs kyis yongs su bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tha na rna lam du thos na 'di ni de bsaches bsod nams mang du skyed na gang 'dzin pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / rjod pa dang / lung ji skad phog pa bzhin du nan tan du sgrub pa lta ci smos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan spradakyisaphyin pa srang rdza/ nyan /skuphuchen po de dag dang / lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin dang /n+d+ra /shā rnyilhalha pa 'a ga rten rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyisagasungs pa la mngon 130
rañdzañdza/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo dri ma med kyi byin pa zhesabya bas nyan thos brgyad dang byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la zab mo'i don gyi dri ba mdzad pa la de dag gisalan ma theb pa'i tshul dang sangs rgyasakyi drung du phyin te lung bstan pa sogs kyi skor/mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegasapa'i le'u gagasum pa las btus/yang de'i tshe yul ṣ+ka sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo dri ma med kyis byin nga zhes bya ba sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ chos zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga po thob pa zhig yod de bu mo des lha'i mig rnam par dag pa mi'i las 'das pas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thosachen po de dag mthong zhing de dag lam gyi bar skabs su gtam ci brjod pa de dag thams cad kyang thos so/ /bu mo de yang gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ pha ma dang nang mi la byamasapa/ btsas nasalo bcu gnyis lon pa ste/ de dpyid zlo tha chung tshesabargyad skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par pha masadage mtshan dang / bkra gisabyed du gnang nas bram ze zho dang / caku sha dang / me tog dang / yam sreg shing dang / mar dang /bum pa thogs pa lnga brgyas yongs su bskor te khrus bya bar khrid pa las bram ze de dag gis byang chub semasadapa' de dag dang nyan thos chen po de dag mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bkra mi shisaso snyam pa'i 'du shesakyiXnasapar gyur to/ /
de nas bram ze de dag gi nang nas bram ze ches bgres tshangs pa'i lha zhes bya ba desabu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pa la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bu slo dge slong dag mdun na 'khod pa ni bkra mi shis te/ de dag mthong na dgos pa'am/ nor ram/ brtul zhugs sam/ mchod sbyin nam/ bkra shisakyang rung ste mi 'grub kyisagrong khyer du slar bzhud do/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas bram ze tshangs pa'i lha de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'di dag chagasamed mchog tu dge shisapa/ /skye bo mang po'isdig pa 'jig par byed/ /'di dag rnam par dag cing bden bzhi mthong / /dul la grol bar gyur cing mnyam par bzhag /'di dag rkang gnyis dam pa bsod nams zhing / /'di la yon phul mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di la yon phul 'bras bu 'chi med 'thob/ /byin nas sems can ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /tshul khrims dang ni dul bar ldan pa yin/ /'dod las rgal cing sdig med re ba med/ /'di dag sman pa mchog ste 'jig rten rgyu/ /sdug bsngal gzir ba'i sgog chagasathar bar byed/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten dag na chos kyi rje/ /de sras 'di dag rdul med nyon mongs med/ /'di dag byang chub sems dpa' gzhan yang mang / stonas rab ldan mis 'di dag ji ltar spang / /'di dag brtul zhugs spyad cing 'dod chags zhi/ /bkra shis gyur cing mkhas pa sbyin char phab/ /'di dag rnams la bkur sti chung byasakyang / /mi rnams chos dang de bzhin nor yang 'grub/ /'di dag mtshan rnams yongasardzogs dge shis ldan/ /'di dag zhing mchog rnam dag sems dang ldan/ /bram ze 'di la su zhig dad byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams mang po skyed par 'gyur/ /de nas bram ze tshangs pa'i lhas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa la tshigs su bcad de slar smras pa/ byis pa'i sems kyis dbang du ma bzhud cig mchod sbyin dus 'dir dbe slong ma gzigs shig ngur smrig gos can de bzhin mgo bregs pa/ /de dag don 132
'dod pasani blta mi bgyi/ /yab dang yum yang dgyesapar mi 'gyur zhing / /bdag kyang mkhasaparnamasakyisasmad par 'gyur/ /khyod kyang mchod sbyin 'grub par mi 'gyur gyis/ /de bas dge slong rnams ni shin tu spongs/ /de nasabu mo dri ma med kyis byin pasabram ze tshangs pa'i lha de la tshigs su bcad de slar smras pa/ yon tan ldan pa 'di dag ma gtogs par/ /pha dang ma yang kho mo'i skyabs ma yin/ /gnyen gyi tshogs dang nor dang lang tsho min/ /'di dag 'khor bar bying ba rnams kyi skyabs/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas dga' bsalusabatang zhing / /de bzhin phyog dang longasaspyod rnamasakyang btang / /dkon mchog gsum nyid skyabasayin ma gtogs par/ /kho mo3skyabasarten semasacan 'di na med/ /de nas bram ze tshangs pa'i lhas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo btsasanasakhyod kyis sngon sangs rgyasakyang ma gzigs/ sngon chos kyang ma gsan/ sngon dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur kyang ma mdzad na khyod ci'i slad du sangasargyas la dad par gyur/ bu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pas smrasapa/ bram ze kho mo bcasanas zhag bdun lon pa na tsan dan gyi khang bzang gi nang na gser gyi khri la bzhag pa'i tshe lha'i bu lnga brgya steng gi bar snang la 'dong ba kho mosamathong ste/ de dag rnam grangasadu mas sangs rgyasakyi bsngagasapa brjod/ chosadang dge 'dun gyi bsngagasapa rjod pa kho mos thos so/ /de nasalha'i bu de dag gi nang nasagang gis sngon de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba gcig po de la lha'i bu rnams kyisadrisapa/ grogs po de bzhin gshegs pa ni ci 'dra ba zhig de ni ji ltar shes par bya/ de nas lha'i bu des kho mo'i bsam pa shes nas lha'i bu de dag kyang dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /de yi dbu skra dri med snum zhing mdzes/ /gcang 'jam g.yas su 'khyil pa'i lcang lo can/ /zhal mdog pad ma 'dab ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /zla nya mtshan mo nam mkhar mjesapa bzhin/ /de yi mdzod spu kha 133
ba shel mdog bzang / /smin mtshams bar nas 'khyil zhing shin tu mdzes/ /de yis 'khor rnams zil gyis mnan te 'dug rgyal ba'i zhal yang shin tu mdzes par byed/ /mi dbang spyan mdzes 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra/ /sems stobs mi zhum tshems mnyam thagadragakyang bzang / /de yi ljagadrangache zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs/ /de yi zhal ni dri med rnam par mdzes/ /de yi gsung ni phan zhing snyan la ran/ /tshig rtsub spangasashing mi 'byed sdig pa med/ /skye bo dpag tu med pa dang mdzad cing / /'gro la phan phyir rgyal ba'i gsung yang sgrogs/ /de yi mgur ni dung dang mtshungasashing 'dra/ /de bzhin mi dbang phyag gi sor mo ring / /de yi phyag ni glang chen sna dang 'dra/ /brang yangs dri med lte ba gzhol zhing zab/ /rta mchog lta bur 'domasakyi sba ba nub/ /de bzhin spu yi khung bu gser dang 'dra/ /brla yi dbyibasani glang polilag dang mtshungs/ /zhagasani legasaganas byin pa e na'i 'dra/ /thub pa'i dbang po bden gsung rgyags pa'i skyon dang bral/ /ngan ltas bcom pa rnams kyi sdig pa'i lta ba 'jig /'khor gyi nang du dri ba bye ba drisabyas kyang / /'khrul med skyon dang bral bas sems can kun tshim mdzad/ /gya gyu med drang tshig gis lusani tshim mdzad cing / /mya ngan 'dasapa bde mchog yid 'ong yang dag zhi/ /skye bo kun gyi yid 'ong mya ngan 'das ston cing / /mtha' gnyis dag dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam yang ston/ /de ni rang gis sangs rgyas gyur pa ste/ /bdag nyid rgal cing pha rol rnams kyang sgrol/ /'gro ba'i skyob dang skyabs dang dge shisashing / /'jig rten kun la thugs brtse phan pa mdzad/ /ston pa de yi yon tan 'di dag dang / /gzhan yang mtha' yas kho bos de ma brjod/ /thos nas lha rnams yid dga' dad gyur nas/ /rgyal ba la ni dang ba'i yid kyang sgom/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smrasanas bram ze tshangasapa'i lha la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /134
bram ze kho mo btsasanasazhag bdun lon nasasangasargyasakyi yon tan rnam pa 'di lta bu dag thos so/ /mngon par dran te de tshun chad nam yang rmugs pa dang gnyid kyis non par ma gyur to/ /nam yang 'dod pa la rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang /gnod semasakyi rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa ma byas so/ /mngon par dran te de tshun chad nam yang pha la dga' ba'am/ma la dga' ba'am/ ming po la dga' ba'am/ skrun la dga' ba'am/ nye du la dga' ba'am/ nor la dga' ba'am/ rgyan la dga' ba'am/ gos la dga' ba'am/ lus la dga' ba'am/ srog la dga' ba'am/ grong khyer la dga' ba'am/ skye mched la dga' ba ma bskyed kyi/ bram ze gzhan du na sangasargyas nyid rnam pas rjesasu dran no/ /bram ze kho modragani gsum semasal yid la bya ba yid la byaphute/ de bzhin gshegaphupa phyogs gang na bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin gshegasapas chos gang bshad pa de thams cad kho mos legs par yongs su bzung zhing kho mos don tam tshig 'bru las yi ge dang tshig gcig kyang chud ma zosapar byasaso/ /de bzhin gshegasapa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyisayongssu bskor ba kho mosanam yang yid la ma byasapar ma gyur to/ /kho mosanyin mtshan gang du yang sangs rgyas ma mthong ba dang / chosam thos pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ma byasapar ma gyur to/ /bram ze kho mo ni sangs rgyas la blta ba dang / chos mnyan pa dang /dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya bsachog pa med do/ /de nasabram ze tshangasapa'i lhasabram ze'i khye'u zhig la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u khyod song la lo rgyus 'di rgyal po dang btsun mo la gsol cig de nasabram ze'i khye'u de rings pa'i tshul du song ste ji ltar mthong ba'i lo rgyusathamasacad rgyal po dang btsun mo la gsol to/ /bu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pas kyang ji ltar bram ze tshangs pa'i lha la sogs pa bram ze lnga brgya po de dag gis bla na med pa 135
yang dag par rdzogadragapa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de ltar sangs rgyadragakyi bsngags pa brjod/ chosadang dge 'dun gyi bsngagasapa brjod do/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa shing rta las babs nas bram ze de dag dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag ga la ba der song ste phyin nasade dag gi rkang pa la mgo bosaphyag 'tshal te/ gusapa dang bcas/ rje sadang bcas par tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i mdun du 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de tshe dang ldan pa shwa ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu bud med ni shesarab sor gnyisapa/ nyon mongasapa drag pa/bag med pa mang ba/ dman pa la mos pa/ tshul bzhin ma lagasapa yid la bgyid pa'i dbang du mchisapa laga'agan/ bdag la thugasabartse ba nye bar bzung ste ci nasabadag gi yun ring polidon dang sman pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba'i slad du btsun pas de ltar bdag la chosalegs par bstan du gsol/ ko sala'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyisagatam byung ba 'di dang / bram ze'i tshig thosanas myur ba'i tshul gyisaphyogs der phyin te/ desanyan thosde dag dang byang chub semasadapa' de dag la phyag byasanasarang gi bu mo la 'di skad cessmrasaso/ /bu mo khyod na re kho mo nam yang rmugasapa dang gnyid kyis non par ma gyur to/ /nam yang dga' ba dang rtse ba dang ldan pa'i sems ma bskyed do zhes zer ba de ltar khyod bde ba dang yid bde ba la brtson nam/ 'on te 'di ltar yid byung ba'i tshul gyis smra/ de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rang lha bu mo la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ khyod kyi gzugs byang lha yi bu mo mtshungasashing 'dra/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni de nyid chas pa'i cha byad 'dzin/ /ji ltar khyod ni nam yang gnyid kyisam non pa/ /ci phyir bu mo khyod ni 'di 'dra'i yid byung gyur/ /khyed kyi rgyal srid rgyasashing shin tu legasapar 'byor/ /ma ni rtag tu khyod 136
kyisadabang du gyur pa yin/ /bu mo dga' ba de lasaci 'dra gzhan yod na/ /de yisakhyod kyi lus ni dga' ba rnyed ma gyur/ /sdug cing phangs la yid du 'ong ba ste/ /skye bo kun la dga' ba skyed yin na/ /yon tan brgya phrag du mas brgyan pa khyod/ /ci yi phyir na khyim 'dir dga' ba med/ /bu mo khyod kyis ci zhig thosagyur cing / /ci zhig mthong na 'di ltar yid mi bde/ /yongasasu nyamasashing yid byung semasasu gyur/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa ci 'dra nga la smos/ /de nasabu modri ma med kyis byin pas rang gi pha rgyal po gsal rgyal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ yab cig phung po nyes dmigs snod rnams dang / /khyim gyi skyon rnamasathugasasu ma chud dam/ /'khor ba'i gnasani gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten mi gnas 'jig pa can/ /sprul gdug nang na gnas pa'i khyim 'di la/ /gnyid dang 'dod pa'i 'dun pa ga la mchis/ /khams 'di dag ni gdug pa'i sprul bzhi ste/ /srid pa sems pa bde ba ga la mchis/ /mi mdza' tshogs kyis rab tu gtses gyur cing / /dgon par phyin la dga' ba ga la mchis/ /kun nas nyon mongs dgra yis yongs bskor ba/ /ji ltar bde 'thob rgyal po bka' stsol cig /dug 'thung pa la bde ba ga la mchis/ /gsad par bkri la dga' ba ga la mchis/ /g.yang dragachen 'dir su zhig yid rton bgyid/ /rgyal po 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten de dang mtshungs/ /blo ngan dag gis lus rnams bor ba ni/ /ri rab tsam gyi phung por gyur to zhes/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dpe ni bka' stsal na/ /'dus byasaslu ba'i chosal su yid rton/ /pha dang ma dang sdug dang ming po dang / /bu dang rtsa lag gnyen tshogs 'gro ba kun/ /'dus byas thams cad me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'di 'dra'i mi sdug gang la su yid rton/ /gang tshe bdag gis rang byung rgyal ba mthong / /de tshe sangs rgyas 'gyur snyam sems kyang skye/ /byang chub sems dpa' bag med 'gyur ba ni/ /yab cig bdag gis ma thos ma mthong ngo / /bdag sna 137
mtshan rdzogasargyal ba blta 'tshal gyur/ /bde bar gshegasapasagasungasapa'i chosakyang thos/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i srasapo 'di dag mthong / /yab cig ji ltar 'dod pa bsten par bgyi/ /de nasargyal pogasalargyal bu mo'itshig 'di thosanasacang mi smra bar gyurato/ /de nasabu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pasarang gi pha cang mi smra bar gyur par rig nas tshe dang ldan pa zhwa ri'i bu la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bston pa shā ri'i bu khyod la zhu ba zhuszugasabartse bar dgongasate lan gdab tugasol/ 'di ltar btsun pa shā ri'i bu ni bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci shes rab de 'dus byas lags sam 'on te 'dus ma byas lags/ de gal te 'dus byas lagasan de bzhin gshegasapasa'adusabyasathamasacad ni rdzun pa slu ba'i chosacan yin no zhes bka' stsal to/ /ci ste 'dus ma byas lags na/ 'dus ma byas la ni skye ba ma mchisaso/ /gang la skye ba ma mchisapa de la ni phrad pa ma mchisan/ phrad pa ma mchisapa'i shesarab kyisaji ltar btsun pa zhwa ri'i bu shesarab chen po zhesabagyi/ de nasatshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shā ri'i bu bu mos dris pa'i lan thob cig shā ri'i busasmrasapa/ bu mo ni 'dusabyasami 'dri'i/ bu mos ni skye ba med pa drisate/de ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /'di ltar btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po khyod ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci tshe dang ldan pa sems can du 'du shes pa la gnas te rdzu 'phrul ston tam/'on te chos su 'du shes pa la gnas te ṭu'aphrul ston/ /gal te sems can du 'du shes pa la gnas te ston na sems can ni ma mchis pa ste/ de lta bas na rdzu 'phrul de yang ma 138
mchisapar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste chosasu 'du shesapa la gnasate ston na chosanyid ni 'gyur ba ma mchis pa'o/ /'gyur ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de la ni rnam par rtog pa ma mchis na rnam par mi rtog pas ji ltar tshe dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'byor par gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yang cang mi smra bar gyurato/ /de nasabyamasama'i bu gang pos tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /mod gal gyi bu chen po bu mosadrisapa'i lan thob cig mod gal gyi bussmrasapa/ bu mo ni 'gyur ba mi 'dri'i/ bu mosani 'gyur ba med pa drisate/ 'gyur ba med pa dang rnam par mirtog pa ni de bzhin gshegasapa rnamasakyi byang chub yin pasade ni lan gdab par mi nusaso/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pasabyams ma'i bu gang po la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa gang po ni bcom ldan 'dasakyisachosasmra ba rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lagasan/ ci tshe dang ldan pa dmigs pa dang bcaphupa'i chos ston tam/ 'on te dmigs pa ma mchis pa'i chos ston/ gal te dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i chosaston na ni khyod byisapa so so3skye bo rnamasadang mtshisaso/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ byisapa so so'iskye bo thamasacad ni dmigasapa dang bcasapa'i slad du ste/ de lta bas na btsun pa yang byis pa so so3skye bo thams cad kyi chos rnams dang ma bral ba lags so/ /ci ste dmigasapa ma mchis pa'i chos ston na ni chos smra ba nyid dngos po ma mchis par 'gyur te mi 'thad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po bu mos dris pa'i lan thobs shig tshe dang ldan pa gang posasmras pa/ bu mo ni kun rdzob mi 'dri'i/ bu mo ni don dam pa dris te/ de ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nasabu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /139
