'di ltar btsun pa 'od srung chen po ni rnam par thar pa brgyad la snyomasapar zhugs nas langs te gzhan dag la chos ston cing gang dag las tha na gzar bu gang tsam gyi bsod snyomasayongasasu blangasapa de dag thams cad mtho risasu 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ de ci btsun pas lus kyis sbyin pa sbyong ngam/ 'on te sems kyisasbyin pa skyong / gal te lus kyis sbyong na lus ni bem po g.yo ba ma mchis pa byed pa ma mchis pa ste/ rtswa dang / shing dang / rtsig pa'i chos lta bu mig yor dang mtshungasapasadesakyang sbyong bar mi nus so/ /ci ste semasakyisasbyong na semadrangani sgyu ma lta bu gnas pa ma mchisapa ste/ des kyang sbyong bar mi nusaso/ /ci ste lusadang semasakyi phyi rol gyisaspyong na de ni ma mchisapa ste/ ma mchispas ji ltar sbyong bar bgyid/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /rab 'byor gyisasmrasapa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po bu mosadrisapa'i lan thobs shig 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bu mo ni len pa mi 'dri'i/ bu mosani len pa med pa drisashing yang dag pa'i mtha' 'dri bsade ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas gnas brtan rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar btsun pa rab 'byor ni bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci nyon mongs pa med pa de dngos pos rab tu phye ba lagasasam/ 'on te chos nyid kyis rab tu phye ba lags/ gal te dngos pos rab tu phye ba lagasan ni 'dus byas su 'gyur ro/ /ci ste chos nyid kyis rab tu phye ba lags na ni chos nyid ni skye ba ma mchis pa'i mchan nyid dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa'i mtshan nyid de/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa'i ma/chan nyid gang lags pa de ni mnyam pa nyid do/ /mnyam pa nyid gang lags pa de ni de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de ni 'gyur ba ma mchis pa'o/ /'gyur ba ma mchis pa gang 140
lags pa de ni tha snyad ma mchis pa'o/ /tha snyad ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni bsam gyisami khyab pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang lags pa de ni bstan du ma mchis pa'o/ /bstan du ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /dngos po ma mchis pa gang lagasapa de ni ma byung ba'o/ /ma byung ba gang lags pa de ni 'phags pa rnams mi ston to/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa nam grus tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so / |tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor bu mos drisapa'i lan thobasashig rab 'byor gyis smrasapa/'di la brjod du ci yang med/ /cang mi smra ba de 'thob byed/ /spros pa med pa'i chos 'di dag /bu mo yongs su 'dri bar byed/ /ji srid dngos po skye yod pa/ /de srid skyon gyis gosapar 'gyur/ /chosakyi dbyings ni tha snyad med/ /'di ni nyon mongasamed pa'i tshul/ /de nasabu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa nam gru la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bsam gtan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci sems la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad dam/ 'on te sems ma mchis pa la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad/ gal te sems la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad na sems ni brjod du ma mchis shing sgyu ma lta bu ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pa kun brtags pa lags na/ ci yang dag pa ma yin pa kun brtags pa ma mchis pa la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad dam/ ci ste sems ma mchis pa la gnas te bsam gtan mjad na ni rtswa dang / shing dang / rtsig pa dang / rdo la sogs pa byung ba dang zhig pa de dag thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni sems ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshe dang ldan pa nam gru la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 141
nam gru bu mos drisapa'i lan thobs shig nam grusasmras pa/ bu mo ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul yongasasu 'dri ste/ de ni nyan thos rnams kyis bstan par mi nus so/ /bu mos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nam gru chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yang gzhan la/ nyan thos rnams kyi yang gzhan lags sam/ gal te chos kyi dbyings gzhan lagasan ni tha dad du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin nyid ni gnyis su ma mchis te/ de bas na de bzhin nyid dang gnyis ni bye brag ma mchis na ci'i slad du tshe dang ldan pa nam gru de skad gsung nam gru yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gagasapa/ la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i mig can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na lha'i mig gis dngos po gzigs sam/'on te dngos po ma mchis pa gzigs/ gal te dngos po gzigs na ni rtag par lta bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste dngosapo ma mchis pa gzigs na ni chad par lta bar 'gyur te/ de yang mi rigs so/ /ma 'gags pa yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa bu mos dris pa'i lan thobs shig tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas smras pa/bu mos ni shes rab kun tu 'jom pa dris pas de ni lan gdab par mi nus so/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod ni bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lagasan/ ci mang du thosapa nyid de don du blta'am/ 'on te tshig 'brur blta/ gal te don du blta na don ni brjod du ma mchis shing bsnyad du ma mchis pa ste/ de ni rna ba'i rnam par shes /pa spras par bgyi ba ma lags pa nas yid kyi
rnam par shes pa'i bar gyis shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa ste/ rnam pa de lta bu gang lags pa de ni bstan du ma mchis pa'o/ /ci ste tshig 'brur blta na ni bcom ldan 'das kyis don la rton pa yin gyi tshig 'brur rton pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pas de bas na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bolimang du thos pa nyid ni rton pa ma lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bu mos dris pa'i lan thobs shig kun dga' bos smras pa/ bu mo ni yi ge dang bral ba 'dri ste/ de ni sgras tshim pa ra byed par mi nus so/ /bu mo ni sems dang bral ba'i mnyam pa nyid 'dri ste/ slob pa rnams kyi sa ma yin na de ji ltar bstan par bya ste/ chos kyi mnga' bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu dgos pa'o/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pas zab mo la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na/ ci rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab pas khyod zab bam/ 'on te ngo bo nyid zab pas zab/ gal te rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab pas khyod zab na ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang ldan pa'i chos gang yang ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni song ba ma lags/ 'ong ba ma lags te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni mig gi rnam par shesapadraX)sa par bgyi ba ma lagasapa nas yid kyi rnam par shesapa'i bar gyis shes par bgyi ba ma lags shing gnyis su ma mchis la kun tu 'byung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /ci ste ngo bo nyid zab pasazab na ni ngo bo nyid gang yang sus kyang brtag par mi nusaso/ /'jam dpal gyisasmrasapa/ bu mo yang dag pa'i mtha' zab pasakho bo zab bo /143
bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ 'jam dpal yang dag pa'i mtha' ni mtha' ma lags te/ de'i slad du rnam par shes pas 'tshal ba ma lags so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ bu mo yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba 'di ni dmigs su med pa'i tshig bla dgas so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smras pa/ 'jam dpal dmigs su ma mchis pa ni gang gi tshig bla dgas kyang ma lags te/ dmigs su ma mchis pa ni tshig bla dgas las yang dag par 'das pa lags so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ bu mo 'di ji ltar gzhan dag la bstan par bya/ bu mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub ni bstan pa las yang dag par 'das pa lags te/ de ni brjod pas bstan par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'di skad du ci nas kyang grong khyer na skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo gang dag kho bo'i mig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyi skur mthong bar mdzad dam/ 'on te chos kyi skur mthong bar mdzad/ gal te gzugs kyi skur mthong bar mdzad na de ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma lags te/ bcom lda na 'das kyisani 'di skad du/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shesapa/ /'dun pa 'dod chagasaldan pa ste/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong zhesagasungasaso/ /ci ste de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi skur mthong bar mdzad na chos kyi sku ni bstan du mi nus pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku ni mig gi rnam par shes pa las yang dag par 'das pa ste blta bar mi nus pa'i slad du'o/ /mthong 144
ba don yod kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che tog gis smras pa/ mthong ba don yod bu mos dris pa'i lan thobs shig mthong ba don yod kyis smras pa/ bu mo ni dngos po med pa 'dri ste de ni bstan par mi nus so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas smrasapa/ bdag ni dngos po'am dngos po ma mchis pa mi 'dri'o/ /bstan pa slobasal de nasaston cig mthong ba don yod kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nasabu mo dri ma med kyis byin pasabyang chub sems dpa' rin po che tog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du gang gis grong khyer na khyim tham sa cad du rin po ches gang ba'i gter rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci zang zeng dang bcas nga 'i phan 'dogasapar mdzad dam/ 'on te zang zing ma mchis pas phan 'dogs par ma dzad/ ga' te zang zing dang bcas pas phan 'dogs na ni byis pa so so3skye boliphan 'dogs nga/ dang bye brag ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byis pa so so'i skye bo rnamasakyi dga' ba ni zang zing dang bcasapa'i slad du'o/ /ci ste zang zing ma mchis pas phan 'dogs par mdzad na zang zing ma mchis pa ni bsgrub tu ma mchis pa lags so/ /rin po che tog kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' ngan song spong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du gang gis grong khyer 'di na sems can rnams kyi las ngan song myong bar ce'agyur ba gang yod pa de tshe 'di nyid la yang zhing chung ngu myong bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhesagasungs pa de/ de bzhin gshegasapasalasani bsam gyisami khyab pa nyid du bstan pa de ri khyod kyis bsam par mi spyod do/ /gal te spyod na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsam par mi spyod na mi 145
mkhyen bzhin du mang po myong bar 'gyur ba'i lasatshe 'di nyid la yang zhing chung 6 phyong bar ji ltar mdzad de/ bdag po ma mchis pa'i chosarnams la bdag po rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ltar mdzad na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /ngan song spong gis smras pa/ kho bos ni smon lam gyi dbang gis mang du myong bar 'gyur ba'i las nyung ngu myong bar 'gyur bar byed do/ /bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu chos rnams kyi chosanyid ni smon lam gyi dbang gisabasgyur du mi nus lags so/ /gal te nusapar gyur na semasacan thamasacad yongasasu mya ngan las bzla'o zhes de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i dgongs pa de smon lam gyi dbang gis ji ltar mi 'grub ste/ rnam grangs 'dis na smon lam gyi dbang gis bsgyur bar mi nus par rig par bgyi'o/ /ngan song spong yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'di skad du gang gis mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por skye bo'itshogs thamasacad kyi sgrib pa lnga po dag rnam par sel bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o zhes gsungs pa de ci ting nge 'dzin de bdag la rag las pa lags sam/ 'on te gzhan la rag las pa lags/ gal te bdag la rag lasapa lags na ni mi 'pho ba'i chos can lags te/ ji ltar khyod snyoms par zhugs pas gzhan dag gi sgrib pa rnams rab tu zhi bar mdzad/ ci ste gzhan la rag lasapa lagasan ni ting nge 'dzin de khyod kyi ma lagasaso/ /gang khyod kyi ma lags pa des ni gzhan la phan par mdzad par mi spyod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas smras pa/ bu mo kho bolisbyor ba 'di ni byams pa sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis ༷༷ pas smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas
bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyang byams pa la gnas lags na sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams na sems can dag la sgrib pa rnams kyis gnod pa yang ma mchis so/ /byang chub semasadapa' sgrib pa thamasacad rnam par sel ba yang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du ci nas kyang grong khyer na sems can gang dag bcings pa dang / gsad par bkri ba de dag thar ba dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams kyang 'jigs pa med pa thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bos bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci khyod kyi sbyor ba 'di len pa dang bcasapa lagasasam/ 'on te len pa ma mchisapa lags/ gal te sbyor ba de len pa dang bcasapa lags na ni byis pa so so3skye bo rnams kyang len pa dang bcas pa lags te/ byisapa so so'iskye bo rnamasadang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na de yang mi rigs so/ /ci ste sbyor ba de len pa ma mchis pa lags na ni mngon par 'dusam byasapa lags te/ mngon par 'dusam byasapa la ni nye bar sgrub pa ma mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan rasagazigasadabang phyug la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bu mos dris pa'i lan thobs shig byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzikas dbang phyug gis smras pa/ bu mo ni skye ba dang 'gag pa mi 'dri ste/ de ni lan gdab par mi nus so /tsho /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pasasmras pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang na skye ba ma mchis pa dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa de ni dri ba ma mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ bu mo gang na skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa 147
de ni yi ge 'jug pa med do/ /bu mos smras pa/ 'jug pa ma mchis pa dang / yi ge ma mchis pa'i chos thams cad la ni mkhas pa dag yi ge dang 'jug pa mi ston te/ yi ge rnams la mi chagasaso/ /chags pa ma mchis pa ni chos kyi dbyings te/ de la ni rtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du chagasapa ma mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan rasagazigs dbang phyug kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' spobasapa brtsegasal 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du gang gis grong khyer na skye bo3tshogs thams cad phan tshun tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs dang / byams pa'i semasakyis smra bar 'gyur ba dang / spobs pa yang thob par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bosabasam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i khyod kyi spobs pa nye bar sgrub pa gang lags pa de ci rnam par rtog pasabaskyed pa lagasasam/ 'on te rgyu ma mchisapa lasabyung ba lags/ gal te rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa lags na ni 'dus byas thams cad kyang rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa lags te/ de lta bas na rnam par zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rgyu ma mchis pa las byung ba lagasan ni ma byung ba la sgro 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis smras pa/ bu mo sems can gang dag kho bolimig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad spobs pa thob par gyur cig ces bya ba'i kho bo'ismon lam 'di ni dang po sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste btab bo/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pasasmrasapa/ rigasakyi bu semasabaskyed pa gang gisasmon lam btab pa'i sems bskyed pa de mchisasam/ 'on te ma mchis/ gal te mchis na ni rtag par lta ba lags so/ /ci ste ma ma chis na ni chad par lta ba lags te/ de gsung na ri khyod kyi gsung ba log pa lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de 148
nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas byang chub sems dpa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad du ci nas kyang grong khyer na sems can gang dag kho bo'imig lam na snang bar 'gyur ba de dag tham sacad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i bsam pa kho bosabasam par bya'o zhesagasungs pa de ci byang chub de mchisapa zhes brjod par bgyi'am/ 'on te ma mchis pa zhesabarjod par bgyi/ gal te mchisan ni rtag pa ste yod pa'i mthar 'dzin pa lags so/ /ci ste ma mchis na ni chad pa ste med pa'i mthar 'dzin pa lagasaso/ /byang chub semasadapa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod kyis smras pa/ bu mo byang chub ces bya ba 'di ni ye shes kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pasasmrasapa/ ci ye shesade skye bsarab tu phye ba lagasasam/ 'on te zhi bsarab tu phye ba lags/ 'on te skye badrangarab tu phye ba lagasan ni tshul bzhin ma lagasapa yid la bgyid pa lasabyung ba 'dusabyasasu 'gyur te/ shesapa de ni byisapa rnams kyi lagasaso/ /ci ste zhi bas rab tu phye ba lags na ni de la dmigs pa ma mchisaso/ /gang la dmigs pa ma mchis pa de la 'di ni so so'i skye bo'o zhe'am/ nyan thos so zhe'am/ rang sangs rgyas so zhe'am/ byang chub semasadapa'o zhe'am/ sangasargyasaso zhes rnam par rtog pa mi skye'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ byang chub ni rnam par mi rtog pa lags na byis pa so so'i skye bo rnam sa ni byang chub la rnam par rtog ste/ mkhas pa rnams ni mi rtog pa'i slad du'o/ /byang chub semasadapa' gom pa 'dor ba don yod kyang cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis byang chub sems dpa' de dargu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bsod snyoms kyi phyir grong khyer du 'jug par mi bya'i slar 'dong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ deng bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa las chos thos pa gang yin pa 'di ni 149
mkhasapa'i zasayin pasachog par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ chos kyi zasabaza' bar bya'o/ /de nasabu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pasaganasabartan rab 'byor la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /btsun pa rab 'byor gang na gdeg pa med pa dang gzhag pa med pa de la ci zhig khyod kyisbtsal bar sems/ btsun pa rab 'byor dge sbyong gi tshul ni sprosapa ma mchisapa lags kyi spros pa la dga' ba'i ni ma lags so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor dge sbyong gi chos ni gnadragapa ma mchidragapa/ gnas par mi bgyi ba laga'asnate/ 'phagabaltapa rnamasakyi spyod yul ni mi 'khrugs pa lags so/ /de nas nyan thos chen po brgyad po de dag dang / byang chub semasadapa' brgyad po de dag dang / bram ze lnga brgya tsam po de dag dang / bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / de las gzhan pa skye bo phal po che rnams bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nasabacom ldan 'das kyi zhabaphul mgo bosphyag 'tshal te lan gsum bskor ba byasanasaphyogasagacig tu 'khod do/ /de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas bcom ldan 'das la lan stong bskor ba byas te gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangasakyis zhu ba zhusapa/ ting 'dzin stobasaldan gragasapa mtha' yasamanga' 'jig rten mgon po bdud rtsi dga' stsol ba/ /mtshungasamed ye shesabade gshegs khyod la zhu/ /byang chub semasadapa' ji ltar spyad pa spyod/ /ji ltar shing dbang drung mchis bdud rnams 'joms/ /ji ltar rir bcasasarnamasagayo bar bgyid/ /gragasapa mtha' yas ji ltar 'od zer gtang / /byang chub spyod tshul legasapar bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyasanor gyi gzungs ni ji ltar 'thob/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba dam pa ji ltar bsgom/ /mi yis rdzu'aphrul stobs ni ji ltar 'thob/ /semasacan rin chen rnams kyi spyod pa gsungs/ /gang gis 150
dran dang rtogasadang blo grosa'agyur/ /spobasapa mdzesadang ldan par gang gisa'agyur/ /gang dang rab tu ldan na 'khor nang du/ /snyan cing shin tu mdzesapa smra bar bgyid/ /gang gis mi ni tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /dri ma ma mchis lha yi mig kyang 'thob/ /lha rna 'thob cing pha rol semasatshul rig /ṭu'aphrul gyisani zhing rnamasabargyar yang mchi ji ltar sbyinapagatang la brtson par 'gyur/ /rtagasgyu tshul khrimasadag cing bzod la dga'/ /ji ltar brtson 'gruphubasam gtan mkhasapar 'gyur/ stonaphurab la yang ji ltar shin tu brtson/ /mngalagyiganasani ji ltar rnam spangasanas/ /pad ma lasani rtagatu rdzusate skye/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar mchis par bgyid/ /bdag med stong pa nyid kyi sgra yang brjod/ /ji ltar de yid dga' dang mi dga' mtshungs/ /sred pa spangs shing tha ba zhe sdang spong / /mtho bar mi sems dma' bar sems ma mchis/ /sems brtan g.yo ba ma mchis ri rab mtshungs/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang ma grags dang / /bstod dang smad dang bde dang sdug bsngal dang / /ji ltar 'jig rten chos rnams zil mnan gnas/ /'jig rten kun na zla ba lta bur spyod/ /nga yi ma mchisatshul 'chos g.yo ma mchis ji ltar rdul bral nga rgyal rgyagasapa spong / /zhi dang rab tu zhi dang zhi gnasabartson/ /blo ldan ji ltar ye shes mchog tu 'gyur/ /chung ma bu nor mdza' la dga' ma mchis/ /ji ltar bsamatha'i mal la mngon par dga'/ /rtag tu bya dang mtshungasashing zla ba 'dra/ /ji ltar chosakyi nor la dga' zhing mos/ /chu dang mtshungasashing sa 'dra rlung dang mtshungs/ /mkhaspa ji ltar me dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu ci yang ma mchis mi rtog lags/ /mnyam pa nyid la dga' zhing nam mkha' mtshungs/ /ji ltar rtag tu chosani spong mi bgyid/ /bdag 'dor bgyid kyi chos mchog yongs mi gtong / /'jig rten dag tu ston pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /ji ltar gnas te byang chub 'jug par bgyid/ /zhing gi bkod pa ji ltar 151
gnasapar 'gyur/ /dge 'dun dag par ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/ /ji ltar dusagasum du yang chos thos shing / /ji ltar tshe ring sems can bde bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sred pa 'gog pa'i pha rol son/ /dgra bcom dul bar bden bzhi ji ltar mthong sems can brgya dag byang chub 'jog par bgyid/ /spyod cing rtag tu dga' mosaji ltar 'gyur/ /gang gisashin tu mdzesapar 'gyur/ /brdzusate skye bar gang gisa'agyur/ /longasaspyod che dang shesarab che/ /kun mkhyen rtogasapar khong du chud/ /gang gisasum cu rtsaganyisamatshan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'thob/ /bsod namasakun la mkhasapa lags/ /spobasapa gang gisaskye bar 'gyur/ /zhing ni ji ltar dag 'gyur lags/ /dge slong dge 'dun phun sum tshogs/ /gang du de yis smon btab pa/ /der ni ji ltar skye 'gyur lags/ /tshe rabasadran par ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sangasargyasarnams dang mjal/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnamasasu/ /ngan 'gror mchi bar mi 'gyur lags/ /rnam par 'dren pa ji ltar na/ /mdog dang gzi brjid snyan gragasa'athob/ /stobasadang mthu dang brtson 'grusarnams/ /ji ltar thub par mi 'gyur lags/ /ji ltar sangs rgyasachosadang yang / /dge 'dun la ni skyabasasu mchi/ /lus dang sgog ni gtong bgyid kyi/ /de dag chos ni 'dor mi bgyid/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod bgyid cing / /the tshom ma mchis ji ltar 'gyur/ /'gyod pa thams cad spangs nas su/ /srog chags rnams la chos kyang ston/ /khyod la mi mkhyen cang mi mnga'/ /thub chen khyod ni thamasacad mkhyen/ /byang chub semasadapa'i spyod gang lags/ /go rim bzhin du bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pa la 'di skad cesabaka' stsal to/ /bu mo legasasolegasaso/ /bu mo de bzhin gshegasapa la don 'di lta bu 'di 'dri bar sems pa ni khyod yang legs so / gi/bu mo de'i phyir legasapar rab tu nyon la yid la zungasashig dang bshad do/ /bu mo 152
dri ma med kyis byin pas bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol te bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'dasakyisa'adi skad cesabaka' stsal to/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na bdud 'dul bar byed de/ bzhi gang zhe na/gzhan gyi rnyed pa la phrag dog med pa dang / phra ma'i tshig yongasasu spong ba dang / skye bo mang po dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / sgrib pa med pa'i byamasapa sgom pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi po de dag dang ldan na bdud 'dul bar byed do/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ phragadogami bya phra masmra mi bya/ /skye bo mang po dge brnamasalasbyar/ /phyogasabasgrurnamasasu byamasapa bsgomasabyasan/ /bdud 'dir btul nasabyang chub reg par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dag ga81 bar byed de/ bzhi gang zhe na/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa dang / chosazab mo la mosapa dang / yi dam la brtan pa dang / skye bo mang po byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangasargyasakyi zhing mtha' yasapa dag g.yo bar byed do/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ ji skad smrasapa de bzhin byed/ /mkhasapa zab molichosla bzod/ /yi dam la yang shin tu brtan/ /dkar polichosal 'dzud par byed/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bla med la/ /skye bo mang po dga' bar byed/ /de ltar chos bzhi de dag gis/ /zhing rnamasabye ba g.yo bar byed/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mu med pa rnams su 'od zer dag gtong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ mar me sbyin pa dang / dam pa'i chosayongasasu 'dzin pa dang / semasacan bag med par gyur cing mi khom par gyur pa rnams kyi gan du song ste chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag la rin po che'i dra bas 'gebs pa ste/ bu mo byang chub 153
semasadapa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yasamu med pa rnams su 'od zer dag gtong ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mar me byin pas 'od ni rnam par dag /zad pa'i dusan dam chosayongs su 'dzin/ /bag med gyur pa rnams la chosasbyin byed/ /mchod rten dag la rin chen dra ba 'bul/ /desan bye ba bsam yasazhing 'gro zhing / /byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer gtong bar byed/ /reg nas sems can bde dang ldan par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa byang chub bla med don du gnyer/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na gzungasa'athob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyan sna tshogs gtsang zhing dag pa sbyin pa dang / bu mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te 'dod pa rnamasal sbyin pa dang / rgyun mi 'chad par de bzhin gshegasapa'i bsngagasapa brjod pa dang / shesrab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mang du gnasapa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na gzungasa'athob bo/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ sna tshogasabyin pasgzungasani thob par 'gyur/ /slong ba rnams la bu mo brgyan te sbyin/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sangasargyasabasngagasapa brjod/ /rgyal ba'i ye shesadon du shesarab bsgoms/ /chosabazhi 'di dag gis ni gzungs 'thob 'gyur/ /bskal pa brgyar yang thos pa chud mi za/ /phyogs bcur de bzhin gshegs pa gang 'chad pa/ /de dag thams cad dran pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na ting nge 'dzin 'thob ste/bzhi gang zhe na/ 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba mang ba dang / gcig pur kun tu dga' zhing mgu la mos pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / las kyi mtha' shin tu yongs su mthar phyin pa yin te/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na ting nge 'dzin 'thob bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ srid pa'i 'gro ba kun la yid kyang 'byung / /bse ru lta bur gcig pur spyod la dga'/ /rtag tu shin tu brtson 'grus 154
brtsams pa yin/ /de yi las rtag shin tu mthar yang phyin/ /rtag tu chos bzhi dag la zhugs nas su/ /byang chub spyod pa zhi ba myur tshol byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin la gor 'thob/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi spyod yul byang chub rtogs/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na dzu'aphrul 'thob ste/ bzhigang zhe na/ lusayang ba dang /sems yang ba dang / chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang / khams bzhi nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis slob pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dzño'aphrul 'thob po/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/lusayang ba dang de bzhin semasakyang yang / /chosarnamasakun la gnas pa med pa nyid/ /nam mkha'i khamasadang mtshungasashing 'dra nyid du/ /khamasabazhi po dag byin gyisarlob par byed/ /chosabazhi 'di dag ngesapar bsten byasan/ /blo ldan de yis〈'phrul mtha' yas'thob/ /skad cig gcig la zhing rnams stong du 'gro/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag mang po rnams kyang mthong / /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ khro ba med de rtsod pa dang / tha ba dang / zhe snang dang bral ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'phyag par mngon par brtson par 'gyur ba dang /tshul khrims kyi sdom pas bsdams shing tshur shog legs par 'ongasaso zhes rtag tu smra ba dang / chos smra ba rnams la khro gnyer dang bral zhing zhe 'gras pa'i sems med pa yin te/bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan la khro dang khon du 'dzin mi byed/ /nga rgyal rgyags dang tha ba zhe sdang bral/ /rtsod pa med la dga' zhing snyan par smra/ /gus par rgyal ba'i mchod rten 'phyag par byed/ /de ni tshul khrims rnam dag rtag tu srung / /de ni rtag tu legs par 'ongs zhes smra/ /chos smra rnams la de ni tha ba med/ /de yi sems ni rdo rje ri 155
rab mtshungs/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na rdzusate skye bar 'gyur te/ bzhigang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegaphupa'i sku gzugaphupad ma'i steng na bzhugadragapa byed du 'jug cing me togayud pa la dang / pad ma dang / pad ma dkar po dag gisalag pa bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegasapa'am/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i mchod rten la mngon par 'thor ba dang / phan pa'i dngos po mang zhing yang dag par dga' bar byed pa'i ngang tshul can dang / gzhan dag gi skyon mi 'dzin pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad semasacan thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu yongs su sngo bar byed pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na rdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs pad ma mchog bzhugasabyed du 'jug /chu skyesame rtag lag pa bkang ste 'bul bar byed/ /pha rol dag la dga' ba skyed pa'i tshig kyang smra/ /dga' bar byed la mngon par brtson gyi skyon mi 'dzin/ /semasacan kun la phan phyir bsod nams yongasasu bsngo/ /thub mchog rnams kyi sangs rgyas byang chub sgrub pa shes/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i yon tan 'di bzhi bsten na de/ /rgyal ba mchog rnamasadrung du rdzusate skye bar 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub semsdpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na longs spyod chen por 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ brnyas pa med par sbyin pa'i tshul can dang / chags pa med par dngos po yongs su gtong ba dang /mos pa mang ba dang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na longs spyod chen por 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ desapa brnyasapa med par sbyin pa sbyin par byed/ /de ni dngos po kun la rtag tu 'dzin pa med/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes mchog la mos pa bskyed byas na/ /de ni phyir zhing longs spyod chen po thob par 'gyur/ /dad dang ldan par 'gyur zhing g.yo med sgyu yang 156
med/ /pha rol dag gi skyon ni 'dzin par yong mi byed/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas gang gi lta ba drang gyur pa/ /desan de 'dir longs spyod bzang po rnams dang ldan/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi dang ldan na shes rab chen por 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ chos la ser sna mi byed pa dang / mi mthun par mi 'jug pas 'gyod pa sel ba dang / gsol ba 'debs pa la yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du gdams ngag ston pa dang / stong pa nyid bsgom pa la mang du gnas pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na shesarab chen por 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mkhas pa nam yang ser sna yong mi byed/ /mi mthun 'jug pa med pas 'gyod pa sel/ /yang dag rab ldan gdams ngag ston par byed/ /rgyal ba'i spyod pa gang yin stong nyid bsgom/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /rgyal bas bzhed pa'i byang chub myur du 'thob/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bstan nadragabaslab byas nas/ /rkang gnyis dam pa sangs rgyas de 'gyur ro/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ lung nod pa dang / kha ton la brtson pa rnams lung mnos pa dang gdams ngag brjed nas yun ring du lon te gsol ba 'debs pa la lung 'bog cing dran par byed pa dang / 'di ltar kun dga' ba'i tshig gis gzhan dag la dang ba nye bar sgrub pa dang /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las nges par 'byung ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba 'ob par bya ba'i phyir gzhan dag la chos ston pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba la mngon par brtson zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma la mkhasapa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lung mnos kha ton brjed la dran par byed/ /gzhan la yid du 'ong ba'i sgra yang sgrogs/ /skyo ba med par chos kyang rjod par byed/ /ting 'dzin 157
bsgom pa'i mtshan ma legs par 'dzin/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /mthu chen ldan pa tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /bskal pa stong phrag bsam yas rjes su dran/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i mchog nyid myur du 'thob/ /bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangasargyasarnams dang 'phrad pa 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ phrog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi spong ba dang / srog gi phyir yang sdig pa'i grogs po rnams dang mi sten pa dang / srog gi phyir yang chosasmra ba la skur pa mi 'debs pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyasarnamasadang 'phrad par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sangs rgyas byang chub gyi tshom spong mi byed/ /chos smra ba la skur pa yong mi 'debs/ /des na sdig pa'i grogs rnams rnam par spong / /g.yel ba med par rtag tu sangs rgyas dran/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na/ /bde gshegs rnams dang 'phrad pa des 'thob bo/ /bla med byang chub ma thob bar du yang / /'dren pa gang na bzhugs pa der de skye/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chosabazhi dang ldan na skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la rin po che spar gyis 'thor ba dang / 'bru mar dri zhim po dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'khru bar byed pa dang / me tog dang / spos dang / sil snyan sna tshogs 'bul ba dang / yid du 'ong ba'i g.yog 'khor gyis mkhan po dang / slob dpon la bsnyen bkur bya bas rim gro byed pa sto/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na skyes bu chen polimtshan sum cu rtsa gnyisapo dag 'thob bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mchod rten la ni spar gyisadabyig rnams 'thor/ /dri zhig 'bru mar rnams kyisamachod rten 'bru/ /spos dang 158
me tog sil snyan sna tshogs 'bul/ /yid du 'ong bas mkhan po slob dpon sten/ /de'i lus sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /rab tu mdzes shing yon tan kun dang ldan/ /gang gis shes rab mchog ldan rgyal mdzes pa/ /chos de dag gis skyes chen mtshan du 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu po dag 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ stan rgyu sna tshogs chos kyi stan du 'bul ba dang /gzhan la bsti stang byed pas mi skyo ba dang / chos smra ba la 'thab mo mi rgol ba dang /sems can rnams byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu po dag 'thob bo de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ stan rgyu sna tshogs chos kyi stan du 'bul/ /gzhan la bsti stang byed pas skyo ba med/ /chos smra ba la 'thab mo yang mi rgol/ /sems can rnams ni byang chub 'dzin du 'jug /'di bzhis lus la dpe byad bzang po rnams/ /'di na de yis rnyed par dka' ba med/ /yon tan 'di dag rtag tu bsten byas na/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di na brgyan par 'gyur/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na spobs pa 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang / nyin mtshan du phung po gsum pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kha ton byed pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa skye ba med cing 'gag pa med par nges pa la mchog tu dga' ba skyes nas 'dzin pa dang / lus dang srog dang yo byad rnams la mi lta ba ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na spobs pa 'thob bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sne snod ni/ /nyin mtshan rab tu 'don par byed/ /'jig rten kun dang mi mthun pa/ /skyo ba med par rab tu sgrogs/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnyed gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin par byed/ /159
lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ /de ni byang chub lta bar byed/ /bzhi po 'di dag bsten byas na/ /de yi spobasapa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun/ /sna tshogs phreng 'dras tshim par byed/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ phrag dog med pa dang /ser sna med pa dang / sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa dang / 'khor dang 'dre ba med pa ste/ bu mo byang chub semasadapa' chosabazhi po de dag dang ldan na sangasargyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa 'thob bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan gyi rnyed la nam yang phrag dog med/ /mthong nas dga' bar 'gyur te ser sna med/ /semasacan kun la de yi sems kyang snyoms/ /'khor dang 'dre bar de ni yong mi byed/ /chos bzhi 'dis ni zhing gi bkod 'thob cing / /myur du byang chub mchog kyang thob par 'gyur/ /bu slo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na dge 'dun phun sum tshogs pa 'thob ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gzhan gyi 'khor mi 'byed pa dang / mi mthun pa rnams kyi sdums byed pa dang / lung nod pa dang kha ton byed du 'jug pas phan 'dogs pa dang / phra ma'i tshig yongs su spong ba ste/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dge 'dun phun sum tshogs pa 'thob bo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan gyi 'khor ni nam yang yong mi 'byed/ /skye bo mi mthun pa dag 'dun par byed/ /lung nod kha nyon byed la yang dag 'dzud/ /pha rol dag la dbyen gyi tshig mi smra/ /chos bzhi 'di dag nges par bsten byas na / /dge 'dun rgya chen rnam dag thob par 'gyur/ /de bas dge 'dun rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas chos 'di rtag tu bsten par bya/ /bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang du sems bskyed pa der skye ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/gzhan dag gi shes kyi khe dang rnyed pa la phrag dog mi skyed pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pas 160
pha rol tu phyin pa drug po yongasasu dag pa yongs su tshol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ston par 'du shes bskyed de tha na sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la yang bsti stang byed pa dang / shes kyi khe'i phyir tshul 'chos pa med pa ste/bu mo byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang du semasabaskyed pa der skye'o/ /de la 'di skad cesabya ste/ gzhan la mchod pa mthong na phrag dog med/ /pha rol phyin pa dag pa yongs su 'tshol/ /byang chub sems dpa' ston par rtag tu sems/ khes khe bde ba'i don du tshul 'chos med/ /yon tan 'di dag rtag tu bsten byasan/ /de bzhin gshegasapa rnams dang de 'phrad 'gyur/ /zhing gang dag tu smon lam btab byas pa/ /'dod pa bzhin du zhing der skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasal bu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pas 'di skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar chos brtags pa 'di dag bdag gis yang dag par blangs te gnas par mi bgyidrangan bdag gis sangs rgyas/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'tsho zhing gzhes la chosakyang ston pa de dag thamasacad bslusapar gyur cig de nasatshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu cho/ khyod de smad smra ba ni ngo mtshar te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub dka' bar mi shes sam/ de nas bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pas gnaca/ brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na ji ltar da ltar de ba'on gshegs pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar brtags pa'i chos 'di dag 161
kyang yang dag par blangasate gnas par 'gyur zhe na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur cig semasacanagang la yang gnod pa med par gyur cig bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar brtags pa'i chos 'di dag yang dag par blangasate gnasapar 'gyur zhe na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig desalha'i me tog gi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig ma dkrol bar sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong sgra 'byin par gyur cig bdag kyang bud med kyi lus las gyur te skyes pa'i lus su red cing lo bcu drug lon pa 'dra bar gyur cig smon lam de skad btab cing bden pa'i byin gyi rlabasa'adi byasam thag tu de nasade'i mod la stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ ma dkrol bar sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi sgra yang byung / lha'i me tog gi char yang mngon par bab po/ /bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa yang bud med kyi lus mi snang bar gyur te skyes pa'i dbang po thob nas lo bgradrug lon pa tsam gyi gzhan nu 'dra bar snang ngo / /de nasabacom ldan 'dasal tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngo mtshar che ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang po sems shāspyan ༵ ༵༵༷zung ste byang chub kyi snying po la gnas pa'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar 'di'i bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis rgyu 'di dag so sor yongasasu rdzogasapasabu mo dri ma med kyisabyin pa 'di ni 'di ltar dzño'aphrul che ba 'di ltar dbang che bar grags pa/ 'di ltar mthu che ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ modagal gyi bu de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ dang po 162
sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying polibar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnamasani lha dang bcasapa'i 'jig rten snyi mchod rten dang sbyin gnasayin te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangasargyasathamasacad kyang zil gyis gnon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nyid de/ gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer kha dog du ma kha dog sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung ste/ 'od des 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag snang bas khyab par mdzad nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phags te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/lha dang tshangs pa'i sgra dang mi mjed bdag po'isgra dang 'brug sgra dbyangs ldan pa/ /mgon po lha sgra yid 'ong ldan zhing 'dod chags zhe snang zhi bar mdzad pa po/ /gti mug spong ba 'jig rten dag na dga' ba bzang po gzhal yas skyed mdzad pa/ /stobs bcu yon tan rgya mtsho mnga' ba gang gi don du 'od btang bstan du gsol/ /rir bcas nags tshal bcas shing chab dang bcas pa'i sa rnamadrangarnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /lha rnams nam mkhar gnasashing lha yi me tog yid du 'ong ba'i char pa 'bebs/ /seng ges wa pham bgyis pa bzhin du khyod kyisamu stegasagazhan kun pham par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gang gi don du 'od kyi ltas 'di bstan pa mdzad pa bka' stsal /sol/ /nyi zla bye ba stong gis 'od bkye ba
dang glog dang nor bu rnams 'od dang / /lha dang klu dang dri za gnod sbyin dag gi 'od rnamasa'abar ba gang lagasapa/ to/kya thub pa'i zhal nas dge zhing dag pa'i 'od byung ba dang mjal gyur nas/ /'od rnams thams cad mog mog bgyis na sangs rgyas 'od ni phyogasabacu rnamasasu mdzes/ /khyod kyi smin mtshams bar gyi mdzod skru rab mdzes dkar zhing dri ma ma mchis bzang / /'bar zhing pad ma'i rtsa dang dung dang me tog kun da 'dra bas phyogs gsal bgyid/ /thams cad mog mog bgyis nas gdugs kyi srin bu me khyer bzhin du rgyal ba mdzes/ /mi yi seng ge thub 'di gang gi don chen bzang por der 'gyur bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad cesabaka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bu mo dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di byin gyis rlabs gang gis bud med kyi dngos po bsgyur te skyes pa'i dbang po thob par gyur pa mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'dasamathong lagasaso/ /bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang chub semasadapa' dri ma med kyisabyin pa 'di bskal pa grangs med pa 'bum phrag brgyad cur bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir spyad de/ bskal pa grangs med pa 'bum phrag drug cur spyad nas phyis bu mo 'di 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu semasabaskyed do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa gang dag yod pa de 'dra ba dag ni byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyisabyin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen posabyang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyisabyin pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod de ltar yun ring du bla na med pa yang dag par 164
rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir spyod spyod na/ de ci'i phyir khyod kyis de'i tshe bud med kyi dngosapo ma bsgyur byang chub semasadapa' dri ma med kyis byin pasasmrasapa/ gnaphubartan mod gal gyi bu chen po ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin na/btsun pa khyod ci'i phyir skyesapa'i lusalasam bsgyur/ gnasabartan mod gal gyi bu chen po cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nasabyang chub semasadapa' semasadapa' chen po dri ma med kyisabyin pasamodagal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bston pa modagal gyi bu chen po bud med kyi lusakyisabyang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yang ma yin/skyesapa'i lusakyisabyang chub mngon par rdzogasapar 'tshang rgya ba yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni ma skyesapa ste/ de ni lusasam semasakyisamangon par rdzogasapar 'tshang rgya bar mi nusapa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyisa'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasa'adi ltar byang chub semasadapa' dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di zab mo la mosapa ni ngo mtshar lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/'jam dpal 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyisabyin pa 'dis sangs rgyas bye ba phrag drug cu'i thad na tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms so/ /bskal pa brgyad cur mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa bsgoms so/ /sangs rgyasabye ba phrag sum cu dang / byang chub sems dpa' zab molitshul dang ldan pa rnamasal shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dris so/ /sangasargyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu la na bza' dang / zhal zas kyisabakur sti byas so/ /spobasapa rnam par ngesapar bstan pa'i chosakyi rnam grangs 'di yang yongasasu dris so/ /'jam dpal rigasakyi bu'am rigasakyi bu mo gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen poXjig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma
snyed dag rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu bkang ste de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dbul ba phul ba bas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan tam/ len tam/ 'dzin tam/'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston na 'di ni de bsachesabasod namasamang du skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgrub pa 'disani byang chub 'thob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de nasayang bcom ldan 'dasakyisa'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zungasashig chongs shig lhogs shig kun chub par gyisashig gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal de'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spobs pa rnam par nges par bstan pa zhes bya bar zungs shig gzungs kyi rdo rje'i tshig ces bya bar yang zungasashig byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod cesabya bar yang zungs shig dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa zhes bya bar yang zungs shig bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa na lha dang mi'i skye dgu las srog chags khrag khrig phrag brgyad cu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa 'di ji srid cig na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rjo gas par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'daX gas bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub
semasadapa' dri ma med kyisabyin pa 'di bskal pa brgya stong phrag grangasamed pa bgrang ba las 'das pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams med pa che'i tshad dpag tu med pa/ byang chub semasadapa'i dge 'dun dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/lha'i longs spyod pas shin tu lhag pa dang ldan pa/ yon tan dpag tu med pa bkod pa zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhad cing 'dzum pa dri ma med pa'itog gi rgyal po zhesabya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pas bcom ldan 'das las mngon sum du lung bstan pa thosanas dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba desata la bye ba phrag brgyad nasrid du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phagasate/ sangasargyasakyi zhing stong 'od kyis khyab par byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug gi steng du rin po che'i gdugs tshad dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong 'od pa byin gyis brlabs te/ rin po che'i gdugs des stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di khebs so/ /des kyang nam mkha' de nyid na ༄1'phrul dpag tu med pa byas nas phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag la bstod cing phyag 'tshal te bsti stang byas nas nam mkha' de las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan stong bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /de nasabram ze tshangs pa'i lha la sogasapa bram ze lnga brgya po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul yang mthong /lung bstan pa de yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te rab tu dga' nas bde ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas sgra skad mthun par bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ gang dag sangs rgyas gus mchis dang / /gang dag sangs rgyas chos slad du/ /blo ni shin tu nges 167
gyur pa/ /de dag rnyed pa chen po rnyed/ /sngon chad sdig pa'i lasabagyisapas/ /bdag cag bram ze'i khyim du skyes/ /ston pa'i nyan thos mthong gyur na/ /bkra mi shis zhes tshig tu brjod/ /sangasargyasasrasadag mthong gyur na/ /bkra mi shisazhesabagyisapa yi/ /tshig tu brjod pa gang mchis pa/ /btsun pa nongs pa bshags par bgyid/ /tshogs kyi rgyal po mchog gyur pa/ /sangasargyasagang dag ma mthong ba/ /mi de dag gisanongasapa rnyed/ /de dag kha zas ngan pa 'tshal/ /dri med byin pas mchod sbyin slad/ /bdag cag mgron du bosapar gyur/ /ston pa'i nyan thosarnamasamathong nas/ /mkhusapasani sdod cing mchis/ /de la bdag cag rnamasakyisadris/ /khyod kyisa'adren pa gang na mthong / /desasmrasabatsasnasazhag bdun na/ /kho mos sangasargyasamatshan thosamachi/ /de yisasangasargyas bsngagsmang ba/ /de bzhin gzhan du mi 'gyur brjod/ /de yi tshig thosabadag cag kun/ /byang chub mchog tu yang dag zhugs/ /bdag cag sngon gyi bsod nams dang / /sangs rgyas zhesabagyi'i sgras bskul bas/ sto1kya seng ge'i zhabadragal ni/ /phyag bgyi'i slad du lhags pa lags/ /rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasamathong phyag bgyis/ /chosakyi dam pa thosapar gyur/ /rkang gnyis dam pa 'di mthong bas/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal kun las grol/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /chos gang bshad pa mdzad pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi don slad du / /bdag cag de la slob par bgyid/ /sangasargyasachos thob bgyi slad du/ /byang chub spyod pa thos gyur nas/ /bdag cag yang dag nan tan gyis/ /spyod pa de la bslab par bgyi/ /byang chub semasadapa'i spyod gang dang / /lam dang sgo yang bstan pa la/ /nan tan gyis ni gnas par bgyi/ /'jig rten rnams kyi mchod rten 'gyur/ /de dag lhag pa'i bsam mkhyen nas/ /thub pas de tshe 'dzum pa mdzad/ /thub chen lung bstan mdzad gsol zhes/ /sangs rgyas la ni kun dgas zhus/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' 168
la/ /'di skad cesani bka' stsal to/ /bram ze lnga brgya 'di dag dang / /bram ze tshangs pa'i lha de dang / /de kun bskal pabacugs tshe/ /rnam par 'dren pa sangasargyasa'agyur/ /sangasargyasalnga brgya tham pa la/ /tshe rabasasnga mar mchod byasapa/ /de nas phyin chad spyod tshe yang / /sangasargyasabye ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyad cur ni/ /de dag ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /de dag bskal pa re re la'ang / /sangasargyasabye ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /de dag bskal pa gcig de la/ /rkang gnyis rnamasakyi mchog 'gyur te/ /'od byed ces bya'i bskal gcig la/ /tshangs pa'i sgra zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /de dag ② tshad mtshungs 'gyur te/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyad cu thub/ /zhing mtshungasadage 'dun mtshungs 'gyur te/ /dge slong bye ba brgyad cu yod/ /semasacan rnams kyi don spyod cing / /chos'di la yang spyad byasanas/ /de dag thamasacad mthar gyisasu/ /mya ngan 'des pa zhi ba 'thob/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs dang / byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med kyis byin pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / bram ze de dag dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / nyan thos chen po de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangasate/ bcom ldan 'dasakyisagasungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ / / /169
༄tsho/ /rgyal po gzugasacan snying polibaston mo bde ldan ma che'iltabya ba sangasargyasadang 'phrad nas lung bstan pa thob tshul/'phagasapabade ldan yolungabastan pa'i mdo laphubatus/de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying polibatsun mo bde ldan ma zhes bya ba khang bzangs mchog gi steng na 'dug pas bcom ldan 'das thag ring po nas gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nasakyang semasadaga' bar gyur te/ khang bzangasakyi steng nasababsnas/ bcom ldan 'dasadang / byang chub sems dpa' semasadapa' chen po byams pa'i gdan dar dkar rin che ba bting ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' semasadapa' chen po byamasapa gdan bshamasapa la bzhugasaso/ /de nas rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan ma lus rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pas bcom ldan 'dasadang / byang chub semasadapa' sems dpa' chen po byamasapa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nasachos mnyan pa'i phyir zhe sa dang bcas/ gusapa dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan ma lus rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la gzigs nas sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir mkhyen bzhin du rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan ma la bka' stsal pa/ bde lda na ma gang lus la thogs pa'i 'bras bu 'di lta bu shin tu lham me lhan rna lha nger 'dug pa'i shing de'i ming ci zhes bya/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan mas 1rdoXsasu bcad de gsol pa/ gang gi 'bras
bu khyod thogasapa/ 9nga de'i ming ni ci yin zhes/ /dpa' bo chen po mkhyen bzhin du/ /gangazag mchog gisarmasapa ni/ /bdag gisasngon ni gang bskyed pa/ /bsod namasalasbyub shing zhesabagyi/ /'dren pa bdag gisamyong ba yi/ /'brasabu 'di dag de yi lags/ /ljon shing bshad pa de nyid kyang / /sangs rgyas nyan thosarnamasal yod/ /sangasargyasaye shes 'thob 'dod rnams/ /byang chub phyir ni de la gnas/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims chab stsal bas/ /ldon shing de rje rnam par bsrungs/ /de ni rnam par 'byungasapa na/ /'brasabu bzang po rnamasakyang 'byung / /bzod pa dang ni brtson 'grusamathus/ /ldon shing bdag gis legasapar bsrungs/ /de ni rnam par 'khrungasapa na/ /'brasabu dri med 'byung bar 'gyur/ stonang 'di lta na mdzesapa ste/ /bsam gtan shesarab me tog rgyas/ /'dren pa bdag gisade dag gi /'brasabu rnamasani myong ba lags/ /ji ltar ri la brten pa yi/ /shing rnamasayal ga lo ma dag /chu zheng gab par rgya che ba/ /'phel bar gyur te bskyod mi nus/ /de bzhin ldon shing che bzang 'di/ /sangs rgyas chosanyid 'tshal bsan/ /semscan kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sngon ni legs par bsrungasapa lags/ /'dren pa'i bsod nams ldon shing 'di'i/ /'bras bu gzhan yang mchisalags te/ /bdag gisanyams su myong ba 'di/ /de yi me tog tsam du bas/ /de yi 'bras bu byang chub mchog /sangs rgyas byang chub bla med lags/ /de ni bdag gis thob par 'gyur/ /smad pa bud med nyid spangasanas/ /skyesapar bdag nyid 'gyur ba lags/ /semasacan kun gyi dam pa mchog /chos rnams kun gyi pha rol phyin/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs/ /sdug bsngal kun gyis nyen pa yi/ /sems can rnams ni bdag gisadagrol/ /'jig rten kun la snying brtse ba'i/ /skyabs su bdag ni 'gyur ba lags/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan ma la bka' stsal pa/ bde ldan ma 171
gang khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che'i tshogasakyi don dang / lha rnamasadang / mi rnamasal phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir zhugadragapa legs so legs so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'dasal rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan masa'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la skyes bu chen polimatshan sum cu rtsa gnyisadang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobasabacu dang /mi 'jigasapa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dresapa bca brgyad dang / byamasapa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po 'di rnams ci las grub lags/ de bzhin du gzhan yang sangasargyasakyi chosadapag tu ma mchisapa dang / bsam gyisami khyab pa dang / gzhal du ma mchisapa dang / brjod du ma mchisapa dang / bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams ci lasagrub lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal poyibatsun mo bde ldan ma la tshigadragasu bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes 'dod padragan/ /sematha(can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ngas kyang 'di ltar ldon pa'i shing / /sngon ni legs pa kho nar bskyed/ /sbyin dang tshul khrimasabazod pa dang / /de bzhin brtson 'grus bsam gtan bsags/ /yun ring dus nas ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab nges par bsten pa yin/ /sems can rnams la mi mnyam sems/ /ngas ni bsgoms par mi dran te/ /rtag tu sems ni mnyam gyur pas/ /sangasargyasanyid ni ngasabarnyesaso/ /nga yi semasani mnyam pa yis/ /rtag tu sdug dang mi sdug dang / /mdza' dang mi mdza' snyoms pa/sa na/ /bso da nams shing ni rnam par bskyed/ /des na ldon shing chen po 'di/ /yon tan mang por gyur pa yin/ /'khor los sgyur nyid ngas thob ste/ /brgya byin nyid kyang byas pa yin/ /rnam mang dbang 172
phyug chen po dang / /tshangs pa nyid kyang de las thob/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas chos/ /mtshan nyid dag kyang ngas rtogs so/ /de nas rgyal po'i btsun mo bde ldan mas bcom ldan 'dasakyi yon tan rnams thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par rab tu gsungs pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangs nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ ji ltar mi mchog dam pa po/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas/ /sngon ni spyod pa shin tu bslabs/ /de ltar bdag kyang rjes su slob/ /yon tan mthar phyin khyod kyi ni/ /yon tan rnams ltar bdag slob ste/ /srid par sdug bsngal spangs nas ni/ /bdag kyang 'di 'drar 'gyur bar bgyi/ /tshe rabs gzhan ni ma lus par/ /bdag gis sbyin pa gang stsal pa/ /mnyam med ye shes 'thob slad du/ /de dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /srid pa 'di 'am gzhan dag tu/ /bdag gis tshul khrims gang bsrungs pa/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'thob slad du/ /de dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab dge ba gang bsten pa/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi don gyi phyir/ /de dag thamasacad bdag gisabasngo/ /lusadang ngag dang yid rnamasakyis/ /las dge gang dag bdag gisabasags/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yon tan phyir/ /byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo/ /bud med lus 'di spangasanas ni/ /skyes pa mchog tu bdag gyur cig /de ltar skyes pa'i lus thob nas/ /dam pa'i mchog tu bdag gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas bde gshegasakyi/ /'khor lo bla med bskor bar bgyi/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yi/ /sems can bye ba dgrol bar bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan ma la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ tshig 'di smras pa legs pa yin/ /sems ni rab tu sdom/ pa legs/ /khyod kyis bdud ni legs par mnan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su khyod 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po'i 173
btsun mo bde ldan ma dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' ba dang / dga' zhing yid bde ba skyedraganabaltabacom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa bza' ba dang bca' ba mang pos tshim par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bstsang sder ni gyu/ phyag ni bcabs nas rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan ma la chos kyi gtam rgyas pas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas lung bstan te/ bde ldan ma khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa du ma zhig na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lha dang mi rnamasakyi ston pa/ sangasargyasabacom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen dpal zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang mchog tu yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ngan song ngan 'gro log par lhung ba'i sdug bsngal med pa yid du 'ong ba yid dang 'thad pa mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas yin te/ khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni de lta bur 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na dge bsnyen ma stong phrag mang po zhig gisani bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu snroshā rnyi rnyisgyu nā ṣ+yo /ba/ sprapa ((rnyi /stong phrag mang po dang / lha dang mi'i skye dgu rnams kyis ni bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ rgyal polibatsun mo bde ldan ma dang / 'bor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa 'i 'jigarten yi rangasate/ bcom ldan 'dasakyisagasungasapa la mngon par bstod do/ / / /174
rabya4/ /li ts+tsha bī dri med grags pa'i sras mo bu mo zla mchog ces bya bas nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la zab mo'ichos kyi 'bel gtan mdzad cing sangs rgyas la mchod pa du ma phul te lung bstan thob tshul/bu mo zla rma chag lungabastan pa'i theg pa me+e po'i mdo 'a phubazla/de'i tshe yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po na lits+tsha bī dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ longs spyod mang ba/ mdzod dang bang ba mang ba zhigaganasate/ de la chung ma dri med ma zhes bya ba mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po/ rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig yod de/ zla ba dgu 'das pa dang / de las bu 51 gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad legs par rdzogs pa zhig btsas so/ /bu mo de btsas ma thag tu khyim de thams cad snang ba chen posakhyab par gyur cing sachen po yang rab tu g.yosapar gyur/ phyi rol gyi sgo gang gi wa dag las kyang mar khu dang / 'bru mar dag rab tu 'dzag cing zhan pa dang / mgon med pa dang / bkren pa dang / sdug phongasapa gang yin pa dag ci bder yongasasu spyod do/ /yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po na/ rnga bo che dang / rdza rnga dang / mkhar rnga dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang ma brdungasapar sgra 'byin par gyur cing me tog gi char chen po dag kyang rab tu bab par gyur/ khyim gyi grwa bzhir yang rin po che sna tshogs kyis rab tu gang ba'i gter chen po bzhi byung zhing kha bye ste kun tu snang bar gyur to/ /bu mo de btsasam thag tu ngu /sta mi 'byin cing mchi ma mi blog la lhag par
yang sor mo bcu thal mo sbyar te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sdig las byas pas 'dir ni gtsang ma yi/ /lus su mi skye yid du 'ong bar min/ /sdig las byas pasa'adir ni longs spyod dag /'byor pa'i khyim rnams su yang mi skye'o/ /sbyin dul yang dag sdom dang bag yod cing / /gus dang bcas pas bla ma bsnyen bkur ba'i/ /gya nom rang bzhin las kyi rtag tu ni/ /longs spyod bdag nyid chen po'i khyim du 'grub/ /'dren pa rgyal ba 'od srung bsod snyoms phyir/ /yangs pa can gyi grong du zhugs pa na/ /bdag gis khang bzangs steng nas mthong gyur cing / /mthong nas der ni bdag yid dang ba dran/ /de tshe bdag yid rab tu dang gyur nas/ /bdag la mertag med cing byug pa med/ /phye ma spos med zas dang skom med pas/ /ston pa 'di la cis mchod bya snyam sems/ /de nas bdag gis sgra thos sangs rgyas ni/ /'gro ba dgrol phyir zang zing med spyod cing / /'jig rten brtse phyir thugs rje skyes nas ni/ /sangs rgyas bsod snyoms slad du 'jig rten brgyan/ /gal te rgyal ba de dag mchod 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir khyod kyis smon lam thob/ /byang chub sems bskyed brtan gyur gang yin pa/ /de las lhag mchod srid pa gsum na med/ /bar snang sgra thos de nas bdag gis sna/ /mtshan mchog spras pa'i sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /byang chub phyir ni mi g.yo yid skyes nas/ /khang pa de nas rang gis lus mchongs te/ /bar snang ta la srid la 'dug nas ni/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugasapa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba 'od srung de yi sku/ /rin chen ri dang lhun po 'dra ba mthong / /rgyal ba'i mthus ni bdag gi lag mthil du/ / man dwa ra ba'i phur ma che byung zhing / /de dag bdag gis 'od srung gtor ba dang / /me tog gdugs gyur nam mkha' la ni gnas/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa mchan gyis sku brgyan de dag bltas na yang / /ji ltar 'od srung stong na 'dug pa ltar/ /de dag 176
la yang me tog gdugasanyid snang / /mkha' la gnasabazhin bdag gis tshig smras pa/ /bskal pa chu rdul snyed du spyad bya zhing / /byang chub ma thob bdag phyir mi ldog gis/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtsor gyur cig /bdag gis seng ge'i nga ro de thos nas/ /de tshe stong phrag bcu gnyis tshang ba yi/ /lha mi lha min gnod sbyin srin po rnams/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog la yang dag zhugs/ /thos nas sum cu rtsa gsum lhar skyes shing / /las bzang byas pa chud zar ma gyur pas/ /de nas shi 'phos 'dzam gling 'dir 'ongs kyis/ /de phyir skye bo rnams kyis bsod nams byos/ /gang tshe sum cu rtsa gsum gnas gyur pa/ /de tshe bdag gis rgyal ba shāka thub mchod/ /bdag ni 'dod dang longs spyod lus mi gnyer/ /rgyal ba yang dang yang du mchod par bya/ /bdag gis bsod nams rnam smin de mthong zhing / /nyin gcig 'dra ba tshe rabasabargya yang dran/ /bdag 'dir skyes pa'i dpal yang 'di 'dra na/ /mkhas pa su zhig rgyal la gus mi skyed/ /de nasabu mo des tshigs su bcad pa de dag smrasanas cang mi zer bar 'dug par gyur to/ /de'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 'bras bu'i rgyu mthun pas lus la lha'i gos rin po che dag gyon bzhin du byung bar gyur nas de'i lus las zla ba las shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'od zer gser gyi mdog tu snang ba dag kyang byung ngo / /de nas pha ma dag gis de'i ming zla mchog ces bya bar btags so/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog de skad cig dang / thang cig dang / yud tsam cig gis 'di lta ste/ dper na bu mo lo brgyang lon pa lta bu'i na tshod du kun tu snang ngo / /des sa'i phyogs gang dang gang dag tu 'greng ba dang /'chag pa dang / 'dug pa dang / mal bcas par gyur pa de dang de dag tu 'od zer gser gyi mdog lta bu dag snang bar gyur to/ /de'i spu'i khung bu thams cad nas can dan sa mchog pa'i dri dag dang / kha nas kyangakhud pa la sngon po〉dri ngad byung bar gyur to/ /de 177
nasayangasapa can gyi grong khyer gyi tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / rgyal bu rnamasadang /de las gzhan pa rigs che ba rnams dang / rigs mtho ba dag gis bu mo zla mchog gi lus kyi gzugs dang / kha dog yongs su rdzogs pa thos so/ /thos nas kyang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sems shin tu dkris par gyur cing so so nas 'di snyam du sems te/de bdag gi chung mar gyur na ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas skye bo phal po che rnams de thob par bya ba'i phyir semasabartson par gyur te/ de dag las kha cig ni lits+tsha sbi dri ma med par gragasapa la sten par byed/ sten par byed cing bsnyen bkur byed par gyur to/ /kha cig ni nor bu dang / gser dang / dngul dang / rdo rje dang / be+eḍūr+ya dang / spug dang / an da rnyil dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru bye ba snyed dag sbyin zhing 'dod pa skyed par byed do/ /kha cig ni nor dang / 'bru dang / khyim dang / longs spyod dang / kha zas dag stobs par byed do/ /kha cig ni bran dang / bran mo dang / las mi dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dag la gsad pa dang / bcing ba dang / brdeg pa la sogs pa dag gis 'jigasapa ston par byed do/ /kha cig ni lits+tsha bī dri ma med par grags pa la 'di skad ces zer te/ gal te khyod kho bo cag la bu mo zla mchog 'bul bar mi byed na/ de'i phyir khyed la des sdug bsngal 'byung bar bya zhing khyod la gnod pa chen po yang bya'o zhesazer ro/ /de nas lits+tsha bī dri ma med par grags pa 'di snyam du ma la dpung dag lhags nas bdag bzung zhing bcom ste/ bu mo yang phyogs la bdag kyang srog dang phral bar mi 'gyur grang snyam nas/ skrag cing dngangasal sgyid lug cing spu zing zhesabyed par gyur nas/de dran pa nyamasashing gzhan gyi sgo shi la rab tu ngu zhing mchi ma blags te/ mig mi 'dzums par bu mo zla mchog la lta'o/ /bu mo zla mchog gis rang gi pha ngu zhing yi shi la gdong mchi mas g.yog cing yul yul por gyur pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas de la 'di skad ces smras 178
so/ /yab ci'i slad du 'di ltar bshums shing bshums mo dag rab tu glog par mdzad lags/ de nas lits+tsha bī dri ma med par grags pas bu mo zla mchog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo 'di ltar khyod dbrog cing khyod kyi phyir grong khyer thams cad du 'thab mo dang rtsod pa dag kun tu 'byung bar khyod kyis mi shes sam/ de'i phyir dpung dag lhags shing bcom ste/ khyod phrogs par mi 'gyur grang snyam nas des na mchi ma byung ba yin mod/de nas bu mo zla mchog gis rang gi pha la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gal te 'dzam gling sems can thams cad dag /sred med bu 'dra'i brtson 'grus thob gyur cing / /de dag mtshon thogs bdag slad rgyug gyur kyang / /de dag rnams kyis bdag gzhom/ rngo mi thogs/ /byamasasemasaldan la dug dang mtshon mi tshugs/ /ro langs dang ni 'jigs pa gzhan mi 'byung / /byams sems tha ba zhe snang ma mchis pas/ /byams pa'i sems la gzhan gyis gnod mi 'gyur/ /yab bdag 'jig rten dag la byams pa che/ /ngan bu bdag bzhin 'gro la dga' bar gnas/ /nam yang gzhan la sdug bsngal ma bgyis pas/ /de phyir ngan bu sdug bsngal mi 'gyur yab/ /chagasabral nam yang 'dod chags ma mchis shing / /byams pa yongasabasgoms zhe ldang ma mchis lags/ /bdag la chags ri nga gti mug ma mchis te/ /de phyir ngan bu gzhan gyis mi thub yab/ /yab dang yum la byams pa mchisapa ltar/ /'gro ba kun la rgyun du bdag de bzhin/ /yab gang 'jig rten dag la de 'drar byams/ /de ri nam yang g.yin gyis gnod mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha' dog sa 'dzin par bgyid gyur ram/ /lhun po yungs 'bru'i nang du gnas gyur tam/ /rgya mtsho chen po gnag rjes zhugs gyur kyang / /bdag 'joms bgyid par rngo thogs ma mchis yab/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog gis tshigs su bcad pa de dag smras nas rang gi pha ma la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /yab yum de'i slad du 'di ltar deng nas dgung bdun na bu mo zla 179
mchog phyir 'byung bar 'gyur zhing byung nas kyang rang gang 'dod pa'i khyim thab 'dam par 'gyur gyis/ der khyod cag gis bsgrim par bya zhing lam srang dang bzhi mdo dang sum mdo'iphyogs thams cad kyang rgyan dag gis brgyan par bya zhing / me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa'i cho ga dag gisakyang byi dor gyisashig ces shul po che dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo thams cad du dril dkrol zhing sgra bsgrag tu gsol/ de nasabu mo zla mchog gisapha ma gnyisarang gi khyim nasabyung ste/ 'di skad du deng nasazhag bdun na bu mo zla mchog phyir 'byung bar 'gyur zhing byung nas kyang bu mo gang 'dod pa'i khyim thab 'dam par 'gyur gyis/ der khyed cag gisabasgrim par bya zhing lam srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo3phyogs thams cad rgyan dag gis brgyan par bya zhing / me tog dang / bdug sbosadang / spos dang / me rtog phreng dang / byug pa'i cho ga dag gis kyang byi dor gyis shig cesarang bzhin de dag kun tu bsgrags so/ /de skad so sor thos nas/ yangs pa can gyi skye bo phal po che rnams 'di ltar rang rang gi lam srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdonaphyogs dag brgyan par bya ba la brtson par gyur cing / sems la 'di snyam du ci nas kyang bu mo zla mchog ni bdag la 'dzin gyi gzhan dag la ni ma yin grang snyam du sems te/ de dag phan tshun 'gran pas rang rang brgyan par byed de/ 'di lta ste/ tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / zhang blon dang / bram ze dang / rgyal bu rnams dang las mi'i bar dag kyang shin tu khrus byas shing lusalegs par byugs te/ gos bzang po bgos shing rgyan sna tshogs kyis lus brgyan nasarang rang gi g.yog 'khor rnams la khyed cag sgrims shig /gal te bu mo zla mchog 'u bu cag gi gan du rang mi 'ong ba lta na/ de'i phyir mthus drangs la phyogs shig ces skul bar byed do/ /de ltar zhag bdun 'dasapa dang / skye bo phal po che dag ngo mtshar du 'dzin 180
par gyur nas/ bu mo zla mchog blta ba'i phyir 'dus par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog nyi ma drug pa la zla ba nya ba'i tshe gso sbyong yan lag brgyad po yang dag par blangs te mtshan mo mi nyal tsam na/ steng gi khang bzangs kyi thog na 'chag ceng 'dugago/de nassangs rgyas kyi mthus bu mo zla mchog gi lag pa g.yas par pad ma sdong bu ni gser/'dab ma ni dngul/ ze ba ni baiḍūr+ya/ snying po ni rdon+dasnying po lasabyasapa/ 'dab ma 'bum phrag du ma yod pa/ lta na sdug pa 'od gsal ba zhig byung bar gyur to/ /pad ma de'i snying ponadabus na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sku mdog gser 'dra la gzi brdzid 'bar ba/'od kyisasnang bar mdzad pa skyesabu chen polimatshan sum nanaganyisakyisasku legasapar brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cusagazugs mdzesapar byasapa/ skyil mo krung gisbzhugaphupa zhig kyang byung bar gyur te/ de bzhin gshegar+sāpa'i sku de'i 'od kyis khyim de thamasacad snang bsagasal bar gyur to/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog gis pad ma de mthong zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang mthong ba dang / dga' zhing mgu la yi rangasate/ rab tu dga' zhing dka' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ 'di 'dra'i dpal dang ldan pa khyod/ /ci lags lha 'am 'on te klu/ /lha min gsang ba mi'am ci/ /su lags dris pa nges par gsungs/ /khyod sku gser mdog 'od gsal ba'i/ /tshad ni dmigasasu ma mchis te/ /skad cig mdog gser btsod ka dang / /myur bar shel 'od 'dra bar gda'/ /ngan bu lhan chad lus kyis ni/ /'du shes ma mchis sems mi g.yo/ /mgon po khyod kyi sku mthong nas/ /bdag ni dga' ba yangasapa skyes/ /khyod sku dpal 'bar me 'dra zhing / /ri lasari bzhin mdzes 'phagasapa/ /ji ltar bzung zhing rab tu gnas/ /gang nas 'dir byon gang du gshegs/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs 181
pa'i sku des bu mo zla mchog la phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ nga ni lha min klu yang min/ /mi 'am ci min gnod sbyin min/ /sangasargyasashākya seng ge yis/ /nga ni khyod kyi gan du btang / /nga ni lha min gnod sbyin min/ /klu min mi 'am ci yang min/ /chos byung nga deng khyod kyi phyir/ /lha mi 'dul bsabaka' stsal to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de la bu mo zla mchog gis tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ sangs rgyas sangasargyasazhesabagyi ba/ /de mdog ci 'dra 'dir gsungasal/ /de yi rtags dang dbyibs gsungs dang / /de thos bdag gisartogs par 'gyur/ /khyod 'dir sangasargyas mtshan gsungasan/ /de mdog rtagasadang dbyibasami gsung / /sangs rgyasarung spyod gang dang mthun/ /mi mnyam mdzad spobasa'adir gsungasashig /de nas de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku desabu mo zla mchog la phyir tshigasasu bcad de bka' stsal pa/ de ni sku mdog gser 'dra zhing / /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyisamanga'/ /semasacan kun gyi mchodarten de/ /de phyir sangasargyasazhesabarjod do/ /byed ldan semasacan rnamasakyi ni/ /spyod pa mchog dang dman pa dag /thugasagacig gisani rtogasamadzad de/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhesabarjod do/ /chosakun rnam pa thamasacad du/ /des ni mi mkhyen cung zad med/ /ye shes kun gyi pha rol byon/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /des ni sems can kun gyi sems/ /thugs gcig gis ni rtogs gyur kyang / /kun gyi sems la nam du yang / /rlom pa mi mnga' gzhan du na/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa sbyin pas 'phags/ /tshul khrims spyod pas mthor 'phags shing / /bzod dang brtson pas mngon 'phags la/ /bsam gtan shes rab yang dag 'phags/ /bzo rnams thams cad legs bslabs pas/ /des ni mi mkhyen cung zad med/ /byamasadang thugasarje phun sum tshogs/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /gang gis bla med 'khor lo yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab 182
bskor cing / /zhing rnamasabye ba rnamasarig la/ /bdag med rab tu bstan mdzad cing / /gang gisasangs rgyasazhing stong dang / /brgya dang khrag khrig snyed rnams dag /ljags kyisrab tu khyab mdzad pa/ /de phyir sangasargyasazhesabarjod do/ /zhing rnamasabye ba stong phrag ni/ /gang gā'i bye ma snyed dag tu/ /dbyangs kyis go bar mdzad pas na/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /'dren pas phyag ni ya gcig gis/ /zhing rnams bye snyed blangs mdzad cing / /bskal pa bye bar de bzhugs pas/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /zhing rnamasastong phrag bye snyed na/ /ri bo lhun po ji snyed pa/ /skra nyagabacugagisade sbamasashing / /zhing rnamasabye bar 'phen mdzad la/ /chos rnamasakun la rang byung zhing / /gsan nas go 'phang mchog brnyes la/ /semasacan bcing ba rnam 'grel bas/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhesabarjod do/ /dbang ldan gyur cing stobasabacu mnga'/ /mi bsnyengs rtogasapar thugssu chud/ /sangasargyasachosal nem nur med/ /de phyir sangasargyas zhesabarjod do/ /dbu yi gtsug tor bltar mi mthong / /spyan lnga dag dang ldan pa dang / /stobasadang dbang po lnga mnga' zhid / /byang chub yan lag lam la gnas/ /ngang tshul bzang zhid 'grogasan bde/ /zhi zhing dul la bla na med/ /g.yo med drang po gsal ba ste/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /de ni rtag tu mnyam gzhag cing / /de la g.yeng ba mi mnga' la semasacan don gyi dus su gsung / /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /yon tan kun dang legs ldan zhing / /de ni 'gro ba'i mchod rtenate/ /thamasacad mkhyen cing thamasacad gzigs/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes brjod do/ /nga yis bskal pa'am yang na ni/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar yang / /gang phyir sangs rgyas de don brjod/ /de phyir sangs rgyas 'es brjod do/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyesanas de bzhin gshegasapa blta bas yongasasu skom par /83
gyur te/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku de la phyir tshigasasu bcad degasol pa/ gang gi yon tan de 'dra ba'i/ /rdzogaphusangasade bltar rngo thogasasam/ /chosa'adi thosan mkhasapa ni/ /su zhig skad 'ga'ang khyim la dga'/ /ji srid bde gshegs ma mthong bar/ /bdag ni rmugasadang gnyid spong zhing / /zasadang skom yang mi 'tshal la/ /stan la'ang mchisapar mi bgyid do/ /bdag gis khyod mthong shin tu rangs gyur cing / /yon tan bdag nyid thos nas bdag rab dang / /mngon sum sangs rgyas de ni mthong 'gyur la/ /slar zhing mtshungasamed dga' bar 'gyur lagasagrang / /bskal pa stong phrag bye bar 'jigarten na/ /skyes bu mchog rnams mthong ba shin tu dkon/ /dgra bcom de'i mtshan deng thos bdag gis ni/ /rnyed pa legs rnyed bdag gis rgyal ba blta/ /sprul pa de yis de la 'di skad smras/ /sems can mchog de tshal chen nang na bzhugs/ /de yi dge 'dun stong phrag brgyad po dag /dpa' bo sdig med mi gtsang spangs pa yin/ /de dag re re'ang lag pa ya gcig gis/ /bskal pa mang por stong gsum zhing 'deg cing / /ting 'dzin mngon shes spobs pa rab thob la/ /thos pa mi 'khrug rgya mtsho 'dra ba yin/ /de dag rgyal ba mchod phyir rdzu'aphrul gyis/ /bye ba dpag med zhing du skad 'gasa'adong / /dong nasasangs rgyasbye snyed mngon mchod cing / /brtan rnamasaphyir yang skad 'gasaldog par byed/ /bdag tu 'du shes sangasargyas 'du shes med/ / zhing du 'du shesasems can 'du shesamed/ /spros pa sna tshogs kun gyis ma gos shing / /sems can tshogs chen rnams kyi don yang byed/ /dgra thul de dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin dge slong dge 'dun lta 'dod cing / /thub dbang drung nas chos mchog nyan 'dod na/ /tshal chen gang na ston de bzhugs par song / /de nas bu mo zla mchog pad ma de nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ji lta ra bzhugs pa de nyid thogs bzhin du khang bzangs kyi steng de nas babs nas rang gi 184
