pha mag la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / rangs pha ma la tshigasasu bcad de smrasapa/ yab gzigasangan bu'i sug pa g.yasapa na/ /pad mgaser sdong mdzesapa yid du mchi/ /skyesbu dam pa'i sku la gzigasashig yum/ /mthong na su zhig de la skyabasami mchi rang gi gnas kun gser mdog 'dra ba yi/ /'od kyis gsal ba bdag gis mthong lags yum/ /skad cig la yang du mar mdog 'gyur bas/ /5 yi tshad ni gzung bar rngo mi thogs/ /de slad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar tshalachen du/ /rgyal bgotam gzigasasu gshegsso yum/ /metog rnamasadang sposamachog bsnamasanasasu/ /de bzhin gshegasapa la ni mchod par bgyi/ /zla ba mchog gi pha dang ma dag gis/ /yid du 'ong ba'i tshig thos legasasozhes/ /gosarnamasadang ni bdug sposasbosadag dang / /me tog rnamasadang phreng ba byug pa'ang blangs/ /rnga chen dzornga hab shang gdugasarnamasadang / /dung dang rgyal mtshan gling bu pi wang dang / /rin chen sil snyan yid 'ong thogs nas ni/ /de dag khang pa de nasangesapar byung / /de'i tshe na nyi ma bdun pa de la srog chagaphu'abum phrag du ma dag bu mo zla mchog blta ba'i phyir 'dus par gyur nas/ de dag las kha cig ni 'dod pa'i 'dod chagasakyis semasakun nas dkrisapar gyur/ kha cig ni lta 'dod par gyur/ kha cig ni rtog pa skyes par gyur nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po rgyan gyis brgyan to/ /khye'u dang bu mo dag kyang ltags bu dang / sgo khang dang / rta babs dang / skar khung dang / pu shu dang / khang pa brtsegasapa dang / khang bzangs kyi steng dag tu dong ste 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad ma la bzhugs pa de nyid kyang thogasabazhin du pha ma dang 'khor mang po rnams dang lhan cig tu me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang /13sdig pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /
gdugasadang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag thogasate/ sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa sna tshogs byed pa de dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te rang gi gnas nas byung ngo / /de nasasgog chagaphu'abum phrag du ma dag gis de grong bar gyi dbusasu byung ba mthong ba dang / bdag gisa'adigazung bar bya'o snyam du semasashing rabatu rgyug go /de'i tshe na yangasapa can gyi grong khyer chen po na skye po phal po che de dag lhan cig tu rgyug pa'i tshe ha ha tshur shog tshur shog cesabya ba'i sgra chen po byung bar gyur to/ /de nasabu mo zla mchog gisade'i mod la skye bo phal po che rgyug pa de dag mthong nas/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad ma la bzhugadragapa de nyid kyang thogasabazhin du bar snang gi nam mkha' lashing ta la'i srid tsam du mngon par 'phagasate 'dug par gyur to/ /'dug nasakyang skye bo phal po che de dag la tshigasasu bcad de smrasapa/ bzod ldan bdag gi mdzes pa'i lusa'adi ni/ /chagasapa'i sems lasabyung ba ma yin te/ /kha dog gser mdog me lce 'bar ba 'dra/ /shin tu yid 'ong kho molilus 'di ltos/ /gang dag yul rnams la ni brkam med na/ /me mdag 'obasa'adra rab 'bar 'dod spong zhing / /dbang po drug rnamasasdom pasabasnams pa dang / /gang dag tshangs spyod rnamasaspyod dag pa dang / /gang dag gzhan gyi bud med rnams mthong na/ /ma sring snyam du 'du shes skyed byed na/ /de dag mdzes shing shin tu blta sdug la/ /rtag tu mchog tu yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /gang gis sa 'di kun tu khyab byed pa/ /bdag gi spu yi khung nas byung ba'i dri/ /'dod chags sems kyis bdag gis de ma bsgrubs/ /de ni sbyin dang dul ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /kho mo 'dod chags ldan pa'i sems mi skyed/ /'dod chags bral 'a/ chags pa ma/ skyed cig /ji ltar smras bden nam yang brdzun min te/ /mdun gyi thub dbang 'di ni bdag gi dpang / /sngon chad khyod cag kho mo'i phar gyur la/ /kho mo'ang khyed kyi pha dang phu 186
nu dang / /sring mo'am mar yang yang dang yang gyur pas/ /su zhig ma la 'dod chags semasaskyed byed/ /sngan chad kho mosakhyed kun bsad gyur cing / /khyod kyisakho mo'ang sngan chad bsad gyur pas/ /thamasacad phan lhun dgra bo gshed yin na/ /khyed cag ji ltar 'dod chags sems skyed byed/ /chags pas gzugs dang ldan par mi 'gyur zhing / /chags sems can dag bde 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /chagasapa'i semasaldan mya ngan mi 'da' bas/ /de phyir 'dod chagasayongar+sāsu spang bar bya/ /'dod pa'i gzhi lasadamyal bar 'gro 'gyur zhing / /'dod chags las ni yi dwagasadud 'gror 'gyur/ /gang dag 'dod chagaphudakrisapa'i semasaldan pa/ khri/la bum lha min gnod sbyin sha༄ra 'gyur/ /'dod chagaphulasani zhan ba 'theng po dang / /lce med gzugasami sdug pa dag tu 'gyur/ /gang dag 'dod chagaphungan pa'i spyad spyod pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogasaskyon gyi snod du 'gyur/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob pa dang / /sum cu gsum pa'i dbang phyug brgya byin dang / /tshangs pa dbang ldan dbang sgyur gang yin pa/ /de ni tshangs spyod yangasapa spyod pa yin/ /rtag tu 'dod pa dag la brkam pa rnams/ /dmus long 'on pa glen pa khyi phag dang / /rnga mo bong bu spre'u dang glang po dang / /stag dang gnag rta phye leb sbrang bur 'gyur/ /gang dag tshangasaspyod yangs pa spyod byed pa/ /sa yi dbang phyug dga' ba rnamasadang ni/ /tshong dpon khyim bdag blon por gyur nas ni/ /bde zhing yid bde zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rang gyal rnams dang de bzhin dgra bcom dang / /sangs rgyas mtshan gyis spras pa gsal gyur cing / /bla med byang chub zhi ba rtogs gyur nas/ /sems can tshogs chen rnams kyi don mdzad 'gyur/ /'dod pas 'khor ba dag na bsreg pa dang / /yang na du bas bdug cing gsad pa'am/ /bcing dang de bzhin brdeg bsdigs mgo dang ni/ /rna mig sna dang rkang pa gcad par 'gyur/ /'dod spyod nyes pa gcig tu ma zad de/ /'dod 187
rnamasami mthun nyes pa mtha' yang med/ /gal te myur du de nas thar 'dod na/ /tshur gshegs rgyal ba de yi spyan sngar 'deng / /lha mis mchod pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par/ /rten dang dpung gnyen gzhan dag yod min zhing / /rgyal ba 'byung ba bskal pa brgyar dkon gyis/ /thams cad lhan cig 'grogs te 'dong bar bya/ /bu mo zla mchog gis tshigs su bcad pa de dag smras ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la sa chen po rab tu g.yosapar gyur cing / nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu rnamasakyisakyangatso5 la la zhesaca co dang ga zha'i sgra chen po 'bum phrag du ma dag rab tu phyung ste/ me tog gi char dag kyang rabasgyu phab/ sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang rabasgyugasil to/ /skye bo phal po che de dag kyang shin tu yid byung zhing spu zing zhes byed la ngo mtshar du 'dzin par gyur nasa'aga' yang phyin chad 'dod chagasadang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / khro ba dang / 'thab pa dang / 'chab pa dang / gnod semasadang / rnam par gnod pa med cing thamasacad kyang semasakyi sgrib pa dang bral la lus rab tu sim zhing nyon mongs pa thamscad dang bral bar gyur nas/ bu mo zla mchog de la ma dang sring mo dang / ston pa lta bur sdug par gyur cing phyag byasate/ ji ltar thogasapa'i me tog dang / bdug sposadang / sposdang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa de dag gisakyang mngon par gtor to/ /gtor ma thag tu sangasargyasakyi mthusade nas de'i mod la me rtog de dag me tog gi gdugasadapag tshad phyed cam pa zhig tu gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de'i dbu'i gtsug gi drang thad kyi steng na 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog bar snang de las babs te/ sor bzhi cam gyis sa la ma reg par nam mkha' la 'chag bzhin du yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po nas byung ngo / /de' rkang pa bzhag pa dang bteg pa thamaX zlod du sa chen po rab tu g.yos pa dang /
yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen polisrog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong tham pa yang bu mo zla mchog song ba'i phyi bzhin 'brang bar gyur to/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig snga dro'i dus kyi tshe sham thabs dang chos gos bgos te lhung bzed thogs nas bsod snyoms kyi phyir yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen por zhugs pa dang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis bu mo zla mchog skye bo phal po ches yongs su bskor cing rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po bu mo zla mchog 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gro na/ bdag cag gis 'di ci bzod pa thob pa zhig gam/ 'on te ma yin zhes shes par byas/ dri ba 'ga' zhig yongs su dri bar bya'am zhes nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu dge slong de dag dang lhan cig tu bu mo zla mchog ga la ba der song ste phyin nasabu mo zla mchog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod gar 'gro/ bu mos smras pa/btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang 'di skad du bu mo khyod gar 'gro zhes gsung ba ni gnas brtan gang du bzhud pa de nyid du bdag kyang mchi lagasaso/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/bu mo kho bo ni yangasapa can du 'jug la khyod ni yangs pa can nasabyung na/ 'o na khyod 'di skad du gnas brtan gang du bzhud pa de nyid du bdag kyang mchi lagasaso zhesazer ba de ji ltar rigs par 'gyur/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod zhabs gang nasa'adeg cing gang du 'jog par mdzad lags/ sha ra dwa ti'i busasmrasapa/ bu mo kho bo ni rkang pa nam mkha' las 'deg cing nam mkha' nyid la 'jog par byed do/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bdag kyang sug pa nam mkha' las 'deg cing nam mkha' nyid la 'jog par bgyid de/ nam mkha'i khams la ni tha dad pa cung zad kyang ma /89
mchis pas/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de'i slad du bdag gisa'adi skad ces khyod gang du bzhud pa de nyid du bdag kyang mchi lags so zhes smras so/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod gar gshegs/ sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo kho bo ni mya ngan las 'das par 'gro'o/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba lags pas bdag kyang der mchi ba lags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/bu mo gal te chosathamasacad yongasasu mya ngan lasa'adas par 'gro ba yin na/ 'o na khyod ci'i phyir yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mi 'gro/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba ni yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' zhing yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba la ni skye ba dang 'jig pa yang ma mchis la/yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mchi ba la ma gtogs par yang gang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba 'ga' yang ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar mchi ba nyid yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa lags pa'i slad du'o/ /de skad cesasmras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus bu mo zla mchog la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bu mo 'o na ci khyod nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa yin nam/ 'on te rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa yin nam/ 'on te theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugasapa yin/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang 'di skad du khyod theg pa gang la yang dag par zhugs pa yin zhes gsung ba ni bcun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de'i slad du de khyod nyid la zhus khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan gdab tu gsol/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod kyis rtogs pa'i chos gang 'a/gas pa'i chos de ci nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa zhig lags sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa zhig lags sam/ theg pa chen po la 19()
yang dag par zhugasapa zhig lags/ sha ra dwa ti'i busasmrasapa/ bu mo de ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chosade la ni rnam par rtog pa'am/ sprosapa 'ga' yang med la tha dad pa nyid kyang ma yin/ gcig pa nyid kyang ma yin/ sna tshogasanyid kyang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de'i slad du rnam par rtog pa ma mchis pa dang /sprosapa ma mchis pa'i chos thams cad dang / tha dad du dbyer ma mchis pa'i chos thams cad la ni gang gnas par 'gyur ba'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i chos de dmigs su ma mchisalags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyi spobs pa ni ngo mtshar na gzhan yang khyod kyisade bzhin gshegasapa ji snyed cig la bsnyen bkur byas/ bu mosasmras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang 'di skad ces khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa ji snyed cig la bsnyen bkur byasazhesagasung ba ni de bzhin nyid dang chos kyi dbyingasaji snyed pa la'o/ khra ra dwa ti'i bus smrasapa/ bu mo de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings kyang ji snyed cig yin/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu ma rig pa dang srid pa'i sred pa ji snyed pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo ma rig pa dang srid pa'i sred pa yang ji snyed cig yin/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sems can gyi khams ji snyed pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smrasapa/ bu mo sems can gyi khamasakyang ji snyed cig yin/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yul ji snyed pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis ci zhig lan btab pa yin/ bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gnas brtan gyis gang yongs su dris pa de nyid kyi lan bdag gis btab lags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo kho bos ci zhig yongs su dris/ bu mos smras pa/ bcun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 9/
yi ge gang dag yongs su dris pa de dag nyid nges par bstan lags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smradragapa/ bu mo yi ge rnams ni rang bzhin gyis 'gags pa ste/ gdags su med pa yin pas de dag ni ngesapar bstan par mi nusaso/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du skye ba ma mchis pa dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang / mtshan nyid ma mchis pa'i chos thams cad la yang gang gis yongs su dris pa dang / gang gis lan btab pa de gnyis ka yang dmigs su ma mchis lags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras nga /bu mo 'di ltar khyod ni bzod pa thob cing byang chub sems dpa'i rnam pa dag yod pa kho na yin pas khyod ni ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub ces bgyi ba de yang spros pa lags so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba de yang spros pa lags so/ /nye ba zhesabagyi ba'am ring ba zhesabagyi ba de yang spros pa lagadra'oso/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang 'di skad ces khyod ni ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsung ba ni bcun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni skye ba ma mchis pa/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa/ chad pa ma mchis pa/ rtag pa ma mchis pa/ don gcig pa ma lags pa/ don tha dad pa ma lagasapa/ 'ong ba ma mchisapa/ 'gro ba ma mchis pa/brjod du ma mchis pa/ 'byung ba ma mchisapa/ rang bzhin ma mchis pa lags pas de la ni gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba 'ga' yang dmigs su ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ byang chub ni gnyisakyi mtshan nyid ma lags pa ste/ byang chub ni gnyisasu ma mchis shing gnyis dang bral ba lagasapa'i slad du'o/ /de nas tshe dang 192
ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus bu mo zla mchog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar song shig dang / kho bo cag kyang chos mnyan pa'i phyir der 'dong ngo | |de nasaganasabartan sha ra dwanya'i bu la bu mo zla mchog gisa'adi skad cesasmras so/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegasapa ni nyan 'tshal ba rnamasal chos ston par mi mdzad lags so/ khra ra dwa ti'i bus smrasapa/ bu mo 'o na de bzhin gshegasapa su dag la chosaston par mdzad/ bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang dag nyan par bgyid kyang dga' bar mi bgyid de/ mngon par dga' ba mi bgyid pa rnams la'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i busasmrasapa/ bu mo sems can mang po dag chos mnyan pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'dong zhing de bzhin gshegs pa yang de dag la chos ston par mi mjad dam/ bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegasapar 'du shesashing chos la ngar 'dzin pa la gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni 'di snyam du 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ bdag cag la chosaston par mdzad pa'o/ /'di ni chos te bstan par bgyi ba'o snyam du sems lags kyi chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa rnams ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ chos sam/ bstan pa zhes bgyi bar sems pa ma mchis lags sam/ de nas gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta bu'i spobs pa dang ldan pa'i bu mo 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'gro bas na der ni chos bstan pa chen po yang 'byung bar 'gyur bas bdag cag zan bcad de phyir log na ni 'o bu cag la legs kyis/ bdag cag chosamanyan pa de lta bu las phyi rol du gyur na ni ma yin no/ /de nas nyan thos chen po de dag phyir phyogs te de nyid nasaphyir log par gyur to/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog tshal chen polikhang pa brtsegasapa'i gnasag la ba dang /193
bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bosaphyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'dasal lan gsum bskor ba byas nas ji ltar thogs pa'i me tog dang / bdug sposadang / sposadang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor te/ mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /skye bo phal po che de dag gisakyang ji ltar thogs pa'i me tog dang / bdug spos dang / sbos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor te/ gtor ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la me tog de dag me tog gi gdugs rgyar dpag tshad bcu tsam pa zhig tu gyur te/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi dbu'i gtsug gi drang thad kyi steng na 'dug par gyur to/ /de nasa'ajam dpalagazhon nuragyur pasabu mo zla mchog la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bu mo khyod gang nasashi 'phosate 'dir 'ongs/ 'di nas shi 'phosanasani gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ bu mos smras pa/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du dgongs/ gang bdag gi sug pa g.yas pa na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad ma la bzhugs pa 'di gang nas shi 'phos te 'dir byon la/ 'di nasashi 'phos nas ni gang du skye bar 'gyur snyam/ 'jam dpal gyissmras pa/ bu mo 'di ni sprul pa ste sprul pa la ni 'chi 'pho yang med la skye ba yang med do/ /bu mosasmras pa/ 'jam dpal bdag gisakyang de bzhin du sprul pa'i rang bzhin gyi chos thamasacad lagang 'chi 'pho ba'am skye ba de ma mthong lags so/ /de nasabyang chub semsdpa' mthong ba don yod kyisabu mo zla mchog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo bud med kyi lus kyis ni byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi nus na khyod ci'i phyir bud med kyi lusasgyur bar mi byed/ bu mosasmrasapa/ rigasakyi bu chosathamasacad ni stong pa nyid kye mtshan nyid lags pas stong pa nyid la ni ldos pa dang 'gyur ba ma mchis 194
lags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sa 'dzin gyis bu mo zla mchog la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /bu mo khyod kyisade bzhin gshegasapa mthong tham/ bu mos smras pa/ rigskyi bu ji ltar de bzhinabashegasapa'i sku 'dis gzigs pa ltar bdag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs kyis smras pa/bu mo khyod kyis chos kyi gtam la spobs par gyis shig /bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi dpyings la ni brjod par bgyi ba dang rab tu brjod par bgyi ba ma mchis la/chosakyi dbyingasani yiger 'grang ba yang ma lagasaso/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa thogs pa med pasasmras pa/ bu mo khyod kyisasngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar chos ji lta bu thos/ bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i slad du steng du gzigs shig dang / bar snang ci 'dra bar de bzhin gshegs pa yang de 'dra la/ de bzhin gshegs pa ci 'dra bar chosabastan pa nyid kyang de 'dra/ nyan pa nyid kyang de 'dra ste/ rigs kyi bu chos thamasacad ni nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de lta bu lagasaso/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis smrasapa/ bu mo khyod kyis sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dag la ji ltar sbyin pa byin zhing ji ltar yongs su bsngos/ bu mos smras pa/ rigasakyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper bgyi na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhig gis sangs rgyas la sogasapa dge slong gi dge 'dun la sbyin pa zhig phul bar gyur na de la rgyu ba ji lta bu zhig 'byung bar 'gyur lags/ smras pa/ bu mo sprul pa la ni rgyu ba 'ga' yang 'byung ba med do/ /bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu bdag gis kyang sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dag la de ltar sbyin pa byin zhing yongs su bsngos pa lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thogs med sems kyis smras pa/ bu mo khyod sems can rnams la ji ltar byamasapas khyab par byed/ bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sems can de dag ji lta ba kho 195
na bzhin du'o/ /smrasapa/ bu mo semasacan de dag kyang ji lta bu yin/ smrasapa/ rigasakyi bu 'dadragapa yang ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa yang ma lags/ da ltar byung ba yang ma lags la/semasade yang 'das pa yang ma lags/ ma 'ongadragapa yang ma lags/ da ltar byung ba yang ma lags pas byams pa bsgom pa de ni 'di 'dra'o zhes gdags par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis chos kyi mig thob bam/ bu mos smrasapa/ rigs kyi bu bdag gis sha'i mig kyang ma thob lags na chos kyi mig lta thob par ga la 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros brtan pas smras pa/ bu mo khyod yun ji srid cig nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs/ bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu yun ji srid cig nasasmig rgyu la chu yang dag par zhugs pa'i yun de srid nas bdag kyang byang chub la yang dag par zhugs lags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas bu mo zla mchog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod yun ji srid cig gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogasapar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ bu mosasmrasapa/ yun ji srid cig gis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa so so'i skye bolis las 'da' bar 'gyur zhing sangasargyasakyi phulasakyang 'da' bar 'gyur ba de srid kyisalagasaso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar sring mo 'di gtso bo chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu dag dang lhan cig yang dag par smra yang 'jigs par mi bgyid/ dman par mi bgyid pani bu mo 'di'i spobs pa ngo mtshar lagasaso/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la bu mo zla mchog gisa'adi skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste dper bgyi na zhugs ni ji tsam du chung yang sreg pa'i ngo bo nyid lags pas ji tsam du nye 196
bar len pa rnyed pa de tsam du sreg par bgyid lags so/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pas tha dad du dbye ba cung zad kyang ma mchisapas de dag thams cad bdag dang gzhan dag gisanyon mongasapa thams cad sreg pa'i slad du nye bar gnasapa lagasaso/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo byang chub thob nas khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ci 'dra bar 'gyur/ bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bdag gi sangasargyasakyi zhing ni sangs rgyasakyi zhing gang na/ gnasabartan sha ra dwalta'i bu ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i semasacan dman pa la mosapa/ shesarab chung ba/ gzhan gyi don la mi lta ba/ nyan thosakyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugadrangapa dag gi ming yang grag par mi 'gyur ba de lta bu 'gyur lags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smrasapa/ bu mo gang khyod 'di skad cesachos kyi dbyings ni gcis go /de bzhin nyid ni gcigasho /zhesazer na 'o na ci khyod kyisanyan thosarnams t+na dman pa nyid yin la ci sangs rgyasarnams ni lhag pa yin par yang dag par rjes su mthong ngam bu mosasmrasapa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ dper bgyi na ba lang gi rjes kyi chab gang lags pa dang / rgya mtsho chen polichab gang lags pa de dag la ni bye brag cung zad kyang ma mchisalagasamod kyi/ 'on kyang ba lang gi rjes la ni rgya mtsho chen po ltar sems can tshad ma mchisapa dag gi go skabasam mchisalagasaso/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegasapa rnams dang / nyan thos rnams kyang chos kyi dbyings gcig las nges par byung ba lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang nyan 'os rnams kyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa dag ltar sems can tshad ma mchis grangs ma mchis pa dag gi don bgyid par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ dper bgyi na yungs 'bru'i khongs su chud pa'i nam mkha'i khams gang lags pa dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig 197
rten gyi khamasathamasacad kyi khongs su chud pa'i nam mkha'i khamasagang lagasapa'i nam mkha'i khams de dag la ni bye brag cung zad kyang ma mchisapa lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang yungasa'abru'i khongasasu chud pa'i nam mkha'i khamasal ni phyogasabacu'i khongasasu chud pa'i nam mkha' ltar grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal polipho brang dag rab tu mi gnasashing kun tu mi gnas la ri'i rgyal po ri rab dag kyang ma mchis rgya mtsho chen po dag kyang ma mchisalagasaso/ /btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang nyan thos rnams kyang stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa ma mchis pa gcig las ngesapar byung ba lagasamod kyi/ 'on kyang nyan thos rnams kyis ni de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag ltar sems can tshad med pa grangs ma mchis pa dag gi don bgyid par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo sangs rgyas rnamasadang / nyan thosarnamasakyi rnam par grol ba gcig pa ma yin nam/ bu mos smrasapa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang 'di skad ces sangs rgyasarnams dang / nyan thos rnams kyi rnam par grol ba gcig go zhesagasung ba ni skur pa 'debasapa lagasaso/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smrasapa/ bu mo ci'i phyir/ bu mosasmras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de'i slad du de khyod nyid la yongs su zhus/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan gdab tu gsol/ gang gi tshe btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu'i sems rnam par grol ba de'i tshe/ jiltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lag mthil ltar mnyam pa kun tu gnas par gyur lags sam/ ji ltar shing ldon pa dang ri thams cad kyis khyod logs su mngon par phyogs te btud mngon par btud/ mngon par rab tu btud lags sam/ ji ltar ngan song thaX cad rab tu zhi bar gyur lags sam/ ji
ltar semasacan thamasacad nyon mongs pa dang bral bar gyur lagasasam/ ji ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'og tu mnar ma mchisapa la thug pa yan chad dang / steng du 'og min gyi gnasakyi mthar thug pa'i bar dag 'od zer gyi kha dog lta budragasnang bar gyur lagadradasam/ ji ltar lha thamadragacad kyis phyag bgyidragalagadragasam/ ji ltar bdud kyi phudang nam mkha' dpag tshad sum natshun chad dpung gisakhyab par bgyiste mchis par gyur lags sam/ ji ltar sem sa kyi skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis rnam par grol lags sam/ ji ltar khyod byang chub pa dang dus gcig kho nar bdud thams cad nges par bcom lags sam/ sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis kho bo la ji skad smras pa de dag las de'i rgyu gcig tsam yang ma byung ngo / /bu mos smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub semasadapa' byang chub kyi snying po darma pa la gnas pa la ni yon tan gyi khyad par de dag dang gzhan yang dpag tu ma mchis pa dag byung bar gyur pas na/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par grol ba dang / nyan thos kyi rnam par grol ba'i khyad par ni de lagasaso/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasakyis bu mo zla mchog la legs so zhes bya ba phyin te/ bu mo legs so legs so/ /bu mo khyod de skad ston pa ni yang khyod legs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus bu mo zla mchog gi lag pa g.yas par de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad ma la bzhugs pa byung bar gyur pa gang yin pa de pad ma'i gdan de las mngon par 'phags te/ bcom ldan 'dasal lan gsum bskor ba byasanasabacom ldan 'dasanyid kyi sku lte ba'i khung du zhugasaso/ /de nasade'i mod la sangasargyas kyi mthus sa chen po rab tu g.yos par gyur cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi smyu'i khung bu thams cad nas pad ma gser gyi mdog tu snang ba/ sdong bu rnamasani gser/ 'dab ma rnamasani dngul/ snying po 199
rnamasani rin po che dpal gyi snying po lasagrub pa dag byung bar gyur to/ /pad ma de dag la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshan gyis legadrangapar brgyan pa pad ma la bzhugadragpa dag kun tu snang bar gyur cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu gshegs te sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khamasadag na chosaston par kun tu snang zhing / 'di lta ste/ sangasargyas kyi mthus chos ston pa de dag kyang 'dir kun tu grag go /de nasabu mo zla mchog gisade lta bu'i cho 'phrul chen po mthong nas dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyesanasadesalag pa g.yasapa na thogasapar gyur pa'i pad ma gang yin pa de bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logs su 'phangasaso 'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de me tog gi khang pa brtsegasapa gru bzhi lham pa ka ba bzhi zug pa/ cha mnyam pa shin tu rnam par bye ba zhig tu gyur te/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi dbu'i gtsug gi drang thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug par gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa der yang khri gdan rkang pa rin po ches spras pa/ lha'i ras bcos bu 'bum phrag du ma bting ba zhig byung bar gyur to/ /khri gdan de la bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegasapa shākya thub pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zhig bzhugasapar yang kun tu snang ngo / /desapad ma de 'phangs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'disangar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa laganasapa'i semasacan rnamasal ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa spang ba'i slad du chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma gnyis pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / des de yang bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logs su 'phangs so/ /'phangasam thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du 200
lhagā shārnyi khang pa brtsegasapa gnyis pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / desatshig 'di skad cesakyang bcom ldan 'dasabadag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang 'brel ba'i semasacanarnamasal 'jig tshogasal lta ba spang ba'i slad du chosaston par gyur cigyang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma gsum pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang /desade yang bcom ldan 'dapag la ba de logasasu 'phangasaso/ /'phangasam thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'dasakyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegasapa gsum pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / tshig 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa dang / 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug spang ba'i slad du sems can rnams la chos ston par gyur cigyang sangasargyasakyi mthusade'i lag par pad ma bzhi pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / des de yang bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logasasu 'phangasaso/ /'phangasam thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa bzhi zhig tu gyur pa dang /tshig 'di skad cesakyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasabadag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'disaphyin ci log bzhi spang ba'i slad du sems can rnams la chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyasakyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma lnga pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / desade yang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su 'phangs so/ /'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa lnga pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / tshig 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sgrib pa lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la sgrib pa lnga spang ba'i slad du chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma drug pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / des de 201
yang bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logs su 'phangs so/ /'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'dasakyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegasapa drug pa zhig tu gyur pa dang /tshig 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye mched drug la brten pa'i semasacan rnamasal skye mched drug yongasasu 'tshal bar bgyi ba'i slad du chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma bdun pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / desade yang bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logasasu 'phangs so/ /'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa bdun pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / mig 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasabadag dge ba'i gab 'disarnam par shesapa gnasapa bdun dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la rnam par shes pa gnas pa bdun yongs su 'tshal bar bgyi ba'i slad du chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma brgyad pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / desade yang bcom ldan 'dasag la ba de logs su 'phangs so/ /'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegasapa brgyad pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / tshig 'di skad cesakyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis log pa nyid brgyad la nges pa'i sems can rnams la log pa nyid brgyad nges par spang ba'i slad du chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma dgu pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang /des de yang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su 'phangs so/ /'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa dgu pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / tshig 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis kun nas mnar sems kyi dngos po dgu la gnas pa'i sems can rnams la kun 202
nasamanar semasakyi dngosapo dgu spang ba'i slad du chos ston par gyur cig yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lag par pad ma bcu pa zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / des de yang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su 'phangs so/ /'phangs ma thag tu pad ma de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug gi drang thad kyi steng du pad ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa bcu pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / tshig 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dir ji ltar da ltar bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcur snang bas khyab par mdzad pa ltar stobasabacu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig de nas pad ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa de dag gong nas gong du brtsegs pa'i 'phang gis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi mthar thug par gyur to/ /de'i tshe na sabla ba'i lha yan chad nasatshangasaris kyi bar gyi lha rnams la pad ma'i khang pa brtsegadragapa de dag gidragayang dag par bskul nas lha bye ba phrag dpag tu med pa dag 'dus par gyur to/ /de nasade'i tshe bcom ldan 'dasa'adzum pa mjad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nyid de/ gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal sgyi sgo nas 'od zer kha dog du ma kha dog sna tshogs kha dog 'bum phrag du ma 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /btsod ka dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung ste/ de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag snang bas khyab par byas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phags te/ 'od kyis nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od zil gyis mnan nas phyir log ste/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'dapa sdu la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud
nas/ bcom ldan 'dasal migasasu bcad pa'i dbyangasakyisa'adzum pa'i don yongasasu zhus pa/ mkhyen pa kun la mngon sum spyan mnga' zhing / /chos rnams kun la rnam nur rnam par brgal/ /'jig rten kun dang mi mnyam mthu mnga' ba/ /rgyal dbang ci slad 'dzum pa rab tu mdzad/ /khyod kyisamatha' yasadusanasasbyin pa byin/ /khyod khrimasarnam dag nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /khyod kyi bzod pa'ang mi g.yos lhun po bzhin/ /drang srong chen po ci slad 'dzum pa mdzad/ /bsamagatan brnyesashing brtson 'grusastobasaldan pa/ /gnod bral na dang rga lasarnam par grol/ /rgya mtsho 'dra bar shin tu zab pa'i blo/ /6ba chen ci slad 'dzum pa rab tu mdzad/ /byams la gnas shing thugs rjer gnas pa po/ /thub pa btang snyomasadang ni dga' la gnas/ /'dod chagaphul sogasa'ajigasabasal rab tu zhi/ /thub dbang ci slad 'dzum par rab tu mdzad/ /khyod spu gcig nasabyung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' yasakhams rnams su/ /nyi zla myur du mog mog rab mdzad de/ /gzi brjid zil gyis gnon cing mig kyang stsol/ /'gro ba'i mgon gcig khyod gsung rnam par dag /snyan cing yid 'ong yan lag drug tu ldan/ /gang dag nyan pa de dag mi ngoms shing / /nyon mongs thams cad ma lus zhi bar bgyid/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas sems can gang mchis pa'i/ /sems kyi spyod pa du ma gang lags pa/ /de mkhyen de dag som nyi gcod pa po/ / rang byung ci slad 'dzum pa rab tu mdzad/ /deng su'i sems ni byang chub slad du nges/ /su zhig sangs rgyas theg pa yangs par zhugs/ /khyab bdag gang gi yid bsams rab tu grub/ /thub dbang ci slad 'dzum pa rab tu mdzad/ /gang gisade ring bdud bzhi pham bgyisashing / /nyon mongasabadud dang 'chi bdag bdud chen dang / /gang gis phung po lha bu mang polibadud/ /pham par bgyis sam ci slad khyod 'dzum mdzad/ /de ring su zhig don chen yangs 'gyur zhing / /su zhig 204
chosalo legasabagyid mi'i seng ge /de ring su yi sgra ni phyogs rnamasamachi/ /thub dbang ci slad 'dzum pa rab tu mdzad/ /kun mkhyen mi dge thams cad rab spangs pa/ /sems can kun la mtshungs par byams pa po/ /g.yo ba kun dang rtog pa rnam spangs pa/ /drang srong chen po ci slad 'dzum pa mdzad/ /de ring su zhig yangs pa chen po thob/ /deng su'i semasakyi smon pa legasa'agrub cing / /deng su'i stobasabacu rnamasadang ldan par 'gyur/ /dgra thul ci slad 'dzum pa rab tu mdzad/ /mkha' la gnas pa lha klu bye ba dang / /gnod sbyin mkha' lding sto 'phye cher bcas dang / /sa la thal sbyar skyes pa bud med rnams/ /dga' zhing lha mi dbang po zla ba lta/ /rdzogasapa'i byang chub semasadapa' mang po ni/ /dam chosa'atshal ba rgya mtsho lta bu dag /phyogs bcu dag nasalhagasanas dgra thul ba/ /yongs dag thugs mnga' 'dzum don bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gang gi rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul mchog mthong nas/ /byang chub phyir ni rgya chen sems skyed cing / /nga yi mdun na thal sbyar gang 'dug pa/ /mdun gyi bu mo mthong ngam kun dga' bo/ /'dis ni sngon gyi srid par rtag tu yang / /rgyal ba sum brgya legasapar mchod byas shing / /ji ltar bdag ni byang chub mchog reg ces/ /rgyal ba de dag kun la mngon sum zhus/ /nam yang lan 'ga' ngan 'gror ma song zhing / /'di ni rtag tu lha mi'i 'jig rten skyes/ /nam yang byang chub sems ni ma brjed cing / /'chi dus byas kyang rtag tu tshe rabs dran/ /rgyal ba 'od srung zhes bya mthong nas ni/ /khang bzangs steng nas mdzes pa'i lus mchongs te/ /rgya chen sems kyis 'od srung de mchod nas/ /de nas rjes mthun bzod pa thob par gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig ces mchan gsol ba/ /de la na bza' dam pa phrugs phul bas/ /de phyir 'di yi lusamadog gser 'dra la/ /mdzesashing dag la zla ba 'dra ba yin/ /205
ston pa gser thub ces bya gang yin pa/ /de la bdug pa spos mchog phul bas na/ /de phyir 'di yi kha dang spu khung nas/ /ud pal tsan dan dri ngad rab tu 'byung / /gcug tor zhesabya rkang gnyis mchog de la/ /'dis ni mtshan bdun nges par brtagasagyur pas/ /de phyir 'di yi mig mdog mthon mthing la/ /'gro ba rtog par byed pa ngoms mi 'gyur/ /tshe rabasalnga brgya dag tu 'dod spangasashing / /tshangasaspyod rnam par spyod pa dag byasanas/ /de phyir chags pas gdungs pas de mthong na/ /de tshe 'dod chags can dag chags bral 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas 'dir 'phos te/ /'dir lits+tsha bī khyim ni yangs par skyes/ /skye dgu kun tu ② rabs dran 'gyur bas/ /tshigs bcad dbyangs kyis smra ba'i bya ba shes/ /pha ma yongs su smin par bya ba dang / /de bzhin sems can gzhan don byed 'dod cing / /la la byang chub phyir ni sems bskyed phyir/ /de phyir yangs pa'i khyim 'dir rab tu skyes/ /bud med skyes pa nye du mdza' bshes dang / /gzhon nu gzhon nu ma dag gdul ba'i phyir/ /de dag stong phrag drug cu 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas theg pa mchog la yongs smin byas/ /'di ni ring po mi thogs bud med kyi/ /lus bsgyur nga yi bstan la rab 'byung zhing / /tshangs spyod dam pa rgya chen spyad byas nas/ /shi 'phos lha yi 'jig rten 'gro bar 'gyur/ /lha gnas de nas shi 'phos phyir yang ni/ /dus mtha'i tshe na chos 'di srung 'gyur zhing / /'dir yang skye dgu'i don chen byas nas ni/ /'di nas phyir yang dga' ldan 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe mi 'pham dgra las rgyal ba po/ /dung gi sras su gyur te 'byung ba'i tshe/ /de ni bzo don sgyu rtsal bya ba kun/ /shes shing mdzes la yon tan kun ldan 'gyur/ /phyog chags brgya phrag du mas mdun bdar cing / /zla ba gsum du rgyal ba mchod byas nas/ /de ni srog chags drug stong sum brgya dang / /lhan cig khyim gyi gnas nas 'byung 'gyur zhing / /rgyal ba mi pham bzhugs dang 'das pa yi/ /chos kyi chul yang 2()6
kun tu 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i dpa' bo de nas shi 'phos nas/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams su 'gro/ /blo ldan des ni 'od dpag med pa dang / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu mtha' yas bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bye mang gang gā klung gi ni/ /bye snyed mthong zhing bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin mngon shes brtson 'grus stobs thob cing / /bskal pa bzang la gang dag phyis 'byung ba'i/ /rang 'byung 'jig rten rnams la phan brtson pa/ /'jig rten mgon de dag la'ang bsnyen bkur byed/ /bye mang bskal pa de dag mchod byas te/ /sems can bye mang yongs su smin byas shing / /bskal pa bye ba stong phrag brgyad cu na/ /rgyal ba zla ba mchog ces bya bar 'gyur/ /zla mchog rkang gnyis gtso bolimadzod skru nas/ /'od zer gser mdog shin tu yid 'ong ba/ /gang dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag gis/ /'jig rten khamasade kun tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'od kyis 'jig rten de khyab pas/ /nyi zla me dang nor bu'i 'od rnams ni/ /snang bar mi 'gyur rgyu skar tshogs min zhing / /nyin dang mtshan yang bgrang du yod ma yin/ /de tshe rang sangs rgyas dag yod min zhing / /nyan thos rnams med mu ltags can tshogs med/ /mnyam med de yi dge 'dun rnam dag cing / /bud med rnam par spangs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mi rnams thams cad gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /bsod nams brgya yi mchan can lta na sdug /mngal na mi gnas 'dod pa mi sten cing / /pad ma'i nang nas rdzus te skye zhing 'byung / /rgyal sras rnamasakyi tshogs 'byung gang yin pa/ /de ni bgrang bas rtogasapar mi nus shing / /thams cad mngon shes thob pa dal spyod dang / /mi skye bzod cing mnyam med chags pa med/ /de na bud med dmigs can yod min zhing / /bslab pa 'dral med phyogasa'adzin yod ma yin/ /'jig rten khams de dag cing dga' ldan gyi/ /nye bar spyod pa'i rnam pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gser dngul mu tig dam pa'i dri mchog gis/ /spras shing 207
gtsang la dri med yangasapa yin/ /rgyal ba de yi sku tshe lo grangasani/ /stong phrag bye ba bdun cu gsum du 'gyur/ /ston pa de ni zhi bar gshegs gyur nas/ /de tshe dam chos bskal pa gcig gnasashing / /bzhugs bzhin mya ngan 'dasana'ang de yi ni/ /dam chosamadzod la nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /gal te rgyal ba dang ni zhing de yi/ /phun sum tshogs par bskal par brjod byas kyang / /rgya mtsho dag las chu trags gcig bzhin du/ /dpe yang brjod par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /de nas bu mo zla mchog gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid mngon sum du lung bstan pa thosanasadaga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba de nyid kyis shing ta la bdun srid tsam du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags ma thag tu bu mo des bud med kyi lus sgyur cing skyes pa'i lus mngon par grub par 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten du sa chen po yang rab tu g.yos par gyur/ me tog gi char dag kyang rab tu bab/ lha dang mi'i sil snyan 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang sgra 'khrol bar gyur to/ /'jig rten kun tu snang ba chen pos khyab par yang gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zla mchog gis bar snang de nyid la 'dug bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ ri rab g.yo zhing nam mkha' sar lhung la/ /lha gnas skad cig tsam la 'jig 'gyur zhing / /rgya mtsho mi g.yo dgung zla lhung yang gda'/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sho be'i tshig mi gsung / /phyogs bcu'i sems can lus rnams gcig 'gyur zhing / /zhugs ni chab gyur chab ni zhugaphu'agyur gda'/ /mnyam med thub dbang yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'gro la phan bzhed log pa'i tshig mi gsung / /bar snang dog sa kun tu 'dzin 'gyur zhing / /yungs 'bru'i nang du zhing brgya chud 'gyur la/ /bser ma zhags pas gzung bar rngo thogs gda'/ /rgyal ba log pa'i tshig ni gsung mi 'gyur/ /de 'drar yang dag de bzhin nyid 208
gsung ba'i/ /rgyal ba des bdag byang chub nges bstan cing / /gang phyir dog sa kun tu rab g.yos pas/ /byang chub dam pa 'thob 'gyur gor ma bkum/ /sangs rgyas theg mchog bdag lung bstan pasan/ /rang byung gis ni ji skad gsungs de dang / /sngon chad bskal brgyar bdag gis gang btsal ba/ /de ltar bdag gis chos mchog 'khor lo bskor/ /lha mi lha min gnod sbyin dge slong dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang byang chub semasadapa' dag /thams cad mnyam med mthu stobs ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegasa'agyur gyis som nyi ma byed cig /chos 'di thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis longasaspyod rmi 'dra zhing / /bdag med gso ba shed bu 'ga' yang med/ /sems can srog med gang zag med par gsungs/ /bzod nas ngo bo nyid kyis chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin dag cing ngo bo nyid med de/ /bdag sngon bud med rang bzhin gyur pa gang / /de ni dngos med gsog stong ya ma brla/ /phyi mi'i dngos de'ang stong zhing skad cig ste/ /dngos med mi g.yo gsog dang ya ma brla/ /rtog dang rnam par rtog pa bral gyur cing / /rtog 'gyur de yang mkha' la bya rjesabazhin/ /gang zhig mnyam med byang chub 'tshang rgya zhing / /thul dka' bdud kyang rab tu gzhom pa dang / /stong gsum chen poli'ajig rten khams su ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa skor 'dod pa/ /des ni brtan par byang chub sem/sa bskyed la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu mchod gyis dang / /des ni myur du yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ston pa rgyal ba sdig med lam rtogasa'agyur/ /skyes bu rtsal 'phags gsung snyan mthar byon pa/ /rgyal ba mi mchog gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' mdzad rab dga'i dngos po stsol mdzad la/ /thub pa chos dbyig 'byung gnas dbang phyug bstod/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas bde kun rab stsol ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud kyi tsher ma dkyugs/ /bstod 'os rnams kyis bstod pa gang zag mchog /rang 'byung dbang ldan 209
sred bral bstod par bgyi/ /bdag gisaphyogasasu bltasan de dag tu/ /sdig med sangsrgyasabargya phrag bsam yas mthong / khrakya seng ge ji lta de lta bur/ /phyogasabacu'i sangs rgyas de dag bdag lung ston/ /rgyal ba thams cad chos nyid sangs rgyas gcig /de bzhin chos kyang de bzhin nyid kyis gcig /sems can rnams kyang yang dag mthar nges pa/ /gang la bzod 'di mchisapa rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de nasabyang chub sems dpa' zla mchog gis tshigs su bcad pa de dag smras nas bar snang de las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la rab tu gtugs so/ /des rab tu gtugs ma thag tu sangasargyas 'bum phrag mang po dag kyapasnang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzo gas pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /des sangasargyasabacom ldan 'dasade dag mngon sum du mthong zhing bdag nyid lung bstan pa yang thosanasadaga' zhing mgu la yi rangasate/rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyesanas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rab tu 'byung bar gsol ba btab ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chosa'adul ba la rab tu dbyung bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ khye'u de'i phyir pha ma dag gnang bar byed du chug cig de nasakhye'u de'i pha ma dag gis cho 'phrul chen po de mthong zhing de mngon sum du lung bstan pa yang zos nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis khye'u 'di rab tu dbyung bar gnang lagasaso/ /bdag cag gisakyang chos de dag slad kyis thos par bgyi lags so zhesagasol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisakhye'u de rab tu phyung ngo / /de nasakhye'u de rab tu phyung ba dang / phrog chags khris kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na lha dang mi khrag khrig phrag bdun 210
chos rnamasal chosakyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go /dge slong lnga brgya ni len pa med par zag pa rnamasalas sems rnam par grol lo/ /sngon byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa'i dge slong ma nyis brgya dang phrog chags nyi khris ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisade skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' zla mchog dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'dor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcasapa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phagasapa bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa zhesabya ba theg pa chen polimado rdzogasaso/ / / /
༄tsho/ /lha mo chen mo dpal zhesabya bsamatshan gyi rnam grangasabargyad rtsa brgyad kyi phan yon dang de'i rgyu rkyen bu mo de'i de bzhin gshegasapa du ma la bsnyen bkur byasapa'i tshul bstan pa/'phag ba lha mo chen modapalalungabastanartswa zhesabya ba'i thegapa chen polimado lasabaltas/de nas bcom ldan 'das bsod nams brgya stong du mas brgyan cing de bzhin gshegasapa bye ba snyed kyisayongasasu bskorate/ brgya byin dang tshangasapa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyisabastod cing bsngags pas lha mo chen mo dpal la gzigs nas/tshangs pa chen poligasung gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyal po'am/ blon po'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ bramaze'am/ rgyal rigasasam/ rje'u rigasasam/ dmangasarigasagang la la lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming brgya rtsa brgyad dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa 'di 'chang na/ rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po de'i yul dang / sems can de dag gi 'jigs pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur zhing / chom kun dang / g.yon can dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigasapa thamasacad 'byung bar mi (sbyi( snro/ nor dang / 'gra dang / mdzod dang / bang ba thamasacad rnam par 'phel bar rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po de'i khyim du yang dpal nges par gnasapar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpaX chen po de dag gis tshig 'di skad ces
gsolato/ /bcom ldan 'das mig 'di legasapar bka' stsal pa/ legasaso legsso//gang dag lha mo chen mo dpal gyi mingarnamasa'adzin pa dang /thosanasanyamasasu len pa gang lagasapa de dag gi yon tan dang phan yon ni de dag tu 'gyur lags so/ /de nasabyang chub semasadapa' semasadapa' chen po 'phagasapa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyugasar+sābacom ldan 'dasala'adi skad cesagasolato//bcom ldan 'dasalha mo chen mo dpal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang du bskyed lags/bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/lha mo chen mo dpal gyisani de bzhinagashegasapa gang gā'i klungs bye ma snyed la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ spyan rasagazigasadabang phyug sngon byung ba 'dasapa'i dusan 'jig rten gyi khamasarin po che lasabyung ba zhesabya ba na/de bzhin gshegasapa rin po che'i mertag yonartan gyi rgya mtsho be+eḍūr+ya dang gser gyi ri bo mdog mdzes gser 'od dpal zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de dang de bzhin gshegasapa mang pogazhanadag layang lha mo chen modapal gyisadage ba'i rtsab bskyed do/ /de bzhinagashegasapa'i mtshan 'di dag kyang lha mo chen mo dpal de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel ba dang /'grub par byed pa dang /rtag tu rjesasu 'brang ba yinate/de dag ni 'dir lha mo chen mo dpal gyisayang dag par brjod pa dang /sdig pa thamasacad sel ba dang /nyesasdig thamasacad med par byed pa dang /lusathamasacad dri ma med par byed pa dang /nor dang 'bru rnamasa'adu zhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / dbul ba gcod par byed pa dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thamasacad 'dun par byed cing 'gugasapar byed pa dang /yamasakyi nad dang /gnod pa dang /'thab pa dang /'khrug pa dang /'gyed pa dang /rtsod pa thamasacad zhi bar byed pa staX / pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogasapar byed
pa'o//'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa dpal stug po la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin tshogs pa rin po che'i me tog yon ga gyi rgya mtsho be+e sh+tsa dang gser gyi ri bo mdog mdzesagaser 'od dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i mu stegs kyi sgo thams cad kyi bkra shisakyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan gyi me tog gzi brjid skar ma'i 'od kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa chos kyi cho 'phrul rgyal mtshan shugasakyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa skar 'od zhi ba'i spos snang dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa sems can gyi bsam pa zhi bar mdzad pa'i sku'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa smon lam rgya mtshosasnang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu yongs su brjod pa mtshan gsol dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhi gshegasapa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo rin po che'i gnasakyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus grangs med pa la rab tu zhugs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa'i gser mdog snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa gsung gi yan lag thams cad kyi sgra dbyangs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab sgron ma grangasamed pa'i 'od kyi me tog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa sred med kyi bu'i brtul zhugasakyi go cha ri rab kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dpal la rdoX 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa dbang
phyug chen poyidapal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla'i 'od dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa zab mo3chosakyi 'od kyi rgyal polidapal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i sgron ma'i 'od bzang dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa nyi 'od tog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa sposakyi sgron ma'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i snying po lasabyung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa sprul pa'i 'brug sgra snyan pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa chosakyi snang ba thams cad bkod pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa shing gi rgyal po ltar skyes pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro ri bo'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od 'phro rgya mtsho'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhinagashegasapa smon lam chen po'ishugasakyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhinagashegasapa sprin chen polidapal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa dran pa'itog gi rgyal po'idapal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mag gyi rgyal po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa nor dang 'bru thams cad sdud pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba 'dren pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum tshogs pa 'gugs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegasapa'i mag 'di dag rim gror byasate/yong bar bya'o//bklag par bya'o//de ltar byasan rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo de la bsod nams shin tu mang du 'phel bar 'gyur ro//lha mo chen mo dpal yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang lung bstan to//lha mo chen mo dpal khyod ma pa pa pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams dpal
rin po ches brgyan pa zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal nor bu rin po che las byung ba zhes bya bar 'gyur te/'jig rten gyi khamasade yang lha'i rin po che sna tshogs kyisabargyan par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid snang bar mdzad par 'gyur la 'jig rten gyi khams de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang rang las 'od 'byung zhing tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' las kyang sangs rgyasadang / chos dang /dge 'dun gyi sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyasakyi zhing der byang chub sems dpa' gang dag skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang pad ma'i snying po dag las skye bar 'gyur ro zhesalung bstan to/ /de la ming brgya rtsa brgyad dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa brgyad cu gnyis pa gang zhe na/ 'jigs pa med pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming rnamasanyon cig 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyisadabang bskur ba/ lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/ lha thams cad kyi ma/ de bzhin gshegadragapa thams cad kyi dpal/ byang chub semadragdpa' thams cad kyi dpal/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po thamasacad kyi dpal/ lha la sogs pa thams cad kyi dpal/ gnas thams cad na yod pa'i dpal/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thamasacad kyi dpal/ rig sngags 'chang dang / lag na rdo rje dang /rdo rje 'chang ba thams cad kyi dpal/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang lnga'i dpal/ gza' brgyad dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dpaX lo/ /oṃ nyi ma'i bu mo/ ma ma yum/ rig
byed bzhi'i dpal/ bkra shisam/ semasacan rnamasakyi ma/ rgyal ma/ rnam rgyal ma/ gang gā ma/ mu stegasakyi sgo thamasacad kyi bkra shisam/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma med par byed pa'i dpal/ sdig pa thamasacad 'phrog ma/ rgyagasapa med pa/ zla ba'i dpal/ nyi ma'i dpal/zla thams cad kyi dpal/ seng ge la zhon ma/ pad ma'i mchog 'bum gyis bkab ma/pad ma pad ma la gnasapa/ pad ma 'dzin pa/ pad ma lasabyung ma/ pad ma dang ldan pa/'od zer 'bar ba du mas 'khor ba/ nor sbyin ma/ dkar mo/ dkar mo chen mo/ lag dkar ma/ bkra shisathamasacad 'dzin ma/ bsod namasakyi phung po thamasacad kyi luscan/ shes nyen can gyi bu mo/ lag pa 'bum dang ldan ma/ mig 'bum dang ldan ma/ mgo 'bum dang ldan ma/ nor bu rnam pa sna tshogar+sākyisamadzesapar byasapa'i cod pan thogasapa/gzugasabazang ba/ gzugasasna tshogasacan/ rab gragasam/ shinasgyu gragasam/ zhi ba ma/sprin ma/ skragatsang ma/ zla ba ltar mdzesam/ nyi ma ltar mdzesam/ dge ma/ dge byed ma/semasacan thamasacad la mngon du phyogasama'i dpal/ 'phagasam/ mertag laganasam/me tog gi dbang phyug ma/ ri polirgyal po ri rab thams cad kyi dpal/ chu klung dang /mtsho thamasacad kyi dpal/ chu thamasacad kyi rgya mtsho'i dpal/ mu stegs thams cad du mngon du phyogasapa'i dpal/ sman dang / rtsi tog dang / shing dang / nor dang / 'bru thamscad kyi dpal/ gser sbyin ma/ zasadang gos sbyin ma/ 'od gsal ma/ snang ba ma/ lusgtsang ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thamasacad kyi dbang sgyur ma/ lha'i tshogs thamasacad la mngon du phyogs pa'i dpal/ gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / ku be ra dang / brgya byin la sogasapa'i dpal/ sbyin pa ma/ longasaspyod ma/ gzi brdzid ldan ma/ kun sum tshogasam/'byor pa ma/ rnam par skye ba ma/ mthong ma/ chosakyi dpal/ khyab 'jug la brten ma/ ku mu da la gnas ma/ bzod ldan ma/ mthu rtsal gyi gnas/ dag byed dang bkra shis thams 217
cad kyi lag pa dang ldan pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad med par byed pa bsod nams thams cad sdud pa'i dpal/ sathams cad dang / rgyal po thams cad kyi dpal/ rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po thams cad kyi dpal/ 'byung po thams cad dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwagasadang / sha za dang / grul bum dang / lto 'phye chen po thamscad kyi dpal/ lha'i gnasadang / lha thamasacad kyi dpal/ bzlas brjod dang / bzlasbrjod du bya ba dang / sbyin sreg dang / sbyin sreg tu bya ba dang / bkra shis thams cad kyi dpal/ 'od la dga' ba/ skal ba dang ldan par 'dod pa/ drang phrong thamasacad dag par byed pa'i dpal/ bud med kyi gnas thams cad kyi gtso mo dang / dpal gyi mchog mi 'am ci mo thamasacad dang lha ma yin mo thamasacad kyi dpal gyi mchog kha na ma tho ba med pa'i gnasan 'dug ma/ yid du 'ong ma/ sim par byed ma/ ku be ra'i snying du sdug ma/chosakyi rgyal polidapal/ yoX sdug bsngal thams cad lasarnam par gzigs shig sgrol cig thar bar mdzod cig bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad bdag la mngon du gyur par mdzod cig swā hā/ o rga ga sarba ltarja mu khi swā hā/ oX sarba bi tri swā hā/ sarba me ga la dhā ra ṇaṃ swā hā/ tsa turbe da sarba nak+ṣa tra gra hā ba ṇa ga ṇa a dhi mū swā hā/ draspri ya swā hā/ biṣ+ṭa be swā hā/ ru dru ya swā hā/ bi shwa mu khā ya swā hā/ o gli ni gli ni sarba kār+ya swa dha ni/ sa ni r+sāni/ā ba ha de bi shrī/ be+e shra ba ṇa ya swā hā/ su bar+ṇa dha na dha n+ya/ ā dar+ṣa ṣ+yo swā hā/ sarba pur+ṇa ā 'ji 〉swā hā/ shrī he ma ba tī ā dzin rū swā hā/ sarba pā pa nā sha snu swā hā/ sarba a kwa la mṛ t+yu pra sha ma snu swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka tā yi swā hā/ sarba de ba ta bhi mu kha shrī yi swā hā/ā yurba la brta ka rā yi swā hā/ sarba yi dwa maX ga la ha stu yi swā hā/ saX haX hi nā yi swā hā/pad+ma salha3 oṃ swā hā/ sarba kṛ t+ya ka khorda bi nā sha snu swā gi/ 'jigs pa med pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang la la lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming nyes sdig thams cad med par 218
byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ bsod nams thams cad sdud par byed pa/ bkra mi shisapa thamadragacad med par byed pa/ dpal dang / bde ba dang / skal ba bzang po thamasacad sdud par byed pa 'di dag dang / de bzhin gshegasapa'i mtshan 'di dag 'chang ba dang / klog par byed pa des nang par langs te gtsang mar byas la/sangs rgyas thams cad la me tog dang bdug pa gsol nas lha mo chen mo dpal la yang tsan dan gyi bdugapa phul te/ bklags na des dpal thams cad thob par 'gyur zhing bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad thob par 'gyur te/ lha thams cad rdzu( drisgroshā ༵ sra) gyu/dṛ sprib pa dang / snyed pa byed par 'grar la de'i don thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs pa med pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / lha mo chen mo dpal de dang /'khor de dag thamasacad dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangasate/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa rdzogasaso/ / / /219
༄༅/ /skyesapa dang bud med mtha' dag bde ba'i thabasamakhasakyisa'adul bar mdzad pa'i byang chub semasadapa' bud med 'gyur ba zhesabya ba dang rab 'byor gnyisakyi zab moyidon gyi dri ba dri lan mdzad cing bud med de sangasargyasadang mjal nasalung bstan brnyesatshul/bud med 'gyurangasapabastanapa'i mdo lasangakho'phags pa bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen polimado/sangasargyas dang byang chub semasadapa' thamasacad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dusagacig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po〉khab na bya rgod phung poliri la dge slong lnga stong gi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub semasadapa' brgyad stong mngon par gragasapa/ mngon par shesapa thob pa/ spobasapa thogasapa med pa/ mi 'jigasapa thob pa/ mi skye ba'i chosal bzod pa dang ldan pa/ sangasargyasadapag tu med pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ theg pa chen polirjes su song ba sha stag la 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mu khyud 'dzin dang / sa 'dzin dang / bang rim 'dzin dang / mchod sbyin rus 'dzin dang / snang ba'i blo gros dang / rnam par dag pa'i blo grosadang / sbyangasapa'i blo grosadang / khyad par blo grosadang / mtha' yasablo grosdang / 'phel ba'i blo grosadang / mthong dga' dang / legasamathong dang/ cher snangasnyeng /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen hūm̐ ༷na kun mthong la sogasapa dang thabs ga
tu bzhugs so/ /byams pa la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' semasadapa' chen po thams cad kyang 'khor de nyid du 'dusapar gyur te 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen po na rten cing bzhugs te/ rgyal po dang / rgyal po'ibu rnamasadang / tshong dpon rnams dang / khyim bdag rnamasadang / blon po rnamasadang / 'khor rnams dang / grong rdal pa dang / yul gyi mi rnams kyis bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mo byas/ mchod pa byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor snga dro'idusakyi tshe smad g.yogasadang / chosagos bgos/ lhung bzed thogasanas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyisa'adi skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdang sum bdag gi rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa zhig mthong ste/ des phyag g.yasapa gser gyi mdog can brkyang nas bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ rab 'byor sang khyod kyi sngon ma thos pa'i chos ston pa thos par 'gyur ro zhesade skad ces bka' stsal na/ bcom ldan 'dasade gang gi snga ltas lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo chos 'dod pa rnams kyi sngon ma thos pa'i chos thos par 'gyur ba'i snga ltasayin no/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasal tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyisa'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'dasabadag rgyal po'ikhab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms la mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de'i dus la bab par shesan songasashig de nasatshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhagaphul mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen 221
por bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rgyal polikhab kyi grong khyer chen por mthar chags su bsod snyoms la rgyu zhing song ba las/ khyim bdag cig gi gnas ga la ba der song ste phyin nas sgo khang gi nang logs su cang mi smra bar sdod do/ /de nas khyim de'i nang nas bud med mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ lta na sdug pa/ rgyan gyis legs par bklubs te/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / byi ru dang /gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dpal shin tu 'bar ba/ kha dog rgyas shing mdzes pa dang ldan pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas bud med des tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nasatshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /btsun pa rab 'byor khyod ci zhig bzhed pa'i slad du sgo khang 'di na gzhes/ rab 'byor gyis smrasapa/ che zhe bdag ni bsod snyoms 'dod pa'i phyir sgo gang 'di na sdod do/ /bud med des smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor khyod la da dung yang bsod snyoms kyi 'du shes 'byung lags sam/ btsun pa rab 'byor khyod la da dung yang bsod snyoms kyi 'du shes thugs su ma chud dam/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ che zhe bdag gis bsod snyoms kyi 'du shes ni khong du chud mod kyi/ 'on kyang pha ma las skyes pa'i lus 'bras chan dang zan dron gyis bskyed pa 'di zas med kyi bar du 'tsho bar mi nusaso/ /bud med des smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gyis ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag 'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag reg pa 'gags pas cordor ba 'gag 'ordor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag sred pa 'gags pas len pa 'gag len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gagsrid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre 222
sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa 'gag pa mngon sum du ma mdzad dam/ rab 'byor gyisasmras pa/ che zhe bdag gisa'agog pa mngon sum du byasaso/ /smrasapa btsun pa rab 'byor ci zhig ni 'gog par 'gyur/ chos gang ni rab tu bsgom par bgyi/ smras pa che zhe 'gog pa ni chos gang gi rab tu bsgom par bya ba yang ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gal te 'gog pa chos gang gi rab tu bsgom pa yang ma lags na btsun pa rab 'byor gyi lus bsod snyoms kyis ji ltar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ smras pa/ che zhe 'bo|ga pa la lha(mas par zhugs te tshor ba thams cad bkag pa las langasapa'i lusa'atsho bar byed do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gal te gtan du mya ngan las 'das na khyod kyi lusaji ltar 'tsho ba la 'jug par 'gyur/ smras pa/ che zhe bcom ldan 'dasakyi nyan thosarnamasani lusa'atsho bar bya ba'i phyir bsod snyoms la rgyu'o/ /smras pa/ des na bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun pa rab 'byor nyon mongs pa med par gnasapa rnamasakyi mchog tu ma bstan tam/ smras pa/ che zhe de yin no/ /smrasapa/ ci nyon mongasapa med pa de rgyu ba'am rab tu rgyu ba lags sam/ smrasapa/ che zhe ma yin no/ /smrasapa/'o na ci'i slad du btsun pa rab 'byor bsod snyoms la rgyu ba mdzad/ smras pa/ che zhe bdag ni lus cha ba'i phyir bsod snyoms la rgyu ba ma yin gyi/ sgog gi phyir tshor ba dgag pa'i don du bsod snyoms la rgyu'o/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor da dung yang tshor bas 'phrogs sam/ smras pa/ che zhe bdag ni tshor bas mi 'phrogs mod kyi/ tshor ba dgag pa'i phyir bsod snyoms la rgyu'o/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor nyon mongs pa med pa ni mtshungs pa med pa ste/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa ni lus dang sems kyi tshor ba myong ba ma mchis so/ /nyon mongs pa med pa ni lus dang sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa ma lags so/ /nyon mongs pa med pa ni dga' ba'am/ yid mi 223
dga' ba skyed pa mi bgyid do/ /nyon mongs pa med pa ni su la yang nyon mongs pas nye bar gnasapa ma mchis so/ /gzhan yang gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun pa rab 'byor nyon mongasapa med par gnasapa rnamasakyi mchog tu bstan na/ ci'i slad du ni nyon mongs pa med pa nyon mongs pa med pa zhes bgyi/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ che zhe dmigasapa med pa'i nyon mongs pa med pa ni 'dod chagasakyi rdul dang bral ba yin no/ /smrasapa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ci nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ram/ smras pa/ che zhe ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor 'o na nyon mongs pa med pa de ji ltar 'dod chagasakyi rdul dang bral bar gyur/ smras pa/ che zhe nyon mongs pa med par bstan pa 'di ni bshad pa tsam du zad do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ci nyon mongasapa med pa la bshad pa mchisasam/ smras pa/ che zhe med do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gal te nyon mongs pa med pa la bshad pa ma mchis na ci zhig 'chad cing bzhugs/ smras pa/ che zhe bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams ni tha snyad tsam gyis tha snyad du 'dogs par zad do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ji tsam du brjod pa mchis pa de tsam du tha snyad 'dogasaso/ /ji tsam du tha snyad 'dogasapa de tsam du phyin ci log go /ji tsam du phyin ci log pa de tsam du rtsod par 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam du rtsod pa de tsam du dge sbyong gi chos ma lags so/ /smras pa/ che zhe 'o na dge sbyong gi chos gang yin/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor dge sbyong gi chos ni tha snyad ma mchis pa/ phyin ci ma log pa rtsod pa ma mchis pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni chos dang chos ma lags pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni chags pa dang ma chags pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni yul ma mchis pa dang / yul ma lags pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni chags pa ma mchis pa dang / ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni 224
sems ma mchisapa ste/ semasadang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chosani chog shesapa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni phrag dog dang chagasapa spangasapa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni 'dod pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa dang zhen pa ma mchis pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni phung polibadud las nges par grol ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa ste/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud lasayang dag par 'dasapa'o/ /dge spyong gi chos ni ma skyes pa'o/ /dge spyong gi chos ni 'chi bdag gi bdud dang bral ba'o/ /dge sbyong gi chosani g.yo ba ma mchisapa dang / rlom sems ma mchis pa dang /rtog pa ma mchisapa dang / rnam par ma bsgribs pa dang / spyad pa ma lags pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni bdud kyi yul las yang dag par 'das pa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni blang ba ma mchis pa dang / dor ba ma mchisapa'o/ /dge spyong gi chos ni skye ba dang / 'jig pa dang bral ba'o/ /dge spyong gi chosani lha'i bu'i bdud dang ma 'bagasapa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chosani yid la byed pa ma mchisapa dang / thams cad du gosapa ma mchisapa'o/ /dge sbyong gi chos ni mngon par zhen pa ma mchis pa dang / mtshan ma ma mchis pa dang / mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /dge spyong gi chos ni khams dang khams ma lags pa'i tshul thams cad kyis bcu1sa pa ma lags pa dang / bgrang ba dang / bral ba dang / gnas ma mchis pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /dge spyong gi chos bstan pa 'di bshad pa na sgo gang der lha'i bu gang dag chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dus pa de dag las lha'i bu bzhi stong chosarnamasal chosakyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam pa ra dag go /rgya chen po la mos pa'i lha'i bu lnga brgya ni bud med de'i spobs pa thos nas bla na med pa yang dag 225
par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor 'di snyam du sems te/ che zhe 'di 'di ltar spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa de ni ngo mtshar te/ che zhe 'di'i spobs pa 'di 'dra ba las na 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa yin par the tshom med do snyam mo/ /de nas bud med de'i sems kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyi sems shes nasaganasabartan rab 'byor la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /btsun pa rab 'byor 'di ltar 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa yin par the tshom med do snyam du dgongasapa de ni ji ltar dgongs pa de bzhin te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin nyid thugs su chud pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang de bzhin nyid khong du chud de/ des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyang de nyid de/ desan bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de ni nam yang / de bzhin nyid ma lags par mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa dang / semasacan thamasacad kyi de bzhin nyid gang lagasapa de ni nam yang de bzhin nyid ma lagasapar mi 'gyur te/ des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de ni res 'ga' de bzhin nyid du 'gyur ba ma lags la/ bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa de yang res 'ga' de bzhin nyid du 'gyur ba ma lags kyi/rtag tu de bzhin nyid de kho na lags so/ /des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa dang / semasacan thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid gang lags pa dang / chos thamasacad kyi de bzhin nyid gang lagasapa de ni yang dag 226
pa ji lta ba dang / gzhan ma yin pa de ni de bzhin nyid de/ des na bdag ni de bzhin gshegadragapa'i sprul pa'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe ci khyod kyis de bzhin gshegasapa'i mthusabadag gi semasashesasam/ 'on te rang gi shes pas shes smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor nyan thos rnams sam/ rang sangs rgyas rnamasasam/ byang chub semasadapa' rnamasasam/ drang srong mngon par shesapa lnga dang ldan pa gang yang rung ste/ sems can gzhan gyi sems shes pa de dag thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi mthus gzhan gyi sems shes pa lags so/ /de ltar gnas brtan rab 'byor gzhan gyi sems mkhyen pa gang lags pa de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus mkhyen pa lags so| |btsun pa rab 'byor dper na zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / me dang / nor bu dang / mar me dang / skar ma la brten nas skyes bu mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis gzugs rnams mthong ba de bzhin du btsun pa rab 'byor ma rig pa'i mun pa ni 'jig rten gnas pa las gang su dag pha rol gyi semasashes pa de dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa la brten nasashesapa lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe khyod 'di lta bu'i spobs pa dang ldan pa khyod su yi na pa dang ga las 'ongs pa bdag la ston cig bud med des smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la 'dri ste/ rigs kyi bu khyod su yin pa dang rta ga las 'ongs pa bdag la ston cig ces de skad smras na/ ji skad du lan 'debs par 'gyur/smras pa/ che zhe cung zad kyang lan gdab tu med do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de bzhin du chos thams cad sprul pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du shes na bdag gis ci zhig zhes su mchis/ gzhan yang gang zhig btsu/ 29 rab 'byor la 'dri ste/ ci khyod so so'i skye
bo yin nam/ 'on te slob pa'am/ dgra bcom pa yin zhesade skad smrasan/ lan ji skad gdab/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor sems pa la zhugs te/ che zhe 'di'i lan ji skad gdab par bya snyam mo/ /de nas bar snang las btsun pa rab 'byor khyod kyis cung zad cig thob pa'am/ rtogs pa'am/ mngon sum du byas pa'am/ mngon par rtogs pa gang gisadagra bcom pa yin par shes pa de che zhe 'di la ston cig cesasgra byung ngo / /de nasatshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyisabar snang de lasasgra byung ba de thosanas bud med de la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /che zhe bdag ni so so'iskye bo yang ma yin/ slob pa yang ma yin/ dgra bcom pa yang ma yin no/ /smrasapa/ bston pa rab 'byor de bdag gis ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ smraphupa/ che zhe de bzhin gshegadragapa'i sprul pa'i gdagaphupa ji lta ba de bzhin du bdag la zungs shig smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor ni dgra bcom pa/zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongasapa med par gnas pa rnamasakyi mchog dang yon gnas zhes bgyi ba lagasaso/ /smras pa/ che zhe bdag ni dgra bcom pa/ zag pa༄da pa/ nyon mongspa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog dang yon gnas ma yin no/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ltar na shes bzhin gyis rdzun gsung bar mi 'gyur ram/ smras pa/ che zhe gal te bdag zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog dang /yon gnasayin par 'dzin par gyur na ni de ltar na bdag rdzun du smra bar 'gyur na/ gang gi phyir bdag de ltar mi 'dzin pa de'i phyir bdag ni yang dag par smra ba yin gyi rdzun du smra ba zhes mi bya'o/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor sgo gang 'dir lha bden pa mthong ba chosamanyan pa'i phyir 'dusapa rnamasal slu bar mi 'gyur ram/ smrasapa/ che zhe bden pa mthong ba gang dag yin pa de dag ni slu bar mi nus so/ /smrasapa/ btsun pa rab 'byor gyis bden pa rnams gzigs sam/ smras pa/ mthong ngo / /smras pa/ gal te bden pa 228
rnamasamathong du rung na ni de dag bden pa ma lagasapar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bden pa rnamasani susakyang mthong bar mi nusapa'i slad du'o/ /rab 'byor gyisasmrasapa/che zhe bden pa mthong ba zhesabya ba de gang gi tshig bla dgasayin/ smrasapa/ bston pa rab 'byor bden pa mthong ba zhes bgyi ba de ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du yang dag par mthong ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /bden pa mthong zhesabagyi ba de ni phyin ci log yang dag par mthong ba'i tshig bla dgasaso/ /smras pa/ che zhe khyod kyis gang lasabasamasate de skad smras/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor phyin ci log gis nyon mongasapa kun nas bslang bgang lagasapa de ni bden pa mthong bsaskye bar 'gyur te/ desan phyin ci log yang dag par mthong bsabaden pa mthong zhesabagyi'o/ /de nas sgo gang der chos mnyan pa'i phyir lha 'dus pa de dag gis gnas brtan rab 'byor la ragasapa'i lusabastan nasa'adi skad cesasmrasaso/ /btsun pa rab 'byor khyod kyisache zhe 'di'i sbobasapa thos pa de ni khyod kyisarnyed pa legasapa rnyed do/ /semscanagang dag gisabastan pa 'di thosanasamosapa de dag kyang rnyed pa legasapar rnyed pa yin no/ /gang dag mos pa de dag ni gang las kyang rnam par grol ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mos pa mang ba rnams ni gang las kyang rnam par grol ba med do/ /mos pa mang ba la ni 'ching ba med pasan de ni gang lasakyang rnam par grol ba med do/ /de nas bud med des yang tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor bsod snyoms la rgyur mi bzhud dam/ bshos bcad de ci bgyi/ smras pa/ che zhe bdag gi zasani 'di nyid yin te/ chos mnyan pa 'di lta bus chog go /che zhe gang chos gosadang bsod snyomasakyi phyir yid mi bde ba skye ba de ni chosa'adod pa ma yin no/ /gang rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / tshigasasu bcad pa 'dod pa de ni chosa'adod pa ma yin no/ /229
gang lusadang / srog dang / bsod snyomasa'adod pa de ni chosa'adod pa ma yin no/ /gang tha na legs so zhes bya ba 'dod pa de yang chos 'dod pa ma yin no/ /smras pa/ che zhe rigasakyi bu'am rigasakyi bu mo dag chosa'adod pa ji lta bu yin/ smrasapa/ bston pa rab 'byor gang 'dod pa la mi sred pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /gang mig dang gzugs mi 'dod pa dang / rna ba dang / sgra dang / sna dang / dri dang / lce dang / ro dang / lus dang /reg bya dang / yid dang / chosami 'dod pa de ni chosa'adod pa'o/ /gang chosaci la yang mi rten pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /btsun pa rab 'byor gzhan yang gang dag phung po dang /khamasadang / skye mched mi 'dod pa de ni chosa'adod pa'o/ /gang 'dod pa dang / gzugsdang / gzugasamed pa mi 'dod pa de ni chos 'dod pa'o/ /gang dmigs pa'i mtshan ma la dmigs pa mi 'dod pa de ni chosa'adod pa'o/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyisbud med de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe bzod par gyis shig bdag sgo gang 'di nas 'gro'o/ /bud med des smrasapa/ bston pa rab 'byor dper na sa'i khamasal bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du bston pa rab 'byor gang gi sems phudang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rab 'byor chu la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du gang gi sems chu dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rab 'byor me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du gang gi sems me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'chal lo/ /bston pa rab 'byor gru dang / stegasadang / zam pa dang / lam po che la bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal ba de bzhin du bston pa rab 'byor gang gi sems gru dang /stegs dang / zam pa dang / lam po che dang 'dra ba de la ni bzod pa gsol mi 'tshal 'o / /btsun pa rab 'byor byis pa rnams la ni bzod pa gsol 'tshal gyi 'phagasapa rnams la 230
