dang / snying rje chen polisgo dang / byams pa chen polisgo dang / zhi ba'i sgo dang / ngag gi lam gyi sgo dang / tshul gyi sgo dang / khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / rnam par phye ba'i sgo dang / yang dag par 'du ba'i sgo dang / chagasapa med pa'i mtha'i sgo dang / kun gyi sgo dang /sangs rgyasakyi chosakyi sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chosakyi sgo dang / nyan thos kyi choskyi sgo dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi chos kyi sgo dang / 'jig rten 'byung ba'i chos kyi sgo dang / 'jig rten 'jig pa'i chosakyi sgo dang / 'jig rten kun nasaganasapa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khamasarnam par dag pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khamasakun nas nyon mongasapa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kun nasanyon mongs pa la rnam par dag pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa la kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sgo dang /'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu rnam par dag pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhi mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khamasasbrel zhi'i sgo dang /'jig rten gyi khams sbyi'u shugs su rgyu ba'i sgo dang / mig 'phrul du 'jug pa'i sgo dang /'jig rten gyi khamasakyi rgyud kyi sgo dang / gnasakyi 'du shesakyi rnam par gyur pa'i sgo dang /phra ba rgya chen por khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / rgya chen po phra bar khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas mthong bar bya ba'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa tha dad pa'i sgo dang / sangasargyasakyi 'od zer gyi dra ba rnam pa tha dad pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba'i sgo dang / sangasargyasakyi chosakyi 'khor lo mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo tha dad pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo nges pa'i tshig gi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba kun tu 'khor ba'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas 276
kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo dang / sangasargyasakyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba'i sgo dang / sangasargyasakyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyasakyi stobasasnang ba'i sgo dang / sangasargyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / sangasargyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyisarnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo dang / sangasargyas kyi rnam par spyod pa'i sgo dang /sangasargyasakyi byin gyisarlabasakyi sgo dang / sangasargyasakyi sprul pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi sems can pha rol gyi sems thugs su chud pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyisarnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo dang / dga' ldan gyi pho brang na bzhugs pa'i sgo nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba bstan pa'i bar gyi sgo dang / sems can gyi don tshad med pa mdzad pa'i sgo dang / chos zab molitshul gyi sgo dang / chos sna tshogs kyi tshul gyi sgo dang /byang chub kyi semasakyi chos kyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / byang chub kyi semasa'abyung ba'i rnam pa'i chos kyi sgo dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi tshogs kyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / smon lam gyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / spyod pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / mngon par shesapa'i rnam pa'i sbo dang / 'byung ba'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / gzungs rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / ye 34kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / shesarab yongasasu dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang ༈byang chub tshad med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / dran pa rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dag ste/rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgolirgyud dran pas kun nas rnam par brgyan pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' sems nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa/ blo gros chos kyi dbyings ltar yangs pa/ rgyud bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis brtan pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam du zhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos yongs su mi rgyu ba/ ye shes snang ba'i mig rab rib med pa rab tu thob pa/chos kyi dbyingasathams cad mun pa med par khong du chud pa/ blo nam mkha' ltar tshad med 277
pa dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i mig can/ chags pa med pa'i snang ba'i snying po dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad kyi don rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pa/zil gyis gnon la/ 'jig rten kun gyi ril gyis mi non pa/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa'i tshul la rnam par spyod pa/ 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud thamasacad na kha na ma tho ba med pa/'jig rten gyi don byed pa la brtson pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa/ 'gro ba thamasacad kyi ngag gi tshul dang / rnam pa la mkhas pa/ 'gro ba thamasacad duganasapa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigasapa ston pa/ dusakyi 'khor lo thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yonartan brjod par nusare skan/ /song rigs kyi bu/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na yul mig gsum pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na dge slong lta na sdug pa zhes bya ba 'dug gis/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpasabyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gisabu mo byams ma'i rkang pa gnyis la sbyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ bu mo byams ma la lan brgya stong du mar paX k+ṣiṃ phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ bu mo byamasama'i drung nas 278
༄dzoñdza/ /gzhon nu nor bzang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba zhesabya bsabasod nams kyi mdzod mi zad pa'i rgyan zhesabya ba'i yon tan mngon du brnyes pa'i tshul/sangasargya phalabo che zhesabya ba lhanatu rgya pa chen polimado las baspyos /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer rgya mtsho brtan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba zhesabya ba 'dug gis/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris lhag de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshig thosanas phyugayos te/ dga' ba chen po'oshugasaskyes nas/ rab tu dka' ba'i yid dang ldan par gyur pa ngo mtshar gyi bsam pa/ rin po che rab tu dkon pa thob pa/'gro ba mang po la phan pa'i sems dang bsam pasabyung ba sangs rgyas skyes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par 'gro ba la dbang bsgyur ba/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i blo grosal rten pa/ thams cad du rjesasu song ba'i rig pa rnam par phye bas 'byung ba bstan pa la brtson pa/ dus gsum gyi dbyings su ma 'dres pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul dang ldan pa/ bsod namasami zad pa'i rgya mtsho lasabyung ba'i semasadang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi snang ba chen po la dbang bsgyur ba/ khams gsum gyi khyim du sdud pa'i sgo shin tu gcod pa des/ khye'u dbang polidabang phyug gi rkang pa gnyis la sgyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ khye'u dbang polidabang phyug la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/yang dang yang bltasate/ khye'u dbang polida~X phyug gi drung nas song ngo /
de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gi sprin gyi char yongs su 'dzin pa byed cing / gang chen mtsho ltar sprin chen porichar gyis ngoms mi shes pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi nyi ma'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis dge ba yongs su smin par byas pa'i phugazhi las dbang po3myu gu 'thon cing skyesapa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zla ba nya zhing rgyas pa'i gdams ngag gi 'od zer gyi dra bas lus dang /sems shin tu tshim par byas pa/ dpyid kyi nyi ma'i 'od kyis gdungs pa'i ri dwags kyi tshogs gsal zhing bsil ba'i gangs chu la 'thung bar 'dod pa ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gi chu la 'thung bar 'dod pa/ bung ba mang po 'khor zhing lding basrgyas par gyur pa'i pad mo dang ldan pa'i pasmo3matsho ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gis sems kyi me tog bun da ri ka kha phye ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis yongs su rgyasapa'i rin po che'i gling ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdamasangag rin po che 'phel ba'i snang bsasems shin tu snang bar byasapa/ 'dzam bu'i shing chen polime tog dang / 'bras bu'i tshogs chen po dang ldan pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs su gyur pa/ kun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/klu'i dbang po chen po rtsed mo dam pas rtse ba las byung ba'i nam mkha'i sprin chen po ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag thos pa'i tshogs su gyur pa'i rnang shin tu che ba/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i 'jig rten gyi brgyan pa'i sna tshogs kyi spo ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag las byung ba'i chos dri ma med pa sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i spor gyur pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i brgya byin lha ma yin gyi dbang po〉tshogs rab tu 'joms pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag las byung ba'i yon tan dri ma med pa'i tshogasakyis yongs su bskor cing zil gyis mi gnon la 280
gzhan la zil gyisaganon pa de/ mthar gyis grong khyer rgya mtsho brtan pa gang na ba der phyin te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba yongs su tshol tshol ba las de la skye bo mang pos bstanate/ rigasakyi bu dge bsnyen ma phul dubyung ba de grong khyer gyi dbusakyi rang gi khyim na 'dugan zhesanas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i gnas gang na ba der song ste/ thal mo sbyar nasasgo gang na sdod sdod pa dang / desadage bsnyen ma phuladu byung ba'i khyim de shin tu rgya che la yangasashing rin po che'i ra bsayongasasu bskor ba phyogasabazhi nasasgo shin tu mdzes pa rnam par phye ba/ rin po che tshad med grangasamed pa'i rgyan gyisabargyan pa/ bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pas mngon par grub pa mthong nas/de khyim der song ste/ kun tu bltas na dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba na chung shin tu gzhon pa thog ma dar la bab pa/ gzugasamangon zhing mdzesal lta na sdug pa kha dog dam pa/ phri ya ba shin tu rgyasapa dang ldan pa/ skra phye mar bzhag pa/ lus la rgyan med pa/ gos dang smadagayogasadakar po bgosapa/ rin po che'i khri la 'dug pa mthong ste/ sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par de'i lus sam/ sems kyi dbang ngam/ gzi brdzid dang / kha dogages:la gyisam non pa'i semasacan ni khyim de na gang yang med de/lha'am mi'ang rung ste/ semasacan gang gisadage bsnyen ma phul du byung ba mthong bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang / dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba la ston pa'i 'du shes su bsam pa zhig rin po che'i khri la 'dug pa mthong ngo / /gzhan yang khyim de na stan lha rdzas dang / mi'i rdzas las shin tu 'phags pa/ byang chub semasadapa'i lasakyi rnam par smin pas yongs su grub pa bye ba stong phrag bcu bting ba dang / mdun du phru ba gcig cig bzhag pa las kha zas dang skom gyi bag gam/ gos dang rgyan gyi longs spyod kyi bag gzhan ci paX mi snang ngo / /bud med stong phrag bcu tsam
zhig mdun du 'dug par mthong na'ang de dag thams cad kyang lha'i bu molikha dog dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu moligazugasadang ldan pa/ lha'i bu moyitshul dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu molispyod pa dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu molilongs spyod dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu molitshul du shis pa dang ldan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos yid bzhin du gyon pa/ lha rdzas kyi lhab lhub kyis shin tu klubs pa/ lha'i bu moliskad lta bu'i dbyangs snyan pa dang ldan pa lha'i bu molichu zheng mdzes pa dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ de'i 'khor gyi bud med kyang des ci bsgo ba bzhin du byed cing mdun na 'dod do/ /rim gro byed do/ /bkur sti byed do/ /gdong du lta'o/ /ci bsgo ba nyan cing gnas so/ /rje sar 'khod do/ /yongs su lta'o/ /rnam par lta'o/ /'dud do/ /rab tu 'dud do/ /phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gi lus las spos kyi ngad ldang bas ni/ grong khyer de'i 'khor thamasacad du dri zhig posakhyab par 'dug ste/ semasacan gang gis dri de tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang gnod sems med pa'i sems dang / shar gnyer ba med pa'i semasadang / 'tshe ba med pa'i semasadang / phrag dog dang /'jungasapa dang bral ba'i semasadang / sgyu dang g.yo med pa'i sems dang / chagasapa dang /khong khro ba med pa'i sems dang / zhus pa dang / gzengs mtho ba med pa'i sems dang /byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang / sdom pa la gnas pa'i sems dang /gzhan gyis yongs su bzung ba la re ba med pa'i sems su gyur te/ gang gis de dag gi skad thos pa de dag thams cad kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / dul ba'i sems dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis de dag mthong bar gyur pa de dag kyang / 'dod chags dang bral ba tsam du rang rang gis shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mthong nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal 38/2dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba la lan brgya
stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smradrangaso/ /'phagasam bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu semasabaskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub semasadapa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub semasadapa' rnamasal gdamasangag dang rjesasu bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gisathos na/ 'phags ma ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub semasadapa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ smras pa rigasakyi bu kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa/ bsod nams kyi mdzod mi zad pa'i rgyan cesabya ba thob pa ste/ rigasakyi bu kho mo ni phru ba gcig po 'di lasamos pa sna tshogs can rnams kha zas ci la dga' ba bzhin du tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogasadang / dri sna tshogasakyisatshim par byed de/ rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo ni phru ba gcig po 'di las ci la dga' ba'i kha zas kyis sems can brgya'ang yongasasu tshim par byed do/ /semasacan stong dang sems can brgya phrag stong dang / sems can bye ba dang / sems can bye ba phrag brgya dang / sems can bye ba phrag stong dang /sems can bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong nas/sems can brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa mos pa sna tshogs can rnams kyang ci la dga' ba'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byed do/ /yongs su stobs par byed do/ /yongs su dga' bar byed do/ /yongs su mgu bar byed do/ /yongs su spro bar byed do/ /shin tu tshim par byed do/ /yid bde bar byed do/ /'on kyang phru ba 'di las 'gong bar 'grar ba med do/ /'gri ba med de dma' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zad par mi 'grar ro/ /'bri bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sa mtshams yod par mi 'gyur ro/ /mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /283
mur thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gzhung de dang 'dra bar sems can 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / de bzhin du gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khamasakyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang /stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas sems can mos pa sna tshogs can sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig 'ongs kyang / ci la dga' ba'i kha zas tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs kyisayongs su tshim par byed do/ /yongasasu dga' bar byed do/ /nyams bde bar byed do/ /shin tu tshim par byed do/ /yid shin tu bde bar byed do/ /'on kyang phru ba 'di las 'gong bar 'gyur ba med do/ /'grib pa med do/ /dma' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /sa mtshams yod par mi 'gyur ro/ /mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /mur thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can mos pa sna tshogasacan dang / bsam pa sna tshogs can thams cad 'ongasapar gyur na yang / de dag thams cad ci la dga' ba'i kha zas kyisayongs su tshim par byed pa nas/ yid bde bar bya ba'i bar du byed do/ /kha zas sna tshogs kyis ji lta ba de bzhin du btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / ro rnam pa sna tshogs dang / stan sna tshogs dang / mal cha sna tshogs dang /bzhon pa sna tshogasadang / gosasna tshogs dang / me tog sna tshogs dang / phreng ba sna tshogs dang / sbos sna tshogs dang / bdug sbos sna tshogasadang / byug pa sna tshogasadang / phye ma sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang / rgyan sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i shing rta sna tshogs dang / gdugs sna tshogs dang / rgyal mtshan sna tshogs dang / lha'i ba dan sna 284
tshogasadang / yo byad kyi yul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par byed pa nas/ yid dga' bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas sku'i tha ma 'dzin pa gang ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho molikha zas las gsol cing nyan thos dang /rang sangasargyasakyi byang chub kyi 'bras bu brnyesapar mdzad do/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya dang /'jig rten gyi khamasabye ba phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong dang /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas/ de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas sku'i tha ma 'dzin pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thamasacad kyang kho molikha zas las gsol cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu brnyes par mdzad do/ /shar phyogs na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lholiphyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogasamatshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs na ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag 285
thamasacad kyang de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu shar phyogasakyi 'jig rten gyi khamasagacig na sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho molikha zas las gsol cing / snying po byang chub tu bzhugs nas bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par mdzad de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang /stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas/ shar phyogs kyi sangasargyaskyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho molikha zas las gsol zhing snying po byang chub la bzhugs nas/bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par mdzad do/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /shar phyogs na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogasadang / byang phyogasadang / byang shar gyi phyogasamatshamasadang / shar lholiphyogs mtshamaphudang / lho nub kyi phyogasamaXphudang / nub byang gi phyogasamatshamasadang /
'og gi phyogasadang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gisathogasapa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho molikha zas las gsol cing snying po byang chub tu bzhugs te/ bdud sde dang bcas pa rab tu pham par mdzad nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ khrar phyogasakyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na bzhugasapa ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang / 'jig rten sgyi khamasastong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang /stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khamasakyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas/ rigs kyi bu steng gi phyogskyi 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed na/ byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gisathogs pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho molikha zas las gsol cing / snying po byang chub tu bzhugs nas bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par mdzad de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis kho mo'i 'khor bud med stong phrag bcu po 'di dag mthong ngam/ smras pa 'phags ma bdag gis mthong ngo / /smras pa rigs kyi bu bud med 'di dag la sogs pa brgya stong grangs med pa phrag bcu kho mo dang skal ba mnyam par spyod pa/287
smon lam gcig pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig pa/ 'byung ba'i rgyan gcig pa/ mos pa'i lam rnam par dag pa gcig pa/ kho mo dang skal ba mnyam par dran pa rnam par dag pa/skal ba mnyam par blo rnam par dag pa/ skal ba mnyam par blo tshad med par gyur pa/skal ba mnyam par dbang po rab tu thob pa/ skal ba mnyam par sems kyis rgyas par 'gengasapa/ skal ba mnyam par spyod yul kyi yul dang ldan pa/ skal ba mnyam par chos kyi tshul la zhugs pa/ skal ba mnyam par don nges par rtogs pa/ skal ba mnyam par chos kyi don ston pa/ skal ba mnyam par gzugs rnam par dag pa/ skal ba mnyam par stobs tshad med pa/ skal ba mnyam par brtan pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ skal ba mnyam par chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ skal ba mnyam par dbyangs rnam par dag pa/ tshad med pa'i yon tan brjod du yod pas rnam par spyod pa thams cad la skal ba mnyam par yon tan rnam par dag pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa la kha na ma tho ba med cing rnam par dag pas/skal ba mnyam par las kyi rnam par smin pa rnam par dag pa/ 'gro ba thamasacad yongssu skyob pas/ skal ba mnyam par byams pa chen pos rgyas par 'gengs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par byed pas/ mi skyo ba'i phyir skal ba mnyam par snying rje chen pos rgyas par 'gengs pa/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa'i lus yongs su ston pas/ skal ba mnyam par lus kyi las rnam par dag pa/chos kyi dbyings kyi nges pa'i tshig gi tha snyad la skal ba mnyam par ngag gi las rnam par dag pa/ sangasargyasathamasacad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du skal ba mnyam par 'dod pa/sangs rgyas la mchod cing rim gro bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du skal ba mnyam par rgyu ba/ chos thams cad kyi tshul khong du chud par bya ba la skal ba mnyam par mngon sum du gyur pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thamasacad thob 288
par bya ba la skal ba mnyam par spyod pa/ rnam par dag pa sha stag cig kyang yod de /rigasakyi bu bud med stong phrag bcu po 'di dag kyang skad cig gcig )tā 'di lta ste/ byang chub semasadapa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa rnams la zhal zas yongs su 'bul ba'i phyir phyogs bcur rgyas par 'dong ngo / /phru ba 'di nyid nas kha zas blangs shing / srid pa'i tha ma pa dang / nyan thosadang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnamasal bsod snyoms 'bul ba'i phyir phyogs bcur rgyas par 'dong ngo / /phru ba 'di nyid nas kha zas blangs shing phyogasabacargyasapar bkang ste yi dwagasakyi tshogs thams cad kha zasakyisayongs su tshim par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo ni phru ba 'di nyid nas lha rnam sa t+na lha'i kha zasakyisayongasasu tshim par byed do/ /klu rnams ni klu'i kha zasakyis/ gnod sbyin rnamsni gnod sbyin gyi kha zasakyis/ dri za rnamasani dri za'i kha zas kyis/ lha ma yin rnams ni lha ma yin gyi kha zas kyis/ nam mkha' lding rnams ni nam mkha' lding gi kha zas kyis/mi'am ci rnamasani mi'am ci'i kha zasakyis/ lto 'phye chen po rnams ni lto 'phye chen po'i kha zasakyis/ mi rnams ni mi'i kha zasakyis/ mi ma yin pa rnams ni mi ma yin pa'i kha zas kyis yongasasu thim par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu yud tsam zhig sdod dang de'u re mngon du 'gyur ro/ /dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba desatshig de brjod ma thag tu de'i mod la 'di lta ste/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung bas/ sngon gyi smon lam gyisabosapas sems can grangs med pa zhig shar phyogs kyi sgo nas nang du 'ongs par gyur to/ /de bzhin du 'di lta ste/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i sngon gyi smon lam gyisabosapas/ semasacan grangasamed pa zhig lho phyogs dang nub phyogasadang / byang phyogs kyi sgo nas nang du 'ongs par gyur te/ de ltar 'ongs pa de dag dge bsnyen ma phul du byung bas/ stan de dag la bkod de/ so so nas ci dga' ba'i kha 289
zas tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogasadang / dri sna tshogs dang ldan pas yongs su tshim par byas so/ /yongs su bstabs par byas so/ /yongs su dga' ba byasaso/ /gangasasu mgu bar byas so/ /yongasasu spro bar byas so/ 9na tu tshim par byasaso/ /yid bde bar byasaso/ /kha zasasna tshogasakyisaji lta ba de bzhin du btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / ro rnam pa sna tshogs dang / stan sna tshogs dang / mal cha sna tshogasadang / bzhon pa sna tshogaphudang / gosasna tshogasadang / metog sna tshogs dang / phreng ba sna tshogs dang / spos sna tshogs dang / bdug spos sna tshogs dang / byug pa sna tshogs dang / phye ma sna tshogasadang / rin po che sna tshogasadang / rgyan sna tshogasadang / rin po che'i shing rta sna tshogs dang / gdugs sna tshogs dang / rgyal mtshan sna tshogs dang / lha'i ba dan sna tshogs dang / yo byad kyi yul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par byas pa nas/ yid dga' bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byasaso/ /lha rnams ni lha'i kha zasakyis yongs su tshim par byas so/ /klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyang mi ma yin pa'i kha zasakyisayongasasu tshim par byas pa nas/ yid bde bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byasaso/ /'on kyang phru ba de lasa'agong bar gyur pa med/ 'grib pa med/ dmas pa med/zad par gyur pa med/ sa mtshams su gyur pa med/ mthar thug pa med/ mur thug pa med do/ /de nasadage bsnyen ma phul du byung ba des/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsod nams kyi mdzod mi zad pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di shes par zad na/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsod namasachen po'argya mtsho mi zad pas/ mi za(9 pa'i bsod namasadang ldan pa bsod nams
kyi tshogs rgya chen po shin tu bsags pas/ nam mkha' lta bur gyur pa/ 'gro ba thanā/sa cad kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed pas/ nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgya' po lta bu/ 'gro ba thamasacad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongasasu bsrung bas/ bsod nams che7/ poli'akhor yug dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du rin po che snyim pa nas char ltar 'thor bas bsod nams chen polisprin du gyur pa/ chos kyi grong khyer gyi sgo 'byed pas/bsod namasachen polimadzod la mngon sum du lta ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi phongs pa/'imun pa sel bsabasod namasachen polisgron mar gyur pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am /yon tan brjod par nusare skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer 'byung ba chen po zhesabya ba yod de/ de na khyim bdag mkhasapa zhesabya ba 'dug gis/de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 4༄ bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba dris shig de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i rkang pa gnyis la sgyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba la lan brgya stong du mar g.yadrar phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/dṛr+sha / ( pa/ (ltas te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba' drung nas blta bas mi ngoms 291
༄tsho/ /dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba zhesabya ba'i rang gi sngon gyi skye rabasadang ting nge 'dzin la bsten nas 'phags pa'i spyod yul zab mo dag gzhon nu nor bzang la bstan pa'i skor/sangasargyasarmadagaṇad zhesabyab shinatu rgyasapa chen poyimado lasabatus/rigasakyi bu rgyal po'i pho brang brtan par dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba gang na ba der songs shig dang / de las byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thos par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mong dpon gyi bu nor bzang ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes snang ba las langs nas mthar gyis rgyal po'ipho brang brtan par dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba gang na ba der song nas/ dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba yongasasu tshol zhing rmed rmed pa las/ de la 'gro ba mang posabastan pa/rigs kyi bu dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba de ni rang gi khyim na pha ma dang / 'grogs shing gzhon nur gyur pa ste/ rang gi gnyen bshes kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / skye bo3tshogasachen po la chos ston to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dga' ba chen po dang / mos shing spro bas/yongs su rgyas pa'i sems dang ldan pa de dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'i khyim gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'i khyim gyi sgo na sdod pa'i tshe/ des khyim de thams cad 'od lusadang sems shin tu bde bar byed pa/ gser gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa zhig gisakhyab cing gsal bar gyur nas/ 'od des tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la phog par gyur ma thag tu tshor ba thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po dang / zhi ba'i gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ṭ+wāṃ pang po dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang bral
ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po dang / kun tu lta ba'i btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po dang / de bzhin gshegasapa'i mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po la sogasapa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo lnga brgya tsam la zhugs par gyur te/ yongs su skyesaso/ /dza dag kyab shin tu phra zhing gzhon pa ste/ 'di ltar dper na thog ma mngal du zhugasapa'i rnam par shes pa lta bu ste/ ting nge 'dzin de dag kyang shin tu phra zhing gzhon par skyes par gyur to/ /des dri zhim po zhig tshor na'ang de ni lha la'ang med lha'i bu mo la yang med/ klu la yang med klu'i bu mo la yang med/ gnod sbyin la yang med gnod sbyin gyi bu mo la yang med/ dri za la yang med/ dri༄'i bu mo la yang med/ lha ma yin la yang med/ lha ma yin gyi bu mo la yang med/ nam mkha' lding la yang med/ nam mkha' lding gi bu mo la yang med/mi'am ci la yang med/ mi'am ci'i bu mo la yang med/ lto 'phye chen po la yang med/ lto 'phye chen po3bu mo la yang med/ mi la yang med/ mi'i bu mo la yang med cing mi srid nga de lta bu'i dri zhim po tshor bar gyur to/ /bud med de'i gzugasadang mnyam pa yang phyogasabacu'i 'jig rten na med na lhab pa ltag lasa'ong / kha dog dang mdog de lta bu yang de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku mdog dang kha dog dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba'i kha dog dang mdog ma gtogs par de'i kha dog dang / mdog tu mnyam pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na med na lhag pa lta ga lasa'ong / lusakyi chu zheng dang dbyibasade lta bu yang de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku'i khun chu zheng dang / dbyibasadang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba thob pa'i lusakyi chu zheng dang / dbyibs ma gtogs par de'i lus kyi chu zheng dang dbyibs su mnyam pa/phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na med na lhag pa lta ga las 'ong / 'od kyi rgyan de lta bu'ang de bzhin gshegasapa'i 'od kyi rgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba thob pa'i 293
'od kyi rgyan ma gtogs par de'i 'od kyi rgyan dang / mnyam pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na med na lhag pa lta ga las 'ong / de'i kha'i ngad kyi dri zhim po dang mnyam pa'i dri de lta bu yang phyogasabacu'i 'jig rten gyi lha'i gnas sam/ klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnasan med na lhag pa lta ga las 'ong / khyim gyi rgyan dang / longs spyod de lta bu'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i longs spyod dang / byang chub semasadapa' dbang bskur ba thob pa'i longs spyod ma gtogs par de'i khyim gyi rgyan dang / longs spyod du mnyam pa yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na med na lhag pa lta ga lasa'ong / g.yog 'khor kun sum tshogasapa/ de lta bu'ang de bzhin gshegasapa'i 'khor kun sum tshogasapa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ma gtogs par de'i g.yog 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / mnyam pa yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na med na lhag pa lta ga las 'ong ste/ dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba de la 'dod chagaphudang ldan pa'i semasakyisabalta bar nus pa'i sems can de lta bu'ang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi sems can gyi ris na med do/ /dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba de mthong ma thag du nyon mongs pa zhi bar mi 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sems can yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi sems can gyi ris na med de/'di lta ste dper na/ tshangs pa chen po stong phrag bcu la dbang sgyur ba la ni 'dod pa la spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnamasami rgyu'o/ /de bzhin du dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'ang mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa mi rgyu'o/ /dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba de la blta bas ngoms par 'gyur ba'i sems can de lta bu'ang shes rab kyis ngoms pa ma gtogs par phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gyi ris na /shā 4do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang
mdo lde'i snod lasabatsoyoba'i byang chub semasama'irnam tharator/gisadage bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'i lusakyi byin bsam gyisami khyab pa dang / gzugs dang kha dog dang dbyibasadang / chu zhed bsam gyisami khyab pa dang / sa'i gzhi dang / grong khyer dang rin po che thams cad la thogasapa med pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / semasacan gyi don bsam gyisami khyab pa bsgrub pa mthong ste/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas byung ba'i dri zhim po tshor nas/ 'khor rgya mtsho phun sum tshogs pa mtha' yas pa mthong ste/ khyim dang gzhal med khang gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pa mi 'phrogs pa ma'ong nas yon tan rgya mtsho tshad med pa khong du chud de/ dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba la tshigasasu bcad pa 'disabastod do/ /khyod kyisartag tu tshul khrimasadri med yongs bsrungs te/ /bzod pa shin tu yangs pa'ang yongasasu bsgomasamadzad cing / /brtson 'grus brtan pa rdo rje lta bu bsgrubs pas na/ /ri bolirgyal po lta bur 'gro bar 'phagagashing 'bar/ /de nasamong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba la tshigs su bcad pa des mngon par bstod de 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu semasabaskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpasabyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do/ /zhes bdag gis thos na/ 'phags ma ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ de nasadage bsnyen ma mi g.yo bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i ngag 'jam zhing yid du 'ong la nyams su bde bas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la dga' bar 'gyur ba'i tshig tu brjod nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis bla na med pa 295
yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legasaso legasaso/ /rigasakyi bu kho mo ni byang chub semasadapa'i rnam par thar pa thub par dka' ba'i ye shesakyi snying po thob pa ste/ byang chub semasadapa'i spyod pa'i sgo yi dam brtan pa la slob pa/ chosathamscad mnyam pa nyid kyi sa'i gzungasakyi sgo thob pa'o/ /kho mo ni spobasapa'i ye shesasnang ba/chos kyi gzhi thamasacad snang bar brjod pa thob pa'o/ /kho mo ni chosathamasacad yongasasu btsal bsami skyo ba'i rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thob pa'o/ /smras pa 'phagadragam byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa thub par dka' ba'i ye shesakyi snying po de'i yul ni ji lta bu zhig mchis/ yi dam la brtan pa'i byang chub semsdpa'i spyod pa'i sgo dang / chos thamasacad mnyam pa nyid kyi sa'i gzungasakyi sgo dang / choskyi gzhi thams cad snang bar brjod pa'i spobs pa snang ba'i sgo dang / chos yongs su btsal bsami skyo ba'i rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgoliyul ni ji lta bu zhig mchis/ smrasapa/rigs kyi bu gnas 'di ni yid ches par dka'o/ /smras pa 'phags ma bstan du gsol/sangasargyasakyi byin dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyisayongs su bzung na yid chesapar mchi grang / rtogasapa dang 'tshal ba dang / rnam parartogasapa dang / rjesasutogasapadang /rig pa dang / dmigasasu phebasapa dang / gomasapa dang / mi 'gal ba dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / sgro 'dogasapa ma mchis pa dang / mnyam par bgyid par yang mchi grang /de nasadage bsnyen ma mi g.yo bas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /rigs kyi bu sngon 'das pa'i dusashig na dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi bskal pa la/ de bzhin gshegasapa phyag rab tu brkyang ba zhesabya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ kho mo yang de'i tshe rgyal po glog gis byin pa'i bu cig ma zhig tu gyur nas/ de'i tshe nub mo mi nyal tsam zhig na rgyal po'i sgo yang bcad/ pha dang ma yang nyal/ skyesapa dang bud med dag kyang gnyid kyis296
log rol mo brdung ba dang dkrol ba'i sgra yang zhi/ lhan cig spyod pa'i bud med lnga brgya tsam dag kyang nyal bar gyur pa zhig na/ kho mo mal gyi steng na 'dug cing / nam mkha'i dbyingasal rgyu ba'i skar ma'i tshogs kyi phreng ba rnam par 'khod pa la lta lta ba las/ steng gi bar snang la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasaphyag rab tu brkyang ba/ ri'i dbang po ri rab ltar lha dang klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i'akhor mang posabaskor ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangasamed pas yongasasu bskor ba/ phyogasathamasacad du 'od zer gyi dra ba thogs pa med pasargyas par khyab pa'i sku bzhugadragapa mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegasapa de'i sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thamasacad nasakyang dri zhim po rnam pa 'di lta bu byung ste/ desakho mo'ilusadang sems shin tu bde bar gyur/ yid shin tu dga' bar gyur te/ mal gyi steng nas langs nas sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar te sa la babs nas/ bcom ldan 'dasade bzhin gshegs pa phyag rab tu brkyang ba de la phyag 'tshal te/de'i sgyi gtsug la bltas na'ang / mthar thug par ma rung / g.yas g.yon gyi tshad kyang zin par ma rung / mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs pa la bsams na'ang ngoms par ma rung ste/ de'i tshe kho mo 'di snyam du bsams so/ /las ji lta bu zhig byas na lus phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu ni 'thob par 'gyur/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po phun sum tshogasapa ni skye bar 'gyur/ 'od kyi rgyan phun sum tshogasapa ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni 'grub par 'gyur/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / 'o ngas spyod phun sum tshogs pa ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa ni skye bar 'gyung / ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ni rnapa par dag par 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam
par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phun sum tshogs pa ni yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur/ gzungasaphun sum tshogasapa ni yongasasu rdzogasapar 'gyur/ spobasapa kun sum tshogs pa ni dbang du 'gyur snyam pa dang / rigs kyi bu de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag rab tu brkyang ba des kho molibasam pa thugasasu chud nas des 'di skad cesabaka' stsal to/ /bu mo khyod kyisanyon mongasapa thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir thub pa med pa'i semsskyed cig mngon par zhen pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir pham pa med pa'i sems skyed cig chos zab molitshul khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir zhus pa med pa'i sems skyed cigsems can bsam pa mi zad pa dang ldan pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong du lhung bas mi sgul ba'i sems skyed cig srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad du skye ba'i skye mched du mgo rmongs pa med pa'i sems skyed cig sangs rgyas thams cad blta bar mos pa rgyun mi gcad pa'i phyir ngoms mi shes pa'i sems skyed cig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin yongs su gzung ba'i phyir chog mi shesapa'i sems skyed cig sangs rgyasathams cad kyi chos kyi tshul snang ba rtogs par bya ba'i phyir nges par rtogs pa'i sems skyed cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo gzung ba'i phyir yang dag par gzung ba'i sems skyed cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas byung ba shes par bya ba lta la ci smosakyi chung ngu na brdar byed pa tsam la yang 'phrul pa med pa'i sems skyed cig bu mo khyod kyis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos rin po che rnam par dbye ba'i phyir/rnam par dbye ba'i sems skyed cig ces byung ste/ de ltar rigs kyi bu kho mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyag rab tu brkyang ba las/ chos kyi tshul gyi gaXs ngag gi sgo rnam pa de lta bu dag thos nas
thamasacad mkhyen pa'i ye shesal ni mngon par mos par gyur/ stobs bcu'i rang bzhin la ni mngon par smon par gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung la ni mngon par dad par gyur/sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyi rgyan ni yongs su sbyang bar dga'/ sangs rgyas kyi sku phun sum tshogasapa ni yongs su bsgrub par dga'/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po rnam par dag pa la ni mngon par mos par gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor phun sum tshogasapa la ni mngon par smon par gyur/ sangasargyasakyi zhing rnam par dag pa la ni mngon par dad par gyur/ sangasargyas kyi spyod lam phun sum tshogs pa la ni mngon par mos par gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi sku tshe'i tshad kun sum tshogs pa la ni mngon par dga' nas/ rdo rje ltar ri dang mtshon cha thamasacad kyi mthus thub par dka' ba'i semsnyon mongasapa thamasacad dang nyan thosadang / rang sangasargyas thams cad kyisami phyed mi tshugs pa bskyed de/ rigs kyi bu de nas nye bar bzung ba tshun chad du sems bskyed pa de'i mthudrangabaskal pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig tu yid kyi dgu las kyang 'dod pa la spyad par yang mi dran na/ gnyis kyisaganyis 'du ba lta ci smos/ rigs kyi bu de nasanye bar bzung ba tshun chad du rang gi gnyen bshes la'ang khong khro ba'i sems cig ma bskyed na/ de ma yin pa'i sems can ma nyes pa'i gzhan lta ci smos/ de nas nye bar bzung ba lhun chad du bdag tu lta ba dang / ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa gcig tsam yang bskyed par mi dran na/ de ma yin pa'i yo byad gzhan la bdag gir byas te/ mngon par chags pa lta ci smos/ shi 'pho ba dang mngal na gnas pa'i tshe'ang sems rmongs pa'am/'du shes sna tshogs sam/ lung du ma bstan pa'i sems kyang byung du mi dran na/ legs par bsams shing gnas pa lta ci smos/ bskal pa de snyed cig tu sangs rgyas gcig kyang chung ngu na rmi lam du mthong ba'i rnam par dmigs par yang brjod du mi dran na/ byang chub 99
sems dpa'i mig bcus mthong bar gyur pa lta ci smos/ de nas nye bar bzung ba tshun chad du de bzhin gshegs pa thamasacad kyi chos kyi sprin yang dag par 'dzin kyang chung ngu na ming du bya ba'i rnam pa tsam kyi chosakyi tshig dang / yi ge gcig kyang brjod par mi dran na/de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal gyi mdzod nas byung ba lta ci smos/ de nas nye bar bzung ba tshun chad du chosakyi rgya mtsho de snyed cig 'thung 'thung yang / chung ngu na 'jig rten pa'i chosrnamasal/ tshig 'ga'ang ma bsams ma brtags par mi dran no/ /de nasanye bar bzung ba lhun chad du de snyed cig gi chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho las kyang / chung ngu na 'jig rten pa'i bzo'irgyusadang / tshul yang rung ste/ chosakyi tshul kyi sgo gang la yang kho mos ting nge 'dzin mngon par ma bsgrubasapa de lta bu med do/ /de nas nye bar bzung ba tshun chad du de bzhin gshegs pa de snyed kyi chosakyi 'dor lo bzung yang ji ltar yongs su bzung ba las sems can 'dul ba'i dbang du bya ba ma gtogasapar chung ngu na rjes su brgyud pa'i rgyus tsam gyi tshig dang / yi ge 'ga' yang bor bar mi dran no/ /de nas nye bar bzung ba tshun chad du sangs rgyas rgya mtsho de snyed cig mthong yang chung ngu na sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kyi smon lam gyi rgyud kyang rung ste/ smon lam 'ga' yang kho mosasems can rgya mtsho thamasacad rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mngon par ma bsgrubs pa med do/ /de nas nye bar bzung ba chun chad du sangs rgyas rgya mtsho de snyed cig gi sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'ga' cam yang kho mos bdag gi spyod pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir mngon par ma bsgrubs pa de lta bu mi dran no/ /de nas nye bar bzung ba chun chad du sems can gang kho mos bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma bskul ba de lta bu gcig kyang meg lam du 'ongs par mi dran no/ /de nas nye bar bzung ba chun chad du nyan 3()()
thos dang rang sangs rgyasayid la bya ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa gcig kyang mngon par bsgrubs su mi dran no/ /rigs kyi bu de nas nye bar bzung ba tshun chad du bskal pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig lon yang tshig dang / yi ge 'ga' la yang ze tshom bskyed pa'am/ gnyis kyis 'du shes sam/ rnam par rtog pa'i 'du shes sam/ sna tshogs kyi 'du shes sam/ rab kyi 'du shes sam/ bzang ngan gyi 'du shes sam/ sdug mi sdug gi 'du shes bskyed du mi dran no/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni de phyin cad du sangs rgyas byung ba dang ma bral lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang ma bral lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ma bral lo/ /yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang ma bral lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi smon lam thos pa dang ma bral lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thos pa dang ma bral lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul thos pa dang ma bral lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i ye shes snang ba'i tshul thos pa dang ma bral lo/ //byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin mi zad pa'i mdzod dang / gter thos pa thob pa dang ma bral lo mtha' dang dbus med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dra ba la 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba'i tshul thos pa dang ma bral lo/ /mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sems can gyi khams 'byung ba'i rgyu thos pa thob pa dang ma bral lo/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i dra ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su zad par bya ba'i ye shes snang ba dang ma bral lo/ /sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'byung ba'i rgyu'i ye shes thob pa dang ma bral lo/ /sems can thamasacad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du lus yongasasu ston pa dang ma bral lo/ /sems can thams cad kyi shes par byed pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa dang ma bral lo/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo thub par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi snying po 'di dang / chosathams 301
cad yongs su btsal bas mi skyo ba'i rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'di la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo yi dam la brtan pa 'di rnam par phye ba dang / gzungs kyi sgo chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyis 'di dang / spobasapa'i ye shes snang ba'i sgo chos kyi gzhi thams cad snang bar brjod pa 'di rnam par phye ba dang / cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod na rigasakyi bu khyod mngon sum du blta bar 'dong ngam/smras pa/ 'phags ma 'tshal 21/ /de nas dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba de na de ltar 'dug bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo thub par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi snying po la sogasapa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thamasacad yongasasu btsal bsami skyo ba'i rgyan la sogs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo don yod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan la sogs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ba la sogasapa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sangs rgyasakyi rigs mi zad pa'i mdzod la sogasapa ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong phrag bcu la rnam par blta ba dang / rnam par dpyad pa dang /rjesasu 'jug pa dang / ngesapar rtogs par byas so/ /de ltar dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rnam pa drug du g.yos pa dang / be+eḍūr+ya yongs su dag pa'i rgyu las gyur par gnas par mthong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya brgya na/ de bzhin gshegadragapa bye ba phrag brgya brgya bzhugadragapar ma'ong ste/ la la ni dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa nas/ la la ni yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba mdzad pa'i bar du'ang mthong ngo / /de yang 'jig rten gyi khams be+eḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin de dag yongasasu dag cing sgrib pa med pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin gshegasapa de dag so gnas3()2
'od zer dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyas par khyab pa mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag so so'i'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor shin tu rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho yang mthong bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag re re'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor chosakyi 'khor lo thams cad brjod pa sems can thams cad kyi rna lam du rnam par gragasapa'ang thos par gyur to/ /de nasadage bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la 'di skad cesasmras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis mthong ngam/ thosasam shes sam/ smrasapa 'phagasam mthong ngo / /thos so rig go /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yi dam brtan pa la slob cing / chos thams cad yongs su btsal bas mi skyo ba'i rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo thub par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi snying po la gnas nas/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi sa'i gzungs khong du chud pa dang / spobs pa'i ye shes snang ba chos kyi gzhi thams cad snang ba brjod pa la mkhas pa'i legs par bshad pas sems can thams cad yongs su tshim par byed par zad na kho mos byang chub sems dpa' yon tan tshad med bsam gyisami khyab pa dang ldan pa nam mkha'i dbyings la 'dab chagasakhyu mchog 'khod pa ltar gnas med par spyod pa/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po ltar yongs su smin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gdon pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa tshong pa ltar stobs bcu'i ye shes rin po che mngon par 'dod cing / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rin po che'i gling du rgyu ba/ mthu dang ldan pa'i nya ba ltar/ yid du 'ong ba'i chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgya dang ldan pa'i lag pas sred pa'i chu las byung ba'i sems can yongs su smin paX mngon par gdon pa'i phyir/ chos kyi rgya
mtsho la rnam par rgyu ba/ lha'i dbang po ltar nyon mongs pa'i lha ma yin gyi g.yul chen po brtul ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ khams gsum gyi gnas yongs su bkang zhing rnam par rgyu ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar sems can gyi sred pa'i chu dang / nyon mongs pa'i 'dam ldan tu bskam pa'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings kyi nam mkha'i dbyings la yang dag par 'phags pa zla ba nya zhing rgyas pa ltar 'dul ba'i yid kyi me tog ku mu ta rnam par kha dbye ba'i phyir/ ye shes kyi nam mkha' la mngon par shar ba/ sa'i gzhi ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i dbang po'i myu gu bskyed cing / rnam par spel ba'i phyir byams mi byams dang / mthon dman med par 'jig rten na mnyam par gnas pa rlung mar ltar sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba'i shing dang shing phran gyi nags tshal dang /kun dga' rtsa ba nas gdon pa'i phyir chags pa med par phyogs thams cad tu rnam par rgyu ba/ 'khor los sgyur ba ltar bsdu ba'i dngos po'iyo byad dang / rkyen gyis 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten na rnam par spyod pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu nyo phyogasakyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi yul dga' 'dzin tshad med pa na/ grong khyer dga' ba 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yod de/de na kun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba zhes bya ba 'dug gis/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'i rkang pa gnyis la sgyi bopa phyag 'chal to/ /dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba la lan brgya stod |zlo shā spra /sna /spya ༵nga rjo bskar ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ dge bsnyen ma pa 304
༄tsho/ /gzhan nu nor bzang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge slong ma seṅge rnam par bsgyingadra'opa zhes bya bas 'kho(ra gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dpag tu med pa bstan nas badzosminas pa'i 〈nya5/sangasargyasarmadagacad cesabya ba shinatu rgyasapa chen ngo lim do lasabaXso༈de nasamong dpon gyi bu nor bzang mthar gyi yul shu ma phyi ma'i mtha'i grong khyer ka ming ga'i nags chal gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyingasapa yongs su tshol zhing sems can kun la rmed pa'i tshe/ gang nas gang du song ba de dang der rogs pa brgya phrag du ma dang / bu mo brgya phrag du ma zhig srang dang lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / lam gyi sum mdo dag na tshogs te/ rjes su 'brang ngo / /skyes r+b+ya brgya phrag du ma dang / bud med brgya phrag du ma zhig gis kyang rigs kyi bu 'di re dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa ni/ grong khyer ka ling ga'i nags tshal 'di nyid kyi bza' shing gi ra ba chen po rgyal ba'i 'od kyis byin pa nyi ma'i mdog na sems can chad med pa'i don du chosaston cing 'dug go zhesabastan to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang bza' shing gi ra ba nyi ma'i mdog der phyin nas kun tu btsal te/ bltas na bza' shing gi ra ba de na/ shing zla ba shar ba zhes bya ba khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ 'od sna tshogs kyi kha dog can 'od kyi mdog dang ldan pa/ 'khor kun tu dpag tshad kyi khyon tsam du 'od kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa mang po dang / lo ma'i shing yongs su 'gengs pa zhes bya ba gdugs kyi rnam pa dang 305
dbyebs su 'dug pa'i 'dab mas kun nas khebs pa/ be+eḍūr+ya sngon polikha dog ltar 'dug pa'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan pa mang po dang me tog gi shing me tog gi mdzod ces bya ba/ ri'i rgyal po kha ba can ltar mdangs dga' ba'i dbyibs sna tshogs dang ldan pa kha dog sna tshogs kyi me tog mi zad pa'i char rab tu 'bebs pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i pho brang gi rgyan gyi kun nasa'adu ba dang / sus kyang mi shigs pa lta bu mang po dang / shing tog gi shing rtag tu smin pa'i ro dpe med pa'i 'bras bu'i tshogs shes bya ba gser gyi ri bolilhun ltar 'dug pa/ rtag tu shing tog phun sum tshogs par gnas pa mang po dang /rin po che'i rgyal polishing rnam par snang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba rin po che'i rgyal po dpe med pa'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i phreng ba dang / se mo do dang /rgyan rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal polimadzod nas byung ba ltar phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i kha dog grangs med pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa mang po dang / gos kyi shing dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba lha rdzas kyi gos rin po che'i kha dog sna tshogs kyi tshogasarab tu 'gyed cing 'phyang bsashin tu brgyan pa mang po dang / rol molishing dga' ba skyed pa zhesabya ba lha rdzasalasakyang lhag pa'i rol mo yid du 'ong ba'i sgra snyan pa 'byin pa mang po dang / spos kyi shing kun tu zhim pas brgyan pa zhes bya ba phyogs thams cad du thogs pa med par rnam pa thams cad du yid du 'ong ba'i spos kyi ngad 'byung ba mang po dag kyang yod par mthong / mtshe'u dang lu ma dang / lteng ka dang / rdzing bu rin po che bdun gyi pha gusamatha' brtsigasapa/ phyogs bzhi nas rin po che'i them skas btsugs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi khri 'phang dus dang mthun pa'i tsan dan gyi dri zhim pos bskus pas kun nas bskor ba/ gzhi rin po che'i rgyal po be+eḍūr+ya sngon po las legs par blangs pa/'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi bye ma bdal ba yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu lha rdzas kyi 306
dri yid du 'ong ba can gyisayongs su gang ba/ rin po che'i pad mo dang / ut+pa la dang / ku mu da dang / me tog pun da ri ka kha dog sna tshogs lha rdzas kyi bsung dang ldan pas/ chu kun nas yog pa/ bya bran sna tshogasakyi khyu lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i gzugs yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ sgra snyan pa 'byin cing brjod pas gang ba/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna tshogadragakyi shing gi phreng ba legs par bkye bas yongs su bskor cing brgyan pa dang ldan pa shing sna tshogasade dag gi drung thams cad du'ang rin po che'i seng ge'i khri sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba'i gzugasadang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan bsam gyisami khyab pa du mas brgyan pa/ lha rdzasakyi stan rin po che sna tshogasa'abel bar bting ba/ lha rdzasakyi sposadang /bdug sprodragakyi rnam pa thams cad kyisabadug pa/ lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i dar rin po che mngon par spyangasapa/ rin po che sna tshogasakyi bla re bkye ba/ rin po che sna tshogs dang 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi dra ba sna tshogs kun nas bres pa/ rin po che'i dril gyi dra ba yid du 'ong zhing snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ mang pos brgyan pa/ 'khor du lha rdzas kyi rin potsho che'i stan brgya phrag du ma bting zhing bshams pa mthong ngo / ci/rin po che'i shing drung la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i pad+mo'isnying po can bshamasapa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che'i sbos kyi rgyal poyipad mo'i snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po klu'i rgyan gyi pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge'i bya la'i pad mosasnying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba'i pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po phyogs rnam par snang ba'i pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po dbang po'irdo rje'i pad mos snying 307
po byatshos rnga bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po 'gro ba'i yid du 'ong ba'i pad+mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /rin po che'i shing drung la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po mdog dkar po〉pad mos snying po byas pa bshamasapa mthong ngo / /bza' shing gi ra ba de'i gzhi thamasacad kyang rin po che sna tshogaphukyis yongs su gang zhing rgya mtsho chen po ltar rin po che'i gling gis yongs su gang ba mthong ngo / /be+eḍūr+ya sngon po'i dam pas spras te/ rin po che thams cad kyisabargyan pa'i sa phyogs ka tsa lin da ltar reg na bde zhing 'jam pa/ gom pa bor zhing bteg pa'i tshe mtho dman med pa/ rdo rje rin po che mchog gi pad+mo'idri yid du 'ong bar zhim zhing reg na bde ba'i sil ma kun tu bkram pa/ nga ngur dang / rma bya dang / khrung khrung dang / ku na la dang / ka la ping ka dang / ko zhi la dang / dzi ban dzi ba ka sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro 'byin pa mang pos gang ba/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i tsan dan gyi shing mang po'i nags tshal shin tu legs par 'grigs pas brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi pad+mo'i sprin gyi char dang /rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs mi zad pa'i char rgyun tu 'bab pa/ 'dres pa'i nags tshal las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa/ rin po che sna tshogasakyi khang bu brtsegasam brgyan par bkod pa'i nang nas/ spos kyi rgyal polibadug spos rin thang med pa rtag tu 'thul zhing zhim pa lha'i mdun sa chos bzang polirgyan las kyang lhag par brgyan pa/ lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i rin po che'i dra ba sna tshogs kyis kun nas bres pa/ mu tig rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba dang / lda ldi kun nas bres pas rab tu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dril bu rnam pa sna tshogs su rnam par bkye ba'i gser gyi dra ba 'bar bas/ kun nas dkrigs pa/rol mo'i shing dang / rin po che'i ta la las dril bu'i dra ba rlung gis legs par bskyod pas yid du 'ong ba'i sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs 'byung ba dang ldan pa/ dbang bsgyur gyi lha'i 308
mdo sne'i sde skyod lasabatusapa'i byang chub semasama'irnayothar skor/ —rgyal polilha mo dpe tshul shibya/ tu bzang ba rnams kyis glu snyan pa'i sgra rab tu mi da du 'ong ba len ma/ lha rdzasakyi yid bzhin gyi gos kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char rab tā 'bab pasarnam par mdzesapa/ rgya mtsho chen po ltar kha dog dang / rma dog sna tshogs su ldan pas blta na gtang mi bra ba/ khang pa brtsegs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa brgya stong grangs med pasarab tu brgyan pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i pho brang ltar blta na bzang ba rin po che sna tshogs rnam par phye bas rnam pa thams cad du brgyan pa'i gdugs shin tu legs pa/ rnam par bsgreng zhing bkram pas kun nas blta na mdzes pa/ dbang po chen poli'ajig rten ltar shin tu mdzes pa'i de'u sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'od snang ba chen po rtag par 'byung ba/ tshangs pa chen poliga'al med khang ltar nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po 'gro ba yid du 'ong ba'i 'od kyis 'bar ba ste/ bza' shing gi ra ba chen po nyi ma'i mdog cesabya ba de/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu stobs dang / byin gyi rlabs che zhing bsam gyis mi khyab nga sa/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs shing tshad med de/ rgya chen po dang ldan pa mthong ngo /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis de ltar yon tan tshad med/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshogs pa'i bza' shing gi ra ba'i rgyan byang chub sems dpa'i las kyi rnam pa ra smin pas yongs su grub pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po las skyes pa/ sangs rgyas la mchod cing rim gro byas pa'i rgyu mthun pa bsam/ gyis mi khyab nga las byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pas mi 'phrogs pa/ chosakyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bus grub pa/ dge ba'i bsod nams dri ma med pa rgya chen pos grub cing byung ba/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i 309
sngon gyi spyod pa bzang po legs par byas pa dang / rgyu mthun pa'i stobs dang / shugs kyis byung ba nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / thun mong ma yin pa/ mu stegasacan dang / phasakyi rgol ba thamasacad kyis mi 'phrogasapa/ bdud kyi lam yongssu rgyu ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa/ byis pa so so'iskye bo thamasacad kyisabaltar med pa mthong ste/ shing sna tshogs de dag gi drung gi seng ge'i khri chen po de dag la'ang dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa/ lus shin tu mdzes pa/ spyod lam zhi ba/ yid zhi ba/ shin tu dben pa/ dbang po thul ba/ glang po ltar shin tu dul ba/ mtsho ltar dwangasashing gsal la rnyog pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa/ pad mo la chus mi chags pa ltar 'jig rten gyi chosakyisam gos pa/ seng ge ltar 'jigs pa dang / skyi g.ya' ba med pa/ mi 'jigs pa rnam par dag pas/ ri'i dbang po chen po ltar mi sgul ba/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pasayid du 'ong ba'i spos kyi rgyal po ltar 'gro ba'i sems tshim par byed pa/ kha ba'i tsan dan ltar nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sman gyi rgyal po blta na bzang ba ltar 'gro ba thamaphucad kyi sdug bsngal rnam par zhi bar byed pa/ chu'i lha'i zhagadradapa ltar blta na don yod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od ltar lus dang sems kyi bag yangs bde ba bskyed pa/ tshangs pa chen po ltar 'dod chagaphudang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi kun nasldang ba dang bral ba/ rin po che'i rgyal po nor bu chu 'dang ltar nyon mongs pas rnyog pa can du gyur pa'i semasacan gyi sems rab tu dang bar byed pa/ zhing gshin pa ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pa 'dug par mthong ngo /'khor gyi stan de dag la'ang 'khor sna tshogs 'khod par mthong ste/ 'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i bu dbang po chen po la sogs pa/ gtsang ma'i gnas kyi rigs su 31()
gtogasapa'i lha'i bu rnamasa'akhod cing dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyingasapas/ chos kyi sgo rnam par thar pa mi zad pa yang dag par 'byed pa zhesabya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni tshangasapa yid du 'ong ba la sogasapa/ tshangs pa'i ris su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams 'khod cing dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ dbyangasakyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ gzhi kun nasa'abyed pa zhes bya ba ya nga dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu dang lha'i bu moli'ador dang bcasapa dag 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga' la sogasapa 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu lha'i bu moli'akhor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bskyings pas/ chos kyi sgo thams cad dge bas rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan la sogs pa/ dga' ldan gyi ris su gtogasapa'i lha'i bu lha'i bu moli'akhor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pasachos kyi sgo rang gi sems kyi mdzod kyi klong zhesabya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma la sogs pa lha'i bu lha'i bu moli'akhor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo rgyan mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po brgya byin la sogs pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi ripa ༈ gtogs pa'i lha'i bu lha'i bu moli'akhor
dang bcasapa rnam 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyingasapas/ chosakyi sgo skyo ba'i sgo zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni klu'i rgyal po gang chen mtsho la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po 'od brgya pa dang / dga' bo dang bsnyen dga' bo dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / shugs ldan dang / ma dros pa la sogs pa klu'i bu moli'khor dang bcas pa klu'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcasapa rnamasa'akhod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangasargyasakyi rdzu'aphrul dang / yul gyi 'od kyi brgyan ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni rgyal po chen po ngal bso po la sogasapa gnod sbyin gyi dbang po gnod sbyin gyi bu mo dang / gnod sbyin gyi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i mdzod cesabya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni dri za'i rgyal po gnasasrung po la sogs pa dri za mang po dri za'i bu mo dang / dri za'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo dga' ba mi zad pa char rab tu 'beb pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan la sogs pa lha ma yin rnams lha ma yin gyi bu mo dang / lha ma yin gyi byisapa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo chos kyi dbyings shes pa'i tshul gyi shugs kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni nam ma/kha' lding gi dbang po shugs 'dzin chen po la sogs pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po nam mkha' lding gi bu mo dang / nam mkha' lding gi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams'dod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo srid pa'i rgya mtshos 312
